title: Senior AI/ML Engineer
description:
💎 About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. We connect diamond and gemstone suppliers directly with jewellery retailers across more than 70 countries, replacing a slow, offline, relationship-gated way of trading with a single digital marketplace. We're already powering over $300M in annual transactions, inside an industry worth more than $350B globally — and we're still early. Jewellery is one of the last major global industries to go digital, and we're the ones building the rails it will run on.

🤔 Our Mission

Diamond and gemstone trading has run for decades on fragmented networks, manual processes, and who-you-know relationships — which locks smaller and newer businesses out, and leaves even the biggest players losing time and margin to inefficiency. We started Nivoda to fix that: to give any jewellery business, wherever it is and whatever size it is, the same access, pricing transparency, and ease of trading as an industry giant. Our mission is to make buying and selling diamonds and gemstones radically simpler, everywhere in the world.

⭐️ The Discovery Pod

You'd be joining the Discovery Pod 🔍 — the team that decides how hundreds of thousands of diamonds and gemstones actually get found. That means ranking, recommendations, and search input: from the core search and filtering experience, to Contextual Search and a planned conversational assistant, to image-upload search that lets a buyer find a match from a photo. The same ranking and recommendation engine you'll build has to serve both Nivoda's own marketplace and the many individually branded storefronts jewellers run through our SAAS products. We're a small, high-ownership team and this pod is building the AI-powered product itself, not just using AI tools to go faster.

About the Role

We're hiring a Senior AI/ML Engineer for the Discovery Pod to help build and run the ranking, recommendation, and search systems buyers rely on to find the right stone or piece in seconds. This is real information retrieval and applied ML work on production infrastructure — search systems, embedding-based retrieval, learning-to-rank, LLM-powered contextual and conversational search, image embeddings for photo-based search — not configuring a hosted search widget or calling a model API and moving on. You'll own models end to end, from features and training through evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, and you'll be expected to understand how these probabilistic systems behave and fail, because that understanding is the job, not an adjacent skill.

Tech Stack

  • Search: OpenSearch, fed via CDC from PostgreSQL plus Spark/EMR/Glue ingestion jobs. No vector database anywhere in production — embedding-based retrieval, the ranking model, and image-embedding search are genuinely new builds for whoever takes the Discovery role.

  • Core DB / warehouse: PostgreSQL (OLTP) → Snowflake (dbt-modeled, medallion raw/curated/presentation layers)

  • Backend: TypeScript/Node.js, GraphQL API gateway, Nx monorepo + PNPM

  • Auth: Keycloak · SSO: Okta

  • CI/CD: Jenkins (“Nivoda Build”) + GitOps for deploys

  • Cloud: AWS (EMR, Glue, DMS, Kubernetes-based deploys)

  • Observability: Grafana for logs/traces — I’d flagged Datadog as a guess earlier based on the Frontier agent skill descriptions; the real Confluence docs point to Grafana instead, so I’ve dropped Datadog from both JDs.

What would you be doing?

Core Search Engine

  • Build and operate real search infrastructure — Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Vespa, or vector-search databases like pgvector, Pinecone, or Weaviate — to power ranking and multi-modal search across Nivoda’s marketplace

  • Design multi-tenant, configurable ranking and recommendation systems that serve both Nivoda’s own marketplace and many individually branded jeweller storefronts through Feeds, without forking the codebase

Multi-Modal AI

  • Build and improve Contextual Search and our planned conversational assistant, using prompt design and retrieval-augmented approaches, with zero-result and tradeoff scenarios handled gracefully rather than met with a confident wrong answer

  • Build image-to-attribute and image-to-product-match pipelines using image embeddings for our image-upload search work

  • Build the product around the reality that probabilistic systems can be confidently wrong — designing recovery paths and confirmation steps before high-stakes actions, like generating a manufacturing quote from an interpreted image

Experimentation & Quality

  • Define and run search- and ranking-specific evaluation — offline ranking metrics, interleaving experiments — to tell whether a ranking change is actually better, not just different

  • Evaluate and stress-test foundation model and LLM output directly as part of the engineering process, rather than trusting it by default

Production ML

  • Own the full lifecycle of ranking and recommendation models — features, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring — using learning-to-rank, embedding-based retrieval, and collaborative filtering techniques

  • Design and optimize low-latency, real-time model-serving systems that keep search feeling instant under production load

  • Use AI coding agents to build ML infrastructure and pipelines, paired with rigorous evaluation harnesses that catch ranking and retrieval bugs a system can hide while looking like it’s working

What do we need from you?

Years of experience: 5-10 years

  • Information retrieval infrastructure experience — building or operating real search systems (Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, Vespa, or vector-search databases like pgvector, Pinecone, or Weaviate)

  • Applied ML for ranking and recommendations, end to end — learning-to-rank, embedding-based retrieval, collaborative filtering — with comfort owning features, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring, not just calling a model API

  • NLP and LLM application experience — production experience building on top of language models, including prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, and handling zero-result and tradeoff scenarios gracefully

  • Low-latency serving experience — you've built and optimized real-time model-serving systems under production load, not just trained models in a notebook

  • Specialized evaluation skills for search and ranking quality, distinct from general growth experimentation — offline ranking metrics, interleaving experiments, and judging whether a ranking change is actually better versus just different

  • Direct, hands-on experience building with foundation models and LLMs as an engineering material — prompt design, retrieval-augmented approaches, and critically, evaluating and stress-testing model output rather than trusting it by default

  • Experience designing for graceful failure in probabilistic systems — knowing when a model is confidently wrong and building the product around that reality

  • Comfort using AI coding agents to build ML infrastructure and pipelines, paired with strong evaluation and testing discipline

Nice to have

  • Computer vision fundamentals, specifically image embeddings — experience building image-to-attribute or image-to-product-match pipelines

  • Multi-tenant, configurable system design experience — building systems that behave differently per tenant without forking the codebase

  • Experience building conversational or assistant-style search products

  • Background in a marketplace or e-commerce company's search, ranking, or recommendations team

⭐️ Our culture and what we offer

We're a collaborative, high-growth team that believes in empowerment over hierarchy. You'll have real ownership from day one, the chance to work on problems most companies don't even know they have yet, and a culture that takes learning and growth seriously — because we're scaling fast, and we need you to grow with us.

Our current benefits

  • 🏡 Flexible working hours and a remote-first culture

  • 📈 Real opportunities for growth and learning

  • 🌴 Unlimited holiday allowance

  • 🚀 The chance to join during an exponential expansion phase

❤️ Equal Opportunity

Nivoda is an equal opportunity employer. We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team, and we welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, regardless of race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other characteristic protected by law. Even if it seems you don't meet 100% of our musts, don't let that stop you from applying — we'd still love to hear from you.

Please submit your CV in English.

👋 Not quite the right role?

Join the Nivoda Talent Pool and we'll reach out when something that's a better fit comes up.

title: Credit Strategy Data Scientist
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION:

We are looking for a talented, enthusiastic and dedicated person to join the Credit Risk Strategy team. The incumbent will be responsible for leading key projects associated with credit risk assessment, data analysis and loss mitigation. This position requires a person who has experience performing analytics, refining risk strategies, and developing predictive algorithms preferably in the credit risk domain.

Key Job Functions

  • Design rules to detect/mitigate loss
  • Investigate novel/large cases
  • Identify root cause
  • Set strategy for different risk types
  • Work with product/engineering to improvement control capabilities
  • Develop and present strategies and guide execution
  • Drive results that maximize eligible customers while controlling losses

Professional Experience/Background to be successful in this role:

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in risk analytics, data analysis, or data science within the Fintech or online payments industry.
  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Mining or related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience using statistics and data science to solve complex business problems.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel including key data science libraries.
  • Experience working with large datasets.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex results to technical experts, business partners, and executives including development of dashboards and visualizations, ie Tableau.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity and yet able to steer analytics projects toward clear business goals, testable hypotheses, and action-oriented outcomes.
  • Demonstrated analytical thinking through data-driven decisions, as well as the technical know-how, and ability to work with your team to make a big impact.
  • Desirable to have experience or aptitude solving problems related to risk using data science and analytics.
  • Bonus: Experience with AWS, payment rule systems, and knowledge of credit products.

Expected Outcome in 6-12 months:

  • Development of dashboard and visualizations to track KPI of credit strategies implemented
  • Work closely with team members and stakeholders to consult, design, develop, and manage credit trends and losses that not only solve emerging loss trends but also provide a great experience to end customers.
  • Utilize data analysis to design and implement credit strategies
  • Analyze and transform data using RaaS platforms to identify loss patterns and optimize the systems to flag these patterns
  • Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders including product managers and engineering teams to deploy data-driven credit solutions that operate at scale and in real time for end customers.
  • Make business recommendations to leadership and cross-functional teams with effective presentations of findings at multiple levels of stakeholders.

Preferred Skills:

  • Data analytics
  • Rule development
  • Dashboard Creation
  • Project Management
  • Strong Communication

Notes from Hiring Manager:

  • Interview process: Multiple (At home screening, 1 technical interview with senior team member, 1 interview panel with hiring manager and team member).
  • Team size: 5 team members, position will work closely with a senior team member at outset, role will largely focus on reporting, so experience with visualization and data storytelling is a plus.

MUST HAVE:

  • Bachelors degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Mining or related field or equivalent practical experience.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in risk analytics, data analysis, or data science within the Fintech or online payments industry.
  • Experience using statistics and data science to solve complex business problems.
  • Proficiency in SQL, Python, Excel including key data science libraries.
  • Experience working with large datasets.
  • Ability to clearly communicate complex results to technical experts, business partners, and executives including development of dashboards and visualizations, i.e. Tableau.
  • Desirable to have experience or aptitude solving problems related to risk using data science and analytics.
  • Experience with AWS, payment rule systems, and knowledge of credit products.

We are heavily focused on logistics, technology and marketing to drive the business forward, we even have a creative agency, innovation centre, and insight hub. If you're excited by the idea of working with great people in a thriving business, then Reece may be for you.

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate in Cognitive Evolution over Deep Time
description:
**Grade UE07: £41,064 - £48,822 per annum**

**CSE / School of GeoSciences**

**Full-time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed-term: from January 2027 until 31 December 2028**

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We look for the best in the field across all disciplines and provide a working environment where academics can develop their careers and passion for their chosen subject area.

The University is part of a local community and a contributor to global thinking, progress and research. In Edinburgh, you are in one of the world’s most attractive cities with active arts and social sectors, while working in a University that has made significant contributions to society, medicine, physics and teaching for over four centuries. Our people have helped create the modern world and are working on more ground-breaking technologies and practices.

**The Opportunity:**

We seek an interdisciplinary scientist to join our international team studying the evolution of brains, intelligence, and cognition over deep time. Our Deep Time Cognition team—funded by the Swedish Research Council—combines expertise in cognitive zoology, neurobiology, and palaeontology to understand how cognition and brains have evolved in concert over eons, and what has driven this evolution. By working together, we are creating an initial atlas of how neuroanatomy correlates with cognition expressed in behaviour. Drawing on these results we will then recreate the cognition of long extinct species, by making brain models based on fossils. This will make it possible to pinpoint cognitive changes in geological time, which can be correlated with major events in the history of Earth. More information on our team can be found here: [https://www.deeptimecognition.lu.se/](https://www.deeptimecognition.lu.se/)

The University of Edinburgh component of the team specializes in palaeontology and phylogenetics, and contributes data including CT scans of fossils and reconstructions of the brains of extinct species, and large phylogenetic trees and datasets for testing trends in evolution across genealogy and time. The Edinburgh team is led by Professor Stephen Brusatte (co-PI on the research grant).

The postdoctoral fellow will be a key member of the team. They will gather and synthesize data on the anatomy, size, and shape of the brains (via CT brain endocasts) for tetrapods across time (350+ million years of evolution), working closely with Brusatte and PhD students and external co-PI Lawrence Witmer (Ohio University) who have been gathering data on tetrapod subgroups (extinct dinosaurs, squamates, and amphibians). They will use Bayesian statistics to test for trends in brain size change over time and phylogeny, test for correlations between brain size and neuron counts in extant species, and make the most robust predictions for neuron counts in extinct species, including dinosaurs like _Tyrannosaurus rex_, contributing to an exciting current debate in the fields of cognitive zoology and palaeontology.

People have always been at the heart of our work. We value colleagues with drive, determination, and a passion for what they do. We are a place where everyone is welcome and offer a range of policies and benefits designed to support you.

Discover more about working at the University of Edinburgh on our [Jobs website](https://www.ed.ac.uk/jobs).

A career with us has a range of other benefits that can be tailored to your lifestyle:

- Professional development and subject matter expertise
- Opportunities to develop new skills and broaden your experience
- Leading-edge research
- Opportunities for publication

View the full [**job description**](https://uoe.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/jobdescriptionlibrary/IQDFTKY6EDU_T5U8mFxSnBY5ASmQdOxmwTUL8eA7p4WOKmc) (opens in a new browser tab)

**How to apply**

Please include the following documents in your application:

- CV listing academic positions, degrees, publications, awards, public engagement, and other applicable information (please limit to five pages)

- Cover letter outlining your interest in the position, how you can contribute to the team and its goals, and a summary of your experience working with 3D CT data and phylogenetic comparative and Bayesian statistics

**As a valued member of our team, you can expect:**

- A competitive salary.

- An exciting, positive, creative, challenging and rewarding place to work.

- To be part of a diverse and vibrant international community.

- Comprehensive Staff Benefits, including generous annual leave entitlement, a defined benefits pension scheme, a wide range of staff discounts, family-friendly initiatives, and flexible work options. Check out the full list on our [**staff benefits page**](https://www.ed.ac.uk/human-resources/pay-reward/staff-benefits)and use our reward calculator to discover the value of your pay and benefits.


**Championing equality, diversity, and inclusion**

The University of Edinburgh holds a Silver Athena SWAN award in recognition of our commitment to advance gender equality in higher education. We are members of the Race Equality Charter, and we are also Stonewall Scotland Diversity Champions, actively promoting LGBT equality.

We welcome applications from all qualified candidates of any demographic and particularly encourage applications from a variety of academic fields: palaeontology, anatomy, neurobiology, cognitive biology.

Prior to any employment commencing with the University, you will be required to evidence your right to work in the UK. Further information is available on our [**right to work webpages**](https://www.ed.ac.uk/human-resources/demonstrating-rtw)**.**

The University may be able to sponsor the employment of international workers in this role. This will depend on a number of factors specific to the successful applicant.

**Key dates to note**

The closing date for applications is **Friday 23 October 2026.**

Unless stated otherwise, the closing time for applications is 11:59 pm (UK time). If you are applying from outside the UK, the closing time shown on our adverts will automatically adjust to your browser’s local time zone.

Interviews will be held the **week commencing 2 November 2026.**

title: Applications Administrator - Clarity
description:
Work Schedule

Third Shift (Nights)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

Position Summary

The Application Administrator provides day-to-day L2 operational and administrative support for the Clarity PPM platform. The role is responsible for routine incidents, service requests, application monitoring, data-integrity checks, batch and interface monitoring, access administration, configuration support, documentation, testing support, and operational procedures. The position is designed to develop into a broader Clarity application support role through structured knowledge transfer, hands-on production support, cross-training, and progressive technical development.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2 support for routine Clarity incidents and service requests.
  • Own assigned tickets through resolution or appropriate escalation.
  • Maintain timely ticket updates, resolution notes, and supporting documentation.
  • Perform routine Clarity administration and operational support.
  • Monitor application health, support queues, scheduled jobs, interfaces, batch processes, and automated processes.
  • Identify failed jobs, interfaces, or scheduled processes and follow documented recovery or escalation procedures.
  • Perform routine data-integrity checks and document results.
  • Assist with operational data validation and corrective-action procedures.
  • Support user access, permissions, and application-administration requests in accordance with approved processes.
  • Support periodic Clarity license-utilization reviews and reporting.
  • Assist with application configuration activities under established standards and procedures.
  • Assist with testing of incidents, fixes, enhancements, upgrades, patches, and releases.
  • Create and execute defined test cases.
  • Support UAT preparation and coordination.
  • Support production-readiness checks and post-deployment validation.
  • Support planned production deployments and weekend maintenance activities.
  • Maintain operational runbooks, knowledge articles, Known Error Database entries, standard operating procedures, and support documentation.
  • Participate in knowledge-transfer activities with the incumbent managed service provider.
  • Ensure new operational knowledge is documented and shared with the team.
  • Support incident, request, problem, change, and release-management processes.
  • Assist with service KPI, SLA, backlog, and operational reporting.
  • Support Disaster Recovery exercises and documented recovery procedures.
  • Assist with user guidance and maintenance of training materials.
  • Coordinate with Developers and the Team Lead on incidents requiring advanced functional or technical analysis.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure or other support teams using documented escalation procedures.
  • Execute administrative activities in accordance with SOX controls, access-management standards, security policies, segregation-of-duties requirements, and audit procedures.
  • Maintain required control evidence for access changes, operational checks, and support procedures.
  • Assist with periodic access reviews, audit evidence collection, and control testing.
  • Participate in the team's 16x5 support coverage model.
  • Participate in on-call support as assigned and appropriate for the role.
  • Support planned weekend patches, releases, deployments, and maintenance activities.
  • Develop technical capability in Clarity configuration, SQL, GEL, NSQL, XOG, integrations, and APIs through structured cross-training.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of experience in enterprise systems administration and infrastructure support
  • Fields of Study: Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Foundational knowledge of enterprise application support or application administration.
  • Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting capability.
  • Ability to follow documented operational and change-control procedures.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with business users and technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies.
  • Ability to support scheduled weekend maintenance and participate in an on-call rotation as required.

Required Clarity PPM Skills and Experience

  • Foundational to early-career hands-on experience with Clarity PPM administration or production application support.

title: Website QA Tester at Web Agency
description:
About the role

First&Third is a fully remote web design and development agency and a WordPress VIP and Shopify Plus partner. We help clients achieve their business goals through thoughtful, well-executed websites.

We are looking for a Website QA Tester to join us on a remote, part-time contract basis. You will test client websites across desktop and mobile to make sure they look right, work as expected, and support the journeys users need to complete. You will find and document bugs, help developers reproduce them, and retest fixes before changes reach users.

This is a hands-on manual website testing role. You will work through test cases, explore how real users interact with a site, and check that fixes do not break other functionality. We value attention to detail, sound judgment, clear bug reports, and reliable follow-through more than familiarity with every tool on a checklist.

What you will do

  • Create and run practical test cases based on project specifications, designs, and wireframes. Work with Product Managers and Project Managers to clarify expected behavior and flag gaps before testing begins.
  • Perform functional, visual, responsive, smoke, regression, and exploratory testing across agreed browsers and devices. Prioritize critical user journeys and areas affected by each change.
  • Test key website interactions such as navigation, links, forms, and content updates. Check Shopify storefronts from theme changes through cart and checkout, and regression-test WordPress sites after content, plugin, theme, and core changes.
  • Perform routine automated and manual accessibility checks against the project's agreed WCAG version and conformance level, including keyboard navigation, focus behavior, form labels, and contrast. Flag issues that need deeper specialist review.
  • Follow project checklists to validate key GA4 events, Google Tag Manager implementations, and marketing pixels, with support for more complex tracking investigations.
  • Use tools such as Lighthouse to flag performance regressions and review available Core Web Vitals field data when relevant.
  • Run smoke tests before and after launches, and check redirects and metadata during migrations.
  • Write actionable bug reports in ClickUp with reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior, browser/device details, screenshots or recordings, and severity.
  • Work with PMs, designers, and engineers to investigate issues, retest fixes, and track defects through resolution.
  • Provide concise updates on test coverage, blockers, and remaining launch risks. The designated project lead makes the final launch decision based on those findings.

Comprehensive accessibility audits, complex analytics troubleshooting, and building automated test suites are not baseline expectations for this role; any such work would be scoped separately.

What success looks like

  • Critical user journeys are tested against agreed acceptance criteria within the available time.
  • Developers can reproduce reported issues without repeated clarification.
  • Higher-risk defects are surfaced early, fixes are verified, and outstanding issues remain visible.
  • Project leads know what was tested, what was not tested, and what risks remain before launch.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of hands-on website testing experience, or equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Strong manual testing skills across functional, visual, responsive, and regression testing, including cross-browser and cross-device coverage.
  • Practical familiarity with WordPress and Shopify websites, including content workflows and e-commerce user journeys.
  • Ability to write clear, reproducible bug reports and prioritize issues by user impact and severity.
  • Experience using browser developer tools and cross-browser testing tools such as BrowserStack or equivalent.
  • Working knowledge of HTML and CSS sufficient to inspect pages and describe issues accurately.
  • Familiarity with routine accessibility checks and tools such as axe or WAVE.
  • Clear, concise communication and the ability to manage testing across multiple projects, flag unclear requirements, and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Reliable availability to work during US business hours. Our team members are based across the US; we will agree on your specific schedule before starting.

Nice to have

  • Deeper experience validating GA4, Google Tag Manager, and marketing pixels.
  • Experience interpreting Core Web Vitals and investigating performance issues.
  • Experience with screen readers such as NVDA or VoiceOver, or more comprehensive WCAG accessibility testing.
  • Experience testing React or other JavaScript front-end frameworks.
  • Experience with ClickUp.
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Playwright or visual regression tools.
  • Familiarity with AI tools such as Claude or ChatGPT to support test planning or documentation, while independently verifying findings.

How you work

  • You ask questions to understand client goals and focus testing on what matters most to users.
  • You deliver what you committed to and flag early when timing, scope, or missing information puts that commitment at risk.
  • You manage your own time and methods, coordinate priorities with project leads, and communicate tradeoffs when the available hours cannot cover everything.
  • You take ownership of testing and follow-through, working with the team to get issues resolved.

Work with us

If this sounds like a good fit, we would love to hear from you.

  1. Apply: Introduce yourself, briefly describe your hands-on experience testing WordPress and Shopify websites, and share your hourly rate, weekly availability, and time zone. Include an anonymized bug report or a brief example of a consequential issue you caught and how you reported it. Do not share confidential client information.
  2. We will talk: We will set up a video call to discuss your experience, approach, and fit for the engagement.
  3. Show how you work: Finalists will complete a short, paid website testing exercise focused on finding issues, prioritizing them, and writing useful bug reports. We will agree on its time limit and compensation in advance.
  4. Get to work: We will agree on scope, hours, availability, and terms before starting.

More about First&Third

With over 20 years of experience, First&Third has had the privilege of working with organizations such as Meta, Billboard, The Intercept, Soylent, Tru Niagen, and Elyse Walker. We invest in understanding each client's goals and bring thoughtful design, development, and project management to achieving them.

description:
About Evermore

Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort, the resort that’s redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel. Our Team Members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for each guest. Here, guests create their own adventure, enjoying the best of both worlds: the space and comforts of vacation home rentals combined with the amenities and services of a world-class resort.

Evermore Orlando Resort is an expansive and technically complex property spanning 1,100 acres with multiple operational components. The resort integrates resort-owned vacation rental homes, large-scale water features, and extensive recreational infrastructure. The eight-acre Evermore Bay lagoon includes advanced water treatment, circulation, and safety systems that require continuous monitoring. Two championship golf courses, numerous pools, water sports facilities, and a wide range of amenities, including pickleball courts, event spaces, and dining venues, further enhance the offerings. This diverse environment demands sophisticated engineering oversight to ensure optimal performance, safety, and reliability across all systems.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support the revenue management and reservations division to drive revenue growth through the appropriate balance of volume and pricing strategies to meet or exceed Evermore’s financial revenue targets.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor behavior, and demand patterns to make informed pricing and inventory decisions.
  • Create and adjust pricing strategies based on demand, seasonality, special events, and other relevant factors.
  • Forecast revenue and occupancy trends to inform operational and marketing decisions.
  • Monitor and manage room inventory to ensure optimal distribution and availability across various distribution channels.
  • Manage the distribution of resort inventory across online travel agencies (OTAs), global distribution systems (GDS), direct booking channels, and other distribution platforms.
  • Manage relationships with OTA partners, negotiate commission rates, and optimize channel mix to minimize distribution costs.
  • Monitor channel performance and identify opportunities to enhance visibility and conversion.

  • Utilize revenue management software and tools to track and analyze key performance metrics.
  • Collaborate with sales, marketing, and reservations teams to align revenue strategies with overall business objectives.
  • Conduct training sessions to educate Team Members on revenue management concepts and best practices.
  • Provide guidance on group bookings, promotional activities, and other revenue-generating initiatives.
  • Recommend direction on group bookings, promotional activities, and other revenue-generating initiatives.
  • Monitor and analyze competitive set pricing, promotions, and market positioning to maintain the resort's competitive edge.
  • Analyze historical and current data to identify revenue trends, booking patterns, and opportunities for growth.
  • Identify opportunities for differentiation and develop strategies to capture a larger share of the market.
  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with peers to drive revenue growth and enhance guest satisfaction.
  • Stay up to date on competitors in the vacation rental and resort space for benchmarking and new ideas; monitor local events for impact on occupancy.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

Education, Skills and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field (Master's degree preferred).
  • Previous experience in revenue management, pricing, or distribution within the hospitality industry.
  • Proficiency in revenue management software and tools.
  • Strong analytical, quantitative skills and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Strategic thinking and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to work collaboratively and lead cross-functional teams.
  • Knowledge of industry trends, market dynamics, and distribution channels.

  • Able to read and understand financials and budgets.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to interact with a wide range of people.
  • Outstanding organizational and problem-solving skills
  • Self-starter that can work independently with minimal supervision
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment
  • Inspired to lead Evermore brand and team member values at all times
  • Capable of performing role in a busy work environment
  • Proficient in reading safety procedures and operating guidelines / instructions in English

Physical Requirements

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
About Rimes

Rimes provides the Intelligence Fabric for Capital Markets, a trusted data network and intelligence architecture that transforms fragmented data, operations and workflows into decision-grade intelligence. The world’s leading institutional investors, asset managers, and service providers rely on Rimes to help them make better investment decisions that power more than US$ 75 trillion in AUM annually.

Opportunity:

The Senior Business Analyst is responsible for driving requirements discovery, cross‑functional alignment, and solution clarity across a large‑scale, multi‑stream data transformation programme. This role blends advanced business analysis with selected project‑management responsibilities, enabling end‑to‑end delivery of complex data workstreams while maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

The role will operate across discovery, requirements definition, data onboarding, solution design execution , testing coordination and support, and readiness activities, ensuring clarity, traceability, and quality of all business requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Requirements Leadership & Analysis

  • Lead discovery sessions to understand business processes, data flows, operating models, and functional/non‑functional requirements.
  • Document clear, structured requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria across data ingestion, data mastering, data quality, and downstream integration.
  • Reformulate unclear requirements and ensure full alignment across business, technical, and operations stakeholders.

Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Management

  • Act as the primary liaison between internal delivery teams, data SMEs, engineering, operations, and client teams.
  • Build strong relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders; articulate progress effectively in structured forums.
  • Manage expectation setting, requirement validation, and change impacts with diplomacy and clarity.

Cross‑Stream Coordination (Hybrid PM Responsibilities)

  • Own workstream planning, scheduling, RAID management, and cross‑team alignment.
  • Coordinate activities across requirements, data onboarding, engineering, solution design, testing, and go‑live readiness.
  • Provide RAG status updates and ensure inter‑stream dependencies and risks are well understood.

Testing, Validation & Cutover Support

  • Support testing strategy design and ensure requirements traceability through UAT, data validation, and cutover events.
  • Coordinate automated tests, foundational data checks, and AB comparisons across old vs. new data platforms.

Data Coordination, Analysis & Gap Assessment

  • Coordinate data‑related activities with internal teams (e.g., Data Management, Operations, Engineering) and with client stakeholders to ensure all data requirements are clearly understood, documented, and sequenced appropriately
  • Conduct data analysis, including reviewing existing datasets, mappings, data structures, business rules, and transformations to identify gaps, ambiguities, or inconsistencies that impact downstream processes.
  • Perform gap analysis between current‑state and target‑state data models, data onboarding requirements, and operational workflows.
  • Ensure all data requirements, validation rules, and dependencies are captured clearly and communicated to the relevant technical and operational teams.
  • Track progress of data readiness activities (dataset preparation, mapping completion, validation steps) and ensure they align with workstream milestones, without owning any vendor or licensing tasks.

Governance & Reporting

  • Produce clear workstream packs, status updates, requirement traceability matrices, and risk/issue reports.
  • Present updates to Working Groups and Steering Committees when required.

Key Requirements:

  • 5+ years in business analysis and/or project management, ideally within financial services, investment data, or enterprise data platforms.
  • Strong background leading multi-stream, complex, or data-heavy transformation programs within financial services, investment data, or enterprise data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with: Requirements gathering, user stories, acceptance criteria. , Cross-functional delivery across data, engineering, operations, and testing.RAID, RAG reporting, dependency management, and structured governance.
  • Deep practical knowledge of investment data domains (Security Master, Price Master, Issuer Master, benchmarks/index data)
  • Bonus: exposure to cloud data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake) and regulated or high‑control environments.

Preferred

  • Experience with cloud‑based data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, or similar).
  • Exposure to regulated environments or high‑control data operations.
  • Familiarity with investment data, market data onboarding, or securities reference data.

Only selected candidates will be contacted for interviews. We appreciate your understanding. Thank you for considering a career with us.

title: Research Associate (Socially Responsible Earth Observation)
description:
We are seeking to appoint a talented and enthusiastic Postdoctoral Research Associate (PDRA) to play a key role in delivering an exciting investment project (IrrEO) that will develop satellite-based irrigation mapping tools for governments and development actors in Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA).

Earth Observation (EO) technologies are enabling agricultural mapping at increasingly large scales and fine resolutions. This brings exciting opportunities to understand complex farming systems, particularly in data-sparse smallholder farming regions. However, recent research has revealed the social risks of EO-based land monitoring. Examples include imperfect representations leading to poorly informed decision-making or biased investments, and marginalised people being made visible through EO in ways which may expose them to harm. There is an urgent need for improved social risk analysis and development of good practice guidance for EO-based agricultural mapping.

As part of the IrrEO project, the PDRA will lead on developing guidance for the socially responsible development and use of EO-based agricultural mapping tools in small-scale farming systems in Sub-Saharan Africa. They will catalogue existing scholarship and frameworks on the ethical and equitable use of EO in agricultural mapping. They will also carry out document-based and qualitative interview research to identify potential risks of EO-based agricultural mapping in different socio-political and agricultural contexts, focusing particularly on risks to farmers and farming communities. Based on these two workstreams and consultation with the IrrEO partners, they will devise and share strategies for socially response EO-based agricultural monitoring.

The PDRA will be an integral member of the IrrEO project team, working closely with Principal Investigator Prof. Tim Foster (Department of Civil Engineering and Management) and Co-Investigators Dr. Rose Pritchard (Global Development Institute). They will also work closely with a wider team of investigators and postdoctoral researchers at the University of Manchester involved in the IrrEO project and other aligned research on socially-just use of Earth Observation including the Just Earth Observation for Conservation project (JEOC – https://www.justearthobservation.org/) which is co-led by Pritchard and Foster. The role will involve close collaboration with academic and non-academic partners in the project’s case study countries (Kenya, Nigeria, and Ethiopia) and active engagement with UK and international partners including the World Bank and the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.

The IrrEO project is funded by a four-year (2025-2029) investment from the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation. Due to the nature of the funding, this post is available for a fixed term of up to 24 months with an end date of 31 August 2029. We are looking for a candidate to start in early 2027, with some flexibility over the exact start date.

(Grades 6-9)

Our benefits include:

• 29 days annual leave plus bank holidays, along with Christmas closure

• Ride to work and EV car scheme available

For more information, please see [University of Manchester Benefits](https://www.manchester.ac.uk/connect/jobs/benefits-working-here/). You can also find information on our Flexible and Hybrid working [here](https://www.staffnet.manchester.ac.uk/people/current-staff/flexible-and-hybrid-working/).

title: Program Manager (French speaking)
description:
Type: Full-time contractor (hours negotiable)

Location: Remote, based in Sub-Saharan Africa (Africa time zones)

Language Requirements: French fluency required

Reports to: Head of Growth

OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and digital workflows so that governments and NGOs can deliver public services more efficiently, achieve interoperability across fragmented systems, and scale critical public services across health, humanitarian, and government programs.

Our team, Open Function Group, the primary steward of this open-source platform, is a lean, fully-remote team of integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 40+ countries.

We are not making marginal improvements to already comfortable lives. We are building the infrastructure that allows governments to function, clinics to operate, and vulnerable populations to access services they depend on.


The role

We need a remote, relationship-driven, commercially-minded Program Manager who is genuinely technically fluent, someone who can speak credibly about our platform, integrations, and data workflows with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, to keep our existing customers happy, engaged, and growing, and to help us stand up program management as a function for the very first time.

We are hiring our first Program Manager to own and grow relationships with OpenFn's existing customers as we transition to a subscription model built around packaged product-and-services bundles.

As our first Program Manager in this market, you will own the full portfolio of existing subscription customers and be accountable for their retention, satisfaction, and growth. You will be the trusted advisor customers turn to, the person who makes sure they are getting real value from OpenFn, and the internal owner of the commercial health of each account.

OpenFn is a genuinely technical product: our customers use it to build integrations, move data between systems, and automate complex digital workflows. You do not need to be an engineer, and you will not be doing hands-on implementation work; we have solution architects and implementation consultants for that. But you do need to be technically fluent: able to understand how customers use the platform, hold a credible conversation with their technical teams, spot when something is going wrong, and know when to bring in a specialist. That technical credibility is what will make you a genuine trusted advisor rather than just a point of contact.

Because this is a foundational hire, you will both build and execute. You will not inherit a mature playbook; you will help create it, establishing the processes, cadences, and tooling that a strong program management function depends on, while carrying a live book of business from day one.

Requirements

Own & grow customer relationships

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of existing subscription customers
  • Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across each customer organization, from day-to-day users through to senior decision-makers
  • Develop and maintain account plans that map each customer's objectives to the value OpenFn delivers
  • Plan and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other regular check-ins

Bring technical fluency to the relationship

  • Develop a strong working understanding of the OpenFn platform and how each of your customers uses it
  • Hold credible, substantive conversations with customers' technical teams about their integrations, data workflows, and use cases
  • Translate fluently between customers' technical staff and their non-technical decision-makers
  • Spot technical adoption risks early, and know when to bring in solution architects or implementation consultants

Drive retention & expansion

  • Own gross and net retention for your portfolio, and be accountable for renewals
  • Forecast renewals accurately and manage the end-to-end renewal process
  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and lead recovery plans before they churn
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to grow accounts, including tier upgrades and cross-sell of additional services
  • Negotiate renewals and expansions in line with our pricing and packaging model

Deliver value & coordinate delivery

  • Ensure a smooth handoff from sales and implementation into ongoing program management
  • Monitor product usage and adoption, and work with customers to close gaps and deepen engagement
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, channeling feedback to our product and services teams
  • Coordinate with support and implementation teams to meet SLA commitments and deliver project-based work
  • Manage escalations, bringing the right internal people together to resolve issues quickly

Build the program management function

  • Establish the playbooks, cadences, and health-scoring approach that will let program management scale as OpenFn grows
  • Maintain accurate account data, activity, and forecasts in our CRM, and report on core retention/growth metrics to leadership
  • Help migrate existing customers from legacy project-based arrangements onto the new subscription model

Required Qualifications

  • 3-7+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related customer-facing commercial role at a SaaS or subscription business
  • A proven track record of retaining and growing a portfolio of customers, including owning renewals, forecasting, and driving upsell or expansion
  • Experience managing customers for a technically substantive product, with a demonstrated ability to get up to speed on how a product actually works
  • Genuine technical fluency: comfort discussing concepts such as APIs, integrations, data exchange, and workflow automation, and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to earn trust with both technical users and senior stakeholders
  • Experience running customer cadences such as QBRs, service reviews, and success planning
  • Hands-on proficiency with a CRM, and a data-informed approach to managing account health and forecasts
  • Fluent, professional-level English and French communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to work effectively across a distributed, multicultural team
  • A self-starter mindset suited to a foundational role where you build as well as execute, and the ability to work from home or a shared office space with fast, stable internet, preferably in a country located in Sub-Saharan Africa (Africa time zones)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience helping a business (or its customers) transition from project or services-based revenue to a subscription model
  • A technical background (e.g. a computer science degree, or prior experience in engineering, technical support, solutions, or implementation), including hands-on experience with integration tooling, data pipelines, or APIs
  • Experience managing government, NGO, public sector, or other international customers, ideally within the digital public goods or open source ecosystem
  • Working knowledge of CRMs such as Salesforce or Odoo
  • Additional language skills relevant to our customer base (e.g. Spanish, Portuguese)
  • Experience selling and/or delivering complex digital transformation, business process transformation, or data integration projects

Benefits

  • Financial compensation includes a base salary plus variable pay tied to the retention and growth (upsell and expansion) of your portfolio. Total pay is commensurate with experience, per OpenFn's Equal Pay for Equal Work framework; the detailed variable-pay mechanics are shared during the interview process.
  • N.B.: Selling to NGO and government customers, we don't offer Silicon Valley pay scales, but high quality of life and fair, transparent, and competitive compensation is important to us.
  • Flexible working schedule
  • We're fully remote, with team meetups across Europe and Africa (our last three were in Kigali, Cape Town, and Dakar)
  • Exposure to the hottest industry and technology trends and leading health, humanitarian, and government digital transformation interventions in the sector
  • Opportunity for leadership and advancement; you will be a key contributor to our company's strategy and direction
  • The opportunity to shape our strategy and impact millions of lives through our open source software in a small, mission-driven organization

  • Maintain, diagnose and troubleshoot infrastructure health and fix issues as they arise, including server hardware faults (CPU, DIMM, disk, PSU, fan, RAID controller) and component replacement, and coordinate with vendors on RMA where required

  • Deploy and configure Linux server operating systems
  • Manage data center assets, spares and inventories
  • Maintain proper documentation and reports for auditing and tracking purposes

  • Basic networking knowledge: ability to test connectivity (ping, cable tester), troubleshoot SFP/transceivers, and identify and handle fibre and copper cables (e.g. DAC, LC/MPO fibre, Cat6)
  • Familiar with Linux server operating systems (basic troubleshooting command line)
  • Work independently, with the ability to work under pressure and tight deadlines, and communicate outcomes clearly with minimal supervision
  • Fast-learning ability, willing to pick up new skills and technologies
  • Able to work safely in a data center environment, including lifting and moving equipment

Kindly note that you can only be considered for one role at a time with any of the companies within our Group. If you have applied for other jobs with the Group, you will be considered for roles in the order of your application.

title: Senior Product Manager, Identity and Access Management
description:
It's a new day with a new opportunity at 8am!

About the role:

8am is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for our Identity and Access Management platform. IAM is the foundational infrastructure for every product we build. It's how our customers sign in, how we keep their data secure, and how we manage what people can see and do across our products. This is a high-leverage role: the decisions you make about authentication, authorization, and identity infrastructure ripple across the entire company and directly affect security, compliance, and the day-to-day experience of every user who touches an 8am product.

You'll work closely with engineering, security, and platform teams to define what "good" looks like for identity at 8am, and you'll partner with product teams across the business who depend on IAM to build their own features safely and quickly.

This role is hired through an Employer of Record (EOR) partner in the Czech Republic.

About us:

8am builds software that helps professionals run stronger businesses. Our platform powers payments, client experience, and operational workflows for legal, accounting, and other service-based businesses. U.S. based professionals count on our purpose-built solutions to simplify operations, ensure compliance, and fuel profitable growth, so they can focus on their clients and do more of the work that matters.

More than 250,000 professionals across the U.S. rely on our products every day. As we continue to grow, we’re investing in the next generation of our platform and are looking for experienced engineers who want to help shape its future.

What you'll do:

  • Authentication & SSO: Own the roadmap for login flows, single sign-on, multi-factor authentication, session management, and passwordless authentication. Balance security requirements with a frictionless user experience.
  • Authorization & Permissions: Define and evolve our approach to role-based access control and fine-grained entitlements, ensuring permissions models scale cleanly across multiple products and customer segments.
  • Platform & Infrastructure: Drive the strategy for the underlying identity platform (APIs, service-to-service auth, and integrations with internal services and third-party/partner systems) so other product teams can build on a reliable, well-documented identity layer.
  • Translate security, compliance, and business requirements into a clear, prioritized roadmap, and communicate trade-offs to engineering leadership and stakeholders.
  • Partner with engineering and security teams daily to scope, sequence, and ship IAM capabilities, from discovery through launch and iteration.
  • Act as the internal expert on identity for other product teams, providing guidance on how to safely build features that depend on authentication or authorization.
  • Define success metrics for the IAM platform (e.g., login success rate, MFA adoption, time-to-provision, incident rate) and use data to prioritize investment.
  • Represent the voice of the customer and the needs of internal engineering consumers of the IAM platform in roadmap decisions.

About you:

  • Robust 5+ years of product management experience, including meaningful time owning a platform, infrastructure, or security-adjacent product.
  • Direct experience with identity and access management concepts: authentication protocols (OAuth, OIDC, SAML), SSO, MFA, session management, and authorization/RBAC models.
  • Comfort operating in a technically complex domain
  • A track record of shipping platform capabilities that other internal teams build on, not just customer-facing features.
  • Strong prioritization skills and the judgment to balance security/compliance requirements against speed and usability.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical identity concepts clearly to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience working with security and compliance teams (e.g., SOC 2, data privacy requirements) is preferreda plus.
  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve workflows, enhance decision-making, or drive innovation.

Additional Information

The monthly gross salary range for this position is CZK 1,900,000 to CZK 2,050,000. 8am is committed to fair, objective, and non-discriminatory compensation, and actual pay may vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and education.

Why join our new 8am Czech Republic hub?

  • Founding Team Impact: Be a founding engineer of our new Czech Republic R&D hub. After a brief 1-6 month integration with U.S. based teams, you will help form fully autonomous, locally-led squads with clear paths to Staff and leadership roles with the exciting opportunity to collaborate face-to-face with your team in our upcoming Brno office.
  • Drive our "AI-First" Transformation: We are building a secure, massive-scale "Unified AI Platform". Depending on your squad, you will either help architect this core infrastructure (LLM routing, RAG, agent orchestration) or build directly on top of it.
  • Build the Next Generation of Our Platform: Help shape the systems powering products used by more than 250,000 professionals. You’ll work on complex platform capabilities across payments, workflow automation, and AI-powered features as we expand into new professional service markets.

Benefits and Perks

We offer a competitive, locally relevant benefits package designed to support your life in the Czech Republic while giving you access to global opportunities:

  • Performance bonus opportunities and employee referral rewards
  • Flexible Time Off (FTO) and 13 paid public holidays aligned with the Czech calendar
  • Paid sick leave with additional support through the Czech social security system
  • Maternity, paternity, and parental leave in line with Czech regulations, plus additional paid paternity leave from 8am
  • Full statutory benefits, including public health insurance, social security, pension, and work accident coverage

Grow Your Career

  • Access to Coursera (including Gen AI Academy) and ongoing professional development
  • Clear growth paths, regular feedback, and opportunities for advancement

What Makes 8am Different:

  • International company environment with collaboration across Europe and the U.S.
  • Opportunities to travel for company events (including potential U.S. visits)
  • Engaging team culture with local events, outings, and community initiatives
  • Office spaces in Brno and Prague with opportunities to work in-person and enjoy a flexible hybrid setup

Diversity, equity & inclusion at 8am:

At 8am, we recognize that innovation occurs with a strong team of people who are diverse in background, personality, talent and ideas. Experience comes in many forms and ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where we continue to learn from each other is an integral part of our culture. We are committed to creating a welcoming and transparent environment for all that embraces those differences through education, equal access to opportunities and information, inclusionary programs, and community outreach.

Security advisory:

Our hiring teams at 8am are dedicated to recruiting top talent that share our passion for serving the professional services industry through innovative financial technology. As such, our Talent Acquisition Team only follows legitimate hiring practices. We will always communicate with our candidates using emails with the 8am domain and will never ask for sensitive/personal data during the application process. All interviews take place over phone call, Zoom/Google Meet or in person. All offers are communicated verbally by our Talent Acquisition Specialists with a written offer letter as a follow up.

Applicant Data Privacy Notice:

Your personal data will be collected and retained by Controller as long as Controller determines it is necessary to evaluate your application for employment. Under the GDPR, you have the right to request access to your personal data, to request that your personal data be rectified or erased, and to request that processing of your personal data be restricted. You also have the right to data portability. In addition, you may lodge a complaint with an EU supervisory authority. Full policy linked here.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Full-Stack Engineer — Business Systems (AI-Native)

Whitespace Solutions · Jakarta, Indonesia (Hybrid) · Full-time

WHO WE ARE

Whitespace Solutions is a Jakarta-based consultancy that builds AI-augmented business software. We build it for clients, and we build our own products. We're a small, growing engineering team. You'd work directly with the founder who sets the architecture, alongside a business analyst who models the client's process.

Your time splits roughly 50/50 between client delivery and our own products. That means moving between codebases and domains, sometimes within the same week: retail and inventory, ERP-style operations, document automation.

THE ROLE

We're hiring early-career engineers (roughly 1–3 years of experience, or fresh graduates who can show the ability). You'll turn business workflows into reliable software and ship features end to end: UI, API, and database.

We work agent-native: coding agents investigate, implement, test and review alongside us. That makes plausible code cheap. What stays scarce is judgment: knowing what good software looks like, why it's good, and when the agent is confidently wrong. That's what we hire for. We expect you to learn fast and largely on your own, using agents, docs and code review rather than formal training.

The question we care about: can you use AI as leverage without outsourcing your judgment to it?

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • - Build features end to end: screens in React/Next.js, APIs in TypeScript or Python, schemas and migrations in PostgreSQL.
  • - Turn an analyst's process map into data models, state transitions and permissions.
  • - Integrate with clients' existing systems (ERPs, POS, spreadsheets, third-party APIs) rather than replacing them.
  • - Build AI-assisted workflows, such as extracting structured data from documents, with source tracing and human review.
  • - Direct coding agents through investigation, implementation and testing, then review their diffs before anything ships.
  • - Write tests for the dangerous paths: concurrent updates, retries, partial failures.
  • - Debug issues from symptom to root cause instead of patching the surface.
  • - Join client sessions to clarify requirements, run UAT, and explain how the system behaves.
  • - Improve our engineering system: tests, CI gates, docs, agent instructions.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Recent and current work includes:

  • - a POS and inventory platform for a multi-store retail chain;
  • - a tender pricing and quote-to-cash engine for an enterprise services company;
  • - AI document extraction that reconciles accounts-receivable records against source documents;
  • - an AI sales role-play and coaching platform, our own SaaS product;
  • - an ERP rollout, including integrations with the client's existing systems.

The analyst models the process. You turn it into working software, and you ask the technical questions the requirements missed:

  • - What is the source of truth for product master data, and which systems may only read it?
  • - Two cashiers sell the last unit at the same moment. What happens?
  • - Should this validation live in the UI, the service layer, or a database constraint?
  • - A downstream system is down. Fail, retry, queue, or degrade? And what does the user see?
  • - How do we prove a generated document field came from the right source?

A representative task, once you're ramped up: A branch receives stock from a distributor. Compare the delivery against the order, record discrepancies, update trustworthy stock, keep an audit trail, and behave sensibly if part of the process fails. You'd:

  • - identify the entities and state transitions, plus the failure and concurrency cases;
  • - design the schema and API, and the screens a branch user works in;
  • - implement it with agents;
  • - test the dangerous paths;
  • - explain the design.

HOW WE WORK

The repository is part of how engineering runs, not just where the code lives. It holds the specs, the architecture decisions and invariants, workplans with acceptance criteria, agent instructions, tests and CI gates. These make intent legible to humans and agents alike, so important rules are enforced mechanically rather than remembered. Improving that system (tests, gates, docs, agent instructions) is part of the job.

"Done" means evidence: what was tested or observed. "The agent says it works" is not verification. Agents do engineering work. Authority over risky actions stays with people.

The founder reviews your designs and the evidence for your changes. That makes you the first line of review on the code itself, including code an agent wrote. Expect your design choices to be questioned; that's how you'll learn.

NEEDED AT ENTRY

  • - Solid programming fundamentals in TypeScript and/or Python.
  • - Can build a feature end to end: a React/Next.js interface, the API behind it, and the data underneath.
  • - Working SQL and relational modeling: keys, constraints, joins, indexes.
  • - Reading unfamiliar code, including an agent's diff, and accurately explaining what it actually does.
  • - Explaining why you chose an approach, not just that it works.
  • - A habit of verifying your own assumptions.
  • - Comfort with AI coding tools, or eagerness to work this way.
  • - You learn new tools and domains fast, on your own.
  • - Working English (code and docs are in English) and fluent Bahasa Indonesia for analyst and client conversations.

WHAT YOU'LL GROW INTO

  • - Failure-scenario thinking: what breaks, when, and how badly. Think load, concurrency, dependency outages and partial failure.
  • - Transactions, concurrency, idempotency and safe retries.
  • - Putting business rules where they can actually be enforced: the database is part of correctness, and UI validation alone is not enough.
  • - Interfaces that tell the truth about system state: pending, failed, partially applied.
  • - Integration design, queues and background jobs, auditability.
  • - Code taste. That means clear ownership, cohesive modules, explicit contracts, and abstractions that exist for a reason. It also means spotting the warning signs: duplicated rules, multiple writers to one source of truth, catch-all error handling, unsafe migrations.
  • - Directing agents well. Give context, outcome and constraints; have the agent investigate before it implements; read diffs, not summaries.

USEFUL, NOT REQUIRED

  • - ERP, POS, inventory or procurement domains
  • - LLM APIs and RAG
  • - ETL/ELT basics

PROBABLY NOT A FIT IF YOU

  • - need detailed tickets before you can make progress;
  • - optimize for making the test pass rather than making the system correct;
  • - treat the database as passive storage;
  • - add abstractions or technologies without a concrete reason;
  • - aren't curious about the business behind the code.

HOW WE THINK ABOUT EXPERIENCE

The range is flexible. A one-year engineer who reasons clearly can outperform a three-year engineer who has only followed tickets. The answer we like hearing is: "I don't know yet. Here's what I'd inspect, the trade-offs I think matter, and the evidence I'd want before choosing."
