title: PAHO Consultant - Development of the Health National Adaptation Plans for Aruba and Curaçao
description:
OBJECTIVE OF THE OFFICE/DEPARTMENT

This is a requisition for employment at the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO)/Regional Office of the World Health Organization (WHO)

Contractual Agreement:

Non-Staff - International PAHO Consultant

Job Posting:

October 8, 2026

Closing Date:

October 19, 2026, 11:59 PM Eastern Time

Primary Location:

Off Site

Organization:

TTO Trinidad and Tobago

Schedule:

Full time

PURPOSE OF CONSULTANCY

Small Island Developing States and Caribbean territories are increasingly vulnerable to the impacts of climate change, including extreme heat, flooding, drought, vector-borne diseases, food and water insecurity, and other climate-sensitive health risks. These impacts place increasing pressure on health systems and disproportionately affect vulnerable populations.

As part of regional efforts to strengthen climate-resilient health systems, Aruba and Curaçao are advancing actions to better understand climate impacts on health and identify adaptation measures. Development of Health National Adaptation Plans (HNAPs) will support the integration of health considerations into broader climate change adaptation processes and strengthen the resilience of health systems.

In Aruba, preliminary assessments and vulnerability analyses have been undertaken. Additional data collection may be required to strengthen the country profile and support completion of the Future Risks Assessment component of the Health Vulnerability and Adaptation (V&A) Assessment.

In Curaçao, further work is required to complete the Health Vulnerability and Adaptation Assessment and develop a corresponding HNAP.

The consultancy will support both countries through the assessment, planning, prioritization, and development of comprehensive Health National Adaptation Plans aligned with the WHO Operational Framework for Building Climate-Resilient Health Systems and national climate adaptation processes.

DESCRIPTION OF DUTIES:

Terms of Reference

Consultant – Development of the Health National Adaptation Plans (HNAP) for Aruba and Curaçao

IPC (Band B)


Timeframe: 6 November 2026 – 9 September 2027 (100% FTE)

Location: Off-site. Travel to Aruba and/or Curaçao may be required.


Objectives of the Office/Department

PAHO Country Offices are responsible for ensuring that the Pan American Health Organization/World Health Organization (PAHO/WHO) country program of technical cooperation and its country presence provides adequate support to the national health development process and, at the same time, enables countries to shape the sub-regional, regional, and global health agendas. The PAHO/WHO Trinidad and Tobago Country Office (PAHO/WHO TTO CO), covering Trinidad and Tobago, Aruba, Curaçao, Sint Maarten, Bonaire, St. Eustatius and Saba, is the basic organizational unit for technical cooperation with the countries, drawing on PAHO/WHO resources from all levels and all parts of the Organization.


Organizational Context

Small Island Developing States and Caribbean territories are increasingly vulnerable to the impacts of climate change, including extreme heat, flooding, drought, vector-borne diseases, food and water insecurity, and other climate-sensitive health risks. These impacts place increasing pressure on health systems and disproportionately affect vulnerable populations.


As part of regional efforts to strengthen climate-resilient health systems, Aruba and Curaçao are advancing actions to better understand climate impacts on health and identify adaptation measures. Development of Health National Adaptation Plans (HNAPs) will support the integration of health considerations into broader climate change adaptation processes and strengthen the resilience of health systems.


In Aruba, preliminary assessments and vulnerability analyses have been undertaken. Additional data collection may be required to strengthen the country profile and support completion of the Future Risks Assessment component of the Health Vulnerability and Adaptation (V&A) Assessment.

In Curaçao, further work is required to complete the Health Vulnerability and Adaptation Assessment and develop a corresponding HNAP.


The consultancy will support both countries through the assessment, planning, prioritization, and development of comprehensive Health National Adaptation Plans aligned with the WHO Operational Framework for Building Climate-Resilient Health Systems and national climate adaptation processes.


Scope of Work & Methodology

Under the supervision of the PAHO/WHO Representative and the Technical Officer, Health Promotion, Life Course and Determinants, and in collaboration with the respective Health Authorities, the consultant will:

Aruba

  • Review existing Climate and Health Country Profile and V&A outputs.
  • Conduct additional data collection and stakeholder consultations to address identified information gaps, as required.
  • Complete Phase 2 of the Health V&A Assessment, including:

o Future Risks Assessment;

o Health Impact Assessment using qualitative and/or quantitative approaches;

o Analysis of projected climate-related health risks and vulnerable populations.

  • Identify and prioritize adaptation policies and programmes.
  • Develop Aruba's Health National Adaptation Plan (HNAP).
  • Develop implementation, monitoring and evaluation, and resource mobilization strategies.
  • Facilitate stakeholder consultations and validation workshops.

Curaçao

  • Conduct the Health Vulnerability and Adaptation Assessment, including:

o Framing and scoping;

o Vulnerability assessment;

o Sensitivity analysis;

o Future Risks Assessment;

o Health Impact Assessment.

  • Identify and prioritize adaptation actions.
  • Develop Curaçao's Health National Adaptation Plan (HNAP).
  • Develop implementation, monitoring and evaluation, and resource mobilization strategies.
  • Facilitate stakeholder consultations and validation workshops.

Both Countries

  • Develop and implement stakeholder engagement and communication approaches.
  • Promote coordination with national adaptation and climate planning processes.
  • Integrate gender, equity, and vulnerable population considerations throughout all analyses and recommendations.
  • Estimate resources required for HNAP implementation and identify financing opportunities.
  • Develop monitoring and evaluation frameworks and indicators.
  • Prepare final HNAP documents ready for submission to national authorities.

Qualifications

Essential

Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Environmental Health, Climate Change, Environmental Sciences, Epidemiology, or related field.

Desirable

  • Advanced degree in Public Health, Environmental Health, Climate Change, Environmental Sciences, Epidemiology, or related field.
  • Specialized training in climate change and health.
  • Experience in adaptation planning, health systems strengthening, or environmental health.

Experience:

Essential:

- At least 7 years of professional experience in climate change and health, public health planning, environmental health, or related fields.

- Experience conducting vulnerability assessments, health impact assessments, or adaptation planning processes.

- Experience developing policy or strategic planning documents.


Desirable:

-Experience working with Ministries of Health.

- Experience in Small Island Developing States or Caribbean countries. Familiarity with the Dutch islands will be an asset

-Familiarity with WHO Climate Change and Health guidance and HNAP development processes.


Technical Expertise:

  • Knowledge of climate change and health impacts.
  • Experience in vulnerability and adaptation assessments.
  • Experience in quantitative and qualitative data analysis.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills.
  • Strong technical writing and analytical skills.
  • Experience with monitoring and evaluation frameworks.
  • Project management and coordination skills
  • Stakeholder engagement and facilitation skills

Reporting Relationship:

The consultant will report to the PAHO Technical Officer, Health Promotion Life Course and Determinants. The consultant will submit invoices and activity reports for approval by the PAHO/WHO Representative, according to the schedule indicated below.


Remuneration:

The consultant will be remunerated at the Band B level of the salary scale for the PAHO Consultants (IPCs).


Deliverables and Payment Schedule:

Payment Schedule

1. Inception Report and Workplan; Deadline: 18 November 2026; fee: USD 8,676.00

2. Completed Aruba Health V&A; Deadline: 10 December 2026; fee: USD 11,352.00

3. Updated Country Profile and Draft Aruba HNAP Package; Deadline: 26 March 2027; fee: USD 8,352.00

4. Curaçao V&A Assessment Package; Deadline: 22 May 2027; fee: USD 8,514.00

5. Draft Curaçao HNAP Package; Deadline: 2 August 2027; fee: USD 8,514.00

6. Final Aruba and Curaçao HNAP Package; Deadline: 9 September 2027; fee: USD 11,352.00


The total value of the contract is USD $56,760.00

Confidentiality and Ownership:

  • All deliverables produced during the consultancy will remain the property of the PAHO/WHO TTO CO.
  • The consultant agrees to maintain confidentiality regarding any sensitive information or data shared during the assignment.

Evaluation:

Performance will be evaluated based on:

  • Quality and timeliness of deliverables
  • Technical rigor and completeness
  • Alignment with HNAP objectives
  • Stakeholder engagement and feedback

Terms and Conditions

  • The consultant agrees to comply with all applicable legal and ethical standards.

END

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • This vacancy notice may be used to identify candidates for other similar consultancies at the same level.
  • Successful candidates will be placed on the roster and subsequently may be selected for consultancy assignments falling in this area of work or for similar requirements/tasks/deliverables. Inclusion in the Roster does not guarantee selection for a consultant contract. There is no commitment on either side.
  • Only candidates under serious consideration will be contacted.
  • All applicants are required to complete an on-line profile to be considered for this consultancy. For assessment of your application, please ensure that your profile in the PAHO Career page is updated; all experience records are entered with elaboration on tasks performed at the time. Kindly note that CV/PHFs inserted via LinkedIn are no accessible.
  • A written test may be used as a form of screening.
  • If your candidature is retained for interview, you will be required to provide, in advance, a scanned copy of the degree(s)/diploma(s)/certificate(s) required for this position. PAHO/WHO only considers higher educational qualifications obtained from an institution accredited/recognized in the World Higher Education Database (WHED), a list updated by the International Association of Universities (IAU)/United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO). The list can be accessed through the link: . PAHO will also use the databases of the Council for Higher Education Accreditation and College Navigator, found on the website of the National Centre for Educational Statistics, to support the validation process. Some professional certificates may not appear in the WHED and will require individual review.
  • Any appointment/extension of appointment is subject to PAHO/WHO Regulations, and e-Manual.
  • For information on PAHO please visit:
  • PAHO/WHO is committed to providing a respectful and supportive workplace for all personnel .
  • PAHO is an ethical organization that maintains high standards of integrity and accountability. People joining PAHO are required to maintain these standards both in their professional work and personal activities.
  • PAHO also promotes a work environment that is free from harassment, sexual harassment, discrimination, and other types of abusive behavior. PAHO conducts background checks and will not hire anyone who has a substantiated history of abusive conduct.
  • PAHO personnel interact frequently with people in the communities we serve. To protect these people, PAHO has zero tolerance for sexual exploitation and abuse. People who commit serious wrongdoings will be terminated and may also face criminal prosecution.
  • PAHO/WHO has a smoke-free environment and does not recruit smokers or users of any form of tobacco.
  • Applications from women and from nationals of non and underrepresented Member States are particularly encouraged.
  • Consultants shall perform the work as independent contractors in a personal capacity, and not as a representative of any entity or authority. The execution of the work under a consultant contract does not create an employer/employee relationship between PAHO and the Consultant.

title: Founding Data Engineer
description:
TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

title: Data Center Hardware Engineer
description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The mission

You will work every day on the racks that power one of France's largest AI clusters.

Mistral's compute footprint is our single largest investment and the foundation of our AI research and engineering. We're hiring Data Center Hardware Engineers (L1-L3) to keep our GPU/CPU clusters healthy, safe and growing — hands-on, in the data center, at the intersection of high-performance computing and physical infrastructure.

You'll join a small, senior team working at a scale few engineers get to experience: GPU-dense racks (H100/H200-class and next-generation platforms), high-speed interconnects, liquid-cooled systems — with new sites under development in France and beyond.

Hardware here is not someone else's problem. As part of a small on-site team, you carry responsibility for it end to end.

Location: On-site at one of our data centers in the Paris region

What you'll do

  • Diagnose & repair server and cluster hardware: CPUs, memory, drives, NICs, GPUs, PSUs, and interconnect problems (switches, cables, transceivers; Ethernet/InfiniBand).

  • Intervene safely — power-off/lockout, ESD discipline, pre/post-work checklists, tidy and safe work areas.

  • Capture everything — photos, serials, test results; open, update and close tickets with notes the next engineer can act on.

  • Manage parts — receive, label and track inventory; run RMAs and coordinate with vendors.

  • Help us get better — feed recurring anomalies into monitoring, alerts and SOPs; contribute small scripts (Python/Bash) if you have those skills.

  • Be a good teammate — clear status updates, honest handovers, and respect for the people depending on the cluster.

About you

  • Hands-on comfort in data centers or server hardware — you can (or will quickly learn to) work cleanly in racks: rails, cabling, labeling, mounting.

  • Disciplined and meticulous: checklists aren't bureaucracy to you, they're craftsmanship.

  • Practical electrical basics: power-off procedures, PPE, short-circuit risk awareness.

  • Basic Linux (boot checks, logs) — scripting is a plus, not a requirement.

  • Physically able to work in racks (lift, mount, maneuver) in a data center environment.

  • Comfortable in a 24/7 operation, including a rotating on-call with emergency response expectations.

  • Driver's licence (B) for travel between our sites.

Even if you don't match every criterion

Many of our best hardware engineers came from research labs, telecoms, IT services or the military. If you are rigorous, curious and genuinely motivated by hardware at scale, we would be glad to hear from you — we assess demonstrated scope rather than keyword matching.

Nice to have

  • HPC/AI/cloud production experience at scale; large-fleet server install and maintenance.

  • Networking fundamentals (Ethernet/InfiniBand) beyond basics.

  • Vendor/RMA tooling, ticketing (Jira/ServiceNow), inventory systems.

  • Python/Bash automation for checks, capture, inventory or reporting.

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

Job Summary


You will lead the programs that stand up, retrofit, and expand our distribution centers and put automation into them. You will also act as the link between our DCs and the hospitals we serve. You own delivery of the capital work, and you own the fix when a hospital has a problem. You report on outcomes: sites live, capacity added, dollars saved, and customer issues closed.


Core Responsibilities


Capital programs and site build-out

  • Own end-to-end delivery of multi-site capital programs, from business case through commissioning and handoff to site operations.
  • Lead new-site stand-ups, retrofits, and expansions across the DC network. Set the plan, sequence the work, and hold vendors and internal teams to dates.
  • Manage program CapEx and cost-reduction targets. Track spend against plan and flag variance early.
  • Lead commissioning of automation equipment, including conveyors, sortation, and robotics. Define acceptance criteria and sign off on readiness.
  • Work with engineering, operations, IT, and vendors to resolve design, integration, and schedule conflicts.

Hospital and customer solutions

  • Act as the point of contact for hospitals on complaints and issues tied to deliveries, storeroom organization, and inventory management.
  • Work with DC operations managers to find the root cause of customer issues and fix the process, not just the incident.
  • Visit hospitals to review storeroom organization, inventory practices, and readiness for shipments. Give practical guidance to improve them.
  • Build lasting relationships with hospital supply chain staff. Be the trusted resource they call first, and tell them early about changes that affect them.
  • Feed what you learn from hospitals back into DC and program design, so new sites and automation fit what customers actually need.

Reporting and travel

  • Keep accurate records of customer issues, resolutions, and program milestones. Build dashboards and reports that show trends and repeat problems.
  • Report status to senior leadership. State the blocker, the options, and the ask.
  • Travel approximately 50% to active sites and hospitals. Some time in manufacturing and logistics environments.


Qualifying Experience

  • 8+ years in program management, engineering, or operations, with at least 3 years running capital programs.
  • Proven delivery of multi-site deployments, on schedule and on budget.
  • Direct experience commissioning material handling or automation systems.
  • Operations management experience in a high-volume warehouse or DC.
  • Track record managing programs of $[X]M or more in CapEx.
  • Strong analytical and root cause skills. You can build the business case and track the numbers.

title: Post-Doctoral Research Associate
description:
**UE07: £41,064 - £48,822 per annum**

**CMVM / Institute of Genetics and Cancer**

**Full-time: 35 hours a week**

**Fixed-term: 30 months**

**The Opportunity:**

**An exciting postdoctoral position is available to research the role of epigenetic marks in gene regulation.**

We are looking for a self-motivated, enthusiastic postdoctoral research associate to join the laboratory of Dr Duncan Sproul at the University of Edinburgh’s Institute of Genetics and Cancer to understand the role of DNA methylation in gene regulation. This project is a close collaboration with 3 other groups based at the Universities of Edinburgh and Exeter.

We have recently characterised mutations that prevent the DNA methyltransferase DNMT3B from being recruited to actively transcribed gene bodies (Taglini _et al_. 2024, EMBO Reports **25**:1130, DOI: 10.1038/s44319-024-00061-5). Our new project will use this knowledge combined with recently developed synthetic approaches as an entry point to probe the non-canonical regulation of transcription by DNA methylation within gene bodies and its functional impact on cellular phenotypes.

The successful candidate will work with the Sproul and collaborating laboratories as part of a successful multidisciplinary research team. This project will have a particular emphasis on the use of sequencing based functional genomics assays (eg TT-seq, CUT&RUN, Nanopore sequencing) in human embryonic stem cell models and work with synthetic landing-pad based approaches.

Candidates who have been awarded, or are soon to be awarded, a PhD in a relevant discipline and have experience with a broad range of molecular biology, cellular biology, biochemistry and/or computational data analysis approaches are invited to apply. Applicants must possess the ability to think independently while working within an interdisciplinary research team to drive research projects towards publication. Candidates with a strong track record in epigenomics, gene regulation and/or the use of human stem cells models are particularly welcome.

The post is full-time (35 hours per week) and funding is available from 1st January 2027 for 2.5 years pending review after 6 months.

Further details of work from the Sproul research group is available at:

[https://institute-genetics-cancer.ed.ac.uk/research/research-groups-a-z/sproul-group](https://institute-genetics-cancer.ed.ac.uk/research/research-groups-a-z/sproul-group)

title: Data Engineer
description:
About us:

FIT HUB is a venture-backed technology driven health and wellness startup based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Founded in 2020, FIT HUB's mission is to democratize access to Health and Wellness for all Indonesians. We believe that everyone should have access to improving their health and wellness, so we've built FIT HUB from the ground up to make exercising friendly, affordable, and fun for new gym-goers and fitness-enthusiasts alike.

The Opportunity:

As a Data Engineer, you will be part of our growing Data Team and play a key role in building and operating reliable data foundations that power business reporting, product analytics, and advanced analytics use cases. This role has strong ownership in areas such as curated datasets for sales, user activities (class check-in, personal trainer conduct), and membership analytics, feature pipelines to support scoring and analytics, privacy controls (masking and access management), reliability (data quality and alerting), and platform cost efficiency. You will work cross-functionally with Product, Tech, Data, Commercial, Finance, and the CEO Office to deliver trusted and scalable data products.

What You Will Do:

  • Build and maintain production-grade data pipelines (batch and event-based) that power core business reporting and decision-making (sales funnels, membership and renewal metrics, monthly performance reporting).
  • Develop curated datasets and data models (silver/gold/platinum thinking) to improve metric consistency, usability, and performance for dashboards and analytics.
  • Support migration and modernization work: migrate legacy reports/queries to optimized datasets and improve maintainability of analytics assets.
  • Enable machine learning delivery by building and maintaining feature pipelines and feature store patterns to support offline and online use cases (e.g., lead scoring).
  • Improve reliability and observability: monitor pipeline health, implement data quality checks and alerting, and reduce recurring incidents through runbooks and operational standards.
  • Implement data governance and privacy controls: apply masking/access patterns (row-level and column-level controls), support auditability, and ensure safe use of sensitive data across teams.
  • Drive cost efficiency through query and pipeline optimization, reducing inefficient scans and improving refresh speed.
  • Work closely with stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear data contracts and reusable pipelines, and document datasets/runbooks to reduce knowledge dependency.

What We Need:

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Engineer (or equivalent role) building and operating data pipelines in production.
  • Strong SQL skills and solid analytical data modeling fundamentals (curated datasets, performance-aware design, metric standardization).
  • Proficiency in Python for pipeline development, automation, and tooling; enjoy building and delivering tools from scratch (reusable modules, validators, utilities).
  • Experience working with multiple data sources and formats, including structured and semi-structured/event data.
  • Strong debugging and operations mindset: comfortable troubleshooting pipeline failures, handling incidents, and improving system reliability.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; able to drive clarity from ambiguous requirements.
  • Experience writing clear and concise documentation (data contracts, dataset definitions, runbooks).

Job Title:

Cell Leader III

GENERAL DESCRIPTION

Requires knowledge of heat treat specifications and heat treat processes and the ability to perform these processes. This includes normalizing, stress, relieving, nitriding, carburizing, hardening, tempering and freezing. Will perform all loading and removing of baskets from furnace using forklift or manual equipment. Able to gas quenched or oil quench as required per work instructions. Initiate and maintain all necessary records indicating quantity, times, test results of all materials processed. Maintains history and instruction file for heat treat on every part and fitting through process. Maintain maintenance records of all equipment. Perform tests, such as Rockwell Hardness test, as required on all parts. Will work with steel, beryllium, copper. Use any necessary instruments or controls in regulating the heat-treating equipment or process. Cleans all parts after heat treating by soap cleaning, degreasing or sandblasting as applicable. Rewraps, repacks, after cooling all parts heat treated and returns to source or next operator. Reports on paperwork problems and equipment failures to direct supervision. Demonstrates excellent safety practice and habits to ensure all rules are obeyed. Performs other duties as required.


RESPONSIBILITIES

Responsible for heat treatment of Moog components (metal or alloy) in the solid state to produce desired properties, i.e. improved mechanical properties (hardness, ductility, toughness, etc.) and/or chemical properties. Heat treatment is not limited to core hardening but also case hardening to ensure resistance of surface to wear, while maintaining toughness and strength of the core.


EDUCATION

At least 3rd year related Engineering


EXPERIENCE

With Metallurgy and Heat treatment background


SKILLS

1. Operate the following machines with supervision from Heat treat II/Senior operator. Vacuum furnaces, Hardness testers, Vapor Blast machines, Electric Fork truck loader, Overhead cranes, Industrial freezers, Air ovens, Washer and rinse.

2. Bake Out Cycle (preventive Maintenance Run) and determine leak up rate.

3. Respond to Alarm Problems.

4. Upload recipe program, Load details and batch compilation with supervision from Heat treat II/Senior Heat treat operator.

5. Perform Time-Temp Monitoring.

6. Record / Convert Hardness tests results.

Experis è la società IT & Technology del Gruppo Manpower.

Le persone e le loro competenze sono il nostro successo e insieme ci poniamo come partner tecnologici dei nostri clienti attraverso servizi e soluzioni. Vogliamo essere artefici, proprio insieme a te, di un ambiente di lavoro innovativo, stimolante e flessibile, attraverso i nostri Valori: People, Knowledge e Innovation.

Per ampliamento dei team Experis, ricerchiamo un/una Python Data Engineer che supporti un’iniziativa strategica di modernizzazione applicativa e migrazione di processi esistenti sviluppati in ambiente SAS.

La risorsa sarà coinvolta nell’analisi, comprensione e riscrittura in Python delle procedure attualmente implementate in SAS Enterprise Guide, garantendo la piena coerenza funzionale dei risultati e contribuendo all’evoluzione delle soluzioni verso architetture moderne e scalabili.

Responsabilità

  • Analizzare circa 250 procedure sviluppate in SAS Enterprise Guide.
  • Comprendere e documentare la logica funzionale delle elaborazioni esistenti.
  • Tradurre e reingegnerizzare il codice SAS in Python, identificando opportunità di ottimizzazione e miglioramento delle performance.
  • Progettare e implementare soluzioni più efficienti e facilmente manutenibili.
  • Trasformare, ove applicabile, procedure eseguite manualmente in processi automatizzati e serverless su AWS.
  • Eseguire attività di testing, validazione e confronto dei risultati tra ambiente SAS e Python.
  • Supportare le attività di collaudo, rilascio e messa in produzione.
  • Condividere competenze, best practice e documentazione tecnica con il team interno, garantendo continuità nella gestione delle soluzioni sviluppate.
  • Esperienza pregressa di 1 o 2 anni nel ruolo.
  • Ottima conoscenza di Python.
  • Buona conoscenza di SAS Enterprise Guide.
  • Esperienza con Base SAS, SAS Macro Language e PROC SQL.
  • Solida conoscenza di SQL.
  • Esperienza con database relazionali, preferibilmente Microsoft SQL Server e PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarità con strumenti di versionamento del codice, preferibilmente Git.
  • Capacità di analizzare processi esistenti e tradurli in soluzioni moderne ed efficienti.

Requisiti Preferenziali

  • Esperienza in progetti di migrazione da SAS a Python.
  • Conoscenza di AWS e architetture serverless.
  • Esperienza nell'automazione di processi data-oriented.
  • Familiarità con pratiche di Data Engineering e modernizzazione applicativa.

Sede: Milano

title: Senior Consultant, Value Creation
description:
Overview

Grant Thornton Stax is a strategy consulting firm built for high-impact work with private equity and growth-focused clients. Following our acquisition by Grant Thornton Advisors LLC, we’re expanding rapidly, combining the agility and culture of a boutique with the scale, reach, and platform of Grant Thornton.

Recognized as a top workplace, Grant Thornton Stax has been named to the 2025 Vault Consulting 50 Best Firms, Management Consulted’s Top Ranked Consulting Firms 2025, and Consulting Magazine’s 2025 Best Firms to Work For.

To support this growth, we’re expanding our team of Consultants—professionals who are intellectually curious, analytically strong, and eager to take on real responsibility early.

The Work

As a Senior Consultant in the Value Creation practice, you will play a central role on high-impact engagements focused on driving revenue growth, EBITDA expansion, and operational improvement for private equity portfolio companies.

You will work closely with portfolio company executives and private equity sponsors to design and execute initiatives across pricing, commercial excellence, go-to-market strategy, performance improvement and growth strategy development topic areas. Engagements often extend beyond strategy development into implementation planning and measurable execution.

Our teams operate with high ownership, direct client exposure, and meaningful responsibility—without the heavy travel model common in consulting.

What You’ll Do

·Lead workstreams focused on revenue growth, pricing optimization, sales effectiveness, and commercial strategy

·Diagnose performance gaps and identify value creation levers across customer segmentation, pricing, sales operations, and go-to-market models

·Develop actionable roadmaps with clear financial impact and implementation milestones

·Partner directly with portfolio company executives (CEO, CRO, CFO) to drive alignment and support execution

·Build financial models to quantify revenue and EBITDA impact

·Structure client deliverables that clearly articulate insights, recommendations, and measurable outcomes

·Present findings and implementation plans to private equity sponsors and portfolio company leadership

·Conduct scaled primary research, including phone interviews and web surveys to inform strategic recommendations

·Manage Associates, ensuring analytical rigor and high-quality outputs

·Contribute to business development efforts and support the growth of the Value Creation practice

What Makes This Role Different

·Drive tangible revenue and EBITDA impact across portfolio companies

·Work alongside executive leadership teams to implement meaningful change

·Develop deep expertise in pricing, commercial excellence, and growth strategy

·Experience sustained client relationships beyond transactional engagements

·Operate within a global support model that provides research and analytical leverage

·Rapid professional growth and clear pathways toward Manager and beyond

·Benefit from a sustainable consulting model with minimal travel (~10%)

Qualifications

·3–5 years of experience in strategy consulting, value creation, commercial excellence, pricing, or growth strategy roles

·Bachelor’s degree required, MBA preferred

·Experience working with private equity portfolio companies or corporate growth initiatives preferred

·Demonstrated experience leading defined workstreams focused on revenue growth, pricing, go-to-market, or operational performance improvement

·Strong financial modeling skills, with ability to quantify revenue and EBITDA impact

·Excellent structured problem-solving and analytical capabilities

·Strong written and verbal communication skills, including executive-level presentation experience

·Advanced PowerPoint and Excel proficiency required

·Detail-oriented, organized, and able to manage multiple priorities

·High initiative, intellectual curiosity, and strong collaboration skills

·Experience managing small teams or leading defined modules within larger engagements

Compensation & Benefits

This role offers a base salary range of $165,000–$190,000, plus a discretionary bonus. Base salary is commensurate with experience.

We also offer a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your family; a 401(k) plan with company matching; open vacation policy; life and disability insurance; generous parental leave; pre-tax transit benefits; mobile phone stipend; wellness reimbursement; charitable gift matching; and more.

Grant Thornton Stax is an equal opportunity employer and affords equal opportunity to all applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, disability (except where the disability is a bona fide occupational disqualification), sexual orientation, genetic makeup, predisposition or carrier status, familial or marital status, military or veteran status or any other status protected under local, state or federal laws.

Job Title

Executive-Production

Job Description

Carrying out of Production operations in compliance to cGMP & EHS requirements.

Brief Job Summary: -


Carrying out of Production operations in compliance to cGMP & EHS requirements.

Responsibilities: -


  • Planning and ensuring of raw material availability for daily production as per production plan.
  • Operation and cleaning of process equipment’s Viz. Reactor, centrifuge, Tray drier, Vacuum Tray drier/ Roto cone vacuum drier/ Agitated Nutsche filter cum drier/ Distillation column/ filters, miller & sifter operations etc., utility equipment’s viz. vacuum pump, Ejectors, scrubbers etc. allocated.

  • Execution of production plan and meeting the production targets.
  • Effective utilization of men, utility, equipment, raw materials, and power.
  • Issue and Control of Intermediates.
  • Maintaining Good Housekeeping in workplace and shopfloor.
  • Online Documentation viz. batch manufacturing record, cleaning record etc without any data integrity.
  • Trouble shooting of process equipment’s, utility systems and process.
  • Initiating work order and safety permits as per procedure.
  • Generating new ideas and initiatives
  • Involving Yield improvement, time cycle reduction, capacity enhancement initiatives.
  • Making the plant for the audit readiness.
  • Ensuring the safety of self, operating personnel, workmen and machine associated and knowledge on static electricity and its control.
  • Coordination with the supporting departments for smooth running of production.
  • Participation in training program and effective communication process.
  • Reporting of near miss, unsafe act and unsafe condition.
  • Handling of Hazardous operation and chemicals in safe manner.
  • Proper communication and spot relieving during shift change over in the shop floor.
  • Sampling and submission of in-process samples and receiving the results from QC/ ARD.

Qualification:

B.Sc (Chemistry) / Diploma in Chemical


Experience: 3-6 Years experience in Pharma Production activities

title: Chief Growth Officer iWYZE
description:
Let's Write Africa's Story Together!

Old Mutual is a firm believer in the African opportunity and our diverse talent reflects this.

Job Description

The Chief Growth Officer is accountable for building and operating iWYZE's end-to-end profitable growth engine. The role is responsible for sustainable customer, premium and market growth through the integration of brand, marketing, sales, digital commerce, partnerships and distribution.
A central responsibility of the role is to diversify iWYZE's routes to market, reducing over-reliance on any single acquisition or sales channel and building a scalable, resilient and economically attractive multi-channel distribution model.
The Chief Growth Officer is accountable for creating demand, expanding customer reach, improving conversion and retention, strengthening customer economics and ensuring that iWYZE can acquire and retain customers through multiple complementary routes to market.
As a member of the iWYZE ExCo, the Chief Growth Officer works closely with Actuarial, Operations, Technology, Data and Finance teams to ensure that growth is delivered within agreed pricing, underwriting, risk appetite and profitability parameters.


  • Profitable Customer and Portfolio Growth
  • Develop and execute the iWYZE growth strategy aligned to the business strategy and financial aspirations.
  • Own sustainable growth in customer numbers, policies, premium and market share.
  • Balance acquisition with retention, renewal, cross-sell and reactivation to drive net portfolio growth.
  • Establish measurable growth targets and align investment and resources to the highest-value opportunities.
  • Ensure growth is delivered within agreed profitability, pricing adequacy, underwriting and risk appetite parameters.
  • Monitor growth by customer cohort, segment and channel to understand quality, persistency and economic value.
  • Customer Proposition and Market Strategy
  • Define target customer segments and lead the commercial customer proposition for iWYZE.
  • Use customer, competitor and market insight to strengthen relevance, differentiation and value proposition.
  • Work with Actuarial and Product teams to commercialise propositions that are attractive to customers and economically sustainable.
  • Identify and test new segments, propositions and routes to market.
  • Ensure proposition design is translated consistently across brand, sales, digital and partnership channels.
  • Channel and Distribution Diversification
  • Define and execute iWYZE's overall distribution and channel strategy.
  • Build a diversified portfolio of customer acquisition and sales channels and reduce structural reliance on any single channel.
  • Identify, test and scale new routes to market based on customer behaviour, economics, strategic fit and execution feasibility.
  • Determine the appropriate role and relative contribution of channels across the acquisition portfolio.
  • Create effective integration between brand investment, demand generation, digital journeys, sales channels and partnerships.
  • Ensure customers can discover, engage with and purchase from iWYZE through increasingly convenient and relevant routes.
  • Establish clear economic hurdles for each channel, including acquisition cost, conversion, retention, margin and lifetime value.
  • Reallocate growth investment toward channels demonstrating superior economics and scale potential.
  • Maintain a structured pipeline of new distribution opportunities and experiments.
  • Ensure new channels can be operationalised effectively across technology, underwriting, servicing, compliance and data environments.
  • Brand, Market Presence and Demand Generation
  • Act as Executive custodian of the iWYZE brand and positioning.
  • Increase awareness, consideration, salience and relevance within target markets.
  • Balance long-term brand building with short-term demand generation and performance marketing.
  • Ensure above-the-line and performance marketing investment translates into measurable demand and commercial outcomes.
  • Use customer and market insight to continuously refine positioning, communications and media allocation.
  • Digital Commerce and Growth Engine
  • Own the commercial performance of the end-to-end digital growth journey from discovery and quote through to bind and onboarding.
  • Drive digital conversion, customer journey optimisation, personalisation and experimentation.
  • Increase the contribution of digital channels to new business and reduce friction across customer journeys.
  • Partner with Technology and Data functions to ensure growth requirements are translated into scalable digital capabilities.

title: Talent Engineer
description:
Company

Pace helps leading insurers run complex operations through AI agents and expert human review. Financial institutions spend nearly $400 billion annually on outsourced work. We’re building technology to transform those operations alongside some of the largest insurers in the world.

Role

We’re looking for a Talent Engineer to build new ways to find and engage the people who will build Pace.

Your primary focus will be sourcing: identifying exceptional engineers and operators, understanding what motivates them, and earning their interest. You’ll combine thoughtful outreach with creative research, AI, and automation to help us reach people we otherwise wouldn’t find.

You’ll work closely with founders and hiring managers, test new approaches, and turn what works into repeatable sourcing systems.

What this looks like in practice:

  • Discover exceptional people: Map companies, communities, research, and open-source projects to find promising candidates, including those who aren’t actively looking.

  • Create compelling outreach: Understand someone’s work and interests, then give them a specific, credible reason to explore Pace.

  • Engineer sourcing workflows: Use AI, recruiting tools, APIs, and lightweight code to improve research, candidate discovery, outreach preparation, and follow-up.

  • Experiment with new channels: Test referrals, small events, technical communities, and other creative ways to build relationships.

  • Learn from results: Track which approaches lead to qualified conversations and hires. Use feedback from hiring managers to sharpen your judgment.

  • Build reusable systems: Turn successful experiments into tools, talent maps, and processes the team can keep improving.

You’re a great fit if you:

  • Enjoy investigating what people have built and finding talent in unexpected places.

  • Write clearly and personally, and build relationships with curiosity and care.

  • Are comfortable experimenting with AI tools, data, and automation. Software engineering experience is welcome, but isn’t required.

  • Can show something you’ve built or improved in sourcing, recruiting, research, growth, or operations.

  • Follow through consistently and care about the quality of every candidate interaction.

Bonus:

  • Experience sourcing technical talent at an early-stage company.

  • Familiarity with technical communities, open-source ecosystems, or research networks.

  • Examples of tools or automations you’ve built yourself.

Team characteristics

Integrity: We value thoughtful people who earn trust, keep their commitments, and care about the quality of their work.

Ambition: Our goal is a $100bn+ business spanning vertical services. We want teammates who bring equally serious ambitions to their own development, whether as expert practitioners, leaders, or future founders.

Trajectory

You’ll help shape how Pace finds talent from an early stage. Potential paths include becoming an exceptional technical sourcer, owning recruiting systems, or growing into broader recruiting and talent leadership.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity ownership

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Unlimited paid time off

title: UKCSC Chartered or Principal Enterprise Advisor - Security Architecture
description:
Intelance is an independent UK advisory and assurance firm and an IASME Certification Body for Cyber Essentials, Cyber Essentials Plus and IASME Cyber Assurance. We work with mid-market, enterprise and regulated organisations across cyber assurance, security architecture, governance and technology risk.

We are appointing professionals who already hold formal UK Cyber Security Council (UKCSC) registration in Security Architecture at Principal or Chartered level, to join our associate panel and support the assessment and advisory of large, complex organisations.

This is not permanent employment. Work is offered on a project-by-project basis according to client demand, suitability and availability.

Please note: current UKCSC registration in Security Architecture (Secure System Architecture and Design) at Principal or Chartered level is an essential requirement for this role. Applications without it will not be progressed.

Tasks

You may be asked to:

  • Lead independent security architecture reviews and assurance for large, complex and regulated organisations.
  • Assess cloud, hybrid and on-premises architectures across identity, networks, applications, platforms and data.
  • Carry out threat modelling and identify credible attack paths, design weaknesses and control gaps.
  • Judge whether proposed or alternative controls provide equivalent, proportionate protection.
  • Review high-level and detailed designs and challenge unsupported assumptions.
  • Advise boards, executives and technical teams on secure-by-design decisions and trade-offs.
  • Produce clear, defensible, client-ready architecture findings and assurance reports.
  • Complete scheme-specific training and participate in internal quality reviews where required.

Requirements

You must hold:

  • Current UK Cyber Security Council (UKCSC) professional registration in Security Architecture (Secure System Architecture and Design) at Principal or Chartered level. This is mandatory and will be verified.

You should also have:

  • Substantial experience as a practising security architect in large, complex or regulated organisations.
  • Strong command of secure-by-design principles, threat modelling and architecture assurance.
  • Practical experience across cloud, hybrid infrastructure, identity, networks, applications and data security.
  • Excellent written English and the ability to explain technical risk to non-technical decision-makers.

SABSA, TOGAF, CISSP, CCSP and cloud certifications are welcome but do not replace the UKCSC registration requirement.

You must be based in the UK, able to attend UK client sites when agreed, and able to contract through a limited company or another compliant arrangement.

Benefits

  • Senior, independent security architecture and assurance assignments.
  • Flexible associate working based on your availability.
  • Direct access to Intelance leadership.
  • Work alongside experienced architects, governance and risk advisors and technical assessors.
  • Clear scopes, templates and quality-review arrangements.
  • Potential inclusion in Intelance proposals and associate credentials, subject to agreement.

Please provide:

  • Your CV and LinkedIn profile.
  • Your UK Cyber Security Council registration: specialism, level (Principal or Chartered) and your registration number or public UKCSC profile link.
  • Your location, availability and expected day rate.
  • One example of a complex enterprise security architecture you personally designed or assured.
  • Details of any relevant scheme, architecture or cyber-assurance qualifications.

title: Barnskötare, vikariat
description:
Förskolan Solkullen

Vår vision inom Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen är:

KOMPETENS FÖR LIVET Lust att lära – rätt att lyckas. Alla barn och elever är nyfikna, kreativa och tänkande. Hos oss har alla en känsla för tolerans och solidaritet. Vi möter barn och elever med höga förväntningar. Vi tror på deras förmåga att lyckas i lärandet för livet. I vårt arbete är mötet med barn och elever, undervisning, medarbetarskap och ledarskap centrala delar för att nå vår vision.

Vi söker nu dig som är barnskötare till förskolan Solkullen för ett vikariat.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer att ingå i ett arbetslag som tillsammans arbetar utifrån gällande styrdokument och riktlinjer för förskolan. Som barnskötare har du unika möjligheter att påverka barns utveckling och lärande. Du medverkar till att en positiv och utvecklande miljö skapas för varje barn och för hela barngruppen genom att samarbeta med arbetslaget enligt läroplansmålen.

I din roll är det viktigt att skapa goda relationer till barn, föräldrar och kollegor. Du deltar i planeringen och utvärderingen av det pedagogiska arbetet.

Din kompetens

Vi söker dig som är utbildad barnskötare. Det är meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av arbete inom förskola.

För att lyckas och trivas hos oss behöver du ha god förmåga att samarbeta, vara lyhörd och ha lätt för att sätta dig in i andra människors perspektiv. Du behöver vara trygg i dig själv, stabil och ha god självinsikt. Det är viktigt i rollen att du har en pedagogisk förmåga och har förståelse för hur barn tar till sig kunskap.

Det är också viktigt att du kan ta initiativ och sätta igång aktiviteter i verksamheten.

Övrigt

Tjänsten omfattas av registerkontroll. Sökande måste uppvisa utdrag från polisens belastningsregister innan anställning sker.

Vid interna organisationsförändringar kan tjänsten komma att tas i anspråk.

Inflyttarservice anordnar också återkommande träffar för nyinflyttade för att ge möjlighet att lära känna nya människor och en snabbare väg in i livet i Västervik.

Läs mer om vad Västerviks kommun kan erbjuda dig som anställd hos oss www.vastervik.se/jobba-hos-oss

About Comscore:

At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. If you’re motivated by big challenges and interested in helping some of the largest and most important media properties and brands navigate the future of media, we’d love to hear from you.

With a data footprint that combines digital, linear TV, over-the-top and theatrical viewership intelligence with advanced audience insights, Comscore allows media buyers and sellers to quantify their multiscreen behavior and make business decisions with confidence. title: specialpedagog/speciallärare till Vittra Väsby
description:
Vittraskolorna, ett av Sveriges ledande friskoleföretag med 24 för- och grundskolor runt om i landet. Tillsammans ansvarar vi för cirka 8000 barn och elever och har cirka 1000 medarbetare. Vi startade vår första skola 1993 och ingår sedan 2008 i AcadeMedia, Nordens största utbildningsföretag. Vittra är en samhällsengagerad för- och grundskola där barn och elever lär sig om sig själva och världen. Hos oss formas medvetna barn och elever som får rätt verktyg och kunskap för att skapa ett bättre och mer hållbart samhälle. Det gör vi med vår unika pedagogiska riktning som baseras på tre delar: medvetet lärande, modig kultur och tydlig struktur.

Vittra Väsby söker en legitimerad speciallärare

Vill du göra skillnad för elever och bidra utveckla en tillgänglig undervisning? Vi söker en legitimerad speciallärare som vill kombinera elevnära arbete med handledning och utveckling av skolans elevhälsoarbete.

Om vår skola

Vittra Väsby är en centralt belägen F-9 skola i Upplands Väsby. Hos oss på Vittra möts du av en verksamhet med starkt engagemang, hög kvalitet och massor av glädje. På Vittra har vi höga förväntningar på oss själva och vårt gemensamma arbete som grundar sig på kollegialt lärande och elevens individuella behov. Tillsammans bygger vi en trygg och utmanande miljö där alla ska få utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar, elever som vuxna. I undervisningen väver vi in aktuella samhällsfrågor och utforskar det som sker bortom skolans väggar. Skolan har ett stort fokus på språk och kunskaps utvecklade arbetssätt i alla ämnen. Nu söker vi efter en speciallärare som vill vara med och bidra till en trygg och stimulerande lärmiljö.

Om uppdraget

Som speciallärare/specialpedagog på Vittra Väsby arbetar du både nära eleverna och med att utveckla skolans undervisning samt elevhälsoarbete. Tillsammans med lärare, skolledning och elevhälsoteam bidrar du till tillgängliga lärmiljöer där elevernas olika behov möts. En viktig del av uppdraget är att genomföra pedagogiska utredningar av elevers behov av särskilt stöd, följa upp och utvärdera åtgärdsprogram i samverkan med lärare och elevhälsoteam. Du arbetar strukturerat och säkerställer att den pedagogiska dokumentationen är tydlig och aktuell. Du ingår i skolans elevhälsoteam och bidrar med din specialpedagogiska kompetens i tvärprofessionella samarbetet. Tillsammans med rektor och övriga teamet samordnar och utvecklar du skolans förebyggande och främjande elevhälsoarbete.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad speciallärare/specialpedagog och har ett starkt engagemang för elevernas lärande och utveckling. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Du är lyhörd, lösningsorienterad och trygg i att arbeta både självständigt och handleda andra. Du är flexibel och kan anpassa ditt arbetssätt efter elevernas och verksamhetens behov. Erfarenhet av språk-och kunskapsutvecklande arbetssätt samt arbete i Prorenata är meriterande.

Ansökan

Vi tar ej emot ansökan via mail utan endast via vår rekryterings plattform.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas före sista ansökningsdag. Vänta därför inte med att skicka in din ansökan.

För frågor om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rektor Marika Wadholm marika.wadholm@vittra.se nr: 08-594 213 65.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Prevention Specialist
location: White Bear Lake, Minnesota, United States
description:
Who We Are

Solid Ground (SG) is an award-winning nonprofit organization whose proven, holistic approach helps families build the strong foundations they need to emerge from homelessness into a brighter future. Through safe, affordable housing and innovative supportive programming, Solid Ground helps families transition to a higher-level of self-sufficiency and break the cycle of homelessness and poverty for the next generation.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At the heart of Solid Ground is the belief that housing stability is fundamental to the healthy development of children and to a family’s ability to be contributing members of the community. Solid Ground currently runs eight programs in suburban Ramsey and Washington Counties and housing over 660 individuals annually. Our mission is to prevent and end homelessness for families with children in the communities we serve through housing, resources, and opportunity.

  • SG sponsors a retirement plan with automatic enrollment at 3% and a 3% employer match after one year of service, plus immediate vesting.

Because Solid Ground is a member with Metropolitan Alliance of Connected Communities (MACC) who partners with St. Mary’s University, Solid Ground employees and their spouses are also eligible for the following benefits at St. Mary’s University:

  • Discounted tuition for Bachelor’s, Master’s, and Doctorate programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Access to advancement (internships, job placement, field practice)

Job Summary

  • Collaborate with community partners and other stakeholders to inform people about the programs and to identify potential participants.

  • Knowledge of pluralism and diversity issues.
  • Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office applications.

  • The ability to communicate effectively and persuasively in oral and written communication on an interpersonal and group level.
  • Knowledge and effective practice of boundaries, ethics, and confidentiality.
  • A valid driver’s license, access to reliable transportation, and the ability to meet Solid Ground’s driving record requirements. Please note that if the license was not issued in the state of Minnesota, you have 60 days after becoming a Minnesota resident in which to apply for your Minnesota driver's license or permit.

title: Specialist, Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**Job Title: Specialist, Artificial Intelligence Engineer**

**Job Code: 45547**

**Job Location: Melbourne, FL**

**Job Schedule: 9/80: Employees work 9 out of every 14 days – totaling 80 hours worked – and have every other Friday off**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking a highly qualified **Artificial Intelligence Engineer** who is an experienced professional responsible for developing, implementing, and improving artificial intelligence and automation solutions that support security engineering, infrastructure operations, and systems administration functions. This role applies proficient knowledge of artificial intelligence, machine learning, automation frameworks, IT operations, and engineering practices to enhance operational efficiency, strengthen security posture, and improve the effectiveness of enterprise infrastructure and administrative processes.

The position supports the design and deployment of AI-enabled tools and automated workflows for use cases such as operational monitoring, incident response, vulnerability analysis, alert triage, configuration management, systems health assessment, log analysis, and administrative task automation. The engineer works under general supervision and may be responsible for entire projects or processes within the job area, including coordinating technical activities, contributing to project execution, and reviewing work products.

This role requires regular collaboration with cybersecurity teams, infrastructure engineers, systems administrators, software engineers, and other internal stakeholders to explain technical processes, interpret operational procedures, and deliver scalable solutions aligned with organizational objectives. The Specialist, Artificial Intelligence Engineer also identifies opportunities to enhance systems and processes, solves moderately complex technical problems using prior experience and analysis, and contributes to operational targets with moderate impact on departmental results.

- This is a 100% onsite position at L3Harris offices located in Melbourne, Florida and cannot be performed remotely.
- This position requires the ability to obtain Public Trust suitability.

**Essential Functions:**

- Design, develop, test, and implement AI-enabled tools and automation solutions supporting security engineering, infrastructure operations, and systems administration.
- Build and maintain machine learning and rule-based automation workflows for operational use cases such as alert correlation, event analysis, anomaly detection, incident enrichment, and task automation.
- Develop solutions that improve efficiency in areas such as system monitoring, log analysis, patch verification, compliance checks, account administration, and infrastructure support processes.
- Partner with security engineers, infrastructure teams, and system administrators to identify automation opportunities and translate operational needs into technical solutions.
- Support the development and integration of AI/ML models, data pipelines, and automation scripts into enterprise or mission support environments.
- Analyze operational data from systems, applications, networks, and security tooling to identify patterns, improve visibility, and support proactive response actions.
- Recommend and implement moderate enhancements to systems, workflows, and engineering processes to improve effectiveness within the job area.
- Contribute to projects involving automation of routine administrative tasks, infrastructure diagnostics, security operations workflows, and operational reporting.
- Assist with model evaluation, system testing, validation, and performance tuning to ensure solutions meet operational and technical requirements.
- Create and maintain technical documentation including workflow descriptions, architecture diagrams, operating procedures, and implementation guidance.
- Communicate with stakeholders inside and outside the department to explain technical capabilities, processes, and procedures and to support adoption of developed solutions.
- Provide guidance, coaching, and training to other employees within the job area, as needed.
- Review technical work products for quality, completeness, and alignment to project or operational objectives.
- Ensure solutions are developed and implemented in accordance with applicable security, compliance, and configuration management requirements.

**Qualifications:**

- Bachelor’s degree with a minimum of 4 years of relevant experience, or a Graduate degree with 2 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, 8 or more years of directly related experience will be considered.
- Experience developing automation or AI/ML solutions using Python, PowerShell, Bash, or similar scripting/programming languages.
- Experience supporting security operations, infrastructure management, enterprise systems, or systems administration environments.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Familiarity with operational data sources such as system logs, security alerts, asset data, telemetry, configuration data, or infrastructure performance metrics.
- Ability to work under general supervision while managing assigned projects, tasks, or processes within the job area.
- Ability to analyze operational problems and develop practical technical solutions that improve efficiency, reliability, or security.
- Experience communicating technical processes and procedures to internal stakeholders and collaborating across engineering and operations teams.
- Practical knowledge of project management and experience contributing to the successful execution of technical projects.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to document technical solutions clearly and effectively.
- Experience in applying AI, machine learning, or intelligent automation to cybersecurity, infrastructure operations, or systems administration use cases.
- Experience with security engineering disciplines such as vulnerability management, endpoint security, security monitoring, identity and access management, or incident response.
- Experience with infrastructure operations including server administration, virtualization, storage, network operations, cloud services, or platform support.
- Familiarity with systems administration tasks across Windows, Linux, and enterprise infrastructure environments.
- Experience with automation frameworks and tools such as Ansible, Terraform, orchestration platforms, or workflow automation tools.
- Experience with SIEM, SOAR, log aggregation, monitoring, observability, or ticketing platforms.
- Familiarity with machine learning frameworks, data analysis libraries, and workflow orchestration technologies.
- Experience developing solutions for anomaly detection, alert prioritization, root cause identification, predictive maintenance, or intelligent operational support.
- Ability to recommend and implement process improvements that enhance security posture, reduce manual effort, and improve operational consistency.
- Experience reviewing, validating, and improving technical work products developed by other team members.
- Familiarity with secure development practices, access control requirements, and compliance-driven operating environments.
- Prior experience in aerospace, defense, or highly regulated enterprise environments is preferred.

title: Liability Claims Handler
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Liability Claims Handler

Job Location: UK wide

Job Type: Permanent

Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications

We have a fantastic opportunity for Liability Claims Handlers/ Desktop Liability Adjusters, based anywhere in the UK.

We're looking for dedicated liability professionals to join our growing team. In this role, you'll manage a varied caseload of Employers' Liability (EL) and Public Liability (PL) injury claims, alongside Third Party Property Damage claims, with flexible working arrangements including hybrid options.

This is a technical, customer-focused role involving the investigation of policy coverage and legal liability, negotiation and settlement of claims on behalf of our insurer and corporate clients, and the handling of both injury and property damage claims through to conclusion, working independently and under referral where appropriate.

You will investigate allegations made against policyholders, provide detailed liability advice, gather and assess relevant evidence, identify potential fraud risks, maintain proactive communication with all parties, manage litigated files where required, and ensure accurate record keeping and correspondence throughout the claims lifecycle.

With one of the largest teams of liability experts in the world, Sedgwick supports and resolves property, general, motor, product and professional liability claims, helping clients protect their brands and reputations when it matters most.

The skills you will have when you apply:


  • Thorough knowledge of current case law, common law/statutes, and regulations.
  • Insurance qualifications are desirable, but relevant experience is equally valued.
  • Strong team working and collaboration skills.
  • Good understanding of insurance law and policy wording interpretation.
  • Knowledge of contract, statute, and civil liability.
  • Strong investigation skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work with corporate clients, small businesses, insurers, and brokers.
  • Influencing skills to gain agreement on proposals and ideas.
  • Effective listening and empathetic response skills.
  • Clear and concise communication skills.
  • Motivation to provide prompt, efficient and personalised service to both external and internal customers.

Remuneration & More

  • A Self Invested Personal Pension Scheme (SIPP).
  • Holiday allowance of 25 days plus bank holidays.
  • Flexible working from our office or your home.
  • Health & Support
  • Private healthcare plan (including pre-existing conditions).
  • Life assurance.
  • Employee assistance programme for employee wellbeing.
  • Group Income Protection.

Other Benefits

  • Voluntary benefits including dental cover, cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan, wellbeing support and digital GP applications.
  • Discounts on various products and services.

This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry

At Sedgwick, you won't just build your career; you'll become part of a team of experts. Our Sedgwick University offering empowers you to develop your skills and continue your professional growth through the most comprehensive

training programme in the industry. This includes more than 15,000 on-demand courses, role-specific learning, and opportunities to continue formal education.

Together, we're not only reshaping the insurance landscape, we're building a legacy of talent. Come and be a catalyst for change within our industry.
