title: Community Coach (2026-2027)
description:
Classification: Part-Time, Seasonal
Start Date: Fall, Winter, and Spring Seasons
Schedule: Monday–Friday, 4:00 PM – 6:00 PM, with additional Saturday availability as needed (varies by sport)
Reports To: Head Varsity Coach and Director of Athletics

Notice to Applicants

Thank you for your interest in coaching at Lovett! This position remains open year-round, and we contact candidates based on seasonal coaching needs (Fall, Winter, and Spring sports). We appreciate your patience and understanding as we match coaches with teams throughout the academic year.

Sports We Coach (Opportunities Vary by Season)

Fall Sports:

Football, Volleyball, Cross Country, Cheerleading, Softball, Flag Football, E-Sports, MS Tennis

Winter Sports:

Basketball, Wrestling, Swimming & Diving, Cheerleading

Spring Sports:

Baseball, Lacrosse, Soccer, Tennis, Track & Field, Golf, Gymnastics

Note: Specific coaching needs vary by season. Please indicate your sport(s) of interest and coaching experience in your application.

What You'll Do

Coach & Develop Student-Athletes

You'll help run practices, teach skills and strategy, and prepare students for competition - all while fostering their growth as athletes and people.

  • Co-lead practices Monday-Friday, 4:00-6:00 PM during your sport's season
  • Provide technical instruction on skills, drills, strategy, and game situations
  • Give constructive feedback that helps athletes improve while building their confidence
  • Prepare athletes for competition through focused, purposeful practice planning
  • Collaborate with head coaches to implement practice plans and team strategy
  • Model proper technique, effort, and attitude in all coaching interactions

Build Character & Sportsmanship

You're not just coaching a sport - you're shaping young people during a formative time in their lives.

  • Promote good sportsmanship in practice, competition, and all team interactions
  • Foster character development through athletics - teaching discipline, resilience, teamwork, accountability, and leadership
  • Lead by example as a positive role model in how you compete, communicate, and carry yourself
  • Create an inclusive team culture where every athlete feels valued and challenged to grow
  • Emphasize effort, improvement, and team-first mentality over individual achievement

Ensure Safety & Supervision

You'll help create a safe, well-supervised environment for all student-athletes.

  • Supervise students at all times during practices, in locker rooms, and on team buses
  • Provide for the safety and welfare of all participants through proper supervision and risk management
  • Maintain appropriate boundaries and professional conduct with all students
  • Communicate safety concerns to head coaches and athletic administration promptly

Communicate with Professionalism

You'll interact with students, parents, colleagues, officials, and spectators - always representing Lovett with integrity.

  • Exercise patience, tolerance, and diplomacy when communicating with players, parents, co-workers, contest officials, and spectators
  • Maintain professionalism even in challenging or emotionally charged situations
  • Build positive relationships with student-athletes based on trust, respect, and care
  • Collaborate effectively with fellow coaches and athletic department staff

Who You Are

You bring:

  • Playing or coaching experience in your sport - you know the game and can teach it effectively
  • Passion for working with young athletes - you genuinely enjoy helping students develop
  • Knowledge of technique, strategy, and skill development appropriate to the age level you're coaching
  • Availability Monday-Friday, 4:00-6:00 PM during your sport's season
  • Reliable transportation to get to campus for practices and potentially games/meets

You are:

  • Student-focused – You care more about developing people than just winning games
  • Positive and encouraging – You build athletes up, even when correcting mistakes or pushing them harder
  • Patient and adaptable – You understand that adolescents are still learning, growing, and making mistakes—on and off the field
  • A strong communicator – You can teach skills clearly, give constructive feedback, and maintain professionalism with all stakeholders
  • Collaborative – You work well with head coaches, follow their lead, and contribute to a positive coaching staff culture
  • Character-driven – You model sportsmanship, integrity, and respect in how you coach and compete
  • Passionate about your sport – Your love for the game is contagious and inspires athletes
  • Emotionally intelligent – You stay calm under pressure, manage your emotions, and respond to challenges with maturity
  • Inclusive – You create environments where all athletes - regardless of skill level, background, or experience - feel welcomed and valued
  • Reliable and punctual – Your athletes and fellow coaches can count on you to show up prepared and on time

You have:

  • Sportsmanship and integrity that you model in every interaction
  • Growth mindset about your own coaching and your athletes' potential
  • Respect for the developmental stage of the athletes you're coaching (middle school vs. high school athletes have different needs)
  • Commitment to safety and proper supervision of minors
  • Professionalism in dealing with parents, officials, and challenging situations
  • Enthusiasm that makes practice something athletes look forward to

Bonus:

  • Previous coaching experience (youth, high school, college, club)
  • Played your sport at the collegiate or professional level
  • Coaching certifications or licenses in your sport
  • CPR/First Aid certification
  • Experience working in independent schools or educational settings

True to our core value of Belonging, The Lovett School is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse faculty and staff that reflects the world our students will inherit. We actively seek candidates from all backgrounds who are passionate about our mission to develop students of honor, faith, and wisdom. Employment offers are contingent upon successful completion of a background check and post-offer drug screening.

Physical Requirements

This position requires the ability to sit, stand, and walk for extended periods; use hands and arms for teaching activities; lift and move materials up to 20 pounds; and possess vision abilities suitable for reading and digital work. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities.

title: Senior Tech Lead - Cooling
description:
Sæt den tekniske retning for morgendagens løsninger

Brænder du for teknologisk innovation, komplekse udviklingsprojekter og tætte samarbejder med kunder?

Hos HydraSpecma søger vi en Senior Tech Lead til Cooling, som kan omsætte teknologiske muligheder og kundebehov til konkurrencedygtige løsninger. Du får en central rolle i udviklingen af nye produkter, teknologier og kundespecifikke systemer, samtidig med at du er med til at forme den teknologiske retning for området.

Du bliver en nøgleperson i arbejdet med at udvikle fremtidens løsninger og sikre, at vores produkter fortsat skaber værdi for kunderne og understøtter HydraSpecmas langsigtede vækst og innovationsambitioner.

**Teknisk ansvar fra idé til serieproduktion

Som Senior Technical Lead får du det tekniske ansvar for komplekse udviklingsprojekter, NPI-projekter og strategiske kundeprojekter. Du driver udviklingen af nye teknologier og løsninger fra de tidlige konceptfaser til færdige produkter klar til produktion og marked.

Du arbejder tæt sammen med kunder for at forstå deres nuværende og fremtidige behov og omsætter kundeinput, markedsindsigt og teknologiske trends til konkrete udviklingsmuligheder. Samtidig bidrager du aktivt til udviklingen af vores langsigtede teknologi-, produkt- og platformroadmaps.

I rollen bliver du en vigtig teknisk sparringspartner for kunder, projektteams og interne stakeholders på tværs af Engineering, Operations, Procurement og Quality.

**Skab robuste løsninger og reducer tekniske risici

En vigtig del af rollen er at sikre robuste og konkurrencedygtige løsninger gennem analyser, beregninger, tekniske reviews og risikovurderinger. Du identificerer og løser komplekse tekniske problemstillinger på tværs af fagområder og sikrer, at nye teknologier modnes og valideres, før de introduceres på markedet.

Du arbejder løbende med standardisering, platformisering og genbrug af teknologier og løsninger for at skabe skalerbarhed og effektivitet på tværs af produktporteføljen.

Samtidig sikrer du, at nye løsninger udvikles med fokus på kvalitet, produktion, service, omkostninger og performance.

**Styrk de tekniske kompetencer

Som en af de førende tekniske profiler inden for Cooling fungerer du som faglig mentor og sparringspartner for Tech Leads og øvrige engineering-kolleger.

Du bidrager aktivt til at opbygge, fastholde og dele teknisk knowhow i organisationen og er med til at styrke de kompetencer, der skal sikre HydraSpecmas fortsatte teknologiske udvikling.

**Kompetencer og kvalifikationer

Vi forestiller os, at du har en stærk teknisk baggrund kombineret med erfaring fra komplekse udviklingsmiljøer, hvor teknologi, kunder og forretning går hånd i hånd.

Du har solid erfaring med produktudvikling og teknisk lederskab og er vant til at drive komplekse projekter fra idé og konceptudvikling til industrialisering og implementering. Du trives med at sætte teknisk retning, skabe struktur i udviklingsforløb og sikre fremdrift i tværfaglige samarbejder.

Derudover har du:

  • En stærk teknisk forståelse og evnen til at omsætte avancerede tekniske problemstillinger til robuste og kommercielt attraktive løsninger.
  • Erfaring med udvikling, validering og modning af produkter og teknologier.
  • God forståelse for produktudviklingsprocesser, stage-gate-modeller og industrialisering.
  • Erfaring med tekniske analyser, risikovurderinger og design reviews.
  • Et stærkt forretningsmæssigt mindset med fokus på kundeværdi, konkurrencekraft og langsigtet værdiskabelse.
  • Evnen til at identificere og omsætte markedsbehov, kundekrav og teknologiske trends til nye forretnings- og udviklingsmuligheder.
  • Erfaring med at arbejde i et team, hvor hovedfokus er at lykkes med projektet.
  • Erfaring med at arbejde tæt sammen med kunder, leverandører og interne interessenter på tværs af funktioner og lande.

**Personlige kvalifikationer

Som person er du nysgerrig, analytisk og motiveres af at løse komplekse tekniske udfordringer. Du har en naturlig gennemslagskraft og evner at skabe følgeskab gennem din faglighed og din evne til at bygge relationer.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er strategisk tænkende og samtidig operationelt stærk.
  • Kan skabe retning og overblik i komplekse problemstillinger.
  • Tager ejerskab og driver opgaver i mål.
  • Formår at udfordre konstruktivt og stille de rigtige spørgsmål.
  • Er en stærk samarbejdspartner, som arbejder naturligt på tværs af organisationen.
  • Kommunikerer klart og troværdigt med både kunder, specialister og ledelse.
  • Har en passion for teknologi og innovation samt lysten til løbende at udvikle både løsninger og mennesker omkring dig.
  • Trives i rollen som faglig mentor og sparringspartner, hvor du bidrager til at udvikle den samlede tekniske organisation.

**Hvorfor HydraSpecma?

Hos HydraSpecma får du en unik mulighed for at kombinere teknologisk dybde, innovation og tæt kundesamarbejde i en rolle med stor indflydelse på fremtidens løsninger. Du bliver en del af en global ingeniørvirksomhed med stærke tekniske kompetencer, høje ambitioner og en kultur præget af samarbejde, faglighed og entreprenørånd.

Som Senior Tech Lead får du mulighed for at sætte retning for udviklingen af nye teknologier, produkter og platforme inden for Cooling. Du kommer til at arbejde tæt sammen med kunder, specialister og beslutningstagere og får direkte indflydelse på både tekniske prioriteringer, produktstrategi og fremtidige roadmap-initiativer.

Hos os er beslutningsvejene korte, og gode idéer kan hurtigt omsættes til handling. Du får frihed til at udfordre eksisterende løsninger, drive innovation og skabe resultater, der gør en reel forskel for både kunderne og forretningen.

Vi tilbyder et stærkt fagligt miljø, hvor videndeling, sparring og kontinuerlig udvikling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Du bliver omgivet af dygtige kolleger, som brænder for teknologi og problemløsning, og som ser samarbejde som en forudsætning for succes.

Samtidig bliver du en del af en international organisation med + 1.600 medarbejdere på tværs af 11 lande, hvor lokal handlekraft kombineres med globale muligheder. Det giver en spændende hverdag med mulighed for at påvirke løsninger, der anvendes på tværs af markeder og industrier verden over.

For den rette kandidat er dette mere end et job. Det er en mulighed for at sætte et varigt aftryk på HydraSpecmas teknologiske udvikling, styrke vores position i markedet og være med til at skabe de løsninger, der skal drive vores kunder og forretning fremad i de kommende år.

title: Analyst, Primary
description:
Adams Street Partners (“Adams Street”) is a global private markets investment manager that has nearly $76 billion* in assets under management. The firm is 100% employee-owned, which fosters a positive and unique culture of collaboration, intellectual rigor, integrity, and a commitment to professional development. For the eighth year in a row, Adams Street was named one of Pension & Investments’ Best Places to Work in Money Management in 2025.

Employees operate as a single global team, integrating the expertise of the firm’s investment professionals across five strategies: primary investments, secondary investments, growth equity, private credit, and co-investments. Adams Street is considered a private markets pioneer and was inducted into the Private Equity Hall of Fame in 2000.

The firm was founded more than 50 years ago, and clients include leading public and corporate pension plans, foundations, endowments, insurance companies, registered investment advisors, and high net worth individuals worldwide.

Adams Street has offices in Abu Dhabi, Austin, Beijing, Boston, Chicago, Hong Kong, London, Munich, Menlo Park, New York, Seoul, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo and Toronto.

*As of June 30, 2026. Adams Street Partners’ methodology to calculate Assets Under Management (AUM) is based on fund net asset value (NAV), plus unfunded commitments, plus leverage, but excluding the effect of subscription lines of credit. The prior AUM methodology was based on investor commitments minus commitments to fully liquidated underlying partnerships. Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. This updated methodology more closely aligns with (i) the amount of assets managed on behalf of investors and (ii) the amount of capital available to make direct and/or partnership investments. Amounts stated by investment advisers in regulatory filings (“regulatory AUM”) have a prescribed methodology, which may, in some circumstances, differ from the methodology such adviser uses for other purposes, including marketing efforts. Additional information is available upon request.

The Opportunity

This is a rare chance to launch your investment career at the heart of one of the most established primary investment franchises in private markets. As an Analyst on our London Primary Investments Team, you will sit alongside experienced investors evaluating the best private equity and venture capital funds in Europe and beyond – the managers backing the companies shaping the future economy.

From day one, you will be a genuine member of the deal team: forming a view on managers, interrogating track records, and helping decide where our clients’ capital is committed. You will gain exposure across the full breadth of private markets – buyout, growth, and venture, across geographies and sectors – building the judgement and network that define a long-term career as an investor.

What You’ll Do

  • Evaluate investment opportunities – assess private equity and venture capital funds, forming a view on manager quality, strategy, and the durability of their edge.
  • Dig into the numbers – analyse fund and portfolio performance, track records, value creation, and attribution to understand what truly drives returns.
  • Build the investment case – contribute your analysis and conclusions directly to investment memoranda that go in front of our investment committee.
  • Develop market intelligence – build a proprietary, forward-looking view of managers, sectors, and themes across European private markets, becoming a genuine expert in your coverage areas.
  • Conduct due diligence – play a hands-on role in researching and interrogating new opportunities, working directly with GPs and the broader market.
  • Partner across the firm – collaborate with investment colleagues globally and engage with clients and managers, building the relationships that are central to this industry.

Who We’re Looking For

We are looking for a bright, ambitious, and intellectually curious individual excited to build a career as a private markets investor. You will likely have:

  • A curious, driven and self-motivated outlook and be able to demonstrate these qualities through a record of achievement, whether academic, professional or self-directed.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for private equity and venture capital, and a desire to learn what makes great investors and great companies.
  • Sharp analytical ability and strong written communication, with confidence in Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Proficiency in the use of AI tools to enhance research, analysis and productivity is also expected.
  • A collaborative approach – someone who thinks creatively, and thrives as part of a team.
  • A professional presence and strong interpersonal skills to engage effectively with colleagues, clients, and managers.
  • This role is London based.

As a Territory Account Specialist (TAS), you’ll lead with purpose – crafting personalized experiences that reflect the unique needs of each account and Health Care Provider (HCP). Acting as the primary point of contact, you’ll build meaningful connections, identify shared priorities, and navigate solutions that link customers to Novartis resources – all with the goal of improving patient outcomes. Preferred Qualifications

The work environment and requirements described below are representative of those necessary for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role.


The Physical Side of the Role: This is an active, hands-on role. You can expect to be on your feet frequently, navigating active job sites with uneven terrain, stairs, ladders, and hoists. The work is physically demanding and requires a full range of motion, including bending, kneeling, and reaching. You’ll need to be comfortable frequently lifting and carrying materials up to 25 pounds, and occasionally up to 50 pounds. This role requires the ability to communicate effectively, as well as visual acuity for reading plans and inspecting work. The role does include desk time in the office that may require prolonged periods of sitting for tasks like computer work, document review, and meetings.


Your Work Environment: You’ll spend a significant amount of your time on active construction sites, which means being adaptable to all kinds of weather and moderate to loud noise levels, and comfortable in elevated or confined work areas with moving mechanical equipment and with the fast-paced nature of a project in progress. You will also spend time in a typical office setting with moderate noise levels. Our High-Performing Culture: This is a demanding, high-performance environment. We are looking for candidates who are energized by challenge, thrive under pressure, and are prepared to do what it takes to achieve exceptional results. Success in this role requires significant commitment, including flexibility to work extended hours, especially during critical project phases or client deadlines. Beyond regular working hours, there will be occasions where business needs require your attention, particularly for time-sensitive matters or emergencies. You are expected to monitor and respond to communications (phone calls, emails, text messages) as required to address these situations effectively. Your ability to manage these expectations and be responsive when critical issues arise is key to your success in this role and our collective success as a team.


A Drug Free Workplace: Clark promotes a drug free workplace. A pre-employment drug “fitness for duty” screening is required, and the company conducts random quarterly drug “fitness for duty” tests.


Clark offers a total compensation package that includes base salary, bonus potential, and a comprehensive benefits package including health/dental/vision benefits, paid time off, retirement/401k, and Company Contribution plan. Additional benefits include life insurance, commuter benefit, short & long term disability, fitness reimbursement, FSA, tuition reimbursement, back-up daycare, tutoring & family support benefits, EAP/Work-Life assistance, and a holiday contribution program. For this role the base salary range is $85,000 - $185,000. Compensation may vary outside of this range depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s education, experience, skills, and geographic location. Base pay is one part of the Total Compensation Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work.

title: Vice President of Carrier Relations
description:
Importance of the Role

The VP of Carrier Relations is responsible for building and advancing Matic's carrier marketplace as a core competitive advantage across our insurance businesses.

This role owns Matic's carrier strategy, strategic carrier partnerships, and carrier innovation, ensuring we have the products, relationships, economics, and technology capabilities required to deliver greater choice, conversion, and customer value.

Responsibilities

  • Carrier Strategy & Marketplace
    • Build the carrier marketplace required to support Matic's growth and win across our distribution businesses.
    • Set and own Matic's overall carrier and insurance product strategy, with clear priorities and accountability across the Carrier Relations team.
    • Continuously evaluate the competitiveness of our carrier lineup across products, geographies, customer segments, and business models.
    • Identify carrier, product, and coverage gaps and develop strategies to address them.
    • Own the strategy and business case for adding new carriers and expanding existing carrier relationships.
    • Anticipate the carrier capabilities required to support Enterprise Agency, Matic Local, Book Acquisition, and future growth opportunities.
  • Carrier Partnerships & Performance
    • Build and oversee Matic's carrier relationship strategy, personally owning executive relationships with our most strategic carrier partners.
    • Develop joint strategies with key carriers to increase production, improve performance, and expand the relationship.
    • Manage carrier performance across production, placement, profitability, quality, and other key carrier expectations.
    • Maximize carrier economics through production bonuses, long-term incentives, and other strategic opportunities.
    • Build and lead a high-performing Carrier Relations team with clear ownership across carrier relationships, priorities, and performance.
  • Carrier Innovation
    • Push Matic and our carrier partners to build differentiated capabilities that improve the customer and agent experience.
    • Own the vision for advancing Matic's Carrier Quoting Platform and carrier connectivity.
    • Partner with Product & Engineering to define and prioritize the carrier technology roadmap.
    • Advance carrier partners toward deeper technology integration, including bindable quoting APIs, servicing APIs, and other capabilities that create a more seamless insurance experience.
    • Identify opportunities to use carrier technology, data, and connectivity to improve quote availability, accuracy, conversion, servicing, and customer experience.
    • Build strategic partnerships with carriers willing to innovate alongside Matic and create capabilities that differentiate our platform.

How Success Is Measured

  • Breadth, competitiveness, and quality of Matic's carrier and product marketplace.
  • Increased quote availability and placement across priority customer segments and markets.
  • Growth and performance of strategic carrier partnerships.
  • Improved carrier economics and profitability.
  • Expansion of bindable APIs, servicing APIs, and other strategic carrier integrations.
  • Measurable improvement in customer and agent experience enabled by carrier innovation.

The Leader We Need

You are a strategic insurance leader who can turn Matic's carrier network into a true competitive advantage.

You are more than a traditional relationship manager; this leader needs deep P&C insurance expertise and credibility with senior carrier executives. You should be commercially minded, analytically strong, and technology-forward, with the ability to understand where insurance distribution is going and influence carriers to move with us.

You should be equally comfortable negotiating a strategic carrier partnership, analyzing gaps in our marketplace, and sitting with Product & Engineering to define the next generation of carrier connectivity.

What We Offer

  • Matic Stock Options - all employees have ownership in Matic
  • Flexible Paid Time Off - take off as much time as you need - we support work / life balance
  • Medical, Dental & Vision insurance - Matic pays 100% for employees - $0 out of your paycheck for benefits!
  • Health Savings Account (HSA) - with monthly $$ employer contribution
  • 401(k) Retirement Plan Option
  • A TRUE team culture - One Team, One Dream is our company motto
  • Frequent team events & activities - happy hours, charity events, game nights, volleyball/kickball teams, etc

About Matic

Matic is an insurance tech startup who delivers an unbiased approach to insurance. We combine a powerful digital experience with assistance from our team of trusted advisors. Matic has changed the landscape of the insurtech industry by integrating insurance within the home and auto ownership experience.

Our digital insurance marketplace has over 40 A-rated home and auto carriers, as well as distribution partners in industries ranging from mortgage origination and servicing to banking, auto financing, and much more.

Working at Matic means working collaboratively towards one common goal; we are one team with one dream. We have a fast-paced culture that is driven by quality, transparency, and of course fun.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis now and in the future. This position does not offer sponsorship.

If you require a reasonable accommodation at any stage of the application or hiring process, please reach out to us at HR@matic.com.

Initiative & Accountability

Communication & Customer Service

title: Förskollärare, vikariat
description:
Förskolan Solkullen

Vår vision inom Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen är:

KOMPETENS FÖR LIVET Lust att lära – rätt att lyckas. Alla barn och elever är nyfikna, kreativa och tänkande. Hos oss har alla en känsla för tolerans och solidaritet. Vi möter barn och elever med höga förväntningar. Vi tror på deras förmåga att lyckas i lärandet för livet. I vårt arbete är mötet med barn och elever, undervisning, medarbetarskap och ledarskap centrala delar för att nå vår vision.

Vi söker nu en förskollärare för ett vikariat till förskolan Solkullen i Gamleby.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Du kommer tillsammans med övriga pedagoger på förskolan att utveckla, driva och genomföra förskolans uppdrag utifrån våra styrdokument och med vår vision i sikte. Som förskollärare har du unika möjligheter att påverka barns utveckling och lärande. I rollen ingår planering, uppföljning och dokumentation av arbetet. En viktig uppgift är att skapa inspirerande och utmanande lärandemiljöer på förskolan.

Som förskollärare ansvarar du för förskolans pedagogiska innehåll och arbetar med att främja varje barns utveckling och lärande. I ditt ansvar ligger att skapa goda relationer till barn, föräldrar och kollegor.

I Västerviks kommun strävar vi efter en likvärdig förskola i hela kommunen. Vi arbetar med att utveckla det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet med pedagogisk dokumentation och utforskande arbetssätt som verktyg.

Din kompetens

Vi söker dig som har förskollärarexamen. Om du har tidigare arbetslivserfarenhet som förskolelärare så ser vi detta som meriterande.

För att lyckas och trivas hos oss behöver du ha god förmåga att samarbeta, vara lyhörd och ha lätt för att sätta dig in i andra människors perspektiv. Du behöver vara trygg i dig själv, stabil och ha god självinsikt.

Det är viktigt i rollen att du har en väl utvecklad pedagogisk förmåga. Du har god förståelse för hur barn tar till sig kunskap och om olika förutsättningar för lärande. Det är också viktigt att du kan ta initiativ och sätta igång aktiviteter i verksamheten.

Övrigt

Tjänsterna omfattas av registerkontroll. Sökande måste uppvisa utdrag från polisens belastningsregister innan anställning sker.

Behöver du hjälp att hitta bostad försöker vi hjälpa dig med det. Inflyttarservice i Västerviks kommun hjälper till med tips, information och kontakter för arbete, bostad, skolor med mera. Inflyttarservice anordnar också återkommande träffar för nyinflyttade för att ge möjlighet att lära känna nya människor och en snabbare väg in i livet i Västervik.

Läs mer om vad Västerviks kommun kan erbjuda dig som anställd hos oss www.vastervik.se/jobba-hos-oss

Vi håller löpande intervjuer under ansökningstiden så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Information Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Vi undanber oss erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

title: Director of Development, Student & Campus Life and Athletics
description:
Cornell University welcomes candidates for the position of **Director of Development, Student & Campus Life and Athletics** in our Alumni Affairs and Development division, based in Ithaca, NY. This role presents an exceptional opportunity to contribute to the university's development efforts.

**Position Summary**

The Director of Development serves as a fundraising leader for Cornell's Student & Campus Life and Athletics division, helping to guide a comprehensive development program that advances key philanthropic priorities. Reporting to the Executive Director, this position serves as a key member of the division’s fundraising leadership team and a trusted partner in advancing fundraising strategy and organizational goals. This individual provides leadership for fundraising operations, staff management, and major gift strategy while helping shape the direction, priorities, and future growth of the development program. As a close collaborator to the Executive Director, the Director plays a critical role in translating vision into fundraising success.

**Key Responsibilities**

Strategic Thought Partner

- Serve as a trusted advisor to the Executive Director, helping shape fundraising strategy, organizational goals, and long-term growth opportunities across Student & Campus Life and Athletics
- Partner with divisional leadership to identify opportunities, address challenges, and advance key initiatives
- Contribute to strategic planning, goal setting, forecasting, and decision-making

Operational Leadership

- Provide leadership for the development program, ensuring alignment with divisional and university fundraising priorities
- Supervise, coach, and develop a team of fundraising professionals, fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, and high performance
- Oversee fundraising operations, performance metrics, and key processes to ensure effective execution and achievement of fundraising goals

Portfolio Management

- Manage a portfolio of major gift prospects and donors, developing and executing strategies to cultivate, solicit, and steward philanthropic support while authentically engaging donors around the impact of athletics and student life programs
- Partner with divisional leaders, coaches, alumni, volunteers, and donors to build meaningful relationships and advance fundraising priorities

**About Alumni Affairs and Development**

At Cornell Alumni Affairs and Development, we connect alumni, parents, and friends with opportunities to make a meaningful difference at Cornell and beyond. Our success is built on the strength of relationships, a commitment to excellence, and a culture of collaboration, innovation, inclusion, and continuous learning. As one of higher education's leading fundraising and engagement organizations, we recently completed a record-setting campaign that engaged more than 221K alumni and raised $6.7 billion. Joining our team means growing your career alongside supportive, mission-driven, and high-performing colleagues while helping shape Cornell's future.

title: Applications Administrator - Clarity
description:
Work Schedule

Third Shift (Nights)

Environmental Conditions

Office

Job Description

Summary

The Application Administrator provides day-to-day L2 operational and administrative support for the Clarity PPM platform. The role is responsible for routine incidents, service requests, application monitoring, data-integrity checks, batch and interface monitoring, access administration, configuration support, documentation, testing support, and operational procedures. The position is designed to develop into a broader Clarity application support role through structured knowledge transfer, hands-on production support, cross-training, and progressive technical development.


Key Responsibilities

  • Provide L2 support for routine Clarity incidents and service requests.
  • Own assigned tickets through resolution or appropriate escalation.
  • Maintain timely ticket updates, resolution notes, and supporting documentation.
  • Perform routine Clarity administration and operational support.
  • Monitor application health, support queues, scheduled jobs, interfaces, batch processes, and automated processes.
  • Identify failed jobs, interfaces, or scheduled processes and follow documented recovery or escalation procedures.
  • Perform routine data-integrity checks and document results.
  • Assist with operational data validation and corrective-action procedures.
  • Support user access, permissions, and application-administration requests in accordance with approved processes.
  • Support periodic Clarity license-utilization reviews and reporting.
  • Assist with application configuration activities under established standards and procedures.
  • Assist with testing of incidents, fixes, enhancements, upgrades, patches, and releases.
  • Create and execute defined test cases.
  • Support UAT preparation and coordination.
  • Support production-readiness checks and post-deployment validation.
  • Support planned production deployments and weekend maintenance activities.
  • Maintain operational runbooks, knowledge articles, Known Error Database entries, standard operating procedures, and support documentation.
  • Participate in knowledge-transfer activities with the incumbent managed service provider.
  • Ensure new operational knowledge is documented and shared with the team.
  • Support incident, request, problem, change, and release-management processes.
  • Assist with service KPI, SLA, backlog, and operational reporting.
  • Support Disaster Recovery exercises and documented recovery procedures.
  • Assist with user guidance and maintenance of training materials.
  • Coordinate with Developers and the Team Lead on incidents requiring advanced functional or technical analysis.
  • Coordinate with infrastructure or other support teams using documented escalation procedures.
  • Execute administrative activities in accordance with SOX controls, access-management standards, security policies, segregation-of-duties requirements, and audit procedures.
  • Maintain required control evidence for access changes, operational checks, and support procedures.
  • Assist with periodic access reviews, audit evidence collection, and control testing.
  • Participate in the team's 16x5 support coverage model.
  • Participate in on-call support as assigned and appropriate for the role.
  • Support planned weekend patches, releases, deployments, and maintenance activities.
  • Develop technical capability in Clarity configuration, SQL, GEL, NSQL, XOG, integrations, and APIs through structured cross-training.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree plus 2 years of experience in enterprise systems administration and infrastructure support
  • Fields of Study: Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Foundational knowledge of enterprise application support or application administration.
  • Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting capability.
  • Ability to follow documented operational and change-control procedures.
  • Strong attention to detail and documentation.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with business users and technical teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to learn new technologies.
  • Ability to support scheduled weekend maintenance and participate in an on-call rotation as required.

Required Clarity PPM Skills and Experience

  • Foundational to early-career hands-on experience with Clarity PPM administration or production application support.
  • Foundational knowledge of Clarity user administration, security groups, access requests, application configuration, scheduled jobs, support queues, and routine operational procedures.
  • Basic SQL skills for data validation, investigation, and operational support.
  • Foundational exposure to GEL scripting, NSQL, XOG, REST APIs, XML, web services, or Clarity integrations is required. Deeper hands-on proficiency can be developed through structured training and experience in the role.
  • Experience monitoring batch jobs, interfaces, scheduled processes, application health, and failed-process recovery or escalation.
  • Experience supporting incident and service-request queues, maintaining accurate ticket updates, and following documented escalation procedures.
  • Experience creating or executing test cases and supporting UAT, patches, releases, and post-deployment validation.
  • Experience with application access administration, operational controls, documentation, runbooks, or knowledge articles.
  • Exposure to SOX-controlled applications, formal change control, access governance, or audit evidence requirements is preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to develop Clarity technical skills in configuration, GEL, NSQL, SQL, XOG, APIs, and integrations over time.

Technical / Functional Skills

  • Clarity PPM administration
  • SQL
  • Application configuration
  • Application monitoring
  • Batch and scheduled-job monitoring
  • Interface monitoring
  • Data-integrity validation
  • User and access administration
  • REST APIs
  • XML and web services
  • Linux
  • GEL scripting
  • NSQL
  • XOG
  • Knowledge Management and KEDB
  • SOX control execution
  • Access-management and change-control procedures

Key Success Measures

  • Timely and accurate completion of incidents and service requests
  • Effective monitoring and escalation of production issues
  • Reliable execution of operational checks
  • Accurate data-integrity and monitoring activities
  • Quality and completeness of support documentation
  • Growth in Clarity functional and technical capability
  • Increased ability to independently resolve routine application issues
  • Effective contribution to 16x5 support coverage
  • Effective participation in weekend maintenance and on-call support
  • Compliance with SOX, access, operational, and change-control requirements

title: Sviluppatore Software
description:
SVILUPPATORE SOFTWARE

One Team ricerca una nuova risorsa da inserire nel team di sviluppo WEB.

Chi siamo?

Fondata nel 1997, One Team è un’azienda italiana solida e in forte crescita che lavora nell’ambito dei sistemi informativi a supporto dell’ingegneria e della produzione. L’azienda è tra i principali partner italiani dei maggiori brand globali di software per la progettazione ed è impegnata nel fornire soluzioni innovative ai propri clienti. One Team partecipa inoltre a progetti di sviluppo e innovazione europei. L’azienda lavora su tutto il territorio nazionale e si sta espandendo all’estero: ad oggi contiamo cinque sedi in Italia e una in Spagna. Il team è composto da oltre cento risorse, tra cui specialisti di prodotto, ingegneri, architetti, sistemisti, analisti programmatori e sviluppatori.

Il candidato, in base all’esperienza maturata, svolgerà le seguenti attività:

  • Sviluppo di Applicazioni Web, “Full Stack Developer”;
  • Analisi dei requisiti funzionali e definizione delle specifiche di progetto;
  • Supporto e affiancamento ai clienti nella risoluzione di problematiche legate all’utilizzo del software e delle procedure realizzate;

La sede principale di lavoro è Milano, con possibili trasferte presso i clienti in Italia.

Il candidato dovrà lavorare in team e avere una spiccata attitudine al problem solving e all’analisi delle esigenze dei clienti.

Competenze informatiche

È richiesta la conoscenza delle seguenti tecnologie:

  • Backend: Microsoft ASP.NET Framework / Microsoft ASP.NET Core
  • Frontend: Javascript, HTML5

Costituisce elemento di valutazione preferenziale l’eventuale esperienza maturata nella gestione di Database quali SQL Server, Oracle, MySql, PostgreSQL

Competenze linguistiche

È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese.

CCNL Commercio, Terziario, Servizi

Range retributivo: 24.000 – 27.500

Welfare aziendale secondo regolamento interno

Smart working

Dotazione aziendale standard

Piano formativo e di crescita

About UOB

United Overseas Bank Limited (UOB) is a leading bank in ASEAN with a global network in Southeast Asia, Asia Pacific, Europe and North America. Operating through our head office in Singapore and banking subsidiaries in China, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam, we have a global network of about 430 branches and offices in 19 markets. At the heart of UOB is our culture, shaped by the UOB Way and anchored on our four values – Honourable, Enterprising, United and Committed. title: Field Wholesaler - Washington
description:
Job Description:

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.


That’s why we’re actively seeking a talented Field Wholesaler to join Pacific Life's Consumer Markets Division (CMD) to cover the Washington territory.


The Consumer Markets Division leverages its strengths in product development, technology, service, and risk management to create retirement solutions for individuals, families, and businesses. With the guidance of financial professionals, customers have access to an array of annuities and mutual funds designed to help grow assets and to provide retirement income for financial independence.


As a Field Wholesaler you'll sell mutual funds, fixed and variable annuities within all channels (wirehouses, independent, and banks) within the territory. You will fill an existing role that sits on a team of 16 external wholesalers (West Division). Your colleagues will include both Internal and Field Wholesaling professionals. You'll develop and maintain ongoing relationships with financial professionals and key broker/dealers within the region by making face-to-face and virtual sales visits as well as telephone calls. You'll also introduce new products through established and new broker/dealers. Finally, you'll attend and speak at national, regional, and office broker/dealer sales meetings.


How you'll help move us forward:

  • Engage with Financial Professionals from 3 major distribution channels, including Independent Planners, Banks and Wirehouse firms
  • Represent CMD's 3 core lines of business (Variable Annuities, Fixed Annuities and Mutual Funds)
  • Work as part of a team, in partnership with an Internal Wholesaler, other Field Wholesalers and Sales Management
  • Efficiently leverage wide array of business tools and resources

The experience you will bring:

  • Bachelor's Degree
  • 5 or more years direct sales/marketing experience wholesaling variable and/or fixed annuities or mutual funds to wirehouses, banks, and broker/dealer community
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce platform and other customary business software such as Outlook
  • Strong presentation skills, the ability to work independently and a track record of success
  • Outgoing, adaptive, goals-based individual with exceptional interpersonal communication skills
  • Series 6 or 7, 63, and Variable Contracts licenses required

Compensation:

title: Global Sourcing Governance Assistant
description:
**Help strengthen responsible sourcing across our global organization

**Responsible sourcing starts with strong processes, accurate data and effective collaboration. As Global Sourcing Governance Assistant, you will play an important role in BioMar’s global supplier approval processes and help ensure that supplier governance is managed consistently across our international organization.

Working closely with the Global Sourcing Governance Specialist, Category Managers and local sourcing departments, you will contribute to efficient and compliant supplier management. Your work will help support the responsible sourcing standards that underpin BioMar’s commitment to sustainable aquaculture.

**Create structure and support sourcing excellence worldwide

**Our Global Sourcing team plays a key role in supporting BioMar facilities worldwide. We balance ambitious requirements for quality, nutrition and sustainability with commercial and logistical considerations to ensure responsible sourcing across our supply chain.

In this role, you will help maintain and strengthen the processes, systems and documentation that support supplier governance and compliance. You will work with colleagues across functions and cultures, helping create consistency and transparency in supplier management activities.

  • Maintain supplier data and ensure high data quality in relevant systems
  • Evaluate and approve global suppliers
  • Collect, review and follow up on supplier documentation
  • Assist with audit preparation activities
  • Maintain sourcing governance procedures and documentation, while supporting training of new sites and employees

**Bring accuracy, collaboration and a process-driven approach

**You enjoy working with structured processes and detailed documentation, and you take pride in maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy. You collaborate effectively with stakeholders and are comfortable working across functions to support shared goals.

You bring relevant experience from governance, compliance or process-driven administrative work and can confidently manage multiple priorities while ensuring consistency and attention to detail.

**Must-have requirements:

**

  • Experience working with supplier onboarding, compliance processes, quality management systems, audit preparation or similar governance-related administrative activities
  • Strong attention to detail and a commitment to maintaining high data quality while applying evaluation standards consistently
  • Good communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to engage with suppliers and follow through on agreed actions
  • A structured and organized ability to manage priorities in a dynamic environment
  • Fluency in written and spoken English

**Nice-to-have:

**A bachelor’s degree in supply chain, procurement, business administration or a related field. Familiarity with quality management systems and relevant standards or certification schemes such as ISO 9001, ISO 22000, GLOBAL G.A.P. and GMP are considered an advantage.

**Grow your expertise in global sourcing and supplier governance

**At BioMar, sustainability is closely connected to our purpose. You will join a global team that values collaboration, continuous improvement and responsible sourcing, while working with colleagues across our international organization.

This role offers a unique opportunity to gain hands-on experience in supplier governance, compliance and global sourcing. You will help strengthen supplier compliance processes and support the consistent application of BioMar’s sourcing standards worldwide. At the same time, you will build valuable expertise within responsible sourcing, supplier governance, ESG compliance and global procurement.

**How To Apply And Whom To Contact

**Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. If additional application documents are required, such as a cover letter, please include them with your application.

If you would like to learn more about the role, please contact Qing Yuan, Global Sourcing Governance Specialist at +45 3135 8227.

PLEASE NOTE: Our job advertisement is automatically and continuously renewed on job portals until the position is occupied. A renewal of the job advertisement does not indicate reposting, even if it may appear that way.

We look forward to hearing from you and learning more about how you can contribute to responsible sourcing at BioMar.

**About BioMar

**More than half of the seafood consumed globally comes from aquaculture. At BioMar, we are committed to developing and delivering efficient, sustainable, and healthy aquaculture feed solutions. Innovation and partnerships are at the heart of everything we do, and we are proud that our highly skilled people share this commitment. With feed factories in 13 countries across 4 continents, we supply feed to over 90 countries, supporting more than 45 different species of fish and shrimp. Join us on our journey to innovate aquaculture.

Powered by Partnership. Driven by Innovation.

title: Operations Lead - Computer Vision
description:
At Expedition Technology (EXP), we believe exceptional technology is built by exceptional teams. Our Operations Leads create the environment where those teams can thrive.

As an Operations Lead, you will be responsible for a portfolio of advanced technology programs and the engineers, scientists, and technical leaders who deliver them. You will operate at the intersection of execution excellence, people development, and program financial performance, helping teams transform ambitious technical ideas into capabilities that matter for national security missions.

This role is ideal for leaders who enjoy developing people, solving organizational challenges, improving execution, and building healthy, high-performing teams.

What You'll Do

  • Drive Execution Excellence
  • Oversee a portfolio of advanced technology programs across computer vision, signal processing, AI/ML, software, and related mission areas.
  • Ensure programs meet customer commitments, technical objectives, schedules, and budgets.
  • Identify risks early and help teams remove obstacles before they become major problems.
  • Partner with Product Owners, Scrum Masters, technical leads, and program leaders to continuously improve delivery performance.
  • Foster transparency, accountability, and data-driven decision making across your operation.
  • Lead People and Develop Leaders
  • Serve as the primary organizational leader for approximately 20-30 engineers and mission staff.
  • Support employee growth through coaching, feedback, recognition, career development, and promotion discussions.
  • Develop the next generation of technical, program, and organizational leaders.
  • Help create a culture where talented people can do their best work while continuing to grow professionally.
  • Partner with coaches, Human Resources, Talent Acquisition, and technical leaders to support employee success.
  • Own Program Financial Performance
  • Partner with program leaders, Project Control, Finance, and Mission Leads to understand and improve program financial performance.
  • Maintain visibility into revenue, margin, staffing, forecasting, and delivery trends across your portfolio.
  • Help teams understand the relationship between program decisions, customer outcomes, and business results.
  • Balance financial discipline with technical excellence, customer success, and employee development.
  • Build and Sustain Great Teams
  • Work with Mission Leads, Talent Acquisition, and technical leaders to ensure the right people are working on the right problems.
  • Participate actively in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, and onboarding.
  • Anticipate staffing needs and help shape workforce plans that support both current execution and future growth.
  • Strengthen collaboration across teams, programs, and mission areas.
  • Contribute to the long-term health and effectiveness of the organization.

What We're Looking For

Required

  • Active TS/SCI clearance.
  • Demonstrated success leading technical teams, programs, or organizations.
  • Experience supporting Department of Defense or Intelligence Community customers.
  • Experience managing program execution involving cost, schedule, staffing, risk, and customer commitments.
  • Experience developing employees, leaders, and high-performing teams.
  • Financial acumen, including experience with budgets, resource planning, forecasting, or program financial management.
  • Technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, including computer vision, signal processing, AI/ML, software engineering, sensor systems, or data platforms.
  • Strong communication, coaching, and organizational leadership skills.
  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, scientific, business, or related discipline.

Preferred

  • Experience leading multiple programs or teams simultaneously.
  • Experience managing organizations of approximately 20-30 technical staff.
  • Experience with applied AI/ML, computer vision, RF or signal processing, autonomous systems, or advanced software systems.
  • Experience recruiting, hiring, and developing technical employees.
  • Experience leading Agile teams and organizations.
  • Advanced degree in a technical, scientific, or business discipline.

title: Manager - Tax Data Analytics Engineer
description:
About Wolt


At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.


Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.


We are looking for an experienced Data Analytics Engineer to join our growing Tax Data Mart team. This role will be a key contributor to the team and will be responsible for building the tax data operations function for our Deliveroo and Wolt legal entities. This includes building and operating the data pipelines and infrastructure that power tax analytics and support decision-making across the company.


As DoorDash continues to grow its global footprint across multiple business lines, we are looking for a candidate with experience working with Tax teams to gather requirements, and designing scalable data processes to support them.. This person will grow our unique community via your blend of tax, data technology, and process improvement experience.


About the Role


You will be reporting to the Senior Manager of Tax Data & Operations, and play an integral role in DoorDash’s data function, owning the processes for ingesting, transforming, and controlling our data, ensuring accuracy, and making it available to analytics and business users.


As a member of this team, you will lead the design, implementation, and operation of data pipelines and related processes to support the Company’s exponential growth.


What you’ll be doing



  • Lead the collection of Tax Data and Reporting requirements through close relationships with Tax team counterparts

  • Design, build, and maintain scalable, reliable data pipelines (ETL/ELT) that serve data across the company

  • Develop and optimize data models and warehouse structures to support analytics and reporting

  • Participate in new business initiatives and identify their impact on existing data system(s) and processes.

  • Work closely with Analytics, Data Science, and business partners in the development and validation of new data sources.

  • Identify and document business, functional and technical requirements to support new business initiatives and to enhance existing system functionality.

  • Leverage AI & AI assisted tooling to build and automate recurring data tasks & pipelines.

  • Monitor data quality, reliability, and observability, and resolve data-related issues for our internal business partners.

  • Participate in defining the Company’s data tooling needs, including the maintenance of existing systems.

  • Prepare documentation related to our data systems and processes.

  • Share knowledge and best practices with engineers and analysts across the team.


Our humble expectations



  • You have 7+ years of experience in a Tax data & technology or similar role.

  • Experience using Data Build Tool (DBT) or a similar product to manage data flows.

  • Experience using Claude, Cursor and similar AI tools.

  • You are an expert at using SQL with experience using Snowflake.

  • Proficiency in Python (or a comparable language) for building data pipelines.

  • Experience with modern data stack and orchestration tools such as Airflow, Spark, or Kafka.

  • You have strong attention to detail and analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

  • You’re an independently motivated person with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize work independently.

  • You have excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Project management experience, including creation of project plans, milestones, and due dates.

  • Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related degree.


Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion


We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That’s why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

title: Survey Project Manager
description:

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage the fielding of the survey from survey launch through to fielding completion; ensuring that surveys go live, appropriately collect data, target the correct population. Fine-tune the fielding approach as necessary
  • Coordinate with the programming team to ensure that questionnaires are programmed accurately and meet researcher’s specifications
  • Perform quality checks on the programmed survey
  • Troubleshoot project issues and document processes
  • Work with sample vendors during fielding as needed
  • Concurrently handle projects to accommodate deadlines

What You’ll Need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree
  • 2+ years work experience managing online surveys
  • Working knowledge of MS Office Suite; familiarity with Confirmit software
  • Understanding of computer programming and technical familiarity with scripting (JavaScript, jScript.NET) is an asset
  • Strong project management experience
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, juggle priorities and be self-directed
  • Attention to detail and demonstration of commitment to the accuracy and completeness of information
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to tailor communication style
  • Willingness to develop expertise by client, product, or survey type

Shift Timing:

Benefits:

title: Associate Director, Operational Excellence
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.




Position Summary

The Associate Director, Operational Excellence leads the development and implementation of continuous improvement (CI) and operational excellence (OE) strategies, programs, and practices for the Bothell Cell Therapy manufacturing site. Reporting to the Director, Strategy & Business Operations, this role manages the operational excellence team and provides expert guidance to site leadership on deploying continuous improvement principles and tools in a GMP-regulated, patient focused environment. This role drives a continuous improvement culture through implementation of OE practices and behaviors in a harmonized manner across site and network functions that aligns with the broader BMS operational excellence framework. In partnership with leaders across the site, this role leverages the OE skillset to implement improvements in right-first-time performance, turnaround time, capacity, and cost, ensuring these efforts tie directly to strategic site objectives and deliver sustained value for the site.


Key Responsibilities

  • In partnership with the Director, Strategy & Business Operations and site leadership, develop and execute the site operational excellence strategy and roadmap aligned with site annual and long term goals
  • Embed OE capability and a performance management culture at the site by deploying and sustaining the site operating system (visual management, lean leadership, etc.) in alignment with the broader BMS OE framework
  • Align site KPIs and tier management dashboards with network and site strategy and objectives
  • Manage the OE team’s book of work including contribution to strategic initiatives, intake of ad hoc requests, prioritization across competing efforts, benefits tracking, and reporting to leadership
  • Lead and coach the OE team, setting goals, allocating resources, driving delivery, and developing skills
  • Use data analysis to enable site identification, selection and implementation of OE initiatives
  • Partner with site leaders to deliver measurable improvements in key site metrics tied to strategic objectives
  • Advise senior leaders as the site's CI expert, guiding them in understanding and deploying CI principles
  • Facilitate high-impact, complex improvement workshops, kaizens, and Lean Six Sigma/DMAIC projects
  • Strengthen continuous improvement competencies across the organization through training,workshops, facilitation, role modeling, coaching, and constructive feedback
  • Represent and advocate for the site in network and global operational excellence forums

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Operations, Business, or equivalent discipline
  • 10+ years of experience in operations, manufacturing, continuous improvement, or related functions
  • 5+ years hands on experience applying operational excellence principles
  • 3+ years of experience leading people or teams through direct or project/matrix leadership
  • Demonstrated proficiency in, and passion for, OE methodology, tools and manufacturing process improvement (e.g. lean leadership, visual management, kaizen, DMAIC, structured problem solving)
  • Demonstrated success leading continuous improvement initiatives to achieve strategic results
  • Strong data driven analysis and decision making skills
  • Working knowledge of GMP or similar quality-regulated environments
  • Demonstrated application of project management and change management principles in achieving results
  • Strong relationship builder with the ability to drive alignment across a range of levels and functions
  • Exceptional skills in coaching, facilitation, and analytical problem solving
  • Advanced written/verbal communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint, and Outlook

Preferred

  • Experience in a regulated high tech/manufacturing industry
  • Understanding of cGMP regulations and FDA guidance applicable to biopharma or medical devices
  • Experience in cell therapy, gene therapy, biologics, or other personalized or small-batch manufacturing
  • Strong business acumen with ability to strategically connect continuous improvement to business value
  • Experience with data mining and data analytics for KPI reporting
  • Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Shingo or equivalent certifications
  • Experience building or sustaining a site operating system or daily management system
  • Familiarity with deviation, CAPA, and change control processes
  • Training or certification in change management or project management


We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

Compensation Overview:

Bothell - WA - US: $184,270 - $223,294


The starting pay range(s) listed above is for full-time employees (FTE). You may also be eligible for additional discretionary incentive cash and stock opportunities. We determine starting pay thoughtfully – carefully considering the nature of the role, required skills, work location, schedule and the knowledge and experience you bring. Final compensation is guided by pay equity principles and applicable employment laws. Compensation programs are reviewed on an ongoing basis and may be adjusted over time to reflect evolving market factors, and individual, team or Company performance.


Benefits:


Subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans then in effect, you may be eligible to participate in our comprehensive benefit plans – including wellbeing support, retirement and financial protection benefits, and insurance offerings (medical, dental, vision, life and disability).


U.S.-based exempt employees are eligible for Flexible Time Off (FTO), which provides paid time off without a set accrual limit, subject to manager approval, along with 11 paid company holidays each year.


Non-exempt employees, RayzeBio employees, and employees located in Puerto Rico receive 160 hours of paid vacation annually for new hires (subject to manager approval), 11 paid company holidays, and 3 optional holidays.


Depending on eligibility, employees may also have access to additional time-off benefits, including paid sick leave, up to two paid volunteer days per year, summer hours flexibility, and leaves of absence for medical, personal, parental, caregiver, bereavement, or military needs. Eligible employees also enjoy an annual Global Shutdown between Christmas Day and New Year's Day.


U.S.-based job seekers can explore full benefit offerings at

title: Van Data Analist naar Data Engineer
description:
Je bent data analist en wil meer bouwen aan de achterkant: stabiele datapipelines, slimme modellen en betrouwbare platforms. In ons 1,5-jarig programma groei je stap voor stap naar de rol van volwaardig Data Engineer. Je werkt projectmatig bij een opdrachtgever, met ruimte om jouw route te kiezen. Blijf jezelf voor: we helpen je vooruit, op jouw manier. Na 1,5 jaar kun je na jouw opleiding in dienst treden bij de opdrachtgever!

Dit ga je doen

  • Je volgt een leerroute richting Data Engineer en past die direct toe in je opdracht.
  • Je ontwerpt en bouwt datapipelines (batch en/of realtime) en zet ETL-processen op, dit zodat je geen frustratie meer ervaart omdat je zelf bepaalt hoe duurzaam en robuust het gebouwd wordt. Dit doe je samen met collega's.
  • Je werkt mee aan het ontwerpen en bouwen van een dataplatform binnen een Microsoft Azure omgeving, waarbij je data uit verschillende bronnen samenbrengt en ontsluit. Dit doe je middels de Medaillion architectuur.
  • Je modelleert data en levert datasets op die klaar zijn voor rapportages en analyses.
  • Je borgt kwaliteit met testen, monitoring en heldere documentatie, bijvoorbeeld via Microsoft Purview.
  • Je stemt af met stakeholders; de inhoud verschilt per opdrachtgever en project

Je bent fit for the job als je...

  • je minimaal 3 jaar ervaring hebt als data analist, data scientist of BI developer.
  • je een hbo- of wo-diploma hebt behaald in Informatica, Data Science, (Technische) Bedrijfskunde, (Toegepaste) Wiskunde, Econometrie of vergelijkbaar.
  • je een stevige basis hebt in Power BI en Python en/of SQL
  • je ervaring hebt opgedaan met data modelleren binnen een cloud (Microsoft Azure) omgeving is een pré.
  • je enige ervaring hebt met Azure Datafactory, Databricks/Spark, dbt, CI/CD (Azure DevOps), Tests & Monitoring en/of Git workflows of soortgelijke tools zijn een sterke pré.
  • Je jezelf committeert aan een ontwikkeltraject van 1,5 jaar en beschikbaar bent voor 36-40 uur per week.

Dit krijg je van ons

We bieden een salaris tussen de 3.800 en 6.000 euro bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week passend bij je ervaring en expertise.

Vanuit jouw rol als data analist groei je op opdracht naar een data engineer. Wij zorgen voor passende opdrachten die deze ontwikkeling stap voor stap mogelijk maken. Het ontwikkelprogramma ondersteunt je hierin en versnelt jouw groei naar een volwaardig data engineer. Je volgt praktische trainingen waarin je erkende certificeringen behaalt richting de Azure stack, krijgt coaching van je performance manager en maakt deel uit van een groep die dezelfde ontwikkeling doormaakt. Juist door samen te leren en ervaringen te delen, versnellen jullie elkaars groei.

Klik hier voor onze onepager met alle belangrijke informatie die je nodig hebt voordat je besluit te solliciteren op dit programma!

  • Creëer je ideale thuiswerkplek met onze vergoeding
  • Leer van Olympische topsporters hoe je topprestaties levert én volhoudt
  • Trap je werkdag af op 2 wielen. Lease een (elektrische) fiets en blijf in beweging.
  • Een premievrij pensioen. Goed geregeld!
  • Boost je salaris met onze verschillende bonussen
  • Met 25 vakantiedagen heb je alle tijd voor jouw avonturen
  • Met kennissessies en webinars blijf je bij in je vakgebied
  • Op tijd naar je afspraak in je (elektrische) leaseauto
  • Ontwikkel je onbeperkt met de Team EIFFEL Academy trainingen
  • Mobiliteitsbudget: jij bepaalt hoe je reist

Dit zijn wij

Groot in interim capaciteit en sterk in consultancy, dat is EIFFEL. We versterken organisaties precies waar dat nodig is, of het nu gaat om een bank, gemeente of ziekenhuis. Dat doen we door slimmer te werken, ideeën van papier naar praktijk te brengen en de juiste mensen op de juiste plek te zetten. Voor grote transformaties én snelle oplossingen. Van start up tot multinational: als professional bij EIFFEL kom je overal binnen.

Binnen team Technology werken we in twee focusgebieden: Data & Analytics en IT. Jij maakt onderdeel uit van Team Data & Analytics, samen met zo'n 35 professionals binnen een unit van 100 specialisten. Onze cultuur is business casual: hard werken, veel humor en volop ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

Het mooie van Technology? We werken niet sectorgebonden. IT en data raken elke sector, daardoor vind je bij ons altijd een project waar jouw kennis, ideeën en energie perfect tot hun recht komen.

Op vrijdag werken we samen in ons clubhuis in Arnhem. Deze dag staat in het teken van kennisdeling, sparren met collega's en het versterken van de verbinding met Team EIFFEL. Verwacht een opdrachtgever je die dag op locatie? Dan gaat dat natuurlijk voor.

EIFFEL is onderdeel van Team EIFFEL: een community van 3.000+ experts, verspreid over 24 kennisdomeinen en actief bij 600+ opdrachtgevers. Groot in schaal, maar persoonlijk in aanpak. Ons clubhuis staat open voor iedereen die zichzelf wil blijven ontwikkelen en voor wil blijven.

#LI-GH1

Deze skills komen van pas

  • SQL
  • RESTful API development
  • Kennis van programma's en portfolio's
  • Kennis van BI-tools
  • ETL processen

Je werkt gestructureerd, denkt in oplossingen en vindt het leuk om dingen te automatiseren. Nieuwsgierigheid en eigenaarschap helpen je om snel meters te maken als Data Engineer.

title: PT Recreation Attendant
description:

Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort—the resort that’s redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel.
