title: Scientist (EO/IR Image Analysis)
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SCIENTIST (EO/IR IMAGE ANALYSIS)

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Scientist of EO/IR image analysis and pattern recognition for Rocket Lab Optical Systems worksite in Tucson, AZ, you will develop, validate, and deploy algorithms for advanced image processing, object detection, and tracking EO/IR space payloads.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO

  • Develop, validate, and optimize algorithms for EO/IR sensor data, including a broad range of image processing techniques such as noise reduction, image enhancement, image registration, correction, and pattern recognition.
  • Apply pattern recognition techniques to detect, classify, and track objects in EO/IR data for mission-critical applications.
  • Build and enhance modeling and simulation libraries, including the development and utilization of image simulators to generate synthetic EO/IR data for algorithm development, testing, and validation in support of EO/IR payload missions.
  • Support and enhance existing operational programs, including maintaining and improving deployed algorithms, troubleshooting fielded systems, and ensuring ongoing system performance and reliability.
  • Implement and test algorithm improvements in deployed systems to support ongoing mission needs.
  • Apply strong programming skills (MATLAB, Python, C/C++) to develop robust solutions for real-world mission problems.
  • Analyze large and complex EO/IR datasets to extract features, identify patterns, and assess algorithm performance.
  • Develop and document software tools for data collection, analysis, and performance assessment.
  • Decompose high-level customer requirements into algorithm and subsystem requirements to inform software and systems engineering execution.
  • Document and present algorithm performance results to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including government customers.
  • Attend technical interchange meetings and represent the organization in matters pertaining to project development.
  • Provide status on assigned tasks and program schedules.
  • Support travel or off-site work, as needed.

YOU’LL BRING THSES QUALIFICATIONS AS A SCIENTIST

  • Bachelor's degree in physics, optical sciences, computer science, mathematics, electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline with demonstrated experience in image processing or EO/IR systems.
  • Active U.S. Government Security Clearance with TS/SCI eligibility; U.S. citizenship required.
  • 12+ years of professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience with MATLAB, Python, and/or C/C++ for analysis, modeling, simulation, or algorithm development.
  • Strong experience designing, implementing, testing, and optimizing algorithms for EO/IR sensors, with a focus on image processing and pattern recognition.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document technical work and present results to diverse audiences.
  • Ability to contribute to the completion of programs and project milestones.

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE

  • Master's degree or PhD in physics, optical sciences, computer science, mathematics, electrical engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience with pattern recognition methods for EO/IR applications, including feature extraction, classification, and tracking.
  • Experience with sensor calibration procedures (radiometric, geometric, temporal) for EO/IR systems.
  • Expertise in modeling and simulation, including multiple EO/IR phenomenologies.
  • Experience across all phases of product development, including proposal design architectures, requirements generation, design development, integration, verification, and transition to production.
  • Experience managing or leading others in a technical and/or functional capacity within an engineering environment.

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

*As of June 30, 2026. Adams Street Partners’ methodology to calculate Assets Under Management (AUM) is based on fund net asset value (NAV), plus unfunded commitments, plus leverage, but excluding the effect of subscription lines of credit. The prior AUM methodology was based on investor commitments minus commitments to fully liquidated underlying partnerships. Such change in methodology was effective July 2026; however, for periods shown prior to December 31, 2025, Adams Street continues to use the previous methodology. This updated methodology more closely aligns with (i) the amount of assets managed on behalf of investors and (ii) the amount of capital available to make direct and/or partnership investments. Amounts stated by investment advisers in regulatory filings (“regulatory AUM”) have a prescribed methodology, which may, in some circumstances, differ from the methodology such adviser uses for other purposes, including marketing efforts. description:
**Grade UE06: £34,610 to £39,906 per annum**

**School of Regeneration and Repair / Centre for Regenerative Medicine**

**Full Time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed term: for 24 months**

**The Opportunity:**

Together we can do great things. Be part of something bigger.

Join the University of Edinburgh and you’ll be making a difference to everything around you. Be part of something bigger – where you’ll do meaningful work, grow and progress, be rewarded and recognised, and benefit from our strong commitment to your wellbeing. There are so many reasons to join us.

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We look for the best in the field across all disciplines and provide a working environment where academics can develop their careers and passion for their chosen subject area. We offer the full range of academic roles and have a genuine focus on our students performance and wellbeing.

**Help develop new optical technologies for measuring the mechanical properties of living cells and tissues.**

We are looking for a Research Assistant to support the development of optical elastography technologies that use light to measure the biomechanics of cells, organoids and tissues. Building on our group’s advances in optical coherence elastography, you will help translate a new quantitative imaging approach into practical, commercial applications.

Working with the Principal Investigator and a Postdoctoral Research Associate, you will fabricate and mechanically characterise soft gels, undertake biomechanical and optical elastography measurements, support prototype assembly and testing, and collect, analyse and document research data. You will also contribute to research dissemination, knowledge exchange and engagement with academic and industry partners.

You should hold a degree in biomedical engineering, mechanical engineering or an equivalent discipline. You will have experience of relevant engineering methods, gathering data using defined research procedures, computational data analysis and preparing clear reports. Strong communication, teamwork and problem-solving skills are also essential. Experience of mechanical measurements, biomaterial characterisation, 3D printing or prototyping would be advantageous.

title: AVP, Salesforce Administrator
description:
ABOUT LOWELL FIVE

With $1.9 billion in assets, over 200 employees and 16 banking and lending locations throughout the Merrimack Valley and Southern New Hampshire, Lowell Five Bank is honored to play a vital role in the economic vitality of the region. Our employees are engaged in myriad community boards and organizations with the Bank’s support. ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Salesforce Platform Administration (Financial Services Cloud)

  • Administer the day-to-day Salesforce FSC environment: users, profiles, roles, permission sets, security, page layouts, record types, and validation rules
  • Configure and maintain FSC-specific capabilities to support retail, lending, and relationship-banking workflows
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy Salesforce releases and AppExchange tools; perform regular system audits and prepare for upgrades
  • Maintain data integrity through routine audits, deduplication, and data-quality monitoring

Analytics, Reporting, and Marketing Automation

  • Design and maintain reports and dashboards in Analytics Studio to track KPIs and support executive and branch-level decision-making
  • Administer Marketing Cloud Account Engagement for marketing automation—managing lead flows, campaigns, scoring, and alignment between marketing and CRM data
  • Ensure clean, accurate CRM data feeds the Bank’s broader Business Intelligence and executive reporting

Platform Backup and Resiliency

  • Administer and maintain the Bank’s Salesforce backup and recovery solution; monitor backup jobs, verify data recoverability, and perform periodic restore testing
  • Ensure backup and retention practices align with the Bank’s business continuity, disaster-recovery, and regulatory requirements

Integrations and Data Movement

  • Serve as the administrator and steward for key integrations between Salesforce and the Bank’s core banking, loan origination, mortgage, digital banking, and telephony platforms
  • Manage current data-load processes, monitor and resolve data-load errors, and maintain documented procedures

Business Analysis and Solution Design

  • Partner with business units (Retail, Lending, Marketing, Risk/BSA, IT) to gather, analyze, and document requirements and translate them into scalable solutions
  • Perform gap analysis to determine configuration vs. light code vs. third-party tools; create process flow diagrams, data dictionaries, and user stories with acceptance criteria
  • Build and enhance declarative automation (Flows, validation rules); read and understand basic Apex and SOQL/SOSL to collaborate on more complex solutions
  • Coordinate user acceptance testing (UAT) and manage change and adoption

Compliance, Security, and Support

  • Apply a security-first, least-privilege approach to protect customer information in a regulated banking environment
  • Maintain auditability, documentation, and retention practices aligned to regulatory requirements; support vendor due-diligence activities
  • Provide user support and training; build and champion a super-user network to drive adoption

Please note this job description is not designed to cover a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change over time.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field (equivalent experience considered)
  • 2+ years of hands-on Salesforce administration experience, ideally in banking or financial services
  • Proficient with report writing and dashboards creation (Analytics Studio or comparable) and administering marketing automation (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement or comparable)
  • Working knowledge managing data loads/integrations and troubleshooting data-quality issues
  • Demonstrated business-analysis skills: requirements gathering, process mapping, and UAT
  • Excellent communication skills, able to translate between business and technical audiences
  • Extremely organized, ability to multi-task, prioritize, and adapt to change
  • High degree of initiative, dependability, and ability to work independently
  • Must be willing and able to report to Headquarters in Tewksbury five full days a week

Preferred

  • Working knowledge of Salesforce Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
  • Familiarity administering a Salesforce backup/recovery solution (e.g., OwnBackup or comparable)
  • Exposure with cloud data platforms and building/integrating data via APIs
  • Ability to read basic Apex/Visualforce and use SOQL/SOSL
  • Strong data skills: intermediate-to-advanced Excel and working knowledge of SQL
  • Knowledge of banking regulations, data privacy, and compliance practices

SALARY RANGE

The annual base salary range for this position is $95,000 to $115,000. This range reflects the Bank’s good faith estimate for this role at the time of posting. The Bank may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range, and the range may be modified in the future. Actual compensation will be determined based on factors, such as but not limited to, relevant education, experience, and skills.

title: Senior Executive
description:
About the Suite

The B Suite is a membership organization for those identifying as people of color. Our community, made up of Black and Brown talent, has expertise across several functional areas including digital media, human resources, finance, marketing, fundraising, and more. B Suite facilities matching between our Executives and clients for fractional, interim, and consulting opportunities.

While our client base and projects will always vary, you can expect projects to last an average of three months for approximately 10-25 hours per week. We work across industries with many clients in tech, finance, nonprofits, education, media, and social impact sectors.

About the Executive Role

A Senior Executive guides high-level vision, leads strategic planning sessions, and owns client outcomes end-to-end. You serve as a trusted advisor to C-suite and board-level stakeholders.

Requirements

We maintain a strict and rigorous vetting process to ensure quality matches for our client base. All executives are required to meet the following criteria to be eligible to join the Suite as a Senior Executive:

  • Minimum of 10 years of specialized, professional experience
  • Experience as a senior or executive leader (e.g. Managing Director, AVP, VP, Chief, etc.)
  • Significant experience in team leadership, people management, coaching, and staff development
  • Proven success in setting org-wide vision and goals, driving organizational transformation, and influencing at the highest levels
  • Superior strategic thinking, stakeholder management, and communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage large projects
  • Comfort with collaboration tools and virtual work environments
  • Commitment to B Suites values: equity, transparency, and antiracist leadership

Key Responsibilities

While every project varies in scope, most client engagements will require the following responsibilities.

  • Collaborate with clients and project leads to refine project scopes and objectives, determining clear action plans for each engagement
  • Thought partner with clients to plan projects, set goals, and solve business challenges.
  • Regularly meet with clients, document progress towards goals, understand internal shifts and updates, and provide subject-matter support
  • Define strategic priorities, success metrics, and long-term roadmaps
    Advise on organizational design, change management, and stakeholder alignment
  • Facilitate board- or C-level discussions, presenting insights and recommendations
  • Oversee project health, guiding Executives on delivery and course-correcting as needed
  • Communicate proactively: raise risks, update progress, and adjust plans as needed
  • Set clear expectations regarding availability and communication for the engagement, immediately communicating any updates or change
  • Model mission-driven leadership: surface systemic biases, call out power imbalances, and advance equitable practices.

Compensation & Structure

Starting compensation for Senior Executives is $100/hour. All executives are 1099 contractors. All executives are eligible for referral bonuses and free coaching and development.

Anti-Racism

Historically, people of color, women, people with disabilities, and LGBTQIA2S+ individuals have faced insurmountable oppression while navigating their professional lives and careers. At the B Suite, we know talent is boundless and not dependent on any specific identity or story. Our organization exists to carve out opportunity for the most targeted and harmed of these groups: people of color. Statistically, within all marginalized groups, no one suffers more than Black and Brown people. By centering these identities in our work, we can work towards dismantling systems of oppression that impact all marginalized groups. To that end, the B Suite exists to elevate people of color and our membership organization is exclusively for those identifying as such.

title: Senior Systems Engineer II
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

SENIOR SYSTEMS ENGINEER II

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Senior Systems Engineer II for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Tucson, AZ, you will be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of advanced space payloads in support of Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Support the development of system architecture for space-based optical instruments, subsystems, and payloads on airborne and space platforms, with emphasis on electrical architecture and controls integration
  • Define, decompose, and manage system requirements with focus on electrical behavior, control functions, subsystem interactions, and overall system performance
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, interface control documents, electrical interface definitions, concepts of operations, state and mode descriptions, test plans, and verification artifacts
  • Support development of electrical and functional architectures, including command and telemetry flow, power distribution, control logic, signal paths, timing, synchronization, and subsystem interaction
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, firmware, and test teams to ensure the electrical architecture and controls implementation align with system requirements and mission intent
  • Support the development, integration, and testing of space payloads to be integrated on spacecraft platforms
  • Support hardware and software development teams with system-level test planning, debugging, integration, and execution of verification procedures; analyze data and recommend design refinements
  • Participate in hardware and software verification and validation activities related to system behavior, electrical performance, controls implementation, and interface compliance
  • Support architecture trades involving sensors, motor control, embedded electronics, power systems, command and data handling, and subsystem interfaces
  • Participate in technical interchange meetings and project discussions with internal teams, customers, and external partners as needed
  • Identify, assess, and help mitigate technical risks related to electrical architecture, controls implementation, and subsystem integration
  • Support travel or off-site work as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS YOU’LL BRING AS SENIOR SYSTEMS ENGINEER II:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, systems, or aerospace engineering; or other technical discipline
  • 8+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years supporting development programs and 2+ years in technical leadership, CAM, IPTL, or equivalent role
  • Demonstrated systems engineering experience with emphasis on electrical architecture, subsystem integration, and controls focused development
  • Strong electrical engineering background supporting complex aerospace, payload, avionics, or instrument systems
  • Experience developing system requirements, interface definitions, and verification approaches for complex systems
  • Strong background in electrical interfaces, control functions, avionics integration, or subsystem architecture
  • Experience with requirements management and modeling tools such as JAMA, DOORS, Cameo, or similar tools
  • Experience working across hardware, software, and firmware development throughout the lifecycle
  • Familiarity with command and telemetry interfaces, power architectures, signal interfaces, timing, synchronization, and control logic
  • Experience supporting integration and test, including troubleshooting electrical or controls-related issues at the subsystem or system level
  • Strong ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical, interface, and system technical documentation
  • Familiarity with aerospace development standards, environmental testing, and mission assurance practices

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Current SSBI clearance
  • EO/IR payload integration experience
  • Experience with spacecraft bus interfaces, payload electrical integration, avionics architecture, or embedded electronics
  • Experience with pointing, stabilization, gimbals, motion control, focus/control electronics, or other closed-loop control applications
  • Experience defining or troubleshooting electrical architectures for sensors, actuators, motors, power systems, or embedded controllers
  • Hands-on expertise leading troubleshooting and resolution of system-level electrical or controls-related issues
  • Demonstrated experience working with minimal supervision in complex projects
  • Experience in astronomy, physics, or remote sensing
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and explain complex implementation processes to other organization members
  • Strong communication, task management, and cross-functional coordination skills

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

Important information:

To conform to U.S. Government space technology export regulations, including the International Traffic in Arms Regulations (ITAR), Rocket Lab Employees must be a U.S. citizen, lawful U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum, or be eligible to obtain the required authorizations from the U.S. Department of State and/or the U.S. Department of Commerce, as applicable. title: Data Engineer (Rif.1146)
description:
Per una rinomata tech company italiana in continua espansione, specializzata in soluzioni avanzate di Data Engineering e nello sviluppo di piattaforme software ad alta complessità, si ricerca un/una Data Engineer da inserire su progetti strategici in ambito big data, cloud e sviluppo di architetture dati scalabili. La risorsa contribuirà alla realizzazione di soluzioni tecnologiche innovative, lavorando su sistemi distribuiti e framework moderni per la gestione, l’elaborazione e l’ottimizzazione dei dati.

Il ruolo prevede un buon livello di autonomia nell’analisi e implementazione di funzionalità complesse, nel rispetto degli standard aziendali relativi al ciclo di vita del software. La persona selezionata avrà l’opportunità di contribuire alla progettazione tecnica delle soluzioni, ottimizzare le performance dei sistemi e collaborare con team altamente qualificati in un contesto tecnologico dinamico e orientato alla crescita professionale.

La figura sarà inserita, nel primo anno, su un importante progetto ad alta visibilità che richiede attività in presenza (con possibilità di usufruire, se fuori sede, di alloggio, trasporti e pasti a carico dell’azienda).

Successivamente, potrà essere coinvolta in ulteriori progettualità nazionali e internazionali, con possibilità di lavorare in modalità full remote.

Attività principali:

  • Analizzare, progettare e implementare funzionalità complesse in autonomia, garantendo qualità, scalabilità e manutenibilità delle soluzioni sviluppate.
  • Sviluppare soluzioni software e data pipeline aderendo agli standard aziendali relativi al Software Development Life Cycle.
  • Partecipare alla progettazione tecnica delle funzionalità, contribuendo alla definizione delle soluzioni architetturali sotto il coordinamento dei referenti tecnici.
  • Lavorare su tecnologie big data e framework distribuiti, contribuendo alla gestione, trasformazione ed elaborazione di grandi volumi di dati.
  • Comprendere, monitorare e ottimizzare le performance di sistema, individuando eventuali colli di bottiglia e proponendo interventi migliorativi.
  • Collaborare con team cross-funzionali, contribuendo all’integrazione delle soluzioni con ambienti cloud, containerizzati e applicativi.
  • Definire in autonomia le priorità operative dei task assegnati, sulla base dei requisiti progettuali, delle scadenze e del contesto tecnico.

Requisiti richiesti:

  • Esperienza pregressa nel ruolo di Data Engineer, Software Engineer o in ruoli affini su progetti data-intensive o ad alta complessità tecnologica.
  • Conoscenza di Hadoop, Apache Spark e/o framework simili per l’elaborazione distribuita dei dati.
  • Buona conoscenza di almeno un linguaggio di programmazione, preferibilmente Java.
  • Familiarità con almeno un cloud provider tra AWS, Microsoft Azure o Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarità con soluzioni di containerizzazione, ad esempio Docker e/o Kubernetes.
  • Capacità di analizzare requisiti tecnici e funzionali, traducendoli in soluzioni software robuste ed efficienti.
  • Attitudine a lavorare secondo standard strutturati di sviluppo software, testing, versionamento e qualità del codice.

Requisiti preferenziali:

  • Laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria Informatica, Informatica o discipline affini.
  • Conoscenza di Spring Boot.
  • Conoscenza di Apache Camel.
  • Conoscenza dei protocolli HTTP e delle logiche di integrazione tra sistemi.
  • Esperienza o interesse verso attività di project management, coordinamento tecnico o gestione delle priorità progettuali.
  • Esperienza in contesti consulenziali, tech company o progetti enterprise complessi.

Completano il profilo ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, attitudine al problem solving, predisposizione al lavoro in team, curiosità tecnologica, proattività e forte orientamento all’apprendimento continuo.

Range retributivo annuo previsto: 38.000 – 48.000 euro, in funzione del livello di autonomia, seniority tecnica e ampiezza delle responsabilità.

Sede di Lavoro:

Provincia di Roma (primo anno in presenza con eventuali rimborsi spese e successivamente full remote)

L’offerta è rivolta a tutte le persone, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. 198/2006 e dei D.Lgs. 215/2003 e 216/2003.

I dati personali saranno trattati ai sensi del Reg. UE 2016/679 (GDPR). Informativa privacy.

title: Editor II, Network Desk - Northeast Region
description:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions

  • Application Deadline: Monday, October 19th, at 5:00 pm ET.
  • Submission Instructions: Please submit a cover letter in addition to your resume including a direct link to a story (audio or digital) that you edited and were particularly proud of. Please describe any challenges you encountered, and call out the contributions you made.

Intro to Position

The Network Desk represents NPR’s strategic commitment to deepening, broadening, and transforming how we partner with Member stations and Regional Hubs. As the Northeast Regional Editor, you will serve as the essential bridge between local station newsrooms across the Northeast and national NPR news programs and digital platforms. In this role, you will help identify, curate, and elevate distinctive local reporting to national audiences while helping stations plan and execute ambitious enterprise and breaking news coverage.

The ideal candidate brings a collaborative editorial mindset, sharp line-editing skills across audio and text, and a commitment to expanding the diversity of sources and stories emerging from the region.

NPR defines its Northeast Region as ME, NH, VT, MA, RI, CT, NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD, and DC.

This is a union represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with SAG-AFTRA.

This is an NPR editorial role covered under the terms of the NPR Ethics Handbook.All editorial staff are bound by this guidance. Editorial staff are defined as staff members who play a role in shaping the journalistic or creative direction of NPR's content, including events.

Responsibilities

  • Network Editorial Coordination: Communicate and collaborate daily with journalists, news directors, and editors across Northeast regional hubs and Member stations to identify, develop, and coordinate coverage with national resonance.
  • Content Editing & Quality Assurance: Edit, fact-check, and supervise the preparation of multiplatform material (audio, digital, broadcast) from station reporters and freelancers, ensuring all work meets NPR’s journalistic standards of fairness, accuracy, and technical quality.
  • Breaking News Leadership: Coordinate rapid-response breaking news coverage from the region, directing station updates and dispatches for national shows, digital platforms, and hourly newscasts.
  • Show & Platform Integration: Maintain ongoing communication with NPR daily news magazines (Morning Edition, All Things Considered, Here & Now), podcasts, and the digital news desk regarding story length, angles, framing, and scheduling.
  • Coverage Planning & Horizon Scanning: Track evolving regional news cycles, maintain forward-looking editorial calendars, and spot emerging cultural, political, and systemic trends across the Northeast.
  • Editorial Mentorship & Training: Partner with Regional Hubs to conduct workshops, coaching sessions, and feedback discussions that strengthen station reporting capabilities and familiarize partners with NPR production workflows.
  • Inclusive Sourcing & Story Development: Champion story ideas that reflect the full demographic and geographical diversity of the Northeast, actively expanding regional source networks.
  • Desk Administration & Contributor Management: Coordinate administrative desk workflows, including processing freelancer agreements, story commissions, and reporter filing payments in accordance with established agreements.
  • Network Collaboration: Partner with fellow regional editors and Network Desk leadership to refine communication pipelines, eliminate operational silos, and improve newsroom workflows.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Required Skills

  • 5+ years of professional journalism experience at with a reputable news organization.
  • 3+ years of experience editing regional or national daily news coverage across audio and digital platforms.
  • Demonstrated track record editing breaking news under tight deadlines with precision and journalistic integrity.
  • Proven experience editing enterprise, investigative, or feature journalism, guiding stories from pitch to final audio/digital production.
  • Sound journalistic judgment rooted in rigorous fact-checking, balance, fairness, and adherence to editorial ethics.
  • Track record of building collaborative partnerships with decentralized reporters, freelancers, or station partners.
  • Experience editing for both the ear (audio broadcast/podcasting) and the eye (digital news writing).
  • Willingness to travel up to 10% of the time for visits to member stations and other stakeholders.

Preferred Skills

  • Prior reporting or editing experience within the public media system (Member stations, regional news hubs, or public media collaborations).
  • Deep familiarity with the socio-political, economic, and cultural landscape of the Northeast region.
  • Bilingual or multilingual fluency relevant to regional coverage areas.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Editorial & Audio Craft: Exceptional news-writing, line-editing, and sound-rich audio structuring skills.
  • Collaborative Leadership: Ability to offer constructive, empathetic, and clear feedback to journalists of varied experience levels.
  • Adaptability & Calm Under Pressure: Ability to prioritize multiple assignments and navigate breaking news calmly and decisively.
  • Cross-Platform Agility: Comfort navigating modern digital content management systems, audio editing tools, and communication platforms (Slack, AirTable, etc.).

Education Requirement

  • Bachelor's degree in journalism, communications, or a related field, or equivalent relevant work experience.

Work Location

  • Remote Required: This is a remote required role. This role includes duties that are better performed or are required to be performed in a designated location OUTSIDE of an NPR facility. The employee is required to work at a designated remote work location within the designated coverage area: ME, NH, VT, MA, RI, CT, NY, NJ, PA, DE, MD or DC.

Job Type

  • This is a full time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S. based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $110,000 - $112,000 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

Benefits: NPR offers access to comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

Does this sound like you? If so, we want to hear from you.

The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

$110,000—$112,000 USD

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Senior Software Engineer – Data Plaftorm

Location: Cork, Ireland (Hybrid – 3 days in office, 2 from home)
Industry: Financial Technology

An exciting opportunity has opened up for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join a growing FinTech company and contribute to building their data platform. Some products already run on it, others are in the process of being moved over, and new products will be built on it from the start. You will need to have shipped and run production backend systems and you need to care whether the data is correct.

Key Responsibilities
  • Event-driven ingestion: Build reliable data ingestion services that handle retries, redelivery, reordering and late changes while ensuring exactly-once results.
  • Versioned APIs & contracts: Develop secure, tested and versioned APIs, SDKs and data feeds that can evolve without disrupting downstream teams.
  • Accurate, reproducible data: Build point-in-time history and precise decimal calculations into the platform so results can always be reproduced.
  • Scalable & cost-efficient: Scale services and storage significantly while maintaining performance and controlling costs through measurement and load testing.
  • Self-service onboarding: Build tooling and services that enable new products and customers to onboard quickly within a multi-tenant platform.
  • AI/ML-ready data: Ensure customer data is accessible for AI and ML while maintaining strong contracts, tenant separation and reproducibility.
  • Built-in operability: Implement SLOs, monitoring, alerting and CI controls, while taking ownership of incidents and preventing recurrence.
Requirements
  • Ideally 8-10 years experience building software, including backend services you designed, deployed and ran in production.
  • Backend development experience with Python, C#/.NET, Java or similar. Python and C# are the main technologies used.
  • Strong distributed systems knowledge, including idempotency, concurrency, ordering, retries and exactly-once processing.
  • Strong testing practices, including unit/integration testing and CI.
  • Experience evolving APIs and data schemas, including versioning and backward compatibility.
  • Strong SQL skills and an understanding of cloud data warehouse performance and costs.
  • Collaborative approach, with experience mentoring through code reviews, pairing and clear documentation.
  • The stack is Python and C#/.NET, Snowflake, dbt, Terraform, Azure (Functions, Container Apps, Service Bus), GitHub Actions.
  • Ability to work within a small team with high autonomy.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Ciao, siamo Subito!


Continui a leggere per comprendere appieno cosa richiede questo lavoro in termini di competenze ed esperienza. Se il suo profilo è in linea, invii la sua candidatura.

Hai presente quell'app che quasi ogni italiano ha installata sul telefono? Ecco, quella è casa nostra. Il tuo posto nel team Data

Per il nostro Data Team, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Data Engineer con solide basi in ambito software engineering. In questa posizione, avrai un ruolo chiave nel contribuire allo sviluppo e all’ottimizzazione dei nostri sistemi e delle nostre data pipeline. Il ruolo ha un forte focus sulla creazione di architetture di qualità. Nello specifico, ti occuperai di progettare e creare soluzioni dati altamente performanti, scalabili e facili da manutenere, costruendo sistemi robusti e affidabili. Inoltre, sarai parte integrante dei processi decisionali del team, partecipando attivamente alle sessioni di code review e alle discussioni di system design, con l'obiettivo di promuovere e applicare le migliori pratiche di sviluppo.

Sei la persona giusta se hai...
  • Laurea in Ingegneria Informatica, Scienze Informatiche o materie affini.
  • Esperienza pregressa nel ruolo di Data Engineer (5+ anni).
  • Conoscenza approfondita di AWS, Spark, Flink e framework affini.
  • Buona padronanza di linguaggi quali Java, Scala e Python.
  • Familiarità con almeno un Cloud Provider e con l'ecosistemaDocker.
  • Ottime capacità comunicative e di gestione delle attività (task management).
  • Propensione al lavoro di squadra (team player) e forte desiderio di imparare e mettersi in gioco.
Cosa andrai a fare?

In Subito, i dati non sono solo numeri, ma la bussola che guida ogni nostra decisione. Ti occuperai delle seguenti attività:

Architettura di Dominio e Sviluppo Critico
  • Design di Sistemi Complessi: Progettare architetture per specifici domini aziendali (es. l'intera pipeline antifrode o il ciclo di vita di un annuncio), assicurandosi che comunichino in modo efficiente con il resto dell'infrastruttura.
  • Codice \"Core\": Scrivere i componenti fondamentali e più complessi dell'infrastruttura dati, creando librerie, framework o astrazioni che verranno poi utilizzati e scalati dai Senior e Mid-level engineer.
  • Risoluzione di Incidenti Critici: Essere il punto di escalation definitivo per i bug sistemici più difficili da individuare (es. problemi di concorrenza, data loss, colli di bottiglia nelle performance di Spark o Kafka).
Moltiplicatore di Forza (Force Multiplier)
  • Miglioramento della Developer Experience: Costruire strumenti (tooling) e processi che rendono gli altri ingegneri più veloci ed efficienti. Questo include l'automazione dei test sui dati, pipeline CI/CD robuste e template architetturali.
  • Mentoring e Coaching: Elevare il livello tecnico di tutto il dipartimento. Un Senior Data Engineer è responsabile della loro crescita ingegneristica.
  • Promozione delle Best Practice: Introdurre nuovi standard di qualità del codice e della modellazione dei dati, assicurandosi che vengano adottati trasversalmente dai vari team.
Gestione di Progetti Multi-Team
  • Lead Tecnico su Iniziative Estese: Guidare progetti che necessitano la collaborazione di più team (es. Data Engineering, Backend, e Data Science). Il Senior Data Engineer coordina gli sforzi tecnici, divide i task architettonici e rimuove i blocchi (blockers).
  • Gestione del Debito Tecnico: Identificare proattivamente le aree dell'infrastruttura dati che stanno diventando obsolete o instabili e pianificare refactoring strategici prima che diventino un problema per il business.
Traduzione tra Business e Realizzazione
  • Negoziazione dei Requisiti: Lavorare con i Product Manager e i Data Analyst per capire cosa serve veramente al business. Un Senior Data Engineer sa dire \"no\" a soluzioni troppo complesse se il valore aggiunto è basso, proponendo alternative più eleganti e manutenibili.
  • Pianificazione a Medio Termine: Mentre il Principal guarda ai prossini 3-5 anni, Il Senior Data Engineer si concentra solitamente sui prossini 6-18 mesi, assicurandosi che la roadmap tecnica supporti quella di prodotto.
Le tue principali responsabilità:
  • Sviluppo in autonomia: Analizzare e implementare funzionalità (feature) complesse in totale autonomia.
  • Qualità del codice: Sviluppare soluzioni software nel rigoroso rispetto dei nostri standard di qualità.
  • Progettazione: Partecipare attivamente al technical design delle nuove funzionalità, con il supporto e la guida del team.
  • Ottimizzazione: Comprendere a fondo l'architettura per ottimizzare le performance di sistema.
  • Gestione delle priorità: Organizzare e dare priorità ai task in modo autonomo, valutando i requisiti e il contesto di riferimento.
  • Reperibilità: Partecipare ai turni di reperibilità (on-call) 24/7.
Cosa ti offriamo?

In Subito crediamo che il benessere passi per un pacchetto completo che va oltre lo stipendio. Per questo ruolo prevediamo un range di RAL tra 48.000€ e 58.000€, a cui aggiungiamo bonus annuali, incentivi legati ai risultati e ticket restaurant da 10€ (elettronici). Il range retributivo è definito sulla base di criteri oggettivi e neutrali, tra cui responsabilità del ruolo, competenze richieste, livello organizzativo, benchmark di mercato e coerenza interna. Si applica il CCNL Grafici Industria.

Ci trovi in via Angelo Scarsellini 14 (fermata M3 Affori Centro): abbiamo creato un ufficio open space super luminoso e pieno di comfort, perfetto per collaborare dal vivo ma con tutta la flessibilità di cui hai bisogno. title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Company Overview

Wego is an online travel metasearch platform used by millions to find the best flights and hotel deals. We are seeking a talented, agile Marketing Automation & AI Engineer with a strong focus on Agentic AI to join our MarTech team.

Role Description

As part of the Marketing Technology (MarTech) team, you will build the next generation of marketing automation — designing and deploying autonomous AI agents that drive insights from digital campaigns and independently optimize marketing operations. You will work daily alongside the Performance Marketing team, deeply understanding their KPIs (ROAS, CPA, CTR, conversion rates) and how media platforms work, their campaign structures, auction mechanics, and APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, Apple Search Ads) to ensure every system you build directly serves campaign performance goals.

Unlike traditional, rigid backend data roles focused solely on static data lakes, this position requires building highly adaptable, configuration-driven automation systems. You will design architectures that allow the Performance Marketing team to quickly pivot campaign strategies, creative assets, and budget pacing without needing structural core code deployments for every minor requirement change.

Key Responsibilities

  • Campaign Creation & Optimization Automation: Architect end-to-end automated workflows for campaign creation, audience segmentation, creative assembly, launch, and continuous optimization using AI/ML signals to drive dynamic bidding, budget pacing, and A/B testing across channels.
  • AI-Driven Content Orchestration: Engineer multi-agent systems to generate and iterate on personalized ad content (ad copy, images, videos) at scale.
  • Agile Data Activation & Automation Infrastructure: Build and maintain flexible data flows optimized for real-time marketing activation. Ensure data structures are explicitly designed for dynamic content generation and automated campaign adjustment rather than just static reporting or legacy ETL pipelines.
  • Performance Marketing Collaboration: Partner daily with the Performance Marketing team to translate KPIs and rapidly changing campaign objectives into technical configurations; ensure data integrity, API reliability, and consistent AI agent deployments across all paid channels.
  • Agentic Workflow Development: Design, build, and deploy autonomous AI agents using LLMs (Claude, Gemini, OpenAI) for automated marketing workflows.

Qualifications

Experience & Domain Expertise

  • 3+ years in performance/digital marketing analytics and marketing automation with hands-on experience in AI engineering.
  • Deep understanding of paid/performance marketing KPIs, how media platforms work (campaign structure, auction mechanics, targeting, measurement) and their APIs (Meta, Google Ads, TikTok), and MMP tooling (AppsFlyer, Adjust).
  • Proven experience building end-to-end campaign automation systems including programmatic campaign creation, ML-driven optimization, and automated actions via ad platform APIs.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced SQL and Python.
  • Proven experience building configuration-driven architectures or rules engines (e.g., headless CMS integrations, dynamic creative optimization tools), attribution models, and activation workflows.
  • Proficiency building and orchestrating AI agents using foundational LLMs; integrating LLMs and AI agents with external tools and APIs.

Soft Skills & Mindset

  • Extreme flexibility and comfort with ambiguity: Understands that marketing strategies pivot quickly and intentionally designs technical solutions to accommodate fluid business requirements.
  • Strong product mindset: Views the marketing team as your core users and builds tools that empower them to self-serve safely.
  • Excellent communication skills to seamlessly bridge technical architectures with creative marketing strategies.

title: HR Operations Partner, Americas
description:
Position Summary


The HR Operations Partner, Americas plays an important role in supporting employees, managers and leaders across the Americas region. Reporting to the Head of HR, you will work across the full employee lifecycle, helping to ensure employees receive an excellent experience from recruitment and onboarding through to development, benefits administration and offboarding.

This is a broad and varied HR generalist role where no two days are likely to be the same. You'll work closely with employees, managers, external providers and colleagues across the wider Quortex and Lumine organisations, helping to deliver effective people processes while contributing to a positive and inclusive employee experience.

The role offers significant exposure to international HR practices and provides opportunities to participate in regional and global HR projects. It is well suited to someone who enjoys working independently, takes pride in delivering excellent service and is interested in developing their career within a growing global organisation.


Key Responsibilities


Employee Lifecycle Management


  • Own and administer all employee lifecycle activities for employees, contractors and EOR workers across the Americas.
  • Coordinate onboarding activities including employment documentation, system setup, inductions and manager readiness.
  • Prepare and manage employment changes including promotions, compensation changes, transfers, leave arrangements and contractual updates.
  • Coordinate offboarding activities, ensuring all employment, payroll, benefits and system actions are completed accurately and on time.
  • Maintain accurate employee records and ensure data integrity within Workday and associated systems.

Employee & Manager Support


  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers throughout the region.
  • Provide practical guidance on HR policies, procedures and employment-related matters.
  • Support managers with performance, attendance, leave management and routine employee relations issues.
  • Escalate complex employee relations matters appropriately whilst maintaining a positive employee experience.
  • Support compliance with applicable US and Canadian employment laws and company policies

Recruitment & Talent Support


  • Support managers throughout the recruitment process including interview scheduling, candidate communications and offer administration.
  • Ensure a smooth and professional experience for candidates and new hires.
  • Assist with talent review, performance management and employee development processes.

Payroll, Benefits & Provider Management


  • Coordinate employee data changes and payroll inputs with payroll providers and Finance teams.
  • Manage relationships with external benefits brokers, insurers, EOR providers and employment service vendors.
  • Support annual benefits renewals, enrolment activities and employee communications.
  • Assist employees with benefits-related queries and ensure timely resolution of issues.

Projects & Continuous Improvement


  • Lead or support regional implementation of global HR initiatives, policy changes, organisational transitions and systems implementations across the Americas.
  • Support policy development and process harmonisation projects.
  • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, employee experience and operational effectiveness
  • Produce HR reports and workforce information as required.
  • Assist with policy implementation and employee communications.

Skills & Competencies


•Strong customer-focused approach.

  • Excellent communication and relationship management skills.
  • Highly organised with strong attention to detail.
  • Practical and solutions-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work independently and manage competing priorities.
  • Strong judgement and ability to escalate appropriately.
  • High levels of integrity and confidentiality.

•Continuous improvement mindset.


Experience Requirements


We recognise that strong candidates may not meet every requirement listed below. If your experience is broadly aligned and you're excited about the opportunity, we encourage you to apply.


We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:


  • Evidenced progressive HR Generalist or HR Operations experience.
  • Strong knowledge of US employment practices and employee lifecycle processes.
  • Experience supporting payroll and benefits administration.
  • Experience managing relationships with external benefits providers, brokers or EOR providers.
  • Experience using Workday or a similar enterprise HRIS.
  • Experience within an international technology or software environment would be advantageous.
  • International HR exposure is desirable but not essential.

title: Middle School Librarian
description:
Reports to: Director of Learning Technology and Library Services

Position Overview: The Middle School Librarian is a visionary and innovative educator who is responsible for leading collaborative planning and teaching to develop media and information literacy mindsets in faculty, staff, and students. This individual will work closely with the Director of Learning Technology and Library Services, middle school academic technology coordinator, K-12 library department, and school faculty to support student learning while creating a welcoming and innovative library program that encourages knowledge acquisition and both media and digital literacy. The ideal candidate enjoys unlocking media and information systems with Middle School students and encourages a continued love of reading.

The Lovett School’s Mission, Core Values, and Diversity Mission Statement

Responsibilities of the Middle School Librarian

Instruction and Collaboration

  • Design and facilitate engaging learning experiences that develop information and media literacy skills and mindsets
  • Provide instruction using innovative strategies based on best practices that foster critical thinking and creativity
  • Collaborate with classroom educators to establish learning objectives and assessment strategies, and to develop learning experiences that build information and media literacy skills
  • Empower all members of the learning community to become critical thinkers, enthusiastic readers, skillful researchers, curators, and ethical users of information
  • Collaborate with K-12 library staff to promote and grow library services within the larger community

Library Program Management

  • Create welcoming physical and digital library environments that promote collaboration and inclusion, as well as allow for active, participatory, and inquiry-based learning
  • Curate a well-balanced collection that meets curricular and leisure reading needs of the school community
  • Manage library tasks such as collection development and evaluation, weeding, cataloging, inventory, etc.

Flexible Scheduling and Shared Services

  • Implement a responsive schedule that balances Middle School needs
  • Adjust time and presence based on instructional priorities and collaborative projects
  • Participate in department/grade level meetings to further connection and collaborative practices

Student Support and Engagement

  • Foster a love of reading and lifelong learning through programming, displays, and student interactions
  • Provide targeted support for research, technology use, and independent reading
  • Create opportunities for student voice and choice

Technology Integration

  • Collaborate with the academic technology coordinator to integrate digital tools and media resources into instruction
  • Support the use of digital tools, databases, and media resources for learning
  • Guide students in the effective and ethical use of information

Professional Growth & Leadership

  • Plan and provide professional development opportunities for faculty and staff through evaluating, introducing, and modeling emerging technologies that will support curriculum goals
  • Proactively share resources and ideas regarding evolving trends in media and information literacy with students, faculty, and administrators

Perform additional duties as assigned.

Essential Expectations for ALL Employees

All employees at Lovett are expected to:

  1. Demonstrate alignment with the School's mission and values as outlined in the Employee Handbook Introduction and on the school's website.
  2. Foster a safe, consistent, and supportive environment for students by providing appropriate supervision, establishing clear and predictable expectations, communicating with respect and care, and modeling the behavior we expect from our students.
  3. Engage with colleagues and community members in a manner that cultivates Purpose and Belonging through collaboration, open-mindedness, flexibility, and a willingness to have the respectful conversations that strengthen our community.
  4. Affirm and engage in practices that reflect Lovett's Statement of Belonging by acting with empathy and respect, listening to understand, making space for multiple perspectives, and respecting the dignity of every human being in our diverse community.
  5. Demonstrate role-appropriate planning and preparation consistent with Lovett's approach to learning, recognizing that every employee contributes to our unique educational mission by understanding their work within the broader context of student learning and growth.
  6. Uphold professional standards of personal presentation, punctuality, professional courtesy, and discretion as outlined in the policies and procedures in the Employee Handbook and Divisional or Departmental Guides to maintain a professional atmosphere and model expectations for our students.
  7. Fulfill specific assignments as defined by your job description and agreement with attention to detail and commitment to excellence in all aspects of your role.
  8. Honor the confidentiality of school, student, and family information by communicating through appropriate channels, protecting sensitive information, and sharing private details only with those who need them to do their jobs.
  9. Engage in guided self-reflection for the purpose of professional growth and development by participating in the growth cycle process, exhibiting a growth mindset, and receiving feedback with openness and a desire to improve.


Minimum Qualifications

Education:

  • Master’s degree in Library Media, Library and Information Science, or related field (will accept applicants graduating in December 2026)

Experience:

Required

  • Proficiency with educational technology, digital resources, and library management systems

Preferred

  • Classroom teaching experience
  • Experience working with middle school students
  • School library experience

Skills and Competencies:

  • Motivated self-starter that takes initiative to identify opportunities for growth
  • Demonstrate a commitment to the library mission and recognize the importance of adaptability to enhance information and media mindsets
  • Awareness of the importance of diversity, equity, and inclusion and their role in the development of the whole child
  • Well-versed in the instruction and pedagogy associated with the research process
  • A commitment to intentional collaboration across divisions and disciplines
  • Ability to manage multiple projects with deadlines at the same time
  • Working knowledge of library databases, library catalogs, and basic computer troubleshooting skills
  • The drive, organization, and flexibility to work in a fast-paced environment, contributing to the school community beyond the classroom
  • Facilitate effective communication with students, parents, colleagues, and supervisors
  • Employment of a variety of techniques—including the meaningful use of technology—to engage students and further their critical thinking, communication, collaboration, and creativity
  • A strong desire to work in a collaborative learning community, employing a growth mindset and commitment to ongoing development
  • Demonstrated flexibility and responsiveness to a variety of learning styles and across a range of abilities

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, and have use of hands. Occasional lifting of up to 25 pounds may be required. Vision and focus adjustments are necessary. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

title: Staff Data Platform Engineer
description:

Staff Data Platform Engineer

Large-scale data/Cloud infrastructure | ClickHouse / OLAP | Technical Leadership

No Sponsorship Option

London or Oxford, X2 per week

£100,000-£130,000

We're looking for a Staff Data Platform Engineer to take technical ownership of a large-scale analytical data platform, tackling complex infrastructure challenges and shaping the foundations for the next generation of AI-driven products.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role for someone who enjoysinnovating at the limits of what data infrastructure can do.   • Large-scale data engineering: Design, optimise and scale multi-tenant ClickHouse or equivalent OLAP platforms, tackling complex challenges across sharding, replication, materialised views, query performance and cost efficiency.
  • Platform reliability: Build automation, observability and intelligent capacity management to improve resilience, reduce operational overhead and enable data-intensive systems to scale efficiently.
  • Data-as-a-Service: Shape the architecture of a secure, multi-tenant data platform, enabling immutable data releases, discoverability and efficient access to complex datasets.
  • AI infrastructure: Build the data foundations that support agentic AI systems, working closely with ML engineers to enable secure, scalable and reliable access to platform data.
  • Security by design: Establish robust tenant isolation, least-privilege access controls and credential management across the platform.
  • Technical leadership: Set architectural direction, establish engineering standards, mentor other engineers and line-manage a small team while remaining hands-on with the technology.
What We're Looking For
  • Deep expertise in ClickHouse or comparable OLAP technologies, ideally with experience operating multi-tenant analytical systems at significant scale.
  • Strong understanding of database internals, query optimisation, distributed architectures, sharding and replication. Experience contributing to open-source database projects or working at source-code level would be highly advantageous.
  • A proven track record building scalable, observable and resilient data platforms, with a focus on automation and operational efficiency.
  • Experience developing data platforms as products, including multi-tenancy, secure data distribution, immutable releases and large-scale data discovery.
  • An understanding of how to expose data securely to AI agents and other automated systems, including access controls, isolation and guardrails.
  • Strong knowledge of platform security, secrets management and least-privilege principles.
  • The ability to influence technical strategy, mentor engineers and lead a small team without stepping away from hands-on engineering.
The Opportunity

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a technically ambitious data platform, solve infrastructure problems at significant scale and influence the architecture underpinning data-intensive and AI-powered products.

We're looking for someone who leads through technical expertise, enjoys solving problems that don't have obvious answers, and wants to make a lasting impact on how a platform evolves.

title: Building Services Director
description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

As the Building Services Director, you will provide leadership and oversight for all building operations, maintenance, grounds, utilities, life safety systems, and facility-related projects across your assigned campus. You will ensure our physical environment remains safe, attractive, functional, and compliant with all applicable regulations.

Facility Operations & Maintenance

  • Direct the day-to-day operations of the Building Services department, ensuring timely completion of maintenance requests and preventative maintenance activities.
  • Oversee maintenance, repair, and operation of building systems including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, mechanical equipment, fire alarm systems, generators, life safety systems, and energy management systems.

  • Coordinate repairs through internal staff or outside contractors as appropriate.
  • Maintain inventories of maintenance supplies, tools, equipment, and replacement parts.

Regulatory Compliance & Life Safety

  • Ensure compliance with all applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including Life Safety Code requirements and applicable building codes.
  • Maintain all required maintenance records, inspections, testing documentation, and preventative maintenance schedules.
  • Coordinate and document required fire drills, emergency preparedness activities, generator testing, and other regulatory inspections.
  • Serve as the department lead during state surveys, inspections, and life safety reviews, partnering with leadership to develop and implement corrective action plans as needed.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Recruit, hire, train, coach, and develop Building Services team members.
  • Establish work schedules, assign daily work orders, and prioritize maintenance activities.
  • Conduct performance evaluations, provide ongoing coaching, and address performance concerns in partnership with Human Resources.
  • Promote a culture of accountability, teamwork, safety, and exceptional customer service.

Budget & Project Management

  • Develop and manage departmental operating and capital budgets.
  • Monitor labor, supply, and maintenance expenses while identifying opportunities for operational efficiencies.
  • Obtain vendor quotes, manage service contracts, and oversee contractor performance.
  • Lead facility improvement projects from planning through completion while minimizing disruption to residents and operations.

Customer Service & Collaboration

  • Respond promptly to facility concerns from residents, families, employees, and visitors.
  • Partner with department leaders to support daily operations, special projects, move-ins, renovations, and organizational initiatives.
  • Maintain systems for work order management, key control, equipment tracking, and facility documentation.
  • Participate in the leadership on-call rotation and provide emergency response support as needed.
  • Support Lutheran Life Villages’ mission, vision, and values in all interactions and work.

Safety & Emergency Preparedness

  • Maintain disaster preparedness plans and support emergency response activities.
  • Coordinate annual fire safety education, employee safety orientation, and other required safety training.
  • Assist with snow removal, inclement weather response, and other campus safety needs.

WHAT YOU NEED

Education

  • Associate's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, Construction Management, Engineering Technology, or a related field preferred.
  • Trade school certification, project management certification, or equivalent technical training is preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree is a plus.

Experience

  • Five (5) or more years of progressively responsible maintenance or facilities management experience.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of leadership experience supervising maintenance staff, budgets, vendors, and facility projects.
  • Experience in healthcare, senior living, hospitality, education, or another large campus environment preferred.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Working knowledge of building systems including HVAC, plumbing, electrical, carpentry, mechanical systems, and grounds maintenance.
  • Knowledge of applicable Life Safety Code, building codes, OSHA requirements, and regulatory compliance standards.
  • Ability to interpret blueprints, construction documents, equipment manuals, and technical specifications.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent interpersonal, leadership, and customer service skills.
  • Ability to prioritize multiple projects while meeting deadlines.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) is preferred.
  • Ability to safely operate maintenance equipment, power tools, and company vehicles.

​

The experience you bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience preferred
  • 5–7+ years of Life Insurance claims experience required, including adjudication of complex claims such as contestability reviews, exclusions, beneficiary disputes,
  • Demonstrated expertise in investigating, evaluating, and adjudicating life insurance claims from initial notice through claims decision in accordance with policy provisions and company guidelines
  • Proven ability to interpret policy language, contractual provisions, and beneficiary designations, ensuring accurate, consistent, and defensible claim outcomes

  • Demonstrated commitment to a customer-centric claims philosophy, with a strong focus on empathy, care, and respect, recognizing the sensitive nature of life claims and the impact on beneficiaries and families
  • Demonstrated ability to navigate grief and emotionally complex situations with sensitivity and care, adapting communication style to meet individuals where they are and ensuring beneficiaries feel supported, respected, and treated with dignity
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, ensuring accurate benefit calculations, thorough documentation, and complete claim file management in support of audit readiness and defensibility
  • Demonstrates ownership of outcomes, with a focus on timely, accurate, and customer-centered claim resolutions that build trust and confidence

What makes you stand out:

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced, evolving environment while maintaining quality and consistency

title: Senior Build Reliability Engineer
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Senior Build Reliability Engineer partners closely with the design and manufacturing teams to right-size processes and controls to enable scaling the production of spacecraft hardware. Build Reliability Engineers ensure production processes yield verified, reliable hardware at rate. You will flex beyond Build Reliability to support Quality, Flight Reliability, and Mission Assurance. The ideal candidate is a responsible, collaborative, process-oriented engineer with hands-on hardware design/test/manufacturing/troubleshooting experience.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with design engineering and manufacturing teams to create test, manufacturability, and inspection plans for all vehicle hardware.
  • Contain suspect or known non-conforming product, providing guidance to quality inspectors, technicians, shop supervisors, and engineers.
  • Lead failure investigations in production, test, and operation; identifying and mitigating immediate and underlying root causes to reduce risk and improve the reliability of designs and processes.
  • Provide critical peer review of hardware during design reviews and acceptance and qualification test campaigns.
  • Perform failure modes and effects analyses, build requirements compliance matrix tools, and ensure adequate test coverage, change management, and manufacturability of flight hardware.
  • Own vehicle level deliverables for regulatory bodies including requirements compliance, functional or flight hazard analyses, and verification evidence.
  • Support Mission Assurance's vehicle level risk management and identification/tracking/execution of mitigations.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in aerospace, computer science, electrical, manufacturing, mechanical, or material sciences engineering.
  • 5+ years professional experience in aerospace, design, quality, or related engineering role.
  • Hands-on hardware test, qualification, troubleshooting, or failure analysis experience.
  • Commitment to lean quality principles without compromising safety or reliability.
  • Demonstrated application of process controls in high volume manufacturing, test, and quality environments.
  • Experience generating, processing, and/or analyzing data for production insight.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaborative skills, with a drive to innovate and improve reliability in cutting-edge technology.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Full project lifecycle ownership experience (cradle-to-grave).
  • Proficiency with quality tools such as measurement systems analysis, design of experiments, statistical process control, root cause analysis and corrective action, advanced product quality planning (APQP), metrology, process failure mode and effects analysis (PFMEA), control plans, and various problem-solving approaches.
  • Hands-on knowledge of CNC machining, additive manufacturing, casting, welding, fastening, or other special manufacturing processes.

Pay Range

  • Salary range: Senior: $140,333 - $179,314/ per year.
  • This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
  • Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
  • You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Varda, like all employers, must ensure that its employees working in the United States are lawfully authorized to work in the U.S. Additionally, our employees are exposed to and have access to certain export-controlled items. Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

“US person” means: U.S. citizen, U.S. lawful permanent resident, or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) (i.e., individual admitted to the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum).

title: Automation & Quality Specialist
description:
Job Description:

You will work closely with developers, QA, and DevOps teams to ensure our backend services are scalable and resilient, contributing directly to our mission of delivering seamless customer experience.
