  • CI/CD Integration: Implement and manage automated test suites within CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions) to enable continuous quality.
  • Defect Management: Analyze test results, identify root causes of defects, and collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolutions.
  • Strategy & Documentation: Develop comprehensive test cases, test plans, and data strategies for backend systems, ensuring high test coverage and clear API documentation.
  • Full Lifecycle Testing: Conduct regression, smoke and integration testing to support frequent production releases.

title: Technical Steward - Devices
description:

Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybrid
Location: Hyderabad, India

Relocation Support: This role is based in Hyderabad, India. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support: please only apply if accessible.

What happens when cutting-edge medicines meet equally innovative device technology? Patients receive treatments that can transform lives. As Technical Steward – Devices, you will be at the center of that intersection, providing technical leadership for medical devices and drug-device combination products throughout their lifecycle. From late-stage development and technology transfer to commercialization, lifecycle management, and product retirement, you will ensure that device technologies are fit for purpose, compliant, and capable of supporting reliable product delivery. Working with global suppliers, cross-functional partners, and regulatory stakeholders, you will serve as a trusted device expert, lead strategic product activities, and manage a team of specialists dedicated to advancing some of Novartis’ most important therapies.


Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the device expert for high-priority brands, overseeing auto-injectors and other drug-delivery systems throughout their life-cycle.
  • Assess how device technologies operate with drug products, identifying compatibility, performance, quality, and patient-use risks.
  • Review supplier documentation and technical data to confirm devices perform as intended and meet health authority requirements.
  • Lead technical activities from late-stage development and technology transfer through scale-up, commercialization, life-cycle maintenance, and product retirement.
  • Prepare and maintain device documentation, including design history, risk management, human factors, and post-market surveillance files.
  • Respond to health authority questions and provide technical input for regulatory submissions involving devices and combination products.
  • Investigate device-related quality issues, evaluate proposed changes, and recommend actions that protect product quality and reliable delivery.
  • Work with suppliers, development teams, manufacturing sites, quality, and regulatory partners to resolve technical challenges and transfer knowledge.
  • Maintain inspection readiness by reviewing technical records and providing device expertise during audits and regulatory inspections.
  • Lead and develop a team of seven to eight specialists, setting priorities and ensuring high-quality, timely delivery.

Essential Requirements

  • Degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering, or another relevant scientific or technical discipline.
  • At least 10 to 12 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including medical devices or drug-device combination products.
  • Strong understanding of drug products, device technologies, and their compatibility within injectable drug-delivery systems.
  • Demonstrated experience managing external device suppliers, contract manufacturers, and strategic partners across global markets.
  • Proven stakeholder and crisis management skills, including regular engagement with senior leaders and cross-functional teams.
  • Experience leading and developing a team, setting priorities, managing resources, and ensuring high-quality delivery.
  • Strong knowledge of pharmaceutical manufacturing, Good Manufacturing Practice, quality risk management, and global device regulations and standards.
  • Fluency in English, with strong communication and data analysis skills, including interpreting large datasets using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Novartis is committed to building an outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse team representative of the patients and communities we serve.

If, because of a medical condition or disability, you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, or in order to perform the essential functions of a position, please send an e-mail to diversityandincl.india@novartis.com and let us know the nature of your request and your contact information. title: Account Management and System Value Lead
description:
ROLE SUMMARY


The Account Management & System Value Lead is a strategic field leadership role responsible for leading the NHS Solutions Partner and Clinical Effectiveness Consultant teams while developing and embedding industry-leading account management capability across the organisation.

Central to the role is the ability to ensure Pfizer consistently understands and responds to the priorities, challenges and opportunities facing the NHS. The role develops organizational capability to translate those priorities into compelling customer solutions, system value propositions, partnership initiatives and customer engagement strategies that improve patient care, support the healthcare system objectives and deliver sustainable business growth.

The role acts as the organizational expert and champion for account management excellence, ensuring customer-facing teams develop exceptional capability in account planning, environmental insight, stakeholder engagement, value communication, customer execution and coaching discipline. Through direct leadership of NHS Solutions Partners and Clinical Effectiveness Consultants, and through leadership without authority across the wider business, the role builds future capability and ensures Pfizer is recognized as a trusted partner to the NHS.


ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES


Leadership and capability development

  • Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team of NHS Solutions Partners and Clinical Effectiveness Consultants.
  • Create an environment of accountability, engagement, continuous learning and customer excellence.
  • Build future organizational capability through effective performance management, coaching, mentoring and talent development.
  • Develop succession plans and future leaders across both teams.
  • Championing a growth mindset culture, inspiring colleagues to continuously improve and develop.
  • Foster collaboration and knowledge sharing across the organisation to accelerate customer and business impact.
  • Leading through change and ambiguity, ensuring teams remain focused on delivering customer, patient and business outcomes.


Account management excellence

  • Own and lead the national account management capability strategy.
  • Develop and embed best-practice account management standards and ways of working across customer-facing teams.
  • Lead capability development in account planning, strategic customer engagement, environmental analysis, stakeholder mapping, influencing, negotiation, value proposition development, pre-call planning, in-call effectiveness, post-call evaluation and multichannel engagement.
  • Develop coaching capability within field leaders to ensure sustainable improvement in account management capability.
  • Identify and replicate account management best practice nationally.
  • Ensure alignment with One Pfizer account management approaches and customer engagement principles.
  • Use digital and AI-enabled tools to improve account insight, planning quality, customer preparation, coaching effectiveness and organizational learning.


Capability strategy and future readiness

  • Develop and own a multi-year Account Management and System Value Capability Strategy aligned to the evolving needs of the NHS, customers and Pfizer.
  • Anticipate future capability requirements and ensure the organisation develops the skills, behaviors and expertise needed to succeed in an increasingly complex healthcare environment.

title: Technology Sourcing Specialist
description:
Our patients are our number one priority! We're committed to giving children back their childhood!

Job Posting Title:

Technology Sourcing Specialist

Location:

Dallas - Hospital

Additional Posting Details:

Monday - Friday, Days

Job Description:

Duties/Responsibilities

  • Lead and administer the end-to-end technology sourcing lifecycle, including intake, requirements validation, market research, competitive evaluation, vendor due diligence, negotiation, contracting, implementation handoff, renewal, and termination.
  • Manage TEC operations, including meeting schedules, agendas, materials, decision documentation, action items, approvals, and stakeholder communications.
  • Partner with business and clinical requestors to clarify needs, expected outcomes, funding, timing, alternatives, dependencies, and total cost of ownership.
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies for software, hardware, cloud services, professional services, maintenance, support, and other technology-related purchases.
  • Coordinate requests for information, proposals, and quotations; establish evaluation criteria; facilitate vendor demonstrations; and document objective selection recommendations.
  • Partner with Legal on contract review and negotiation, including pricing, service levels, data protection, security requirements, warranties, limitation of liability, indemnification, termination rights, audit rights, and renewal provisions.
  • Coordinate vendor risk, cybersecurity, privacy, architecture, integration, accessibility, compliance, and operational assessments with the appropriate subject-matter experts.
  • Negotiate commercially favorable pricing, terms, service commitments, and protections while maintaining productive vendor relationships.
  • Maintain a centralized inventory of technology agreements, renewal dates, notice periods, financial commitments, ownership, risk findings, and required actions.
  • Monitor contract performance, vendor obligations, service levels, utilization, spend, and stakeholder satisfaction; coordinate corrective actions and escalations when needed.
  • Establish a risk-based vendor governance framework that segments vendors by criticality, spend, data access, operational dependency, and regulatory impact, with oversight requirements appropriate to each tier.
  • Develop and maintain vendor scorecards and lead periodic business reviews that evaluate service levels, quality, responsiveness, security and compliance obligations, financial performance, contractual commitments, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Own vendor issue management and escalation, including root-cause analysis, corrective action plans, service credits, dispute resolution, risk acceptance, and timely communication to accountable stakeholders.
  • Coordinate vendor onboarding, material changes, and offboarding with business owners and control functions, ensuring appropriate access, documentation, knowledge transfer, data return or destruction, asset recovery, and continuity planning.
  • Partner with vendor and internal leaders to maintain relationship plans, product and service roadmaps, executive engagement, innovation opportunities, and succession or exit strategies for critical suppliers.
  • Lead renewal planning far enough in advance to assess value, utilization, alternatives, budget impact, negotiation leverage, and termination requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to consolidate vendors, eliminate redundant technology, improve license utilization, reduce cost, and simplify the technology portfolio.
  • Prepare sourcing analyses, negotiation summaries, status reports, decision briefs, dashboards, and recommendations for leaders and governance committees.
  • Establish and improve sourcing standards, templates, workflows, controls, documentation, and performance measures.
  • Support audits and ensure sourcing records are complete, accurate, accessible, and retained in accordance with organizational requirements.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Bachelor’s degree in business administration, supply chain, information technology, finance, contract management, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in technology sourcing, procurement, vendor management, contract management, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience negotiating software, cloud, hardware, professional services, maintenance, and support agreements.
  • Working knowledge of commercial contract terms, licensing models, subscription pricing, service-level agreements, data protection requirements, and vendor risk concepts.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional reviews with Legal, Information Security, Privacy, Finance, Supply Chain, technical teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, financial, organizational, negotiation, written communication, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple complex initiatives, deadlines, stakeholders, and confidential information with limited supervision.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and experience using contract lifecycle management, procurement, service management, or vendor management platforms.

  • Experience sourcing technology in a healthcare or similarly regulated environment.

  • Knowledge of healthcare privacy, security, and regulatory considerations applicable to technology vendors and hosted services.

  • Experience with enterprise applications, electronic health records, cloud platforms, cybersecurity services, infrastructure, integrations, and software-as-a-service solutions.

  • Professional certification such as Certified Professional in Supply Management (CPSM), Certified Purchasing Manager (CPM), Certified Commercial Contracts Manager (CCCM), Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM), Certified Professional Contracts Manager (CPCM), or an equivalent credential.

  • Experience implementing or administering contract lifecycle management and vendor performance processes.

Working Environment

  • Working Conditions: Inside
  • Working Position: Sitting
  • Physical Demands: Light
  • Physical Requirements: Repetitive Movement
  • An Individual in this position will be required to lift or carry weight in this group: Up to 10lbs
  • Sensory/Communicative activities essential to the performance of this position: Feeling, Hearing, Seeing, Speaking
  • An Individual in this position will be exposed to: Inside environment

title: Scrum master
description:

  • 7+ years of experience in Salesforce platform delivery and Agile/Scrum environments.

  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Health Cloud, Service Cloud, and/or Experience Cloud.

description:
A Little Bit About Us

Each property is carefully selected, locally managed, and held to an uncompromising standard of care. We live and work in the communities we serve, which means every stay comes with generous local knowledge, genuine hospitality, and the confidence that what you booked is exactly what you’ll find.

401(k) with Company Match

Benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plan documents, which govern in the event of any discrepancy. The Company reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate benefit plans and programs at any time.

About This Job

The Reputation Management Coordinator supports key administrative and operational processes that contribute to a positive guest experience and effective property management operations. This role is responsible for managing guest reviews and ratings, coordinating follow-up on guest concerns, and supporting the end-to-end unit termination and offboarding process.

Working cross-functionally with local market teams and other internal partners, this position helps ensure guest feedback is addressed appropriately, outstanding concerns are followed through to resolution, and departing units are accurately and efficiently transitioned out of First Chair Destinations’ systems and operations.

Compensation + Schedule

  • $20 - $23 / HR less payroll deductions and all required withholdings
  • Monday - Friday schedule
  • Fully remote
  • Weekends and holidays may be required

Essential Job Functions

Guest Reviews & Reputation Management

  • Manage guest reviews and ratings across applicable platforms, including reviewing incoming feedback, rating guests, and responding to guest reviews in a timely and professional manner.
  • Ensure review responses reflect First Chair Destinations’ service standards, brand voice, and commitment to the guest experience.
  • Identify guest feedback that requires additional follow-up or escalation and coordinate with the appropriate local or internal teams.
  • Track outstanding guest concerns and follow through with responsible teams to help ensure issues are appropriately addressed and resolved.
  • Identify recurring themes or trends in guest feedback and elevate insights as appropriate to support service and operational improvements.

Guest Concern Coordination

  • Partner with local market teams to address guest concerns identified through reviews, ratings, or other feedback channels.
  • Facilitate communication and follow-up between teams when multiple departments are involved in resolving a guest issue.
  • Maintain visibility into open concerns and help ensure agreed-upon actions are completed.
  • Document relevant resolutions and follow-up activity as needed.

Unit Terminations & Offboarding

  • Coordinate the full unit termination and offboarding workflow from notification through completion.
  • Complete required system updates and administrative steps associated with removing units from the First Chair Destinations portfolio.
  • Maintain accurate and complete documentation throughout the termination process.
  • Coordinate with local teams and applicable internal departments to ensure required offboarding activities are completed on schedule.
  • Track unit terminations through completion, following up on outstanding tasks and escalating delays or issues when appropriate.
  • Help ensure internal systems, records, and documentation accurately reflect the final status of terminated units.

General Functions

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing program performance, identifying bottlenecks, and implementing process optimizations. Stay current with industry trends, best practices, and emerging technologies relevant to the function.
  • Contribute to a collaborative work environment that promotes open communication, innovation, and employee engagement.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to align departmental goals with broader organizational strategy.
  • Other duties as assigned because every day is different in hospitality!

Skills + Qualifications

  • Experience working in hotel, hospitality, vacation or similar industry is highly preferred.
  • College education is strongly preferred, though we recognize that great talent comes from many different paths.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience within a similar guest / customer facing support role.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workflows, deadlines, and follow-up items simultaneously.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy when completing system updates and maintaining documentation.
  • Demonstrated ability to coordinate work across multiple teams and follow issues through to resolution.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling guest concerns and sensitive information.
  • Tech-savvy with experience using various digital systems and applications and comfortable using mobile apps, tablets, and various software platforms.
  • Comfortable talking to people—online or in person—and being able to share information in a way that’s clear, thoughtful, and easy to understand.

Workplace Environment + Physical Requirements

  • Fully remote work environment with reliable internet connection.
  • Reliable transportation required.
  • Typically a Monday - Friday workweek with expectations to be flexible to support the needs of the business.

This job description does not identify every requirement of the position. First Chair may change position requirements, responsibilities, and work environment at any time with or without notice.

Some positions may require that you drive a personal vehicle and/or company vehicle for work purposes. Employees who are required to drive a personal vehicle must have reliable transportation, a valid driver’s license, and be at least 18 years of age. Employees who are required to drive a company vehicle must have a valid driver’s license, be at least 21 years of age, and have been a licensed driver for no less than 3 years.

An offer of employment for this role will be contingent upon the successful completion of a background check.

You collaborate with your teammates within the packaging department in developing and executing packaging concepts and artworks.

Your Mission

  • You support the process of designing and developing new packaging concepts based on a project brief, as well as adapting existing packaging to new needs, sizes, and forms. Packaging needs to be entirely correct across various versions and complete in its functional development steps, quality, construction, and target price needs to meet product, stichd & market standards.
  • Any packaging development needs to be compatible with the product, therefore you will work closely together with internal teams to evaluate packaging requirements at all developmental phases. In addition, it is important you have a full understanding of how the product and packaging interact, as you will create digital representations of this for packaging production.
  • You are able to meet deadlines and be efficient while working several simultaneous projects/tasks.
  • You research market, consumer and industry trends and prepare mood boards during the concept and design phase. This requires carrying out in-depth investigations into the latest trends, pricing architectures, and any potential obstacles that may come up during the testing stage.
  • You create overviews and presentations in coordination with other members of the packaging team in order to present new work or information across the organization and/or to certain stakeholders.
  • You are responsible for accurately using and maintaining the order of the server where all packaging files are stored, as well as adhering to standards such as file naming conventions, export specifications, and change logs.
  • You work closely within the process of print production and must possess the relevant knowledge in relation to materials, dielines, color systems and accuracy, etc.
  • You are able to manage the tasks delegated to you independently and within the time frame necessary, while utilizing the support and help of the wider packaging team when needed.
  • You take on other occurring relevant activities and/or projects.

Your Talent

  • You have a minimum Bachelor education level in Graphic, Packaging or Industrial Design;
  • You have some work experience (internship, 1 year) in a similar position or in graphic design related position, preferably in international organization working with global brands;
  • High proficiency in Adobe Illustrator; Technical ability to think and construct in 3D , structured, brand & product understanding, eye for details;
  • You are fluent in English;
  • Enthusiast and ready to learn from experience;
  • Hands on approach;
  • Open and positive mindset.

This role is based in Den Bosch, the Netherlands. Working remotely from other countries is not possible.

To apply for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. We will not apply for work or residence permits.



We Offer


· Our salaries are based on 38 hours per week, but fulltime work is 40 hours per week. Instead, you choose between a lot of holidays; 37 per year ór choose for a 40-hour salary per month with still 25 holidays. You can switch every six months;

· Annual bonus scheme;

· New hires (introduction) days;

· Great offer of e-learnings and a training offer for personal development;

· Enough free fruit for you daily vitamins;

· Provided lunch for low cost;

· Choose between lease-bike, NS Business Card or travel by car for € 0,25 per km (>10km).

· 8% holiday allowance, employee insurances and a good pension scheme;

· Employee discount on the PUMA, Levi’s, Fuelforfans and BMW Lifestyle websites;

· Hybrid working. On fulltime basis 3 days in the office and 2 days at home (incl. allowance for home working);

· Flexible working hours, modern workspace and a good working atmosphere;

· International working environment with colleagues of more than 50 different nationalities;

· Wellbeing activities (f.e. yoga, pilates and bootcamp) and an inhouse gym;

· Community involvement (STICHD impact tool);

About Us

Ok, we know what you’re thinking: at over 700 members, that’s a pretty big family. But what we really mean is that, whatever our skills or our story, whatever the task or the time pressure, we’re in it together. Pushing each other, backing each other and believing in each other, always.

From design and logistics to retail and events. From our HQ in the Netherlands to sales offices and logistics centres all over the world. Like we said: a lot.

description:
**Grade UE07: £41,064 – £48,822 per annum, pro rata**

**Corporate Services Group / Edinburgh Research Office**

**The Opportunity:**

**Together we can do great things. Be part of something bigger.**

Here, you can continue to make a difference in everything around you. There are so many reasons to take your next step with us.

- As the **Fellowships Coordinator**, you will work within a small team at Edinburgh based in the Edinburgh Research Office, as well as communicating with counterparts across the EvEx consortium.

We value colleagues with drive, determination and a passion for what they do. Discover more about working at the University of Edinburgh on our [Jobs website](https://www.ed.ac.uk/jobs)

- Working within one of the world’s leading universities
- Interesting work

- Responsibility and autonomy

This post is part-time (21 hours per week).

title: Sales Engineer - DACH
description:
About GreyNoise

GreyNoise Intelligence is a mission driven security startup focused on helping organizations understand and mitigate risks from Internet scanning and exploitation. GreyNoise provides real-time, verifiable intelligence on all actors scanning the Internet and how some of them are attempting to exploit vulnerabilities on assets connected to corporate networks. The intelligence is highly trusted because it’s generated from a global fleet of thousands of purpose built sensors observing the Internet. Advanced data science techniques and AI are used to process millions of observed events into real-time intelligence for customers.

The GreyNoise Global Observation Grid observes and analyzes unique threat data at-scale that no one else can. GreyNoise provides the most actionable threat intelligence against perimeter threats, so that no attack works twice.

All US based positions are fully remote within the US, with optional office attendance at our DC area headquarters, unless otherwise specified. Applicants must have US work authorization.

Please see the specific job description for all international position locations.

The Role

As a Sales Engineer at GreyNoise, you will support the technical components of the sales process for our DACH enterprise and government accounts. You will partner closely with Account Executives to understand customer needs, demonstrate product value, lead Proof of Values, and address any technical requirements or concerns. This role is instrumental in driving technical validation and accelerating deal cycles.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as the technical lead during the sales process.
  • Lead technical discovery and deliver customized product demos and workshops
  • Design, execute, and support successful PoVs and pilots.
  • Demonstrate workflows for security operations, threat intelligence, threat hunting and vulnerability prioritization
  • Validate integrations and automation using APIs, scripting and supported security platforms
  • Work with customers to understand their environment, challenges, and desired outcomes.
  • Respond to RFIs/RFPs and assist in crafting technical proposals.
  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Experience to ensure feedback is captured and incorporated.
  • Represent GreyNoise at industry events, webinars, and customer briefings.

What You Will Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering or Solutions Architecture roles in the cybersecurity or enterprise SaaS space.
  • An understanding of network security and internet-facing threats
  • Deep familiarity with threat intelligence, SIEM/SOAR/TIP, and incident response workflows.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise security architectures and technical decision-making.\
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience with API integrations, scripting (eg. Python) and tools like curl, JSON, etc.
  • Ability to present technical content to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Professional fluency in English and availability for customer and partner travel across EMEA

Benefits

💵 Equity in a Growing Startup. Every employee has the opportunity to share in GreyNoise's success through equity.

👩‍⚕️ Health & Wellness Benefits. US employees receive 100% company-covered health, dental, vision, and life insurance. Benefits for international employees vary by country and local requirements.

6️⃣ Retirement Benefits. US employees receive a competitive 6% employer 401(k) match, 100% fully vested from day one. International employees receive applicable statutory pension benefits in accordance with local regulations.

🏖 Flexible Paid Time Off. We believe taking time away from work is essential to staying healthy and doing your best work. We take this very seriously and even include scheduled all-company shutdowns throughout the year. Employees also receive any additional leave required by local laws.

🌎 Remote-First, Globally Connected. Headquartered in the Washington, DC area, GreyNoise is a distributed team working remotely across the US and Europe. We value flexibility, trust, and meaningful connections, no matter where you work.

💻 Equipment Budget. Every new employee receives a GreyNoise Apple Mac laptop and a $500 stipend (or local currency equivalent) for equipment and accessories to create a comfortable and productive workspace.

👼 Paid Parental Leave. Growing your family is a big milestone, and we're here to support you. We offer four months of paid parental leave for birth or adoption, plus up to two additional months of optional unpaid leave, coordinated with applicable statutory leave entitlements and local requirements.

📚 Learning & Development Budget. Every employee receives $1,500 annually (or local currency equivalent) to invest in professional development. Use it for courses, books, conferences, certifications, and other learning opportunities related to your role.

🌴 Team Connection & Company Offsites. We bring our distributed team together through multiple company and team offsites, virtual events, and local meetups to build relationships and stay connected beyond our day-to-day work.

Benefits and eligibility may vary based on country of employment, local regulations, and applicable employment arrangements.

GreyNoise Culture

The hallmark of any great company is a palpable and viscous culture. The most important pillars of our culture are:
  • Be transparent, honest, and objective. This is what it means to be “clinical”
  • Empathize with customers, partners, and each other
  • Learn from mistakes and share the knowledge
  • The way feedback is delivered to one another matters as much as the feedback itself
  • Good work-life balance is the key to sustained productivity
  • The measure of a team member’s effectiveness is how well the rest of the team operates in their unexpected absence
  • No such thing as a million dollar idea, only million dollar execution
  • Out-innovate our previous selves
Check out our (work-in-progress) longform culture document.

Explainability

Any security product that is a “black box” that asks you to blindly trust it should raise red flags - we believe the same is true of your place of work. We obviously think GreyNoise is doing something unique, but don’t take our word for it - ask any of our 150+ enterprise customers, investors, thousands of happy users, or dozens of journalists who have cited GreyNoise over the past few years.

Why You Should Work at GreyNoise

  • You enjoy identifying and solving hard problems
  • You are comfortable taking an idea from concept to customer
  • You are open to both explaining your stance and questioning others in a clinical, open-minded, and respectful manner
  • You want to directly impact users
  • You want to grow beyond your current skill set

description:

Shanghai, China

R0145947

Job Description:

The opportunity
Hitachi Energy is a global technology leader that is advancing a sustainable energy future for all.

Hitachi Energy's Grid Integration business unit has delivered more than 4,000 projects over the last 15 years. Our Grid Integration portfolio spans a wide range of transmission and substation applications, which facilitate reliable and efficient system integration of the future digital electric network with minimum environmental impact.

We incorporate the integrated systems, solutions and services of our business' DC and AC fields, including HVDC, Substations, FACTS, Grid and Power Quality solutions such as offshore wind connections, and Semiconductors. We offer Power Consulting for key segments in the energy system, such as renewables, transmission distribution and as well as e-transportation solutions.
How you’ll make an impact
1. You will ensure projects follow sound methodology and execution practices in accordance with internal standard procedures, and ensure that an integrated schedule for the project's entire scope of work is provided.
2. You will analyze project requirements with project team, check that all essential work activities have been identified in sufficient detail to serve as a basis for developing realistic project schedules. You will define, jointly with the project team, project work aligned to the cost breakdown structure, develop, and maintain properly linked, required role loaded/integrated, baseline and current schedules that provide time phased baseline, actual and forecast data for project. You will monitor project progress and regularly analyze project critical paths to ensure all critical path activities and project milestones are progressed to the plan, notify Project Managers of any deviations or scheduling issues, and provide input for optimizing resources. When required you will prepare EOT Schedules and Schedule Analysis to support Project Team. You will work together with Line Management Organization to resolve Resource Demand / Staffing Conflicts. You will issue progress reports, schedule updates and productivity data on a regular basis and as requested by customers and stakeholders.
3. You will support the establishment of a baseline plan for cost and cash flow performance measurement. You will work with project team to define the necessary resources for project completion, evaluating the work breakdown structure and standard productivity. Where required – you will create As Sold reference point in Project Control tool suite and generate Original Budget baseline. You will reflect Variation Orders in the revised baseline.
4. You will work closely with engineering, construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning, client and contractors to identify potential changes in scope and quantify the impact of each change in a timely fashion. You will revise baseline in line with the approved Variation Orders and Extension of Time requests.
5. You will work with project team to identify and assess the priority of project risks (e.g. schedule, cost and scope risks), and propose mitigation plans. You will analyze impact of risk on the overall timeline and resources.
6. You will integrate material resource requirements with project schedule and define procurement activities and order lead times. You will regularly communicate with Supply Chain Management team and update schedules to ensure procurement activities take place in a timely way and lead times are optimized to meet schedule targets.
7. You will participate in project reviews. You will compose reports and update all required project data in Project Controls and reporting systems for Management Information and Project Analysis. You will communicate project progress and control issues to project management team and offer solutions.
8. You will effectively communicate appropriate information to the Project Manager and other stakeholders in a timely manner and achieve desired understanding.
9. You will ensure at the Portfolio level that project planning activities for the project portfolios are in line with Hitachi Energy instructions and guidelines and are adequate to implement contractual agreements with Hitachi Energy customers.
10. You will support Sales & Operations Planning Process where required. You will work together with Sales team to define Planning Scenarios, drive workload data collection process from organization, and chair monthly S&OP Review Meeting.

11.You will be responsible for ensure compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

12.Living Hitachi Energy's core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
1. bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or equivalent

2.Minimum 10 years of experience in project schedule control on medium to large-size international projects.
3.Strong communication & coordination with different stakeholders /interfaces is required;
4.Teamwork player and willing to take challenges under pressure

5.Skilled in Excel (Pivot Table) & project schedule, Proficient in Primavera P6 & Power BI

6.Proficient in English reading and writing, Mandarin
More about us

We pride ourselves on offering a holistic range of competitive benefit programs to support your financial, physical and mental wellbeing and personal development. We want you to truly thrive with us – in work and out. For this role, depending on grade and experience, we offer the following employee benefits (subject to the respective plan rules) :

1.Up to 30 days full paid leaves per year

2.Flexible Benefit program (Supplementary Pensions included)

3.Medical Insurance(outpatient and inpatient)

4.Long service awards

title: Contract & Supplier Management Specialist
description:
**Grade UE07: £41,064 – £48,822 per annum**

**Finance Directorate / Procurement Department**

**Full-time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed-term: 12 months contract**

Edinburgh University is a world leader.

Our vision is “To become world class in everything we do, recognised as a trusted strategic partner in the successful delivery of the University’s Strategy 2030”.

We’re looking for great people to join our Contract & Supplier Management (CSM) team in our award-winning Procurement department.

Procurement at Edinburgh University is undergoing a major transformation as we extend the scope of our influence and impact across our £1bn world-renowned organisation.

To deliver on our commitments we are now looking for people who make things happen, who challenge the status quo, are excited about working in a diverse, dynamic environment and really want to make a change.

Be part of our new Procurement journey.

**The Opportunity:**

We are looking for a Contract & Supplier Management Specialist to join our Strategic Procurement team. The Department currently comprises of four ‘Category’ Teams; Information Services & IT, Professional Campus Services, Estates & Buildings, and Laboratories & Medical - of which the CSM Specialists will be allocated. Embedded within the Strategic Procurement function, the Contract & Supplier Management Specialist is responsible for supporting the delivery and development of the contract and supplier management activities within the Procurement Department, ensuring the right outcomes are delivered and the performance of contracts is maximised, as well as adding value through enhancement of supplier relationship management.

Through the development of strong internal and external relationships, the post-holder will effectively manage a range of key suppliers to maximise the outcomes and benefits to the University through supplier relationship management and contract management processes, with the objective of delivering the following:

- Effective management and monitoring of supplier performance and supply chain risks;
- Commercial and operational value through its contracts with its suppliers, reducing costs and increasing value-add;
- Environmental and social impact through the life of the contracts, driving forward the responsible procurement agenda; and
- Identification of opportunities for in-life innovation and creativity to drive efficiency and consistency.

The post-holder will be expected to contribute to the University’s financial wellbeing and international research profile, by delivering cash savings and other cost efficiencies; and supporting the knowledge creation and transfer which lies at the heart of the University’s Strategy 2030.

Successful candidate will join a forward-thinking, ambitious and supportive procurement team, already well advanced in a service transformation programme.  As part of the wider Finance Directorate, we aim to deliver world-class services to the University’s academic teaching and research staff and our professional services colleagues, in keeping with the institution’s Top-20 World Ranking.

You will engage directly with a wide range of internal and external stakeholders, ensuring that Procurement delivers innovative, fit for purpose solutions which are aligned to University objectives and Government policy.

Candidates will be encouraged to exercise initiative and discretion, taking ownership of CSM projects that deliver maximum benefit across the University.

**Your skills and attributes for success:**

- Self-motivated and proactive, with a passion to help shape and develop the service.
- Good commercial competence, risk management, and strong negotiation skills.
- Personal credibility and ethics; capacity and confidence to manage contracts and deliver change with aptitude for implementing and improving best-practice procedures.
- Demonstrable experience of negotiation skills.
- Relevant contract and supplier management experience.
- Good computing literacy and numerical analysis skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Strong communication and negotiation skills and commercial judgement.

The job description can be found [**here**](https://uoe.sharepoint.com/:w:/s/jobdescriptionlibrary/IQBEBhAm86kpRKcRYmcSEYMeAZXUJ7NYlDSjBDxcrxKPJ5o)

- CV

**As a valued member of our team, you can expect:**

- A competitive salary.

- An exciting, positive, creative, challenging and rewarding place to work.

- To be part of a diverse and vibrant international community.

- Comprehensive Staff Benefits, including generous annual leave entitlement, a defined benefits pension scheme, a wide range of staff discounts, family-friendly initiatives, and flexible work options. Check out the full list on our [**staff benefits page**](https://www.ed.ac.uk/human-resources/pay-reward/staff-benefits)and use our reward calculator to discover the value of your pay and benefits.

The University of Edinburgh holds a Silver Athena SWAN award in recognition of our commitment to advance gender equality in higher education. We are members of the Race Equality Charter, and we are also Stonewall Scotland Diversity Champions, actively promoting LGBT equality.

Prior to any employment commencing with the University, you will be required to evidence your right to work in the UK. Further information is available on our

[**right to work webpages**](https://www.ed.ac.uk/human-resources/demonstrating-rtw)**.**

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining scalable, stable, and high performance technical solutions. Besides delivering new features on time with high quality, this role requires a high degree of initiative to identify and resolve systemic technical debt in the codebase that could hinder development or cause regressions. You are expected to be a driving force in code modernization, a mentor to junior engineers, and a strategic partner to the Backend Engineering Manager in improving the team's code and quality standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Produce high-quality, secure, and maintainable code for new features, and ensure on-time delivery
  • Proactively audit the existing codebase, identify bottlenecks, diagnose the causes of regressions, and lead technical improvement initiatives to enhance development efficiency.
  • Collaborate with the Backend Engineering Manager in reviewing system designs to ensure that the chosen solutions are well-balanced and not under/over-designed
  • Serve as a stronghold for code quality through rigorous and constructive code reviews, and ensure that the team adheres to automated testing standards
  • Be able to independently lead incident response during 24/7 on-call rotations, focusing on rapid detection and response, as well as initiating, leading, and completing RCA creation as the primary point of contact to ensure appropriate action items and timely resolution.
  • Provide mentorship to junior engineers to enhance the team's overall technical capabilities.

Requirements:

  • At least 5-6 years of professional work experience in Backend Engineering
  • Strong professional experience in development using Golang and/or .NET, as well as MySQL and/or PostgreSQL.
  • In-depth experience working with legacy codebases and a proven track record of successfully refactoring or upgrading architecture without disrupting the stability of the running system
  • Strong understanding of design patterns, microservice architecture, database query optimizations, and regression mitigation strategies
  • Experience implementing CI/CD, writing strong automated tests (unit, integration, E2E), and utilizing monitoring and APM tools.
  • Strong communication skills to articulate the urgency of addressing technical improvements (technical debt) to both other engineers and technical/non-technical stakeholders
  • Willing to Work From Office(Mampang, Jakarta Selatan)

title: Sr. Officer, U.S. Philanthropy
description:
Who We Are

International Justice Mission (IJM) is the global leader in protecting vulnerable people from violence around the world. Our team of over 1,200 professionals are at work worldwide in over 30 offices. Together we are on a mission to rescue millions, protect half a billion, and make justice unstoppable.

We are a global community that cares for one another. We believe that the way we work is as important as the results we achieve. We provide professional excellence with joy and celebration to all those we serve.

The Need

For over 25 years, IJM has pioneered the work to protect vulnerable people from violence. 9 out of 9 times in the last decade, IJM’s Justice System Strengthening Projects have reduced slavery and violence between 50 and 85% for very large populations of people in poverty. As we grow to expand our impact to protect 500 million people from violence, we are seeking a Sr. Officer, U.S. Philanthropy to cultivate deep, trust-based relationships with existing donors to inspire continued and increased giving, while also identifying and engaging new supporters through strategic networking and regional connections. This leader will play a pivotal role in expanding IJM’s donor footprint and deepening engagement across the region through personalized cultivation, solicitation and stewardship, as well as through collaboration on events and donor experiences.

This position is remote and requires candidates to be based in the San Francisco, California area. It reports to the Director, U.S. Philanthropy, and requires current authorization to work in the United States. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position, now or in the future.

Responsibilities:

Strategy & Knowledge Development & Implementation:

  • Develop, implement and evaluate strategies to significantly broaden and deepen the base of support from major donors in the region; and
  • Leverage Salesforce to maintain accurate donor records and track engagement; regularly update projections, contact reports, and giving history to drive strategic fundraising decisions and donor stewardship.

Networking & Partnership:

  • Manage a portfolio of approximately 150 major donors and foundations;
  • Cultivate, solicit, and steward existing donors to increase funding levels;
  • Identify and build relationships with new individuals and foundations, including onboarding major donors transitioning from mid-level portfolios;
  • Coordinate with IJM leaders globally to design engagement opportunities aligned with donor passions and field needs;
  • Collaborate with HQ events team to plan and implement regional events that deepen relationships and attract new supporters;
  • Partner with Mobilization teams to identify and cultivate major donor leads from church and workplace engagement efforts; and
  • Develop and execute strategies to expand the donor base through networks, events, and media-driven opportunities.

Communication:

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to engage high-potential donors clearly, intelligently, and with compelling passion for the mission;
  • Ability to communicate consistently in the donor’s preferred style, delivering clear, mission-aligned messages that resonate and inspire action; and

description:

Dan is werken als hulpkracht bij Wibra echt iets voor jou. Je zorgt samen met je collega’s voor een nette en gevulde winkel. Je helpt klanten, vult schappen en springt bij achter de kassa. Je werkt vooral in de avonden en weekenden, ideaal te combineren met school.

Werken bij Wibra is leuk. Je bent veel in beweging, helpt klanten en zorgt dat de winkel er goed uitziet. Juist die afwisseling en het samenwerken maken het werk leuk en zorgen voor een goede sfeer in het team.

Er is vracht binnengekomen en jullie zorgen ervoor dat de winkel snel en netjes wordt aangevuld. Je bent veel bezig met vullen, opruimen en het netjes houden van de winkel. Tussendoor help je klanten en werk je achter de kassa. Je bent de hele dag lekker actief bezig en geen dag is hetzelfde. title: Clinical Scientist - MR
description:
Job Title: Clinical Scientist - MR

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

Are you energized by solving complex problems at the intersection of advanced MRI, innovation, and human longevity? We are looking for an MR Clinical Scientist or Researcher that can bring practical, hands-on experience beyond academic training, along with diverse MR expertise, technical curiosity, and a can-do attitude to GE HealthCare and our collaboration partner.

In close partnership with Magnetic Resonance (MR) clinical and academic partners, as well as GE HealthCare colleagues, you will explore, prototype, and validate advanced MR applications that improve understanding of aging, preventive health, and precision care, ultimately expanding the translational impact of our technology solutions in clinical practice to provide precision healthcare across the globe.

This role operates in a highly collaborative research environment and requires a self-motivated individual who can work independently, identify opportunities proactively, and translate complex scientific challenges into practical imaging solutions.


**This role will need to be able to work onsite at a facility in Englewood , NJ**

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

  • Provide technical expertise and support to optimize the use of GEHC MR products, partnering with GEHC scientists to introduce appropriate prototypes, software, and off-line analysis tools to research collaborators and support related research.
  • Identify key customer needs and serve as the GEHC technical lead for collaborative research projects aligned with the GEHC MR roadmap and strategic goals, particularly in longevity and preventative health.
  • Serve as the primary GE HealthCare scientific and technical representative at a strategic research collaboration site, operating with a high degree of independence and ownership.
  • Apply expertise in MRI, engineering, AI, and clinical workflows to design and develop innovative MR applications that automate and simplify exams, enable biomarker discovery for aging and early disease detection, and support multimodal correlation with therapeutic interventions and lifestyle changes.
  • Develop selected capabilities as prototypes and release them to external GEHC collaborators in accordance with GEHC MR design controls.
  • Conduct original research that contributes to patent applications and joint scientific publications.
  • Support pre- and post-market evidence generation at collaborating institutions by partnering with MR Clinical Directors to align collaborations with GEHC product development priorities and institutional needs.
  • Support customer satisfaction through proactive communication, site observation, and timely escalation of site inquiries and concerns.



Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in an engineering or science field such as Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Math, or Physics.
  • Minimum 5 years of work experience in the medical imaging or medical research field post-graduation.
  • Strong preference for candidates with demonstrated industry experience applying MRI technologies within healthcare technology, medical imaging, clinical research, or commercial research environments beyond academic training alone.
  • Strong background in image processing, deep learning image segmentation, quantitative imaging, and MR open-source post-processing pipelines.
  • Strong understanding of MR Physics.
  • Familiarity with GEHC MR Systems and research conducted on those systems.
  • Substantial experience in software design, implementation, and coding.
  • Excellent coding skills and ability to quickly prototype in C++, Matlab, and Python.
  • Outstanding writing, presentation, and communication skills.
  • Strong collaboration skills and ability to thrive in a dynamic environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and drive initiatives with minimal supervision.
  • Can-do attitude, flexibility, intellectual curiosity, and willingness to work with cross-functional global teams.
  • **This role will need to be able to work onsite at a facility in Englewood , NJ**
  • Willing to travel up to 10% outside of primary work location.



Desired Characteristics

  • Master’s Degree in an engineering or science field such as Electrical Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Computer Science, Applied Math, or Physics.
  • Experience in advanced MR methods such as diffusion imaging, quantitative imaging, and image segmentation/registration.
  • Hands-on experience with in-vivo MR imaging in a research setting.
  • Clinical or research MR experience across multiple anatomical areas, including neuro, body, musculoskeletal, and quantitative imaging applications.
  • Experience in the application of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence to medical imaging.
  • Experience in predictive modeling or multimodal analysis.
  • Familiarity with GEHC EPIC Pulse Sequence Development environment and GEHC Orchestra Reconstruction environment.
  • Demonstrated interest in longevity science, aging research, preventative health, precision medicine, or related research initiatives.
  • Proven ability to thrive within ambiguous research environments, identify unmet needs, and creatively develop innovative imaging solutions.
  • Experience working in highly autonomous roles requiring customer interaction, scientific consultation, and independent decision-making.

**Job Title: Sr. Associate, Integration & Test Engineer (RC-135 Aircraft Mission Systems)**

**Job Code: 45949**

**Job Location: Offutt AFB, NE (On-Site)**

**Job Schedule: 5/8: Employees work 8 hours per day, 5 days a week - Mission Dependent**

**Job Description:**

L3Harris is seeking an Integration/Test Engineering Specialist for RC-135 Mission Systems at our Offutt AFB, Nebraska location to provide immediate impact providing maintenance required to sustain extremely complex airborne and ground-based systems for the RC-135.

**Essential Functions:**

- Operating and sustaining digital/computer-based systems, associated networks, digital and analog audio/interphone and recorder systems.

- Operating LOS and SATCOM radios in voice, text, and data modes.
- Configuring, loading, operating, and maintaining various crypto devices.
- Performing configuration, setup, and usage of Data Transfer Devices.
- Operating and sustaining various datalinks and broadband communications.
- Troubleshooting/Repairing HF, VHF, and UHF receiver/transmitter systems.
- Managing system records and coordinating with maintenance supply organizations for requisition, documentation, and turn-in of parts.
- Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:

Join a culture of collaboration and innovation that matters and a chance to learn, effect change, and make meaningful contributions at work and in communities. ​

About the Role:
The AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) is seeking a Senior AI Engineer to lead the design, development, and deployment of enterprise AI solutions that create measurable business impact across the organization.


This is a senior individual contributor role within the AI Center of Excellence (AI CoE) for an experienced engineer who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys turning complex business challenges into scalable AI solutions. You will work closely with Principal AI Engineers, enterprise architects, business stakeholders, and product teams to drive AI initiatives from concept through production.


As a key member of the AI CoE, you will lead end-to-end solution development, including architecture, development, integration, evaluation, deployment, governance, and operationalization of AI solutions. You will also help establish engineering best practices, reusable frameworks, and standards that accelerate AI adoption across the enterprise.


This role is ideal for a builder who enjoys ownership, technical leadership, and creating innovative solutions in a rapidly evolving AI landscape.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of AI and Generative AI solutions, taking ownership from business discovery and solution design through deployment and operational support.
  • Work directly with business stakeholders to identify opportunities, define requirements, prioritize use cases, and translate business challenges into practical AI solutions.
  • Design scalable solution architectures leveraging LLMs, RAG, AI agents, enterprise knowledge sources, APIs, workflow automation, and cloud services.
  • Develop and deploy production-grade AI applications, services, and copilots using Python, Azure AI, Azure OpenAI, Snowflake, and related enterprise technologies.
  • Drive technical decisions across AI projects, evaluating architecture options, implementation approaches, trade-offs, risks, and long-term maintainability.
  • Establish and implement testing, evaluation, and monitoring practices to ensure AI solutions are accurate, reliable, secure, and production ready.
  • Collaborate with architects, data engineers, platform teams, security teams, and business partners to successfully integrate AI capabilities into enterprise systems and processes.
  • Build reusable frameworks, accelerators, templates, and engineering standards that improve delivery speed and enable scalable AI adoption across the organization.
  • Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design guidance, code reviews, technical coaching, and sharing best practices across the AI CoE.
  • Continuously evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend innovative solutions that deliver measurable business value and strategic advantage

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
  • 4-6 years of relevant professional experience in AI, machine learning, data, or software engineering with min 1 year of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying AI, Machine Learning, or Generative AI solutions end-to-end.
  • Strong Python development skills and experience with software engineering principles including modular design, API development, testing, version control, secure coding practices, system integration, and maintainable application architecture.
  • Strong understanding of modern Gen AI architectures including Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI agents, prompt engineering, evaluation frameworks, deterministic orchestration and AI solution architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AI application and orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, LlamaIndex, or equivalent technologies.
  • Proven ability to operate in ambiguous environments, independently drive technical solutions, and lead initiatives from concept through production deployment

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Copilot Studio, Snowflake Cortex AI, or other enterprise AI platforms.
  • Experience designing and developing enterprise AI applications, copilots, intelligent assistants, automation solutions, or agent-based systems deployed to business users.
  • Experience with CI/CD, DevOps, MLOps, and LLMOps practices for enterprise AI solution deployment and support.
  • Experience with containerization and cloud-native development technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps, or Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS).
  • Experience building AI-enabled applications and services using frameworks such as FastAPI, Flask, Streamlit, React, Next.js, .NET, or equivalent application development frameworks.
  • Demonstrated experience leading the technical delivery of complex software, AI, or automation projects involving multiple stakeholders, systems, and business functions.
  • Familiarity with enterprise governance controls for GenAI (privacy, safety, auditability).
  • Experience optimizing inference costs/latency and implementing observability for AI features.

Professional Skills

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Capacity to thrive in agile, fast-paced environments.
  • Collaborative approach and leadership potential.
  • Commitment to continuous learning and skill development.
  • Effective task prioritization and project management across multiple initiatives.

title: Software Engineer (Java)
description:
Epassi’s purpose is to boost everyday well-being.

We are a leading provider of employee benefit solutions in Europe. We were established in Finland in 2007, and in 2008 we were the first company to launch a mobile-payable employee benefit payment solution in Europe. Since then, we have consistently grown, diversifying our products and introducing our services into new markets. Epassi has been awarded by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe on multiple occasions.

Are you interested in joining one of Europe's fastest growing companies? Do you want to impact the wellbeing of millions of users?

Are you an experienced backend developer ready to grow and deliver impactful services at one of Europe's fastest-growing companies?

If yes, keep reading and join us to make an impact in a fast-paced and dynamic environment where you'll play a key role in boosting everyday wellbeing, at home, at work. Everywhere!

We are currently hiring a Mid-Level Software Engineer (Java) to be based in either Finland, Germany, Poland, Netherlands, Sweden, Spain or UK. The preferred location is Finland or Germany.

Epassi's purpose is to boost everyday well-being. We are a leading provider of employee benefit solutions across Europe, established in Finland in 2007. We were the first company to launch a mobile-payable employee benefit payment solution in Europe, and have been recognised by the Financial Times as one of the fastest-growing companies in Europe on multiple occasions. We are an AI-native engineering organisation — we build with AI tools, we iterate with AI tools, and we expect our engineers to embrace this as a core part of how great software gets made.

Your Mission at Epassi

You will be a core contributor on a cross-functional product team, building and evolving backend services using Java Spring Boot that power Epassi's product vision. We are adding this role to strengthen our backend engineering capacity and bring meaningful features to life reliably and at quality. You will take ownership of defined service areas, work confidently across the stack, and grow into greater technical responsibility over time.

Your Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain high-quality backend services using Java Spring Boot, taking ownership of your work from implementation through testing and release
  • Write clean, secure, and testable code following agreed engineering standards, making it easy for your team to review, understand, and build upon
  • Design and implement RESTful APIs in collaboration with Frontend Engineers, ensuring reliable contracts and well-handled edge cases
  • Ensure code quality through unit and integration tests, thorough code reviews, and participation in refactoring efforts
  • Debug and resolve issues in both development and production environments, communicating clearly about root causes and fixes
  • Identify and flag technical debt within your areas of ownership, proposing improvements as your confidence grows
  • Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes, developing your understanding of how services are built and released
  • Participate actively in agile ceremonies — planning, refinements, reviews, and retrospectives — and document your technical decisions

What You Should Bring

  • 2–4 years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 1 year building backend services with Java in a professional setting. A Computer Science degree or equivalent is not required — we care about what you can build and how you think, not where you studied.
  • Java & Spring Boot (solid): Solid hands-on experience building backend services with Java and Spring Boot, including REST APIs, dependency injection, and the Spring application lifecycle
  • Data persistence: Working knowledge of JPA/Hibernate and relational databases — writing queries, understanding entity relationships, and basic schema design
  • API design: Comfortable designing and implementing RESTful APIs with a good understanding of HTTP semantics, status codes, and error handling
  • Testing: Familiarity with writing unit and integration tests in Java (e.g. JUnit, Mockito); experience with test-driven development is a plus
  • Version control: Confident use of Git, including branching strategies, pull requests, and resolving merge conflicts in a team environment
  • CI/CD basics: Awareness of CI/CD concepts and experience working within an automated build and deployment pipeline
  • AI-native development: Familiarity with AI coding tools such as Copilot or Cursor is a plus — we're an AI-native team and are happy to help you develop this further
  • Containerisation: Basic familiarity with Docker and how containerised services are built and run

Why You Should Join Us

  • Be part of an ambitious growth journey and join a global community of driven, bold, entrepreneurial, yet humble Epassians.
  • Work with a clear purpose — boosting everyday wellbeing — and create a meaningful, positive impact on individuals and society.
  • Thrive in an open and inclusive culture with low hierarchy, built on respect, camaraderie, and shared successes.
  • Come as you are — we’ll bring out the best in you and support your personal and professional growth.
  • Join a fast-growing tech company with a strong financial foundation, offering opportunities to grow and make an impact.
  • Benefit from an inspiring and supportive work environment where employee wellbeing is a true priority.

Imagine influencing the future of medicine before it reaches patients. As Director, Market Access Early Pipeline, you will play a critical role in shaping how Novartis invests across its innovative pipeline, helping determine which assets advance and how they are developed to maximize patient access and commercial success. description:

**CSE / School of Engineering / Cosysense**

**Full-time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed-term: 24 months**

**Location: Primarily based at Cosysense**

**The Opportunity:**

**Where curiosity becomes impact.**

This is a KTP Associate to contribute to the [Knowledge Transfer Partnership](https://iuk-ktp.org.uk/) (KTP) project that aims to develop next-generation thermal comfort and energy optimisation models for scalable deployment. Funded by InnovateUK, the KTP project is co-led by the [Institute for Infrastructure and Environment](https://eng.ed.ac.uk/research/institutes/iie) and [Institute for Energy Systems](https://eng.ed.ac.uk/research/institutes/ies) at the University of Edinburgh (UoE), and [Cosysense](https://cosysense.space/). Cosysense reduces electricity costs and carbon emissions in commercial buildings by delivering optimised comfort through AI-native climate control powered by sensors, digital twins, and autonomous control systems.

The KTP Associate will lead the development and deployment of advanced thermal comfort and grid demand response physics models into Cosysense’s AI control system. You will act as the bridge between academic research and real-world application, translating cutting-edge building physics and human comfort modelling into production-ready algorithms controlling HVAC systems in live buildings. In line with the KTP model, the Associate is embedded at Cosysense day to day, engaging regularly with the University of Edinburgh for knowledge transfer and academic supervision.

**This role will be primarily based at Cosysense.**

The role combines:

- Research (building physics and energy systems)
- Applied AI / modelling
- Real-world deployment and validation in commercial buildings

**A unique employer in a vibrant city.** The University isn’t just any employer. We are part of a local community and a contributor to global thinking, progress and research. In Edinburgh, you are in one of the world’s most attractive cities with active arts and social sectors, while working in a University that has made significant contributions to society, medicine, physics and teaching for over four centuries. Our people have helped create the modern world and are working on more ground-breaking technologies and practices.

**Make a meaningful impact.** Here, you can continue to make a difference in everything around you. Take on new challenges, grow your career, be recognised for your contributions, and benefit from our commitment to your wellbeing. Be part of something bigger — where your work has real impact and your development matters. There are so many reasons to take your next step with us.

This post is full-time (35 hours per week); however, we are open to considering part-time or flexible working patterns. We are also open to considering requests for hybrid working (on a non-contractual basis) that combines a mix of remote and regular on-campus working.

title: Senior Algorithm Developer — Robotics Team
description:
Kela is a secure, open platform enabling rapid and seamless integration of commercial and military systems in service of Western defense. Designed and battle-tested by Israeli innovators, Kela ensures the West meets today's frontline challenges and evolves with tomorrow's innovations. Backed by leading investors, Kela combines Israeli innovation with global mission impact.

About the Role

Our Robotics department works across unmanned ground vehicles, humanoids, quadrupeds, and drones. We combine classical, modular policy stacks with modern physical AI — integrating and fine-tuning open-source foundation models, and designing and training our own perception, planning, and control modules where nothing off-the-shelf is good enough.

We're looking for a world-class Senior Algorithm Developer to join the team. We need people who think big, move fast, and have a track record that proves they can take an algorithmic problem from a whiteboard sketch to a system running reliably in the field.


Requirements

Responsibilities

  • Research and develop algorithms spanning classical methods and deep learning.
  • Design and build perception, planning, localization, navigation and control modules for real, unstructured environments.
  • Integrate, adapt, and fine-tune open-source physical AI foundation models.
  • Own algorithmic pipelines end to end: data, simulation, training, evaluation, deployment.
  • Apply reinforcement learning and imitation learning to build robust, capable policies.
  • Build and run simulation environments to train and validate policies before field deployment.
  • Work closely with systems and software engineers to close the loop between algorithms and real-world performance.
  • Take ownership of problems end to end, from open question to fielded solution.

Must-have

  • A proven track record of excellence — top academic background, competitive achievements, elite technological unit service, or high-impact work in industry — and the potential to become one of the strongest in the world in physical AI.
  • Several years of hands-on experience as an algorithm developer, with real seniority: someone who can own hard problems independently.
  • Strong foundations in classical algorithms and control, alongside real depth in modern deep learning.
  • A builder's mindset: comfortable with ambiguity, driven by hard problems, focused on real-world performance.
  • B.Sc./M.Sc./Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Applied Math, Physics, or a related field from a leading institution.

Nice-to-have

  • Hands-on experience with reinforcement learning and/or imitation learning.
  • Practical experience building data pipelines and simulation environments for training and evaluation.
  • Strong software engineering skills.
  • Experience integrating, fine-tuning, or deploying open-source foundation models.
  • Experience with robotics tooling (ROS/ROS2), simulators (Isaac Sim, Gazebo, MuJoCo), and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch, etc.).

Why Join

  • Work across UGVs, humanoids, quadrupeds, and drones as the group grows.
  • Sit at the frontier of physical AI — shaping which approach wins for each problem, classical, learned, or hybrid.
  • Join a small, high-caliber team where your algorithms reach real robots in the field, fast.
  • Be part of a fast-growing, well-backed Israeli defense tech company with global impact.

Experience should include significant, demonstrated results leading Process-Piping design efforts supporting industrial gas turbine packaging and associated gas compression and power generation projects and BOP systems engineering and design.

  • Participating in and supporting proposal preparation, cost estimates, and technical reports.

Lead the selection, sizing, specification, and integration of rotating, static, heat-transfer, and packaged mechanical equipment for gas compression station and Balance of Plant applications.

Prepare and review equipment datasheets, technical specifications, purchase requisitions, technical bid evaluations, vendor drawings, and equipment general-arrangement documents.
