title: Radioisotope Program Shipment Coordinator
description:
Requisition Id 17250

**Overview:**

The Isotope Science and Engineering Directorate (ISED) of Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL) seeks applications for a Radioisotope Program Shipment Coordinator. ORNL is the largest US Department of Energy science and energy laboratory, conducting basic and applied research to deliver transformative solutions to compelling problems in energy and security. ORNL has an extraordinary 80-year history of solving the nation's biggest problems. Our team is made up of over 7,000 dedicated and innovative individuals! Our goal is to create an environment where a variety of perspectives and backgrounds are valued, ensuring ORNL is known as a top choice for employment. These principles are essential for supporting our broader mission to drive scientific breakthroughs and translate them into solutions for energy, environmental, and security challenges facing the nation.

ISED supports the largest radioisotope production and research portfolio within the Department of Energy Isotope Program, together with a growing stable isotope enrichment mission. ISED produces and ships isotopes such as Cf-252, Ac-225, Ir-192, Th-228, Pm-147 and Se-75 for medicine, science, national security, and industry, using unique ORNL facilities that include the High Flux Isotope Reactor (HFIR), the Radiochemical Engineering Development Center (REDC), Bethel Valley hot cells, and associated waste handling facilities. Every product that leaves an ISED facility, and many intermediate materials that move between ORNL facilities, depends on safe, compliant, and on-time radioactive material transportation.

The Radioisotope Program Shipment Coordinator serves as the single ISED point of coordination for its directorate DOE-IRP sponsored radioactive material shipments, including on-site transfers and off-site shipments. Reporting to the Isotope Program Integration Manager, you will work on site with the ORNL Transportation team, Transport Activity Owners (TAOs), Transportation Safety Compliance, and ISED divisions to ensure that each movement is requested early, prepared in accordance with Standards-Based Management System (SBMS) procedures, and executed on schedule. You will maintain the integrated ISED shipment schedule, coordinate between radioisotope product leads, NIDC, RRD and facilities to ensure reliable and efficient radioisotope shipments.  You will track key performance indicators (KPIs), and escalate shipments that are at risk so that sponsor commitments and short-half-life product deliveries are protected. This role does not replace the regulatory authority of Transportation Safety Compliance or the packaging and shipping expertise of the Transportation team. It connects ISED production planning to those organizations so that they receive earlier, more complete, and more consistent information about upcoming demand.

**Major Duties/Responsibilities:**

- Serve as the ISED single point of coordination for all radioisotope program (DOE-IRP) sponsored material shipments, both on-site transfers and off-site shipments, working with the ORNL Transportation team, Transport Activity Owners (TAOs), Radioisotope Product Leads, Transportation Safety Compliance (TSC), and ISED divisions and facilities, including HFIR, REDC, Bethel Valley hot cells, and waste handling.
- Coordinate shipment requests and preparation in accordance with SBMS procedures, including the On-Site Transportation of Hazardous Material subject area and the ORNL On-Site Transportation Safety Document. Ensure timely and complete submittal of required documentation, such as ORNL-530, Request for Approval for On-Site Shipment; ORNL-531, On-Site Hazardous/Radioactive Materials Shipping Paper; Radioactive Material Transfer Data Sheets; off-site shipment requests; and transportation plans when required by TSC.
- Establish and maintain the integrated ISED radioisotope program shipment schedule. Link shipment demand to ISED production schedules, and the ISED integrated master schedule in Primavera P6, and maintain a rolling look-ahead of at least 30 days.
- Provide early notification of forecast shipments so that Transportation can reserve personnel, vehicles, packaging, and trained drivers. Ensure requests meet required lead times, including the 14-day advance notice requested for shipments that require TSC approval and standard lead times for routine movements.
- Protect recurring shipping windows for short-half-life and time-critical products (for example, Ac-225 and Ir-192) and coordinate production release, quality assurance release, packaging, and carrier cutoff times to reduce late-day compression and after-hours movements.
- Track the readiness of each shipment against required prerequisites, including material characterization, packaging selection, quality assurance release and certificates, receiving-site acceptance and license verification, customer documentation, and carrier arrangements.
- Establish, track, and report shipment KPIs, such as on-time shipment performance, request lead-time compliance, number of shipments at risk, documentation completeness at first submittal, short-notice requests, after-hours or overtime movements, and cycle time from product release to shipment. Publish a weekly shipment status summary and a monthly KPI report.
- Identify shipments that are at risk of missing a committed date and escalate them in accordance with defined thresholds to the Isotope Program Integration Manager, Transportation management, ISED division management, and the appropriate program integrator. Drive recovery actions to closure and document causes and lessons learned.
- Lead a recurring weekly shipment coordination meeting with Transportation, TAOs, and ISED divisions to review the look-ahead schedule, resolve conflicts, and confirm readiness.
- Coordinate with program integrators and the National Isotope Development Center (NIDC) on customer orders and delivery commitments, and confirm that orders are transmitted with sufficient lead time for packaging and documentation preparation.
- Develop and maintain guidance for ISED staff who ship infrequently, including a clear description of the shipment request process, required forms, and lead times, and serve as the first point of contact for their shipment questions.
- Identify and implement process improvements in partnership with Transportation and TSC, such as reducing duplicate data entry, automated schedule-to-Transportation notifications, and electronic document routing where permitted, without bypassing any regulatory or procedural control.
- Support forward capacity planning for transportation resources, including people, trained drivers, vehicles, packaging, and staging space, as ISED isotope production and facilities grow.
- Maintain shipment coordination records and support internal and external assessments, audits, and program reviews.
- Deliver ORNL’s mission by aligning behaviors, priorities, and interactions with our core values of Impact, Integrity, Teamwork, Safety, and Service. Promote equal opportunity by fostering a respectful workplace – in how we treat one another, work together, and measure success.

**Basic Qualifications:**

- BS degree in a technical, engineering, science, logistics, or supply chain field with at least 5 years of relevant experience, or an MS degree with at least 4 years of relevant experience.
- Demonstrated experience building and maintaining schedules and developing, tracking, and reporting performance metrics.
- Ability to apply formal procedures consistently and to work within the authority of regulatory and safety organizations.
- Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple organizations, influence without direct authority, and escalate issues clearly and early.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Office suite software.
- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
- Excellent written and oral communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Experience in a DOE national laboratory, nuclear facility, or radiological production environment.
- Experience coordinating hazardous material or radioactive material shipments, logistics, or transportation scheduling in a regulated environment.
- Working knowledge of US Department of Transportation hazardous materials regulations (49 CFR Parts 171 through 180) and radioactive material transportation concepts, such as Type A and Type B packaging and excepted packages.
- Current DOT hazardous materials employee training (49 CFR 172, Subpart H), or the ability to complete ORNL DOT Advanced Hazardous/Radioactive Materials training.
- Lean Six Sigma Green Belt.
- Experience with Primavera P6 or another enterprise scheduling tool.
- Experience with data visualization or dashboard tools, such as Power BI.
- Lean Six Sigma or other formal process improvement experience.
- Experience supporting multiple sponsors or customers with competing delivery commitments.

**Special Requirements:**

- On-site work: This position is on site at ORNL in Oak Ridge, Tennessee, and requires regular presence in ISED facilities and the Transportation shipping area. Remote or hybrid work is not available.
- Training: The successful candidate must complete required radiological worker training and applicable DOT hazardous materials training within the timeframe established by ORNL.
- Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.
- This position requires access to technology that is subject to export control requirements. Successful candidates must be qualified for such access without an export control license.


**Benefits:**

ORNL offers competitive pay and benefits programs to attract and retain individuals who demonstrate exceptional work behaviors. The laboratory provides a range of employee benefits, including medical and retirement plans and flexible work hours, to support the well-being of you and your family. Employee amenities such as on-site fitness, banking, and cafeteria facilities are also available for added convenience.

Other benefits include the following: Prescription Drug Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, 401(k) Retirement Plan, Contributory Pension Plan, Life Insurance, Disability Benefits, Generous Vacation and Holidays, Parental Leave, Legal Insurance with Identity Theft Protection, Employee Assistance Plan, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, Wellness Programs, Educational Assistance, Relocation Assistance, and Employee Discounts.

**Relocation:** Moving can be overwhelming and expensive. UT-Battelle offers a generous relocation package to ease the transition process. Domestic and international relocation assistance is available for certain positions. If invited to interview, be sure to ask your Recruiter (Talent Acquisition Partner) for details.

If you have difficulty using the online application system or need an accommodation to apply due to a disability, please email: ORNLRecruiting@ornl.gov.

#LI-DC1

This position will remain open for a minimum of 5 days after which it will close when a qualified candidate is identified and/or hired.

We accept Word (.doc, .docx), Adobe (unsecured .pdf), Rich Text Format (.rtf), and HTML (.htm, .html) up to 5MB in size. Resumes from third party vendors will not be accepted; these resumes will be deleted and the candidates submitted will not be considered for employment.

ORNL is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants, including individuals with disabilities and protected veterans, are encouraged to apply.  UT-Battelle is an E-Verify employer.

title: Reader in Artificial Intelligence
description:

We are seeking current and emerging leading researchers in the field. The successful candidate will have a PhD (or be close to completing one), a strong research agenda, and the enthusiasm and ability to undertake original research, teach courses, and supervise student projects.

We seek candidates with research interests in the development of cutting-edge Artificial Intelligence methods and models, particularly in the joint space of perception (e.g., computer vision) and action (e.g., interactive decision-making systems). - Continual, open-ended, self-improving AI
- Agentic AI, world models, and generative models
- Embodied perception and action
- Learning from interaction and reinforcement
- Decision-making under uncertainty
- Long-duration autonomy

Candidates should have a strong research track record. They should also demonstrate interest and ability to teach undergraduate (UG) and master's (MSc) level courses, and to supervise projects for UG, MSc, and PhD in areas related to their research.

title: Velskrivende redaktør til nichemagasin
description:
Er du en stærk og engageret journalist, nysgerrig på naturvidenskabelige og sundhedsfaglige emner, og har du lyst til at præge kommunikationen i faget og fagforeningen for bioanalytikere? Så er det dig, vi søger.

Dit job:

Vi søger en ny journalistisk redaktør, der vil være med til fortsat at udvikle vores nyligt relancerede fagmagasin og foreningens interne og eksterne kommunikation generelt.

Du vil få ansvaret for fagmagasinet, som pt. udkommer seks gange om året. Du er initiativrig, planlægger indholdet, udvikler historier, finder de rette kilder og samarbejdspartnere og sikrer fremdrift fra idé til færdigt magasin.

Du sætter pris på det gode samarbejde både med kilder, freelancejournalister, fotografer, grafiker og bioanalytikere, som leverer faglige artikler til magasinet.

Dine tætteste kolleger er to andre journalister i kommunikationsgruppen, henholdsvis den digitale redaktør, som har ansvaret for nyhedsbreve, hjemmeside og sociale medier samt en journalist på deltid, der varetager forskellige journalistiske og kommunikative opgaver.

Derudover er du på lige fod med resten af kommunikationsgruppen med til at udarbejde kommunikationsplaner og bidrager sammen med kolleger i sekretariatets øvrige teams til rådgivning af det politisk valgte formandskab og dbio’s fem regionsformænd.

Som redaktør referer du til chefen for teamet, der også er leder af andre af dbio’s teams.

Hvem er du?
Du har en journalistisk baggrund, er nysgerrig på at forstå og formidle det, der er relevant for en lille, men vigtig målgruppe og har forståelse for at arbejde i en politisk organisation. Det er et krav, at du kan arbejde på tværs af medieplatforme, da vi versionerer indholdet i fagmagasinet til vores andre platforme, og en fordel, hvis du har erfaring med lyd eller video.

Som redaktør skal du både kunne tænke stort og holde styr på detaljerne. Du skaber struktur, holder overblik over mange processer på én gang og følger op på aftaler og deadlines uden at miste det journalistiske fokus. Du trives med at stå alene i rollen som ansvarshavende redaktør i forhold til medieansvarsloven, men er også i stand til at indgå i tæt dynamik med dine øvrige kolleger i et mindre sekretariat, hvor der er højt til loftet og store ambitioner.

Vi tilbyder:
En fuldtidsansættelse fra den 1/1 2027 på en attraktiv arbejdsplads, hvor vi i vores kommunikationsteam har stor frihed i opgaveløsningen, ligesom fleksibilitet, faglig udvikling og trivsel vægtes meget højt. Og så har vi en virkelig god kantine sammen med de mange øvrige arbejdsfællesskaber på Diakonissestiftelsen.

Din arbejdsplads bliver Peter Bangsvej 7A, 3. etage, 2000 Frederiksberg. Vi har fleksibel arbejdstilstedeværelse og -tider og kan tilbyde attraktive løn- og arbejdsvilkår efter husoverenskomst, hvor man bl.a. sikres en 7. ferieuge.

Din ansøgning mærket ”Redaktør” sendes pr. mail til mve@dbio.dk. Ansøgningen skal være os i hænde senest den 31/10. Vi forventer at afholde ansættelsessamtaler i løbet af november.

Du er meget velkommen til at ringe til chef Jane Fyhn på 50429800 eller digital redaktør Niels C. Jensen på 44223552 med spørgsmål om stillingen, ligesom du kan læse mere om dbio og sekretariatet på .

Når du søger en stilling hos Danske Bioanalytikere, behandler vi dine personoplysninger til brug for ansøgningsprocessen. Du kan læse mere om, hvordan Danske Bioanalytikere behandler dine oplysninger på www.dbio.dk

Hvem er vi?

Danske Bioanalytikere er bioanalytikernes fagforening og har 6.500 medlemmer, et sekretariat bestående af 24 ansatte og tre fuldtidsfrikøbte politikere, samt 5 fuldtidsfrikøbte regionsformænd. Danske Bioanalytikere er en fagforening, hvor faget og udviklingen af faget spiller en stor rolle. Bioanalytikere er en del af sundhedsvæsenet. 70-80 % af alle diagnoser i sundhedsvæsenet stilles på baggrund af bioanalytikeres analyser.

title: Construction Superintendent (C)

DBA TIDEWATER DEVELOPMENT SERVICES CORPORATION (TDSC)

  • Federal Construction experience preferred: USACE, NAVFAC, Department of Veterans Affairs, Coast Guard, Air Force
  • Certifications preferred: OSHA 30, First Aid/CPR, USACE CQM, EM385 40-Hour
  • Extensive experience and knowledge of construction means and methods and a thorough understanding of industry trades and practices.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as construction specifications, blueprints, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.

  • Ability to write routine reports and correspondence.
  • Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers, subcontractors, or employees of the organization.
  • Must be 18 years of age.
  • Must be punctual and reliable.Must be organized and have an eye for detail.


KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Dependable.
  • Attention to Detail.
  • Follow through.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Proactively identifies potential issues.
  • Solve problems calmly and collaboratively.
  • Willingness to receive and give constructive performance feedback.
  • Manage time and competing priorities.

title: Specialist Customer Feedback Swedish(m/f/d)
description:
As a Specialist Customer Feedback, you will play an important role in maintaining a high level of customer satisfaction and strengthening the company's online reputation.

You will work with customer reviews, complaints, comments, and inquiries across multiple channels, including CRM systems, email, social media, review platforms, and app stores. Your goal will be not only to provide a professional response, but also to understand the root cause of each issue, find the best solution, and turn challenging customer interactions into positive experiences.

This role requires strong communication skills, empathy, attention to detail, and the ability to confidently handle complex and emotionally challenging situations.

You will report directly to the Senior Supervisor Customer Feedback and work closely with internal teams to identify recurring customer and operational issues.

Your responsibilities

  • Process customer reviews, comments, emails, complaints, and inquiries across CRM, email, social media, review platforms, and other company channels.
  • Provide professional and empathetic responses to both positive and negative customer feedback in line with company guidelines and Tone of Voice standards.
  • Analyze each case carefully to understand the customer's needs and identify the root cause of the issue.
  • Manage customer cases end-to-end, from the initial contact through to complete resolution.
  • Keep customers informed throughout the resolution process and ensure that all commitments are fulfilled.
  • Handle complex and escalated customer complaints independently, using internal systems, databases, procedures, and approved customer-care tools.
  • Conduct outbound calls when required to resolve complex or escalated cases.
  • De-escalate tense conversations, reassure customers, collect the necessary information, and guide cases toward a satisfactory resolution.
  • Use available loyalty and compensation tools appropriately to resolve customer conflicts and protect customer relationships.
  • Demonstrate initiative and apply expert knowledge when dealing with non-standard or complex cases.
  • Identify recurring technical, operational, service, or platform-related issues and escalate them to the Supervisor Customer Feedback.
  • Follow established SLA, WFM, productivity, quality, and KPI requirements.
  • Maintain productivity at a level of at least 85% of the average team benchmark.
  • Work in accordance with company policies, data protection requirements, consumer protection regulations, and the rules of external review platforms and app stores.
  • Continuously improve the quality, clarity, and effectiveness of customer communication.

What we're looking for

  • Previous experience in Customer Support, Customer Care, Complaint Management, Customer Feedback, Reputation Management, or a related field.
  • Fluent English and Swedish — written and spoken.
  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to adapt communication style to different customer situations.
  • Strong customer focus, empathy, and genuine willingness to help.
  • Excellent active listening and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to handle objections, complaints, and conflict situations professionally.
  • Confidence in conducting outbound customer calls and managing difficult conversations.
  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to identify the root cause of customer issues.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of a case until resolution.
  • Good argumentation and persuasion skills.
  • High attention to detail, accuracy, and consistency.
  • Ability to work effectively under pressure and maintain a professional attitude when dealing with negative or emotional feedback.
  • Flexibility and willingness to adapt to changing processes and procedures.
  • Experience with CRM systems, Microsoft Office, spreadsheets, email, social media, and online review platforms.
  • Good understanding of modern digital and AI-powered tools used for text processing, translation, and customer communication.
  • Ability to follow SLAs, KPIs, schedules, and established processes consistently.

It would be a plus if you have

  • Experience working with Trustpilot, Google Reviews, app stores, or similar review platforms.
  • Experience in e-commerce or an international customer service environment.
  • Experience working with complaints or escalated customer cases.
  • Experience using AI tools to improve customer communication and workflow efficiency.
  • Experience working with compensation, loyalty, or customer-retention tools.

​​​​​What we offer

  • A role with a direct impact on customer satisfaction and the company's online reputation.
  • An international and dynamic working environment.
  • The opportunity to work with customers across different markets and communication channels.
  • A role where you can develop your expertise in complaint management, customer experience, and reputation management.
  • Supportive teamwork and clear operational processes.
  • Hybrid working model.
  • Opportunities for professional growth within the Customer Care organization.


Your profile

  • You are someone who can stay calm when a customer is upset, listen carefully, understand what is really behind the complaint, and find a solution that works for both the customer and the company.
  • You don't simply answer customer messages — you take ownership of the situation and see it through to resolution.
  • If you are customer-oriented, resilient, analytical, and confident in handling challenging conversations, we'd be happy to meet you.
  • Schedule 8:00 - 17.00 (8 hours rotational shift), 40 hours weekly
  • Work remotely

Role Definition

As Associate Design Engineer, you will be responsible for the Engineering & Design of Solar Turbine’s Construction Services’ Products. You will involve in the design of the Oil & Gas Projects such as Gas Compression stations project, you will demonstrate designing, implementing, and maintaining Piping systems within the Oil & Gas industry

The identified candidate will be a member of a cross-functional team that Involves in FEED, Detail engineering, Procurement, inhouse Fabrication and Commissioning activities and ensues all performance metrics are achieved

Responsibilities

The candidate should possess a minimum of 6-8 years of industry experience in engineering / design execution and associated applications. Experience should include significant, demonstrated results leading Piping design efforts supporting industrial gas turbine packaging and associated gas compression and power generation projects and BOP systems engineering and design. In addition, the candidate should demonstrate knowledge of discipline-related industry Codes & standards such as ASME & API and have experience with standards application across engineering specifications and vendor documentation. Comprehensive familiarity with CAD software packages supporting Piping design and broad knowledge of design and drafting techniques including, diagram generation, Isometrics creations, and details dwg creations.

  • MTOs/BOMs, NWD models, Clash checks, Vendor Drawing Review.

  • Ability to create and modify Revit piping families, connectors, parameters, schedules, tags, filters, and templates.
  • Knowledge of BIM coordination workflows, linked models, worksharing, model health checks, clash detection, and issue resolution.
  • Ability to review Revit models and drawings for design intent, constructability, maintainability, data completeness, and compliance with project standards.

title: Gen AI Staff Researcher
description:
Job Description

GM Israel (Herzliya) takes a significant part in introducing sophisticated software features into car in many domains like connected cars, advanced camera technologies and research. We shape the face of the future vehicles in diverse fields by developing cutting edge technologies that define how drivers experience safety, awareness, and confidence on the road.

GM is committed to Zero Emission, Zero Crashes and Zero Congestion vision.


About the Group

At the autonomous vehicles Foundational AI Research team in Israel, which is part of the GM AV AI Research organization, we are shaping next-generation autonomous driving, L3 and beyond. The AI Research organization is dedicated to advancing the state of the art in AI for autonomous vehicles. We are a collaborative, forward-thinking group of researchers and engineers tackling some of the most complex challenges in autonomy and machine learning.


About the Role

As a Gen AI Staff Researcher, you will contribute deep technical expertise to a collaborative research team developing generative world models, with a focus on the design and large-scale training of diffusion models for autonomous driving. You will research and develop models that learn the dynamics of driving environments and generate realistic, temporally consistent, and controllable future scenarios, conditioned on sensor observations, actions, and scene context.

You will contribute hands-on throughout the research lifecycle, from exploring new ideas to large-scale experimentation and implementation, advancing model architectures, training objectives, data strategies, and evaluation methods. As an expert member of the team, you will bring scientific rigor, share technical knowledge, and work closely with fellow researchers and partners in Perception, Behavior/Policy, Data, Simulation, and Validation to translate generative AI advances into measurable improvements in autonomy KPIs. You will also contribute high-quality publications at top-tier conferences and journals and collaborate with leading academic partners.

At the GM Foundational AI Research group, your work will influence millions of drivers worldwide and define what’s next in autonomous driving. If you're passionate about solving hard problems and advancing the frontiers of generative AI and autonomous driving, we want you on our team.


What will YOU do?

  • Contribute original research and technical expertise to generative world models, with a focus on diffusion-based modeling of driving environments and their dynamics.
  • Design, build, train, and evaluate large-scale diffusion models for video and multimodal generation, emphasizing temporal consistency, physical plausibility, and controllability.
  • Implement and optimize large-scale training on distributed, multi-GPU infrastructure, working with fellow researchers and engineering partners to improve training stability, throughput, memory efficiency, and scalability.
  • Develop action- and context-conditioned world models that generate diverse future scenarios and support counterfactual exploration, closed-loop simulation, and long-tail scenario coverage.
  • Develop and evaluate data and training strategies for fleet-scale datasets together with the team, including data curation, pretraining, fine-tuning, and targeted generation of challenging driving scenarios.
  • Develop and apply rigorous evaluation methods that connect generative quality, consistency, and scenario coverage to downstream KPI improvements for the autonomous driving agent.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams to translate state-of-the-art research into scalable solutions for simulation, synthetic data generation, and autonomy development.
  • Publish research at top-tier conferences and journals, track emerging advances in generative AI, and incubate technologies aimed at impacting our L3 autonomous driving technology.

Your Skills & Abilities (Required Qualifications)

  • PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field. Excellent M.Sc. graduates will be considered.
  • Over 3 years of research experience in generative AI, computer vision, machine learning, or related areas, with demonstrated depth of expertise and impactful contributions to complex research projects.
  • Deep expertise in diffusion models and hands-on experience designing, training, and evaluating generative models for images, video, or multimodal data.
  • Hands-on experience with large-scale distributed training of deep learning models, including training stability, performance optimization, and systematic experimentation.
  • Strong understanding of world modeling and spatiotemporal learning, including temporal consistency, conditioning mechanisms, and learning environment dynamics.
  • Strong publication record at top-tier AI/ML conferences and journals.
  • Excellent coding skills in Python and proficiency with modern AI frameworks such as PyTorch.






About GM

Our vision is a world with Zero Crashes, Zero Emissions and Zero Congestion and we embrace the responsibility to lead the change that will make our world better, safer and more equitable for all.

We believe we all must make a choice every day – individually and collectively – to drive meaningful change through our words, our deeds and our culture. Every day, we want every employee to feel they belong to one General Motors team.

We are seeking a responsible and detail-oriented Managed Services Data Centre Engineer to support day-to-day data centre operations. The role is responsible for monitoring data centre systems, responding to alerts and incidents, supporting physical access and security procedures, conducting basic infrastructure checks, and maintaining accurate equipment and asset records.

The successful candidate should be comfortable working in a mission-critical data centre environment, following established operational procedures and escalating technical or facility-related issues to the appropriate Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

Responsibilities
  • Monitor data centre monitoring systems for alerts, alarms, and abnormal conditions.
  • Identify potential operational issues and raise incident tickets in accordance with established procedures.
  • Escalate technical alerts and incidents to the appropriate SMEs or support teams.
  • Track incident tickets from initial reporting through resolution and closure.
  • Maintain accurate records of incidents, actions taken, escalations, and status updates.
  • Follow established operational and escalation procedures to support continuous data centre operations.
2. Security & Access Control
  • Follow established data centre physical access and security procedures.
  • Verify and facilitate authorised visitor, contractor, and vendor access.
  • Escort visitors and vendors within controlled data centre areas where required.
  • Support physical security checks, including rack access and identification of unattended or unauthorized items.
  • Maintain appropriate equipment movement and access records.
  • Follow security policies and procedures when handling or providing access to customer equipment.
  • Ensure vendor activities comply with required escort and access-control procedures.
  • Conduct basic visual checks of the data centre environment.
  • Identify and report abnormal facility conditions such as water or air-conditioning leaks, unusual temperature conditions, or other environmental concerns.
  • Escalate facility-related issues to the appropriate facilities or technical support teams.
  • Maintain awareness of conditions that could affect data centre availability, equipment, or operations.
4. Asset Management, Inventory & Documentation
  • Register and document equipment entering, leaving, or moving within the data centre.
  • Record equipment serial numbers and relevant hardware changes.
  • Maintain and update asset and inventory records.
  • Perform periodic hardware inventory checks and asset verification.
  • Ensure operational documentation and records are accurate and kept up to date.
  • Use Microsoft Office applications for documentation, reporting, record keeping, and operational administration.
Requirements
  • Diploma or Nitec qualification in Information Technology, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline.
  • 1–2 years of experience in data centre operations, IT operations, infrastructure support, NOC operations, technical support, or a similar environment is preferred.
  • Experience with incident / ticket management systems and IT asset management would be advantageous.
  • Responsible, dependable, and able to work with minimal supervision.
  • Able to work independently, self-motivated and diligent.
  • Written and spoken language proficiency in English & Mandarin, as there is a requirement to handle Mandarin-speaking customers' technical enquiries and conduct troubleshooting based on customers' feedback.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when handling access control, equipment records, and asset verification.
  • Able to communicate clearly with internal teams, SMEs, vendors, and customers.
  • Able to follow procedures consistently in a controlled and security-sensitive environment.
  • Comfortable working in 12-hour shift duty.
  • Able to remain attentive and responsive during extended shift operations.
  • Basic understanding of data centre operations and IT infrastructure.
  • Basic knowledge of servers, network equipment, racks, cabling, and other common data centre hardware.
  • Familiarity with monitoring systems, alarms, incident management, and ticketing processes.
  • Understanding of physical security and controlled-access procedures in a data centre environment.
  • Ability to perform basic equipment and asset verification.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, Word, and Outlook.
  • Ability to follow Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), escalation procedures, and security requirements.
  • Ability to identify abnormalities and escalated issues promptly to the appropriate technical teams.
  • Good problem-identification and escalation skills.

title: Data Engineer Consulting
description:
Functieomschrijving
Meer dan dashboards bouwen? Word Fullstack Data Analytics Engineer bij ilionx en combineer techniek, advies en impact in één rol.

Niet alleen bouwen aan dashboards, maar echt richting geven aan hoe organisaties met data werken, dát is waar jij energie van krijgt. Als Data Analytics Engineer bij ilionx pak je die rol. Je denkt mee over architectuur, helpt klanten hun data beter benutten en zorgt dat inzichten ook echt gebruikt worden. Daarbij kijk je nadrukkelijk verder dan traditionele analytics en zet je steeds vaker AI en machine learning in om processen te automatiseren en voorspellende inzichten te realiseren. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen business en techniek en neemt collega’s daarin mee. Hier ben je niet alleen uitvoerend, maar maak je daadwerkelijk het verschil.

jouw functie als Data Analytics Engineer

Als data analytics engineer ben jij de drijvende kracht achter de ontwikkeling van complexe analytics oplossingen bij onze klanten. Binnen multidisciplinaire teams neem je eigenaarschap over het ontwerp en de implementatie van datagedreven toepassingen, waarbij je altijd streeft naar duurzame en schaalbare oplossingen. Je bent niet alleen technisch sterk, maar ook communicatief vaardig, en weet als geen ander de brug te slaan tussen business en IT.

Je begeleidt en coacht collega’s met minder ervaring en stimuleert kennisdeling binnen en buiten je team. Je denkt actief mee over de opzet van data architecturen in bijvoorbeeld Azure, waarbij je tools als (vooral) Fabric/Databricks/Snowflake, Synapse, Data Factory en Data Lake inzet. Daarnaast werk je met tools zoals Power BI en Tabular Editor aan het bouwen van krachtige datamodellen en dashboards.

Performance optimalisatie, heldere datamodellering en een scherp oog voor datakwaliteit zijn voor jou vanzelfsprekend. Je weet hoe je met technieken zoals DAX en M-query maximale waarde uit data haalt. Je treedt op als sparringpartner voor opdrachtgevers, vertaalt hun vragen naar werkbare analytics oplossingen en verzorgt waar nodig ook trainingen. Daarnaast speel je een belangrijke rol in het opzetten en professionaliseren van analytics teams en het implementeren van standaarden, best practices en tools.

wat bieden wij jou:

  • Een salarisrange tussen de €4.500,- en €6.500,- op 40 uur met bonussysteem

  • Een vast contract bij indiensttreding

  • Een uitgebreide leaseregeling voor zowel auto als fiets

  • Een keuze tussen werken voor de klant of het doorontwikkelen van ilionx eigen data driven producten welke als managed services worden aangeboden

  • Een flexibele werkomgeving rekening houdend met jouw specifieke wensen

  • Een groter wordende focus en visie op AI gedreven werken

wat vragen wij van jou:

  • Je hebt een afgeronde HBO/WO diploma

  • Je hebt minimaal 4 jaar ervaring als BI/Data Specialist

  • Je hebt een expertise in data analyse, data modeling en het presenteren van data op een gebruikersvriendelijke manier

  • Je hebt kennis van de nieuwste data technieken en durft verder te kijken dan je neus lang is

verder heb je:

  • Je hebt ervaring met data services zoals: Power BI/ Fabric/ Data Factory/ Synapse/ Data lake(house)/ Delta Lake

  • Je hebt stevige ervaring met en in DAX, M-Query & SQL

  • Je hebt kennis van dimensional data modeling/logical modeling

  • Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift

Deze eisen geven een richting aan het profiel dat wij zoeken voor deze functie. Voldoe jij niet aan alle eisen maar denk je wel dat dit de functie voor jou is? Dan nodigen wij je graag uit om te solliciteren!

het team

Of je nu op een van onze kantoren, bij de klant of thuis werkt, bij ilionx krijg je de perfecte omgeving om je passie voor data en analytics tot leven te brengen! De regionale teams bestaan uit vooraanstaande experts die jouw groei en kennisontwikkeling ondersteunen. Onze collega’s zijn niet alleen analytics en data engineers, maar ook experts in rapportages, dashboards, voorspellende analyses, data gedreven werken, machine learning en data science.

Bij ilionx draait het niet alleen om technische expertise, maar ook om de mensen achter de technologie. We hechten waarde aan een cultuur van samenwerking, kennisdeling en inspiratie. Als onderdeel van ons team maak je deel uit van een gemeenschap die gedreven wordt door nieuwsgierigheid, innovatie en een passie voor het creëren van waarde uit data!

Benieuwd wat onze data specialisten doen? Lees hier diverse verhalen terug van onze medewerkers!

landelijke dekking

Met ruim 10+ kantoren zijn wij landelijk vertegenwoordigd en op die manier kunnen wij regionaal vanuit verschillende vestigingen het verschil maken. Sluit jij je aan bij één van onze ilionx datateams in jouw regio?

title: Research Assistant
description:
**Grade UE06: £34,610 - £39,906 per annum**

**CMVM / Institute of Genetics and Cancer**

**Full-time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed-term: 18 months contract**

**The Opportunity**

An exciting research assistant position is available to research the role of epigenetic marks in gene regulation.

We are looking for a self-motivated, enthusiastic research assistant to join the laboratory of Dr Duncan Sproul at the University of Edinburgh’s Institute of Genetics and Cancer and support research into the role of DNA methylation in gene regulation. This project is a close collaboration with 3 other groups based at the Universities of Edinburgh and Exeter.

We have recently characterised mutations that prevent the DNA methyltransferase DNMT3B from being recruited to actively transcribed gene bodies (Taglini _et al_. 2024, EMBO Reports **25**:1130, DOI: 10.1038/s44319-024-00061-5). Our new project will use this knowledge combined with recently developed synthetic approaches as an entry point to probe the non-canonical regulation of transcription by DNA methylation within gene bodies and its functional impact on cellular phenotypes.

The successful candidate will work with the Sproul and collaborating laboratories as part of a successful multidisciplinary research team. This role will have a particular emphasis on the use of synthetic vector libraries combined with cellular landing pads high throughput sequencing data of variant libraries from mammalian cells.

Candidates who have a degree in a relevant subject and have experience in laboratory research in the areas of molecular biology, cellular biology or biochemistry are invited to apply. Applicants must possess the ability to work with others as part of an interdisciplinary research team to support research projects towards publication. Candidates with prior experience of research in the fields of epigenomics, gene regulation and/or the use of synthetic approaches in these fields are particularly welcome.

The post is full-time (35 hours per week) and funding is available from 1st January 2027 for 1.5 years pending review after 6 months.

Further details of work from the Sproul research group are available at:

[https://institute-genetics-cancer.ed.ac.uk/research/research-groups-a-z/sproul-group](https://institute-genetics-cancer.ed.ac.uk/research/research-groups-a-z/sproul-group)

Check out the full list on our [**staff benefits page**](https://www.ed.ac.uk/human-resources/pay-reward/staff-benefits)(opens in a new tab) and use our reward calculator to discover the value of your pay and benefits.

**Championing equality, diversity, and inclusion**

The University of Edinburgh holds a Silver Athena SWAN award in recognition of our commitment to advance gender equality in higher education. We are members of the Race Equality Charter, and we are also Stonewall Scotland Diversity Champions, actively promoting LGBT equality.

Prior to any employment commencing with the University, you will be required to evidence your right to work in the UK. Further information is available on our [**right to work webpages**](https://www.ed.ac.uk/human-resources/demonstrating-rtw)(opens new browser tab)

title: Junior Software Engineer
description:
Start your software engineering career in a role where you can learn by doing, contribute ideas, think critically and take increasing ownership of real solutions. At Advanzia, modern software engineering includes the thoughtful use of AI. You will be encouraged to use AI-powered tools to support analysis, coding, testing and documentation, while applying your own judgement to ensure that solutions are secure, reliable and useful. As part of our Application Engineering team, you will help build and improve digital solutions supporting finance, payments and credit. You will contribute throughout the development lifecycle, develop your technical expertise and work with experienced colleagues who can support your growth. We are interested not only in the technologies already on your CV, but also in how you think, how you learn, how you solve problems and how you turn ideas into practical results. Dive in and get hands-on experience in the world of finance, payments and credit, working for an unconventional digital bank in the heart of Luxembourg. This opportunity is a full-time CDI contract. Please apply in English, including your CV and motivational letter.

About the job | Your responsibilities

  • Develop practical software solutions: Design, implement, test and maintain application features, services and integrations using .NET and related technologies.
  • Build experience through real responsibilities: Contribute from initial analysis and development through to deployment and operational follow-up, taking ownership of your work while growing with support from experienced colleagues.
  • Use AI thoughtfully: Use AI-powered tools and modern development practices to support analysis, coding, testing and documentation, while reviewing outputs critically and maintaining quality.
  • Turn business needs into working solutions: Collaborate with business analysts, quality assurance specialists and experienced engineers to create simple, maintainable and effective applications.
  • Contribute to reliable and secure software: Follow coding standards, participate in peer reviews and support automated testing, CI/CD and DevSecOps practices.
  • Look for better ways of working: Share ideas to simplify applications, processes or development practices, and help turn agreed improvements into action.
  • Learn and share: Ask relevant questions, seek feedback, share what you learn and use it to move work forward.


About you | Your background, skills and personality

  • Education or practical experience: Studies, vocational training, certifications, personal projects or equivalent practical experience in software development.
  • Early development exposure: Academic projects, internships, personal projects, open-source contributions or first professional experience that show practical exposure to software development.
  • AI as a productivity tool: Interest or first experience using modern AI tools to support learning, analysis, coding, testing or documentation, combined with the ability to question outputs and apply critical thinking.
  • .NET: Exposure to C#, .NET and object-oriented programming principles.
  • Databases: Basic understanding of relational databases and SQL concepts, with openness to learn NoSQL approaches.
  • Cloud and Azure: Basic understanding of cloud concepts, with interest or first exposure to Microsoft Azure or similar cloud platforms.
  • Development tools: Exposure to Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD concepts or comparable development tools.
  • Languages: Fluency in English is essential. Proficiency in French, German or other languages is a plus.
  • Curiosity and initiative: You actively seek opportunities to learn, ask relevant questions, look for ways to contribute and take initiative to move forward.
  • Ownership and accountability: You take responsibility for your work, communicate proactively, ask for help when needed and follow through on commitments.
  • AI-aware mindset: You are curious about AI and see it as a practical tool to learn faster, analyse better, improve productivity and support software delivery, while keeping a critical mindset.
  • Problem-solving mindset: You enjoy understanding how things work, breaking down challenges and finding practical solutions.
  • Adaptability and continuous learning: You enjoy learning new technologies, tools and ways of working, and you can adapt your approach to different environments, technical contexts and delivery needs.
  • Getting-things-done attitude: You focus on outcomes, identify practical next steps and help keep work moving forward when faced with challenges.
  • Team spirit: You collaborate effectively, share knowledge and contribute positively to the success of the team.
  • Efficiency and simplicity: You look for pragmatic solutions and avoid unnecessary complexity.


About Advanzia

Advanzia Bank's mission is to make finance easier and more inclusive by offering simple, smart and user-friendly payment and credit solutions that provide financial flexibility and deliver added value for our customers. Our way of working is guided by responsible lending, open communication and teamwork in cooperation with employees, business partners and customers.

At Advanzia, we are committed to equal opportunities and embrace diversity as a driving force behind our success. We offer challenging projects in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, along with numerous opportunities for training and development, and a performance-driven bonus structure. Our benefits package includes Pluxee lunch vouchers, employee travel insurance, preferential rates on Advanzia products, as well as transportation and wellness allowances. Our zero-carbon Emerald building is designed to support employee health and wellbeing with various health programmes, access to our gym and after-work sports & social events available to all members of #TeamAdvanzia.

title: Retail Leadership Gradaute Program QLD
description:
Retail Leadership Gradaute Program QLD

Position Description: Retail Leadership Graduate

Location: AUS & NZ wide

Start: Feb 2027

The program with Reece will build your skills and abilities to begin a career in retail management.

About the opportunity: The program is designed to accelerate the development of those who are passionate about retail management and leadership, business development and creating customers for life. If you'd like to acquire the skills to run a retail branch as if it was your own - this role is for you.

Throughout the 18-month program, you will enjoy:

  • Permanent employment from day 1 with access to unlimited career opportunities in an organisation that promotes and develops our talent from within
  • A comprehensive, blended learning experience to expedite your development including an initial 5-day induction followed by immersive group learning experiences, as well as digital learning tools, on-the-job training, coaching and mentoring support
  • An end-to-end structured development journey covering all aspects of running your own branch, equipping you to succeed as an Assistant Branch Manager once you've completed the program
  • Rotations around select specialty business units
  • Providing advice on products and services in areas as diverse as plumbing, the provision of sustainable clean water and energy efficiency, heating, ventilation, refrigeration, air-conditioning and climate control, sanitation, bathroom, kitchen, irrigation, pools, civil, design and building products.

About You: At Reece, attitude is key. We aim to improve the lives of our customers and our people by striving for greatness every day. We don't expect you to have industry experience - although retail or customer service experience is advantageous. We'd like to hear from you if you have the following:

  • A growth mindset - you love learning and embrace opportunities to grow and develop, continually improving your skills and acquiring new knowledge
  • Strong written and oral communication skills
  • Demonstrated ability to utilise emotional intelligence to establish and build strong relationships
  • The ability to prioritise many competing tasks and organise work so that it is completed efficiently while always keeping the customer first
  • Proven ability to identify and solve problems, acting decisively and show good judgement

About Reece: Reece is an Australian icon - we've been around for 100 years. We're a big business that works hard to retain the little things that made us great when we were small. We live by our values - we also hire by them and promote by them. We take our work seriously but not ourselves.

Much more than plumbing.

You might know us as Australia's largest supplier of plumbing and bathroom products but that's just the start. We're a major public company with over 9,000 people, 900 branches globally, 10 business lines across Australia and New Zealand.

We are heavily focused on logistics, technology and marketing to drive the business forward, we even have a creative agency, innovation centre, and insight hub. This broad skill base helps us solve customer problems in unique ways. We're growing both nationally and internationally and that's where you come in.

Our Perks: In return, you'll be fairly compensated, provided a uniform allowance, and have access to fuel, gym and other awesome product discounts. Plus, you'll have the opportunity to reach your potential and foster a long-lasting career

If you're excited by the idea of working with great people in a thriving business, then Reece may be for you.

title: JAVA Quarkus Developer
description:
Il Gruppo EIES, composto da Energent, I&M, Enway, e Skienda è unarealtà di consulenza e di prodotto consolidata nel mercato delle soluzioni e dei serviziICT.

La risorsa sarà impegnata nella progettazione e lo sviluppo di servizi backend a microservizi in ambiente cloud-native.


Competenze tecniche richieste:

  • Ottima conoscenza di Maven e del ciclo di build, test e packaging di applicazioni Java.
  • Esperienza su Quarkus in progetti rilasciati in produzione.
  • Esperienza nella progettazione e documentazione di API REST tramite OpenAPI/Swagger.
  • Conoscenza dei principali pattern di progettazione per architetture a microservizi.
  • Esperienza nella gestione di autenticazione e autorizzazione tramite OAuth2/OIDC e JWT.
  • Esperienza nella progettazione e sviluppo di servizi gRPC, inclusa la definizione dei contratti Protocol Buffers, gestione della comunicazione client/server e integrazione tra microservizi.
  • Conoscenza di JPA/Hibernate e database non relazionali (MongoDB)
  • Esperienza con database migration tramite Liquibase o strumenti equivalenti.
  • Messaggistica (Kafka o RabbitMQ).
  • Conoscenza di Docker; e base di Kubernetes/OpenShift e Helm Chart.
  • Testing con JUnit, Mockito e strumenti affini.

Requisiti preferenziali:

  • Programmazione reattiva (Mutiny, Vert.x) e compilazione nativa con GraalVM.
  • Esperienza su cloud pubblico (AWS, Azure, GCP).


  • Ambiente di lavoro dinamico ed orientato alla crescita professionale;
  • Certification Program: il programma formativo di EIES Group pensato per supportare e valorizzare la crescita professionale in un’ottica di miglioramento continuo;
  • Buoni pasto;
  • Piattaforma di e-commerce con scontistiche riservate ai dipendenti e altre convenzioni dedicate;
  • Confronto all'interno di un team strutturato e coeso;

  • Welfare aziendale.

Modalità di lavoro: Remoto o ibrido su Roma

Il Gruppo EIES rappresenta l'alleanza strategica di quattro aziende italiane leader nel settore informatico, unite per offrire al mercato una copertura completa, integrata e sinergica.


Composto da Energent, I&M Consulting, Enway e Skienda, il Gruppo è una realtà che eroga consulenza, progettualità e servizi in ambito ICT, fornendo soluzioni ad alto valore aggiunto per i propri clienti. Con sedi a Roma, Napoli e Milano, operiamo in settori come Finance, Insurance, Telco, Energy e Pubblica Amministrazione, collaborando con aziende di primaria importanza ed i principali System Integrator.


Il gruppo è organizzato in practices tematiche afferenti a diverse aree di competenza: Infrastrutture & Security, Application Modernization & Cloud Transformation, Data Science e Artificial Intelligence e Consulting. Inoltre, il Gruppo dispone di due Factory specializzate in Sviluppo Software e Dati che lavorano sinergicamente per progettare soluzioni innovative, affidabili e personalizzate e per la delivery di progetti chiavi in mano.


Unirsi al Gruppo EIES significa entrare a far parte di una realtà dinamica e all'avanguardia, dove il contributo di ciascuno viene valorizzato e l'innovazione è al centro di ciò che facciamo. title: Account Director, Strategic Accounts
description:
A bit about the team and what you'll deliver...

We’re looking for an Account Director, Strategic Accounts to help accelerate Trustonic’s growth across the North American wireless ecosystem.

As a global B2B SaaS business operating in the cybersecurity space, we help organisations manage risk and unlock opportunities by securing billions of connected devices across mobile, automotive, IoT, retail, and banking and payments.

In this role, you’ll take ownership of a portfolio of strategic customer relationships across the US and Canada, while also identifying and developing new business opportunities across the wireless, mobility, connected device, telecommunications, fintech, and technology markets.

This is a great opportunity for an ambitious sales professional who enjoys building strong customer relationships, navigating complex enterprise sales, and turning strategic opportunities into long-term commercial growth. You’ll have the opportunity to own larger strategic relationships, influence our growth strategy, and work closely with senior stakeholders across Trustonic and our customers.

As the Account Director, Strategic Accounts, you will:

Strategic account management

  • Own and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts across North America
  • Build strong, trusted relationships with key customer stakeholders and act as their primary commercial contact
  • Drive customer retention, contract renewals, upsell opportunities, and long-term account growth
  • Develop and execute account plans focused on customer satisfaction, relationship development, and revenue expansion
  • Act as a customer advocate internally, ensuring customer needs and opportunities are understood across the business

Business development & new business

  • Support the successful closure of strategic opportunities already underway with key industry participants
  • Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities across telecommunications providers, retailers, MVNOs, mobility partners, device financing and leasing companies, and enterprise technology organisations
  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified opportunities
  • Lead sales activity from initial engagement through to contract execution
  • Develop new relationships and identify opportunities to expand Trustonic’s presence across the wireless and connected device ecosystem

Commercial leadership

  • Lead commercial discussions and contract negotiations with customers and prospects
  • Work closely with Legal, Product, Operations, Finance, and Executive Leadership to progress strategic opportunities
  • Maintain accurate sales forecasts and CRM records
  • Achieve or exceed revenue, retention, account growth, and new business targets

Who you are...

  • A commercially driven and customer-focused sales professional who enjoys building long-term strategic relationships
  • Confident managing complex enterprise sales involving multiple stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Comfortable balancing account management with new business development and pipeline generation
  • A strong communicator and negotiator who can build credibility with senior customer stakeholders
  • Commercially curious, proactive, and motivated by finding opportunities for growth
  • Organised and able to manage multiple strategic accounts and sales opportunities at different stages
  • Collaborative by nature, with the ability to work effectively across internal teams to deliver for customers

What makes you, you...

Experience

  • Proven experience in enterprise sales, strategic account management, business development, or a similar commercial role
  • Demonstrable success managing complex sales opportunities involving multiple stakeholders
  • Experience owning and growing strategic enterprise customer relationships
  • Strong experience in customer retention, account expansion, upselling, and new business development
  • Experience leading sales opportunities from initial engagement through to contract execution
  • Experience using Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform
  • Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills
  • Experience within telecommunications, wireless, SaaS, fintech, mobility, device lifecycle management, or related technology industries
  • Experience working with mobile operators, retailers, MVNOs, distributors, channel partners, or service providers

Desirable

  • Experience selling into enterprise technology organisations
  • Existing relationships or understanding of the North American wireless and connected device ecosystem

Skills & knowledge

  • Strong commercial acumen and an ability to identify and develop revenue opportunities
  • Excellent relationship-building and stakeholder management skills

title: Cloud Consultant - Openshift
description:
Job Summary:

The Red Hat Consulting team is looking for a Cloud Consultant focused on Red Hat Cloud Products to join us in Israel. In this role, you will specialize in the design and development of cloud-ready application architectures, including automated container platforms, deployment pipelines. You'll lead the on-site implementation of Red Hat's technologies like Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat OpenShift Container Storage, Red Hat Ceph and Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform. You'll play a key role in the enterprise development of our customers, helping make our solutions both practical and workable for their businesses. You'll work to gain an understanding of customer infrastructure and business needs, make recommendations that resolve their issues, and help them make strategic decisions. As a Senior Cloud Consultant, you will help customers build enterprise applications and capabilities around cloud technologies to streamline development and allow for continuous feature release of applications.


If you have hands-on devops and Linux experience and are prepared to work from customer sites we'd love to hear from you!


What you will do

  • Serve as a subject matter expert at the customer site, addressing technical, development, or strategic IT requirements
  • Understand industry practices and Red Hat's policies, procedures, and values
  • Demonstrate good judgment in selecting best methods to obtain solutions
  • Implement and integrate Red Hat's open and hybrid cloud solutions including Red Hat OpenShift, Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform and other Red Hat's offerings
  • Collaborate with project and customer team members to meet timelines and goals
  • Contribute to project documentation and diagrams and support cases management
  • Mentor and share your knowledge with customers and the team
  • Define and promote the adoption of automation techniques and DevOps processes to improve the cloud life cycle, including infrastructure and application uptime, availability, and time-to-market
  • Implement solutions using cloud technologies, design principles, integration points, and automation methods

What you will bring

  • Advanced experience of Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL)
  • Advanced hands on experience and knowledge of Red Hat OpenShift Platform or underlying components like Kubernetes and Docker
  • Advanced hands on experience and knowledge of Red Hat Ansible Automation Platform
  • Experience implementing system infrastructure and cloud solutions, including data storage, networking, monitoring, and security
  • Ability to communicate value, progress, and metrics of key projects to required stakeholders in both technical and business audiences
  • Ability to study on your own, learn quickly, and put new ideas into practice
  • Good communication skills, verbal and written in English
  • Availability to work onsite on customer sites up to 100% of time

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. title: Säljare Vilt & Fisk - Västerås
description:
Vill du vara med och bryta ny mark inom hemförsäljning? Då ska du jobba med oss på Viltbilen!

Viltbilen är ett nystartat företag i Stockholm som säljer och levererar viltkött och fisk till privatpersoner.

Vi söker nu säljare utanför Stockholm som kan jobba med sin bostad som bas. Du kommer få tillgång till en snyggt loggad och eldriven skåpbil, försedd med frys som är fylld med våra fina varor.

Viltkött är enligt Världsnaturfonden det enda klimatvänliga köttet. Vårt kött kommer från svenskt frilevande vilt och är därför fritt från antibiotika och bekämpningsmedel.

Vi söker dig som:

  • Har B-körkort (automat räcker)
  • Har egen parkeringsplats med eluttag
  • Talar flytande svenska
  • Har minst 1 års erfarenhet inom uppsökande försäljning (direkt till konsument och/eller till företag)
  • Gillar att träffa människor och bygga kundrelationer
  • Värdesätter samarbete och ett bra team
  • Ser möjligheter med provisionslön

Vi erbjuder dig:

  • Marknadsmässig provisionslön
  • Flexibla arbetstider (heltid)
  • Eget distrikt och tillgång till egen frysbil
  • Behovsanpassad utbildning
  • Fint kontor med säljaktiviteter och event i Stockholm

Lönen är helt provisionsbaserad. När du arbetat upp ditt kundregister bör du kunna nå 40 000 kr/mån (heltid). Men viktigt att du är beredd att jobba heltid för att uppnå detta. Du får dessutom provision för de leveranser du gör inom ditt distrikt från onlineförsäljningen, vilket ger ytterligare möjligheter att bearbeta en kund.

Låter detta intressant? Skicka då in ditt CV och några rader om dig själv till oss på mail. Glöm inte att ange vilken tjänst du söker (område/distrikt).

Om du går vidare för intervju, blir det först ett digitalt möte. Nästa steg är en intervju på vårt kontor i Stockholm.

Eftersom tjänsten innebär ansvar för våra premiumprodukter samt frysbil, gör vi en bakgrundskontroll på våra slutkandidater.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Läs mer om oss på vår hemsida: https://viltbilen.se/

description:

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Description Summary

As a Medical Science Liaison (MSL), you will serve as a trusted scientific partner to leading Cardiology Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and healthcare professionals, driving meaningful scientific exchange and advancing evidence-based patient care. In this highly visible field-based role, you will communicate complex clinical and scientific information with accuracy and credibility, helping to deepen understanding of products, therapeutic areas, and emerging data.

You will collaborate closely with healthcare providers to address scientific inquiries, deliver educational insights, and support informed clinical decision-making. Internally, you will work cross-functionally with Medical Affairs, Clinical, Commercial, and other teams, providing medical expertise and strategic input across a variety of initiatives.

This role will support the Central territory.

Our Pharmaceutical Diagnostics (PDx) business is the number one global supplier of contrast media and molecular imaging agents used to enhance medical imaging exams. Used throughout all major disease area diagnostic and treatment pathways, PDx products support three patients every second around the world.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

  • Per the Cardiology Medical engagement plan, interact with KOLs to communicate and advance GE’s Cardiology medical plans and initiatives.

  • Communicate clinical/scientific insights as well as research concepts from KOLs back to medical affairs team members within the organization, for further evaluation. Communication is consistent with bidirectional scientific exchange; encompassing data dissemination and education, as well as the gleaning and capturing of HCP insights.

  • Participate at regional and national cardiology conferences; actively contribute to conference planning, scientific session coverage and development of scientific summary subsequent to conferences.

  • • With oversight from Cardiology Medical Director/ Care Area Lead, provide support to unsolicited investigator sponsored research proposals as well as Company sponsored research.

  • Participate in identification and training of participants in the Company’s speaker’s bureau members, when applicable.

  • Demonstrate full awareness of and compliance with all SOPs and applicable laws and regulations as they apply to this job type/position. Proactively identify and report any quality or compliance concerns and take immediate action as required.

  • Participate in preparation and delivery of training materials to support new and existing medical staff on diagnostic imaging agents used in Cardiology and emerging clinical evidence.

  • Provide medical expertise and support to projects led by US/Canada Medical Affairs and other cross-functional projects, such as advisory boards, educational activities, clinical study support as necessary.

Required Qualifications:

  • Advanced degree is (MS, PhD, PharmD, MD)

  • 2+ years Pharmaceutical/Healthcare industry experience (preferably as an MSL with some experience in Cardiology, Radiology, Nuclear Medicine.

  • A proactive leader who translates strategy into timely, impactful outcomes.

title: Kommunikationskonsulent til Den Fælles Sterilcentral
description:
Den Fælles Sterilcentral har ansvaret for at genbehandle de kirurgiske instrumenter, som hospitalerne i Region Hovedstaden bruger hver dag. Vi leder efter en kommunikationskonsulent, som har lyst til at bygge kommunikation op i en organisation, der stadig er ved at finde sin form efter sin etablering i 2025 og som en del af Region Østdanmark pr. 1. januar 2027.

Kommunikationsområdet er fortsat under udvikling, og en del processer og arbejdsgange er endnu ikke fuldt etableret. Du vil få ansvar for en række kommunikationsopgaver på tværs af organisationen og bidrage til udviklingen af området.

Om stillingen
Kommunikation er et område, som du i høj grad kommer til at drive, og du vil referere til stabschefen. Du kommer til at samarbejde med ledere og kolleger fra hele organisationen. Nogle henvender sig med en konkret opgave, mens andre har brug for hjælp til at skærpe et budskab.

Stillingen indeholder både strategiske og praktiske kommunikationsopgaver. Du vil arbejde med rådgivning, planlægning og koordinering af kommunikationsindsatser, men også med produktion af indhold, udarbejdelse af materialer og andre konkrete driftsopgaver. Det betyder, at du skal kunne skifte mellem opgaver af både strategisk og driftsorienteret karakter.

Dine opgaver

  • Udvikle og drive vores LinkedIn-side med fokus på synlighed, employer branding og engagement
  • Udvikle grafisk materiale til både digitale og trykte medier
  • Hjælpe ledelsen med kommunikation og materialer, der understøtter en ensartet kommunikation på tværs af organisationen
  • Planlægning og gennemførelse af interne kommunikations- og medarbejderaktiviteter, der styrker kultur, trivsel og fællesskab

Vi tilbyder dig

  • Et struktureret introduktionsforløb
  • Mulighed for at sætte dit eget præg på kommunikationsområdet
  • En hverdag med både planlagte og ad hoc-prægede kommunikationsopgaver af forskellig karakter
  • Fokus på et godt arbejdsmiljø og høj trivsel

Om dig

Du har sikkert en uddannelse inden for kommunikation, marketing eller lignende. Men vi lægger mindst lige så meget vægt på, at du har prøvet kræfter med kommunikationsopgaverne i praksis, og gerne med kendskab fra sundhedsvæsenet. Du kan formulere budskaber klart og forståeligt og tilpasse dem til forskellige målgrupper og kanaler.

Vi forventer desuden, at du:

  • har erfaring med digital kommunikation og sociale medier
  • har erfaring med produktion af indhold til digitale kanaler
  • har kendskab til grafiske designværktøjer og layout
  • har erfaring med CMS-, intranet- eller webplatforme
  • er en stærk skriftlig formidler med sans for målgrupper og budskaber

Som kollega er du nysgerrig og opsøgende. Du trives med mange samarbejdsflader, tager selv initiativ og har det fint med, at en plan kan ændre sig i løbet af dagen.

Da vi fortsat er en virksomhed under opbygning, er det vigtigt, at du trives i en organisation, hvor udvikling, forandringer og nye idéer er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi har travlt, men vi har det sjovt, og vi hjælper hinanden.

Om os
Den Fælles Sterilcentral er en ny virksomhed i Region Hovedstaden. Vi har ansvaret for at genbehandle de kirurgiske instrumenter, som hospitalerne bruger hver dag. Det er ikke et område, mange kender. Til gengæld er det et område med høj faglighed, avanceret teknologi og mennesker, der hver dag får sundhedsvæsenet til at hænge sammen.

Løn- og ansættelsesforhold
Ansættelse sker i henhold til én af nedenstående overenskomster. Startlønnen kan variere afhængigt af din anciennitet, erfaring, uddannelse samt arbejdsstedets geografiske placering.

Overenskomster:

  • Overenskomst for Administrations- og IT-personale m.fl. 32.01.1
  • Overenskomster for akademikere ansat i regioner m.v. 33.01.1

Stillinger:

  • Specialister
  • Akademikere med kandidat

Udover startlønnen kan du have mulighed for at forhandle individuelle tillæg afhængigt af stillingen samt din erfaring og dine kvalifikationer.

Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen, og du vil have arbejdsplads på både Herlev Hospital og Rigshospitalet.

Tiltrædelse 1. december 2026.

Yderligere oplysninger
Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte stabschef Morten Koch på telefon 21 65 42 58.

Ansøgningsprocedure
Du søger stillingen via linket i annoncen. Ansøgningsfristen er den 16. oktober 2026.

Vi forventer at afholde samtaler tirsdag d. 20. oktober 2026.

Vi glæder os til at læse din ansøgning.

title: EH&S Coordinator

title: Cyber Analyst - Corporate Cyber Insurance Team (UAE Nationals Only)
description:
Company:

Marsh

Description:

Cyber Analyst – Corporate Cyber Insurance Team, UAE


Eligibility:

  • UAE Nationals with a Family Book only.

What’s in it for you?
At Marsh, we are looking for an early-career professional eager to help companies understand, measure, and manage their Cyber Risk. Marsh Cyber Practice is the largest global advisor on risk and insurance services, supporting clients on their journey in Cyber Risk management. We welcome candidates with an interest in insurance, cybersecurity, or technology.

About Cyber Risk:
As digital transformation reshapes business operations—enabling new ways to communicate, promote brands, and improve efficiency—Cyber Risk has become one of the top five strategic risks for most companies. This role offers the opportunity to become a subject matter expert in Cyber Insurance within the UAE corporate market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the first point of contact for day-to-day communication with clients, managing correspondence and maintaining effective communication.
  • Assist in understanding client businesses by conducting research, analyzing industry issues, and supporting the preparation of risk assessments.
  • Support account management tasks such as billing, scheduling, and liaising between internal teams and clients to ensure smooth operations and client satisfaction.
  • Address and resolve client concerns promptly, escalating issues to senior colleagues when necessary.
  • Gather feedback on client satisfaction and report insights to senior team members.
  • Build and grow professional relationships with client counterparts, Corporate colleagues, prospects, and UAE onshore insurance markets.
  • Become a Cyber Insurance subject matter expert for the Corporate Team in UAE.
  • Explain the Cyber Insurance value proposition, Marsh capabilities, and data analysis to clients.
  • Coordinate with the DIFC Cyber team to relay client requirements (industry, risk exposure) and commercial context (competition, budget) to secure the best insurance terms.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Client Executives to present insurance terms to clients.
  • Manage client onboarding and engagement throughout the lifecycle of the cyber insurance program.
