title: Data Specialist
description:
Data Specialist

Location: Remote, USA

Time Zone: Must be in Pacific time zone and willing to work 9AM - 6 PM PT

About Syllo

Syllo is defining the Litigation AI category. We are the first unified platform designed to autonomously manage the entire litigation lifecycle end-to-end. Founded in 2019 by a team of litigators and engineers, Syllo enables legal teams to securely harness the power of AI across any matter, regardless of complexity or scale. Our technology supports Fortune 500 companies and AmLaw 200 firms managing their most complex litigation portfolios. Awarded ILTA Transformative Project of the Year and ALM eDiscovery Technology of the Year for 2026, we are the market leader in enterprise-grade litigation AI. Backed by top-tier VCs, we are at a clear inflection point — the team has doubled in the last six months and growth is accelerating.

About the role

Own the data layer that makes complex litigation possible.

This role is responsible for the technical data operations that underpin every case on Syllo's platform, from collection and processing through production and quality control. You will work directly with Client Services pods and internally with Product and Engineering to ensure data integrity at every stage. We are looking for someone with hands-on EDRM lifecycle experience, deep platform fluency, and the judgment to know when a data issue is a technical quirk versus a signal something is wrong.

What you will do

  • Own data operations: Manage ingestion, processing, and production workflows across active cases. Validate every output before it reaches the client.
  • Own quality control: Apply systematic QC standards across all data outputs, documenting findings and resolving issues before they reach the client or the pod.
  • Resolve complex data issues: Diagnose and resolve collection anomalies, processing failures, metadata errors, and production format disputes.
  • Advise on data strategy: Help clients structure their data workflows, processing specs, and review protocols for efficiency and defensibility.
  • Serve as the pod liaison: Receive data handoffs from Client Services pods, document chain of custody, and ensure all requirements are captured before work begins. Manage intake through a dedicated queue and communicate proactively about capacity and timelines.
  • Partner with Engineering and Product: Surface recurring data-layer issues, document edge cases, and contribute to platform improvement through product testing and timely feedback.
  • Build documentation: Create and maintain processing guides, QC checklists, and workflow standards that hold up as the client base grows.

What you bring

  • EDRM depth: You have owned the full lifecycle, from collection through production, on complex commercial cases with high data volumes.
  • Quality discipline: Your QC process is systematic, documented, and does not depend on memory.
  • Platform fluency: Hands-on experience with Relativity, Everlaw, Nuix, or comparable platforms. You can troubleshoot, not just operate.
  • Metadata and data structure knowledge: You understand file formats, processing parameters, load file specs, and why metadata integrity matters.
  • Cross-functional communication: You can explain a data issue to an attorney and a technical root cause to an engineer.

Experience and qualifications

  • 3+ years in eDiscovery, litigation support, or a data-focused legal role.
  • Hands-on EDRM lifecycle experience from collection through production on complex commercial cases.
  • Proficiency with at least one major eDiscovery platform; Relativity RCA or equivalent preferred.
  • Comfort working with metadata, large datasets, and technically complex data requests.
  • Experience with ticketing systems such as Jira or Linear is a plus.
  • Experience collaborating with engineering or product teams is a plus.
  • High aptitude for learning new software tools and enthusiasm for AI-powered products.

Total rewards and benefits

At Syllo, we believe in taking care of our team so they can focus on building the future of legal tech.

Compensation: Competitive base salary + equity options.

Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, and voluntary insurance options. Vacation, sick leave, and paid holidays. Access to benefit counselors and fitness class reimbursements.

Growth: Annual learning and development budget and real career growth in a fast-scaling organization.

Equal opportunity employer

We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We provide a fair and accessible hiring process. If you require accommodations during the application or interview stage, please let us know.

title: Senior Fullstack Engineer, Growth
description:
Location: US - NYC, Boston

Compensation: $200,000 - $280,000

💎 About Nivoda

Nivoda is the operating system for the global jewellery industry. We connect diamond and gemstone suppliers directly with jewellery retailers across more than 70 countries, replacing a slow, offline, relationship-gated way of trading with a single digital marketplace. We're already powering over $300M in annual transactions, inside an industry worth more than $350B globally — and we're still early. Jewellery is one of the last major global industries to go digital, and we're the ones building the rails it will run on.

Our Mission

Diamond and gemstone trading has run for decades on fragmented networks, manual processes, and who-you-know relationships — which locks smaller and newer businesses out, and leaves even the biggest players losing time and margin to inefficiency. We started Nivoda to fix that: to give any jewellery business, wherever it is and whatever size it is, the same access, pricing transparency, and ease of trading as an industry giant. Our mission is to make buying and selling diamonds and gemstones radically simpler, everywhere in the world.

The Growth Pod

You'd be joining the Growth Pod 🚀 — the team responsible for everything that happens between a business discovering Nivoda and becoming one of our most valuable customers: sign-up, onboarding, verification, activation, and the ongoing work of keeping accounts engaged instead of letting them slip away. We're a small, high-ownership team inside an engineering org that moves fast and expects you to bring judgement, not just code. You'll work closely with Product, Data, and Risk, and you'll have a real say in how we solve problems that don't yet have a playbook.

About the Role

We’re hiring a Senior Engineer for the Growth Pod to own both the backend systems and the front-end experiences that turn a new sign-up into an active, paying customer — the services and screens that decide whether a business converts or falls out of the funnel. The problems worth solving here span Sign-up/Onboarding, Discovery, and Checkout: you’ll build the event-driven, always-on backend systems that track thousands of accounts through activation, slipping, winback, lapsed, and churned states in real time, and the seamless front-end moments that educate customers, represent the Nivoda brand, and move them toward a purchase. This isn’t a role where you ship a spec and move on: you’ll be expected to dig into the data yourself to work out what’s actually going wrong when conversion isn’t where it should be. You’ll also work with identity verification and risk providers and with sensitive credit and payment data, so judgement and rigor matter here as much as raw engineering skill.

Tech Stack

  • Search: OpenSearch fed via CDC from PostgreSQL plus Spark/EMR/Glue ingestion jobs.

  • Core DB / warehouse: PostgreSQL (OLTP) → Snowflake (dbt-modeled, medallion raw/curated/presentation layers)

  • Backend: TypeScript/Node.js, GraphQL API gateway, Nx monorepo + PNPM

  • Auth: Keycloak · SSO: Okta

  • CI/CD: Jenkins (“Nivoda Build”) + GitOps for deploys

  • Cloud: AWS (EMR, Glue, DMS, Kubernetes-based deploys)

  • Observability: Grafana for logs/traces — I’d flagged Datadog as a guess earlier based on the Frontier agent skill descriptions; the real Confluence docs point to Grafana instead, so I’ve dropped Datadog from both JDs.

What would you be doing?

Core Funnel & Lifecycle Systems

  • Own and evolve the backend services behind onboarding, verification, activation, and the broader sign-up-to-purchase funnel, most likely in TypeScript/Node.js given our stack

  • Design and build event-driven, workflow-orchestrated systems that evaluate account state continuously — activation, slipping, winback, lapsed, churned — and trigger the right action automatically, rather than relying on batch scripts

Identity, Risk & Trust

  • Integrate with third-party identity verification, KYB/KYC, and fraud/risk providers, and make sure those integrations are resilient, well-monitored, and fail safely

  • Handle credit and payment data responsibly as part of personalization and reactivation logic, with full awareness of what’s at stake if that logic is subtly wrong

Experimentation & Analysis

  • Design and run experiments properly — including defining guardrail metrics and knowing when a result is real versus noise — for things like referral incentives, reactivation offers, and onboarding changes

  • Write your own SQL and work directly in the warehouse (Snowflake or similar) to run cohort analysis, diagnose time-to-activation and time-to-churn, and get to the bottom of funnel problems without waiting on a data team

  • Take on problems that don’t have an established playbook — like a credit utilization gap or a signup-to-purchase conversion decline — and help define the problem, not just solve a given brief

Building with AI

  • Use AI agents to accelerate building and testing funnel and lifecycle services, with extra care reviewing anything that touches credit, payment, or verification logic

  • Use AI to help draft and sanity-check your own analytical queries, while owning full responsibility for verifying results before they inform a real decision

  • Evaluate AI-generated output — personalized messaging, reactivation copy, churn-cause suggestions — critically, rather than shipping whatever the model produces uncritically

What do we need from you?

Years of Experience: 4 - 7 years

  • Strong backend product engineering experience, most likely in TypeScript/Node.js, with real ownership of funnel-critical, production services

  • Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures and workflow orchestration — workflow engines or event pipelines that evaluate state continuously and trigger actions automatically

  • Genuine experimentation rigor: you've designed experiments properly, you understand guardrail metrics, and you know when a result is real versus noise

  • Strong SQL and warehouse fluency (Snowflake or similar), and the confidence to do your own cohort and funnel analysis rather than waiting on a data team

  • Comfort using AI agents to build and test software and to draft and sanity-check analytical work, paired with the judgement to catch the subtle errors a reasonable-looking AI output can hide

  • High tolerance for ambiguity — you're energised by problems that don't have an established playbook, not just ones with a clear spec

  • Practical fluency evaluating AI-generated output for fitness before it ships, whether that's copy, messaging, or a suggested root cause

Nice to have

title: Electronics Engineer | Robotics
description:
We build humanoid systems: full stack, from hardware and electronics to software and manufacturing, all in-house in Berlin.

At Cell Labs, we push the boundary of what robotics can achieve. Our goal is clear: to build systems that empower humans, not replace them. Our technology is already deployed with industry-leading customers and partners. Now, our own product is close to launch.

The quiet phase is over. We are looking for people who want to be here early, take ownership, and help us build what others only talk about.

Location: Berlin (on-site) Start: Asap Employment Type: Full-time

Tasks

  • Electronics & PCB Design: Design electronic systems for humanoid robots, from motor drivers to sensor interfaces. Create schematics and multi-layer PCBs in Altium or KiCad, from prototype to production.
  • Microcontrollers & FPGAs: Select and integrate ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers from STMicroelectronics (STM32) and AMD Xilinx FPGAs for motor control, sensor processing, and real-time communication. Bring up new boards and write low-level firmware and VHDL where needed.
  • Motor Control & Power: Develop motor driver and power electronics for the actuators, including battery management, power distribution, and protection circuits.
  • Integration & Wiring: Work with the mechanical team to integrate electronics into the robot, including cable routing, connectors, and heat management. Build and solder wiring harnesses for prototypes and test setups.
  • Testing & Documentation: Bring up, debug, and validate boards, including EMC and reliability testing. Keep schematics, BOMs, wiring diagrams and test reports up to date.
  • Production Readiness: Optimize designs for series production with cost and manufacturability in mind. Work with PCB manufacturers and suppliers on ramp-up and testing in production.
  • Systems Integration: Work closely with mechanical and software engineers so that hardware, firmware, and control systems work together seamlessly.

Requirements

  • Background: You studied electrical engineering, mechatronics, robotics, or something close to it.
  • Electronics Design: You design PCBs in Altium, KiCad, or similar tools, and you understand mixed-signal circuits. Sensors, actuators, power electronics, and signal conditioning are familiar ground for you.
  • Embedded Hardware: You've worked with microcontrollers, ideally STM32, and you're comfortable bringing up new boards. Experience with AMD Xilinx FPGAs is a strong plus.
  • Safety & EMC: You know how to handle EMC, grounding, and safety standards in hardware design, and you think about them from the first schematic, not just before certification.
  • Hands-on: You like having a soldering iron, oscilloscope, and multimeter on your bench. You work precisely, build prototypes quickly, and enjoy tracking down why a board doesn't behave.
  • Robotics: You're curious about robotics and complex electromechanical systems, and you want to see your electronics move a real machine.
  • Languages: Fluent English. German is a plus.

Benefits

  • Your work goes into a real robot: The boards, power systems, and wiring you design end up in humanoid robots we build ourselves. You take ownership of real subsystems and see them go from schematic to a moving machine.
  • Everything under one roof: Office, workshop, and test rigs are in the same building in Kreuzberg. Your boards go from layout to bring-up on the bench in no time, and the mechanical and software engineers are a short walk away, not a ticket.
  • Room to grow: Paid learning time and a personal budget for courses, conferences, and the tools you need. You'll get space to try new components, architectures, and ideas, and you'll take on more responsibility as the company grows.
  • Benefits: A benefits package you put together yourself, covering mobility, health, food, or fitness. Plus one extra paid day off a year for volunteering or a project you care about.

How to Apply

Send us your CV and a few projects you've worked on. Ideally, include a board or electronic system you designed and brought up yourself, with a short note on the challenges and how you solved them. No cover letter needed.

Process: Intro call → Technical deep-dive → On-site visit → Offer

We build robots for everyone, so we want a team that reflects that. We hire on what you can do, and we welcome applications from people who are underrepresented in engineering and tech. If you don't tick every box but think this is your job, apply anyway.

title: Senior Narrative Designer

In this role you will :

6+ years of experience in Narrative Design, Game Writing, or a related discipline.Previous professional experience as a writer in the game industry.

Good understanding of how story is used to support game mechanics and enhance player retention.
Possess a strong understanding of visual storytelling.

Dans ce rôle tu devras :

Contribuer à définir, développer et maintenir la voix narrative du jeu;

Identifier les enjeux narratifs et collaborer avec tes collègues afin de proposer des solutions créatives;
Imaginer des façons efficaces et engageantes de présenter l’univers, les personnages et l’histoire aux joueur·euse·s;
Intégrer les contenus narratifs dans le moteur de jeu et assurer le suivi des révisions afin de garantir leur visibilité et leur traçabilité à l’échelle du projet.

Ce que nous recherchons :
6+ ans d’expérience en Narrative Design, en écriture de jeux vidéo ou dans une discipline connexe;


Expérience professionnelle en tant qu’auteur·rice, scénariste ou narrative designer dans l’industrie du jeu vidéo;


Bonne compréhension des principes fondamentaux du game design et de leur application dans le développement de jeux;


Excellente capacité à concevoir et à communiquer des concepts narratifs clairs, ainsi qu’à bâtir des histoires cohérentes et engageantes;


Bonne compréhension de la façon dont la narration soutient les mécaniques de jeu et contribue à l’engagement ainsi qu’à la rétention des joueur·euse·s;


Solide compréhension du storytelling visuel et de son rôle dans la création d’expériences immersives.

Laisse ta marque sur un jeu apprécié par des joueur·euse·s du monde entier, rejoins Behaviour Interactive en tant que Concepteur·rice narratif·ve sénior·e.
Es-tu passionné·e par la création d’histoires captivantes, de personnages mémorables et d’expériences immersives? 
Behaviour Interactive est à la recherche d’un·e Concepteur·rice narratif·ve principal·e pour rejoindre son équipe et contribuer au développement d’un jeu live en cours de production, réalisé en co-développement avec un partenaire externe et lancé sur PC et consoles.
Dans ce rôle senior, tu agiras à titre de référence pour tous les aspects liés à la narration du projet et travailleras en étroite collaboration avec le Directeur Design ainsi qu’avec les équipes multidisciplinaires. Tu contribueras à concevoir et à faire évoluer un univers narratif riche et cohérent, en veillant à ce que l’histoire, les personnages et la narration s’intègrent harmonieusement aux mécaniques de jeu, à la structure, au design et à la vision créative du projet. Ton expertise te permettra d'identifier les opportunités et les défis narratifs, tout en proposant des solutions créatives qui enrichissent l’expérience des joueurs.


Prêt·e à plonger dans le monde du développement de jeux vidéo à la pointe de la technologie ? Basé à Montréal, Behaviour Interactif est un acteur majeur de l’industrie du jeu, créant des expériences inoubliables sur PC, console et mobile. On est un studio indépendant dynamique avec plus de 1200 employés passionnés, et on a des studios à Toronto (Behaviour Toronto), Rotterdam (Behaviour Rotterdam) et au Royaume-Uni (Behaviour UK–North & South). On se concentre sur deux grands axes : les Services et les Jeux Originaux. Notre équipe Services collabore avec des géants du jeu et du divertissement comme Disney, Sony, Activision et Nintendo, en offrant un développement sur commande de premier choix et en innovant dans le divertissement immersif en lieu fixe (LBE). Pendant ce temps, notre unité Jeux Originaux repousse les limites de notre créativité avec nos IPs emblématiques, comme le fameux Dead by Daylight. Rejoins-nous et fais partie de l'avenir du divertissement interactif !

Chez Behaviour Interactif, on croit en l’équité des chances pour tout le monde et on célèbre la diversité des personnes, des perspectives et des idées. C’est donc important pour nous de travailler avec des talents qui proviennent de tous les horizons, et ce, indépendamment de leur âge, sexe, ethnicité, couleur, origine ethnique ou nationale, religion, orientation sexuelle, identité de genre, statut familial, handicap ou toute autre caractéristique protégée par les lois applicables.

title: Business Process Specialist - Logistics Process & Compliance, CVRM
description:
Welcome to Holly Springs, North Carolina— home to Roche/Genentech's largest-ever investment: a $2B greenfield start-up where next-generation technology, high-performing teams and Operational Excellence converge to create the global standard for high-volume, highly-efficient Drug Product manufacturing.

The facility's core is defined by Innovation - leveraging advanced automation, robotics, digital tools, real-time data analytics, and simple, streamlined processes to produce the highest quality medicines. This plant meets today’s demand for CVRM (Cardiovascular, Renal, and Metabolism) medicines and is scalable to grow with the portfolio, which focuses on next-generation metabolic medicines specifically targeting the global obesity epidemic and Type 2 diabetes.  This is a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with a high-level of accountability, with planned launch in 2028.

Are you a problem-solver and change-agent who thrives in a Team environment, eager to tackle the most complex manufacturing challenges? If so, this is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to launch a state-of-the-art facility from the ground-up and shape the culture of our organization for the next generation.

Join us in Holly Springs, where you won't just build a plant—you will build the future of medicine.

**The Opportunity**

You will serve as a pioneering force during our pre-startup build-out and post-launch operations. You are responsible for ensuring that our end-to-end intralogistics processes, material flows, and automated warehousing infrastructure comply strictly with cGMP regulations, Health Authority expectations, and Roche Global Quality Standards. Working in a paperless, highly automated environment, you will bridge the gap between logistics engineering, warehouse operations, quality assurance, and digital technology systems.

**What You'll Do**

- **Operational Readiness & System Build-Out:** Act as the business process expert for SAP S/4HANA (EWM), Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (ASRS), Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs), Autonomous Mobile Robots (AMRs), and Warehouse Control Systems (WCS).
- **Material Flow & Process Optimization:** Partner with cross-functional engineering, robotics, and operations teams to define site-level intralogistics processes, material routing, and a Plan for Every Part (PFEP) and Plan for Every Flow (PFEF) for direct raw materials, components, consumables, and cold-chain Work-In-Progress (WIP).
- **Quality & Compliance Architecture:** Author and review logistics Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), validation protocols, and commissioning documentation for automated logistics systems and temperature-controlled storage (+2 to +8°C, -20°C, and ambient).
- **Equipment Qualification Support:** Collaborate with automation vendors and Engineering to support set-up, testing, and commissioning activities for material handling equipment, downflow booths, and automated pallet conversion systems.
- **Compliance & Quality Assurance:** Serve as the Primary Subject Matter Expert (SME) during internal and regulatory audits (FDA/EMA) for warehousing, material handling, cold-chain integrity, and distribution processes.
- **Deviation Management & Continuous Improvement:** Support and / or own quality events, lead root-cause investigations into logistics deviations or temperature excursions, and implement CAPAs utilizing Lean Six Sigma principles.
- **Operational Performance Monitoring:** Monitor daily intralogistics KPIs, optimize dock-to-stock and kitting cycle times, and resolve throughput bottlenecks in material flow between the warehouse and production suites.
- **Data Integrity & Change Control:** Manage logistics change controls, maintain SAP EWM master data, and ensure data integrity across all automated logistics platforms.
- **Develop Data Visualization Strategy:** Partner with IT/OT and the OpEx teams to develop a strategy for data visualization for real time management of logistics operations..

_Key Skills, Abilities, and Competencies_

- **Technical Mastery:** Deep technical expertise in SAP S/4HANA and Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) systems, along with hands-on operational experience with automated warehouse systems (ASRS, AGVs, AMRs, WCS, and high-speed material conveyance).
  - **Regulatory & Compliance Standards:** Expert knowledge of global cGMP standards, GDP (Good Distribution Practice), 21 CFR Part 11/Annex 11, and Annex 1 cold-chain requirements.
- **Process Leadership:** Proven experience leading root-cause investigations, CAPA development, FMEA/risk assessments, and Lean Six Sigma continuous improvement projects.
- **Agility & Innovation:** Thrive in ambiguous, dynamic greenfield startup environments with an unwavering commitment to patient safety and quality-first operational excellence.

**Who You Are**

- **Education:** Bachelor’s degree (BSc) in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Operations, or a related scientific/technical discipline required.
- **Years of experience:** Minimum of 6+ years (SE5) or 8+ years (SE6) of progressive experience in logistics, intralogistics engineering, or materials management within cGMP-regulated environments (Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or Medical Device required).
- **Other:** Proven experience in greenfield startup operational readiness and qualification of automated systems.

#### Other Job Requirements

- **Shift Schedule:** Standard Day Shift (Monday–Friday) during pre-launch build-out and routine operations.
- **Travel Requirements:** Up to 25% domestic/international travel required during the pre-launch/commissioning phase for vendor acceptance testing, technology benchmark visits, and training. Post-launch travel stabilizes at ~10%.

Relocation Assistance is not available for this role.

The expected salary range for this position based on the primary location for this position of Holly Springs, North Carolina is $98,600 - $183,000. Actual pay will be determined based on experience, level, qualifications, geographic location, and other job-related factors permitted by law. A discretionary annual bonus may be available based on individual and Company performance.

title: Terrestrial Mechanical Design & Test Engineer II, Automation
description:
About Varda

Low Earth orbit is open for business. Varda is accelerating the development of commercial space infrastructure, from in-orbit pharmaceutical processing to reliable and economical reentry capsules. Varda’s W-Series vehicles are built, designed, and operated by Varda in-house, including the pharmaceutical processing payloads, the capsules, the C-PICA heat shields, and the satellite buses.

From life-saving pharmaceuticals to more powerful fiber optics, there is a world of products used on Earth today that can only be manufactured in space. Varda is accelerating innovation in the orbital economy by creating both the products and infrastructure needed so space can directly benefit life on Earth. Our mission is to expand the economic bounds of humankind.

Our team is uniquely suited to accomplishing this goal, with leadership and staff comprised of veterans from SpaceX, Blue Origin, major pharmaceutical companies and Silicon Valley. Varda was founded in January 2021 by Will Bruey and Delian Asparouhov with significant backing from world class investors including Khosla Ventures, Lux Capital, Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, General Catalyst, and Also Capital.

Varda is headquartered in El Segundo, California, where we have offices and a production facility where our vehicles, equipment, and materials are built, integrated, and tested. Varda also has offices in Washington, DC and Huntsville, AL.

Join Varda, and work to create a bustling in-space ecosystem.

About This Role

The Terrestrial Mechanical Design & Test Engineer II, Automation builds bespoke test infrastructure that qualifies spaceflight hardware for orbit. They design, build, and own sophisticated ground support equipment (GSE) and test systems: propulsion test stands, environmental qualification chambers, spacecraft-level integration testing and more! Our stack is modern, including a custom PLC framework and Beckhoff EtherCAT tooling built in-house.

  • Enable high cadence, production enabling equipment is priority #1.
  • Integrate mechanical, electrical, fluid, and instrumentation systems into cohesive test platforms.
  • Implement solutions from concept through fabrication, assembly, commissioning, and ongoing support.
  • Manage both rapid R&D test setups and long-term test infrastructure improvements.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain test systems and ground support equipment (GSE) for flight hardware qualification and manufacturing operations including data acquisition systems (Pelican DAQ, Load cell DAQ, Accelerometer DAQ, prop test stands, fill carts), thermal control systems (chillers, heaters, Ln2), PLC cabinets, and gas/liquid systems (valves, ducers, solenoids, flowmeters).
  • Test infrastructure achieves >99% uptime and predictable performance.
  • Be the "Responsible Engineer" for test infrastructure including centrifuges, TVACs, prop test stands, prop fill carts, prop gas benches, prop water flow stands and torch test stands.
  • Build cabinets, wire panels, and own systems end-to-end from electrical design through commissioning.
  • Partner with propulsion, avionics, GNC, and manufacturing teams to deliver test infrastructure that meets their needs on aggressive timelines.
  • Read, deploy and make minor edits to Varda's internal PLC framework and EtherCAT tooling to support evolving program need.
  • Champion sustainable engineering practices that enable new engineers to ramp quickly on the tech stack and maintain production systems reliably. All systems are thoroughly documented, with clear, accessible procedures and schematics.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field.
  • 3+ years of industry experience in mechanical design or industrial automation.
  • Extensive experience using Solidworks, NX CAD or comparable.
  • Experience with electrical wiring for cabinets, PLCs, harnesses, connectors, etc.
  • Experience with Altium or comparable electronic schematic design software. We are migrating to EPLAN!
  • Hands-on experience working with high-pressure gas or fluid systems.
  • Environmental test experience, including TVAC, thermal cycling, and vibration testing.
  • Experience developing propulsion test stands or other complex, multi-subsystem test infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience integrating with industrial hardware over protocols such as EtherCAT, Modbus (TCP/RTU), RS-232/485 serial, or similar communication standards.
  • Experience with at least one modern PLC ecosystem - ideally Beckhoff TwinCAT 3 with structured text (IEC 61131-3), or a demonstrated eagerness to develop deep expertise there.
  • Proven ability to thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where priorities shift, and end-to-end ownership of problems is expected.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Aerospace experience, particularly in spacecraft testing or GSE development.
  • Familiarity with spacecraft qualification standards and associated documentation requirements.
  • Experience developing safety-related control systems and evaluating proposed solutions for reducing safety-related risks.
  • Programming, either low level firmware or high-level Python.

Pay Range

  • Salary range: Engineer II: $119,543 - $152,749/ per year.
  • This role is on-site in El Segundo, CA.
  • Leveling and base salary is determined by job-related skills, education level, experience level, and job performance.
  • You will be eligible for incentives in the form of stock options and/or long-term cash awards.

ITAR Requirements

Because our employees are provided access to export-controlled items, our policy is to only hire “U.S. persons” who are permitted to have access to our technology without an export license.

title: Administration Assistant
description:
By joining Sedgwick, you'll be part of something truly meaningful. It’s what our 33,000 colleagues do every day for people around the world who are facing the unexpected. We invite you to grow your career with us, experience our caring culture, and enjoy work-life balance. Here, there’s no limit to what you can achieve.

Administration Assistant

Job Location: Bristol

Job Type: Permanent

Remuneration: Competitive salary taking into account skills, experience and qualifications


We have a fantastic opportunity for an administration Assistant in our Bristol team


We are looking for an organised and detail‑focused administrator to join our Property Recoveries team in Central Bristol. This role supports our lawyers by keeping cases moving and costs under control. You will help ensure each matter runs smoothly from start to finish, with clear records and timely action throughout.


In this position, you will assist with the day‑to‑day administration of property recovery cases. You will handle documents, correspondence and case information accurately, following instructions and meeting deadlines. You will also prepare bundles and briefs for experts, courts and counsel, ensuring everything is ready when needed.


Alongside general administrative support, you will keep records up to date on the case management system and treat all client and company information with strict confidence. You will open and close files, log emailed post and help manage shared inboxes, so nothing is missed.


A key part of the role involves financial and billing support. You will help lawyers with billing tasks, record time and disbursements accurately, and provide information to support the prompt issue of invoices. You will also respond to financial queries and liaise with internal teams where required.

In addition, you will carry out general administrative duties such as document management, photocopying and other support tasks that keep the team running efficiently.


This is perfect for someone who enjoys structured work, has a sharp eye for detail and wants to build or develop a career in legal administration within a supportive property recoveries team.


The skills you will have when you apply:


  • Organisation and Prioritisation – You demonstrate strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks, prioritise effectively, and meet tight deadlines.

  • Professional Communication – You communicate clearly and professionally, both verbally and in writing, with colleagues and stakeholders.

This isn't just a position, it's a pivotal role in shaping our industry


At Sedgwick, you won't just build your career; you'll cultivate a team of experts. Our Sedgwick University offering empowers you to excel as well as your team members, with the most comprehensive training program in the industry which includes more than 15,000 courses on demand, training specific to roles, and opportunities to continue formal education.

title: Tech Lead - ServiceNow ITSM
description:
ZEISS in India

ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports & Cine Optics.

ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS’ success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace.

Further information at ZEISS India.

Job Purpose

Welcome to ZEISS – a company that combines innovation and responsibility!
You will play an important role in contributing to the success of digital transformation at ZEISS, with a vision of bringing people, processes, and data together, reliably and easily, to enable all ZEISS employees to work efficiently on one platform. The ServiceNow Team is responsible for operating and customizing/developing Enterprise Service Management and custom applications on the ServiceNow platform.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced ServiceNow ITSM Technology Lead who can work closely on ITSM Development and Architecture requirements and design, develop, implement, and continuously improve enterprise IT Service Management solutions on the ServiceNow platform.

The role combines solution architecture, hands-on development, technical leadership, and ITSM process expertise. The ideal candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Process Owners, business stakeholders, architects, and development teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable ServiceNow solutions aligned with the organization's IT strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Architecture & Solution Design

  • Define end-to-end ServiceNow ITSM solution architecture and technical design.
  • Translate business and ITSM requirements into scalable ServiceNow solutions.
  • Establish technical standards, development guidelines, and architectural patterns.
  • Ensure solutions align with ServiceNow best practices, platform capabilities, and enterprise architecture.
  • Participate in architecture and design reviews.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce customization and improve platform maintainability.
  • Support integration architecture across ServiceNow and enterprise applications.

ITSM Development

  • Develop and maintain business rules, client scripts, UI policies, UI actions, Script Includes, Flow Designer workflows, notifications, and integrations.
  • Develop reusable components and automation to improve operational efficiency.
  • Perform code reviews and ensure development follows platform standards.
  • Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues.
  • Design and implement integrations between ServiceNow and external systems.
  • Work with REST/SOAP APIs, IntegrationHub, MID Server, and other integration technologies.

Technical Leadership

  • Provide technical leadership to ServiceNow developers and implementation teams.
  • Mentor developers and conduct technical knowledge-sharing sessions.
  • Review technical designs, code, and implementation approaches.
  • Support estimation, planning, sprint execution, and release activities.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for ITSM initiatives.

Platform Governance

  • Ensure adherence to ServiceNow upgrade-safe development practices.
  • Minimize unnecessary customizations.
  • Establish standards for scripting, workflows, integrations, security, and performance.
  • Support ServiceNow upgrades, releases, health checks, and technical debt reduction.
  • Monitor platform performance and proactively identify technical risks.

Education & Work Experience

  • Completed degree in computer science, business informatics, engineering, or a comparable qualification.
  • Extensive professional experience as a ServiceNow Solution Architect, Application Specialist in a global enterprise environment.
  • Proven experience in designing, implementing, and operating ServiceNow solutions, ideally including AI-enabled capabilities.
  • Strong experience in ServiceNow implementation projects, stakeholder management, and integration of external systems.
  • Experience in agile or hybrid delivery models, with strong teamwork, ownership, and result orientation.
  • ServiceNow development or full-stack development knowledge is advantageous.

Required Skills & Expertise

  • 7+ years of ServiceNow experience, preferably with significant ITSM implementation experience.
  • Strong experience in ServiceNow architecture and hands-on development.
  • Strong knowledge of ITIL and ITSM processes.
  • Experience with integrations, APIs, enterprise data sources, knowledge management.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable, secure, maintainable, and standard-oriented ServiceNow solutions.
  • Strong communication, consulting, analytical thinking, and stakeholder management skills.

Preferred Certifications

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – ITSM
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) — desirable for senior architecture roles
  • ITIL 4 Foundation or higher
  • Relevant CSDM/CMDB certifications or training

title: Epic Principal Trainer
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Department:

EPIC Acute

Under the direction of the Director of Ambulatory Medical Informatics, the Epic Principal trainers (PTs) work with the Application Team Leads and application analysts to develop and maintain the training program for the user roles in their application. Principal Trainers will have a solid understanding of the access, clinical and revenue cycle workflows and operations of SVMHS’ ambulatory practices including (but not limited to) clinical documentation, orders, scheduling, patient-clinic communications, professional billing, claims and remittance processing.

Primary Duties:

  • Maintains policy and procedures documentation.

  • Learns new content and consulting with subject matter experts to develop training materials and answer any participant questions.

  • Assists with building and testing of training environments, and providing support and troubleshooting issues.

  • Collaborates with other trainers by co-facilitating classroom instruction and assisting with exercises as needed.

  • Prepares training lessons, prints materials, and sets up the training room and environment prior to the training session.

  • Presents information verbally and in writing in a clear and easy-to-understand manner.

  • Follows up with trainees outside of the classroom to offer additional support.

  • Serves as an expert educator to internal staff.

  • Trains and credentials additional classroom trainers as needed.

  • Trains staff and end users by teaching technical topics as needed.

  • Manages projects by prioritizing projects and by creating and adhering to timelines.

  • Is responsible for development of detailed, workflow-based curriculum for designated application(s).

  • Attends status meetings held by the training team and their designated application team(s). May also attend change control meetings and other meetings as needed.

  • Ensures deliverables are approved by the appropriate members of the project team and are completed in accordance with the training strategy.

  • Develops appropriate proficiency measures for training.

  • Determines the appropriate level of training (time, delivery method) for each user in designated application(s).

  • Maintains training curriculum, training environment, and delivers ongoing education post go-live.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
Monaco is building an AI-native revenue platform that replaces the fragmented GTM stack - CRM, sequencing, call recording, enrichment, pipeline management with one unified system, consolidating 6–10 disconnected tools into a single platform built for the AI era.

We launched publicly in Feb 2026, are already 65 people, and have strong early product-market fit generating millions in ARR within months of launch. You'll have the chance to both scale our core systems and build new features from 0 to 1.

We've raised $85M in our Series B from Founders Fund, Benchmark, and Human Capital, and our founders previously led Brex, Apollo, and Clari.

Come join us if you want to be part of a high autonomy, high pace team reinventing one of the biggest categories in enterprise software.

The Role

As Monaco's first Solutions Engineer, you're the technical lead on our upmarket deals. You learn how a customer's sales system works today, design how it will run on Monaco, and help the account executive close.

Our upmarket customers are growing sales teams moving off an existing CRM, and no two setups match. You scope that move, decide with our product team what we can deliver, and hand a defined plan to our implementation team. You'll sit on the sales team.

What You'll Do

  • Lead technical discovery. Map how the customer runs revenue today: CRM objects, fields and relationships, pipelines, routing, reporting, integrations, and the workflows reps actually use.

  • Design the future state. Show how their process will run on Monaco, with agents doing the work their team does by hand today.

  • Demo it. Build demo accounts and walk VPs of Sales and RevOps leaders through that future state, and help the account executive close.

  • Scope the migration. Plan the move off their current CRM end to end: what data comes over, how it maps, how we validate it, and when we cut over.

  • Be the gate. Decide with product whether a requested scope is something Monaco can deliver today, and flag deals that fall outside our upmarket focus.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience building automations or AI agents into a sales process

Nice to have

Location

Benefits

title: Biproduktsansvarig processoperatör till Processavdelningen i Vimmerby Arla
description:
Arla Foods söker biproduktsansvarig processoperatör till Processavdelningen i Vimmerby

Arla Foods Vimmerby söker biproduktsansvarig processoperatör

Vimmerby pulveranläggning är Arlas modernaste mjölkpulveranläggning och tar hand om en stor del av det svenska mjölköverskottet. För att göra ett kilo mjölkpulver behövs 8 till 10 kilo mjölk. Mjölken kommer främst från Arlagårdar i regionen. I Vimmerby tillverkas helmjölks- och skummjölkspulver i olika kvaliteter för att huvudsakligen säljas till andra livsmedelstillverkare som gör bakverk, barnmat, mejeriprodukter mm runt om i världen.


Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

· Säkerställa klassning, hantering och spårbarhet av alla biprodukter (mjölkpulver) från produktion, labb och färdigvarulager

· Hantera systemrelaterade kontroller, avstämningar och korrigeringar i SAP

· Enklare admin-uppgifter

· Kvalitets- och kvantitetskontroll av produkter, inklusive säkra spårbarhet

· Planera och kommunicera med olika stakeholders

· Utföra hygien/städarbete enligt gällande krav och rutiner.

· Vara behjälplig till processpersonal vid t.ex. omställningar av utrustningen

Den verksamhet som bedrivs på vårt mejeri ställer höga krav på att rutiner och hygienkrav efterföljs enligt gällande lagar och direktiv från myndigheter.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från livsmedelsbranschen, eller process- eller tillverkningsindustri. Även erfarenhet av SAP och Excel samt truckkort (TLP10) och traverskort är meriterande.


Krav

Du som söker ska ha fyllt 18 år. Du har godkända betyg i svenska, engelska och matte. Du behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift samt har datavana.

Arbetstider

Arbetstid är förlagd till dagtid, men kan komma att förekomma skiftarbete

Vem är du

Vi tror att du är en engagerad, noggrann och strukturerad person, som gillar att ta eget ansvar för din arbetsdag. Att mixa mer fysiskt arbete med att jobba i system så som SAP och Excel passar dig bra, likväl som att vara flexibel och hantera förutsättningar som kan ändras under arbetsdagens gång. Du är också bra på att samarbeta och kommunicera med olika personer, gillar att klura på förbättringar, och är generellt positivt inställd.

Inom Arla Foods Vimmerby är engagemang, samarbete, kreativitet och ansvarskänsla viktiga värdeord, vilka även bör kännas naturliga för dig.

För mer information vänligen kontakta:

Teamledare i Processen: Siri Bäck sibel@arlafoods.com & Anette Schytt, anette.schytt@arlafoods.com

Facklig kontaktperson för LIVS: Jerry Pettersson, jerrp@arlafoods.com

Arla Foods

Arla är ett globalt bondeägt företag som arbetar ”från bondgården till tallriken”. Vi är marknadsledare inom vårt område och stolta över vår verksamhet som genomsyras av mångfald och stora ambitioner. En välkomnande företagskultur som skapar arbetsglädje är viktigt för oss och vi månar om att ge våra anställda utmanande arbetsuppgifter och goda utvecklingsmöjligheter.

Arla Foods har kollektivavtal, och vi ser alltid till att erbjuda bra och konkurrenskraftiga arbetsförhållanden. Utöver det har säkerhet och arbetsmiljö högsta prioritet hos oss, varför vi bland annat tillämpar slumpmässiga drog- och alkoholtester.

Create the future – Grow with Arla

title: Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer
description:
Data-alustat. Luotettava pilvi. Kestävät tuotantoympäristöt.

Haemme Monadille kokenutta Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineeriä vahvistamaan data-, pilvi- ja DevOps-osaamistamme yhteiskunnan toiminnan kannalta keskeisissä digitaalisissa ratkaisuissa.

Rakennamme järjestelmiä, joissa korostuvat turvallisuus, luotettavuus, pitkä elinkaari ja huolellinen tekninen ajattelu. Asiakkuutemme sijoittuvat muun muassa ilmailun, puolustuksen, terveydenhuollon, teollisuuden sekä huoltovarmuuden kannalta keskeisille toimialoille, joissa järjestelmien on toimittava myös silloin, kun olosuhteet eivät ole yksinkertaiset.

Tässä roolissa olet mukana suunnittelemassa, rakentamassa ja operoimassa pilvi- ja data-alustojen teknistä perustaa. Työsi näkyy siinä, että sovellukset, datavirrat, analytiikka- ja AI-ratkaisut sekä niitä ympäröivä infrastruktuuri voidaan viedä tuotantoon hallitusti, turvallisesti ja ylläpidettävästi.

Et ole vain “se DevOps-tyyppi”, jolle asiat heitetään lopussa. Olet mukana riittävän aikaisin, jotta arkkitehtuuri, automaatio, tietoturva, havainnointi ja tuotantokelpoisuus rakennetaan osaksi ratkaisua alusta asti.

Ketä etsimme

Etsimme kokenutta tekijää, joka yhdistää pilviympäristöjen, DevOps-käytäntöjen ja data-alustojen ymmärrystä. Sinun ei tarvitse olla kaiken erikoisasiantuntija, mutta sinun tulee ymmärtää, miten modernit järjestelmät rakennetaan niin, että ne ovat luotettavia, toistettavia, turvallisia ja jatkokehitettäviä.

Sinä:

  • Suunnittelet ja toteutat pilvi-infrastruktuuria, jota voidaan ylläpitää koodina ja kehittää hallitusti.
  • Rakennat ja kehität CI/CD-putkia sovelluksille, data-alustoille, integraatioille ja analytiikka- tai AI-komponenteille.
  • Autat viemään kontti-, API-, data- ja analytiikkaratkaisuja tuotantoon tavalla, jossa julkaisut, rollbackit, monitorointi ja tietoturva on mietitty kunnolla.
  • Kehität observability-ratkaisuja: lokit, metriikat, tracing, hälytykset, dashboardit, runbookit ja tuotantoympäristöjen näkyvyys eivät ole sinulle sivuseikkoja.
  • Osaat keskustella sekä kehittäjien, dataosaajien, arkkitehtien että asiakkaiden kanssa ja kääntää tekniset ratkaisut ymmärrettäväksi kokonaisuudeksi.
  • Uskallat haastaa ratkaisuja, mutta teet sen rakentavasti. Etsit mieluummin kestävää ja yksinkertaista ratkaisua kuin näyttävää mutta vaikeasti ylläpidettävää viritystä.
  • Ymmärrät, että kriittisissä ympäristöissä tuotantokelpoisuus ei tarkoita vain sitä, että jokin toimii omalla koneella tai testiympäristössä. Sen pitää olla turvallista, seurattavaa, palautettavaa ja ylläpidettävää myös vuosien päästä.

Tekninen osaaminen

Toivomme, että sinulla on kokemusta useista seuraavista alueista:

Pilviympäristöt ja infrastruktuuri

  • AWS, Azure tai Google Cloud — vähintään yhdestä vahva käytännön kokemus
  • Infrastructure as Code, esimerkiksi Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep tai Pulumi
  • Pilviympäristöjen verkotus, IAM, salaisuuksien hallinta, ympäristöjen eriyttäminen ja kustannusten hallinta
  • Hybridit tai osittain suljetut ympäristöt, jos sellaisista on kertynyt kokemusta

DevOps, platform engineering ja tuotantokäytännöt

  • CI/CD, esimerkiksi GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps tai Jenkins
  • Docker ja konttiteknologiat
  • Kubernetes, esimerkiksi AKS, EKS, GKE tai on-prem-ympäristöt
  • Helm, GitOps, Argo CD, Flux tai vastaavat käyttöönotto- ja konfiguraatiomallit
  • Linux, skriptaus ja automaatio, esimerkiksi Bash, Python tai PowerShell
  • Tekninen dokumentaatio, runbookit ja tuotantoympäristöjen operointimallit

Data-alustat ja DataOps

  • Data warehouse-, data lake- tai lakehouse-ratkaisut
  • Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Snowflake, BigQuery tai vastaavat alustat
  • Airflow, Dagster, Azure Data Factory tai muut orkestrointityökalut
  • Spark, Kafka tai muut datan käsittelyn ja siirtämisen teknologiat
  • SQL ja vähintään yksi yleinen ohjelmointikieli, esimerkiksi Python tai TypeScript
  • Datan laadun, jäljitettävyyden, käyttöoikeuksien ja monitoroinnin perusperiaatteet

Havainnointi, turvallisuus ja luotettavuus

  • Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry, ELK/Opensearch, pilvialustojen omat monitorointiratkaisut tai vastaavat työkalut
  • Hälytykset, metriikat, tracing, lokitus ja palvelutason seuranta
  • DevSecOps-käytännöt, riippuvuuksien hallinta, haavoittuvuusskannaus ja toimitusketjun turvallisuus
  • Varmuuskopiointi, palautuminen, ympäristöjen toistettavuus ja häiriötilanteisiin varautuminen

Kaikkea yllä olevaa ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Tärkeämpää on, että olet tehnyt tuotantokelpoisia ratkaisuja, ymmärrät kokonaisuuksia ja opit nopeasti uudet työkalut silloin, kun asiakasympäristö sitä vaatii.

Tekoäly ja automaatio ovat osa tekemistä

Tekoäly ei ole tässä roolissa irrallinen lisä, vaan osa modernia ohjelmistokehitystä, data-alustoja ja asiantuntijatyötä.

Toivomme, että osaat hyödyntää tekoälytyökaluja järkevästi esimerkiksi koodin, Infrastructure as Code -määrittelyjen, dokumentaation, analyysin, testauksen tai vianhaun tukena. Samalla ymmärrät, että kriittisissä ympäristöissä tekoälyn käyttö vaatii harkintaa, tietoturvan ymmärrystä ja kykyä arvioida tuotosten laatua.

Arvostamme myös kokemusta AI- ja ML-ratkaisujen tuotantoympäristöistä, esimerkiksi mallien ajamisesta pilvessä, datavirtojen rakentamisesta mallien käyttöön tai GPU/kiihdytinympäristöjen operoinnista. Tämä ei kuitenkaan ole ensisijaisesti ML Engineer -rooli.

Mitä rooliin ei sisälly

Tämä ei ole pelkkä ylläpito- tai tikettijonon purkurooli.

Tämä ei ole puhdas data engineer -rooli, jossa keskitytään vain datamallinnukseen, raportointiin tai yksittäisten pipelinejen rakentamiseen.

Tämä ei ole myös rooli, jossa tulet yksin paikkaamaan kaikkia DevOps-tarpeita kaikkialla. Monadilla työtä tehdään yhdessä, ja odotamme sinunkin vahvistavan meidän yhteistä osaamista.

Miltä onnistuminen näyttää

Ensimmäisten kuukausien aikana olet ottanut haltuun Monadin tapaa tehdä ohjelmistokehitystä, data- ja AI-ratkaisuja sekä asiakasprojekteja. Tunnet keskeiset pilvi-, DevOps- ja data-alustatarpeemme ja olet mukana sparraamassa ratkaisuja jo suunnitteluvaiheessa.

Kuuden kuukauden kohdalla viet itsenäisesti eteenpäin pilvi- ja DevOps-kokonaisuuksia asiakasprojekteissa. Olet parantanut vähintään yhden hankkeen tuotantokelpoisuutta esimerkiksi CI/CD:n, IaC:n, monitoroinnin, tietoturvan, dokumentaation tai data-alustan operoitavuuden kautta.

12 kuukauden kohdalla olet tunnistettava osa Monadin data-, cloud- ja DevOps-osaamista. Kollegat pyytävät sinua mukaan, kun ratkaisuun liittyy tuotantoympäristö, pilvi-infra, data-alusta, julkaisuputki, observability tai tekninen luotettavuus. Olet myös jakanut osaamistasi muille esimerkiksi sparrauksissa, katselmoinneissa tai Tekniikkatorstaissa.

Työtapa ja laatu

  • Kirjoitat koodia ja määrityksiä, joita on helppo lukea, katselmoida, testata, ylläpitää ja jatkokehittää.
  • Pidät automaatiosta, mutta et automatisoi huonoa prosessia sokkona.
  • Ymmärrät, että hyvä pilvi- tai DevOps-ratkaisu ei ole vain teknologiapino. Se on tapa vähentää epävarmuutta, nopeuttaa turvallista kehitystä ja tehdä järjestelmästä helpommin ymmärrettävä myös seuraaville tekijöille.
  • Toimit mielelläsi osana tiimiä, jossa ratkaisua katsotaan ohjelmistokehityksen, datan, käytettävyyden, tietoturvan ja asiakkaan liiketoiminnan näkökulmista.

Muuta olennaista

  • Tehtävässä voidaan edellyttää turvallisuusselvityksen tekemistä.
  • Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa, sillä toimistomme arki ja sisäinen viestintä ovat suomenkielisiä.
  • Asiakastyö tässä tehtävässä tapahtuu pääosin englanniksi.
  • Toivomme, että sinulla on halu ja mahdollisuus käydä toimistollamme Tampereella viikoittain. Yhteistyö ja sparraus ovat meille oikeasti tärkeitä, eivät vain puhetta.

Tehtävä ja palkkaus

Tehtävän tarkempi sisältö ja vastuut rakentuvat keskustelussa aiemman kokemuksesi, osaamisesi ja kiinnostuksesi pohjalta. Meillä seniorin ei tarvitse mahtua valmiiseen muottiin, vaan etsimme yhdessä sopivan tavan ottaa vastuuta, kehittyä ja tehdä merkityksellistä työtä. Lopullisesta tehtävästä ja vastuutasosta riippuen kuukausipalkka on noin 4 500–6 000 euroa. Palkan lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle laajat edut.

Lupauksemme

Monadilla Senior Cloud & DevOps Engineer ei jää yksin.

Olet osa kokeneiden asiantuntijoiden yhteisöä, jossa data-, AI-, design- ja ohjelmistokehityksen osaajat ratkovat vaativia ongelmia yhdessä. Saat tukea ja sparrausta kollegoilta myös silloin, kun päätökset eivät ole yksinkertaisia.

Meillä tekninen laatu ei tarkoita pelkkää työkalulistaa. Se tarkoittaa kykyä rakentaa ratkaisuja, jotka kestävät aikaa, käyttöä, muutoksia ja vastuuta.

Järjestämme joka toinen viikko Tekniikkatorstain, jossa jaetaan uusia teknologioita, käytännön oppeja ja hyväksi havaittuja toimintatapoja.

Uskomme, että paras lopputulos syntyy, kun ohjelmistoon, dataan, pilveen ja tuotantoympäristöihin liittyviä pulmia voidaan ajatella ja ratkaista yhdessä.

title: Medical Lead, Neuroscience - Toronto
description:

Level 5


Job Description Summary

#LI-Hybride
Location: Toronto, Ontario

This role is based in Toronto, Ontario Canada. Novartis is unable to offer relocation support for this role: please only apply if this location is accessible for you.

This job posting is for an existing position.

Join us as Medical Lead, Neuroscience and shape the medical strategy behind innovative therapies that can transform outcomes for patients across Canada. In this strategic and collaborative role, you will combine scientific expertise, forward-looking thinking and meaningful engagement with healthcare experts to generate evidence, advance clinical practice and address critical unmet needs. Working across functions and with global partners, you will turn insights into action and help advance the future of neuroscience care.


Job Description

Key responsibilities:


  • Lead Medical Strategy: Develop and execute the Canadian Prostate - Radioligand Therapy Medical Affairs strategy to address unmet needs and improve patient outcomes.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the medical co-partner to Commercial, Access, Regulatory, and global teams, providing strategic scientific leadership.
  • Engage External Experts: Build and maintain trusted relationships with healthcare professionals, scientific experts, and key stakeholders to generate actionable insights.
  • Advance Evidence Generation: Identify evidence gaps and lead research, data generation, and scientific communication initiatives that support clinical practice.
  • Ensure Scientific Excellence and Compliance: Provide medical oversight and governance to ensure all activities meet the highest standards of scientific integrity, ethics, and regulatory compliance.

Essential Requirements:


  • Advanced scientific or healthcare degree (MD, PharmD, PhD, or equivalent).
  • Significant pharmaceutical industry experience in Medical Affairs, with expertise in Oncology preferred.
  • Strong scientific and clinical knowledge with the ability to engage credibly with healthcare professionals and external experts.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing medical strategies in a cross-functional environment.
  • Solid understanding of clinical research, evidence generation, drug development, and applicable healthcare regulations.
  • Excellent communication, scientific presentation, and stakeholder engagement skills.
  • Strong leadership, strategic thinking, and project management capabilities.

Desirable Requirements:


  • Experience in Oncology
  • Knowledge of the Canadian healthcare, reimbursement, and regulatory environment.

At Novartis Canada, we are determined to be a valued partner and advocate, with a deep understanding of patient needs along the entire care journey – from drug development, to diagnosis, to access and beyond. Part of the way we are doing this is by leveraging data, technology, and partnerships.

Research & Development: we focus on four core therapeutic areas: Cardiovascular, Renal & Metabolic, Immunology, Neuroscience and Oncology. We also develop and deliver treatments through other promoted and established brands, which today are helping millions of patients. Over the last three years, our average annual research and development investment in Canada was over $30 million, and we conduct clinical trial research in every region throughout Canada.

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion: Novartis is committed to building outstanding, inclusive work environment and diverse team’s representatives of the patients and communities we serve.


Skills Desired

Cross-Functional Collaboration, Data Analysis, Drug Development, Employee Development, Health Sciences, Influencing Skills, Innovation, Inspirational Leadership, Medical Affairs, Patient Care, People Management, Pharmaceutics, Product Launches, Real World Evidence (RWE), Regulatory Compliance, Research Methodologies, Results-Oriented, Stakeholder Engagement, Statistical Analysis

title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Job Description

Analytics Engineer Company Overview:

Endeavour Technology Ltd. has its headquarters in Dublin, Ireland. Endeavour is a company that captures the IoT cellular connectivity experience. Our ground-breaking product nSpire is a SaaS platform that has collectors on the edge (on devices) and provides real value-based connectivity insights to our customers.

Our vision is to improve the quality of connectivity with a specific focus on Business Critical, Mission Critical and Life Critical connectivity. With deep IoT, telecoms, analytics, and information technology experience, we are expanding our global presence to support customers around the world as the IoT and 5G markets continue to grow.

Endeavour Technology turns data from connected devices into actionable intelligence. Our nSpire platform measures real-world connectivity quality from the device’s perspective, helping leading companies in automotive, in-flight connectivity, and telecoms understand and improve the experience their customers get.

Software agents running on devices collect large, rich data sets that power guided analytics workflows used by hundreds of business users. These workflows are built on SQL, cloud databases, and Tableau – and our team uses AI tools such as Claude every day to work faster, explore problems more thoroughly, and deliver stronger results.

Some of our successful solutions include Connected Cars (Auto OEMS), and Industrial Internet of things (IoT) including 5G Enterprise/MEC, NPN Networks.

nSpire ensures that customers have the confidence and assurance that the connectivity delivered is always fit for purpose and enables IoT customers to utilise the QoS data in their IoT products and services.

www.endeavourtechnology.com

Role Description:

We’re looking for an experienced Analytics Engineer who can take a product brief or use case and independently turn it into a robust, scalable analytics solution, with Tableau at the core of what you deliver.

AI is part of how we work. You’ll use tools like Claude as a thinking partner – to shape your approach to a problem, speed up SQL and dashboard development, check your logic, and sharpen how insights are communicated. Your analytical judgement stays firmly in charge; AI helps you get to the best answer faster.

You’ll sit in our value delivery group and work closely with the CTO, Analytics and Product teams to bring real-time, data-driven solutions to life for our clients.

Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and optimize analytical workflows and dashboards using Tableau, SQL, and AWS-based databases.
  • Translate complex business requirements into performant data models and dashboards, using AI tools to explore different approaches and find the best way to solve each problem.
  • Use AI assistants to accelerate everyday work – drafting and optimizing SQL, troubleshooting calculations, suggesting visualization approaches, and checking data quality.
  • Turn analysis into clear, well-structured insight – summaries, commentary, and recommendations that business users can act on.
  • Critically review all AI-assisted output, so every deliverable remains accurate and trustworthy for client decision-making.
  • Build solutions that are scalable, reusable, and reliable, and document them so others can maintain and extend them.
  • Work cross-functionally with product managers, data experts, and engineers.
  • Support live analytics solutions, including troubleshooting and performance tuning.
What Success Looks Like
  • In your first 3 months: you’ve learned our data and platform, and shipped your first series of use cases
  • In your first 6 months: you independently own analytics use cases from brief to delivery, and AI is a natural part of how you get there.
  • In your first year: business users rely on your work for key decisions, and you’re helping raise the quality and speed of the wider team’s output.
Required Skills & Experience
  • 10+ years in analytics, data engineering, or similar technical roles.
  • Deep experience delivering complex dashboards using Tableau and other analytics tools.
  • Deep experience with SQL, ideally in AWS/Postgres/Redshift environments.
  • Regular, hands-on use of AI tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) in your analytics work, with examples of how they’ve improved your speed or the quality of your results.
  • A practical understanding of where AI helps and where it falls short, the discipline to verify its output, and care for data privacy when working with client data.
  • A problem-solving mindset and comfort working independently from a brief.
  • Fluent English and excellent communication skills – you can explain complex findings simply.
  • A degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent practical experience.
Bonus Skills
  • Experience with Python or JavaScript.
  • Experience with AI features in Tableau, such as Tableau Pulse or Tableau Agent.
  • Knowledge of Tableau Server or Tableau Cloud.
  • A Tableau Public portfolio or other shared examples of your work.
  • Background in technical industries such as telecoms, connected vehicles, or aviation.
What We Offer
  • Work on cutting-edge analytics with real world connectivity data from global brands.
  • Access to leading AI tools, and the freedom to use them to do your best work.
  • Hybrid working model based in Dublin or in Belgrade Serbia
  • A supportive team with deep technical and domain expertise.
  • A collaborative, high-trust team culture with real ownership from day one

title: LiftSystem Thermofluids Engineer
description:
Job Description

Job Title: LiftSystem Thermofluids Engineer

Working Pattern: Hybrid/Onsite in office 3 days/week

Working location: Indianapolis, IN


Relocation is available for this position if appropriate


GG09


Why Rolls-Royce?


At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you’ll have the opportunity to create world-class power and propulsion solutions, pushing your problem-solving and ingenuity, to deliver real impact that puts safety first.


You’ll be given responsibility and the opportunity to grow in our high-performance culture. This is Infinite Potential. And it’s your chance to really shine and contribute to one of the world’s most recognized brands and a beacon for engineering excellence.


Position Summary:

We’re looking for a Thermofluids Engineer to join our growing team. This is an exciting opportunity to work on flagship RR programs and play an important role in addressing some of the most complex and interesting technological challenges in Defense.


The Thermofluids Systems Engineer is responsible for designing and analysis of gas turbine air, oil, fuel, and thermal management systems along with component and/or subsystem thermal analysis. The role supports the entire product lifecycle from concept generation and evaluation to in-service support.

What you will be doing:

  • Define requirements for fluid systems and thermal analysis, ensuring accurate and complete flow-down and capture of higher-level requirements pertaining to each engineering problem. This includes system, sub-system and component level requirements.
  • Integrate thermofluid systems through interaction with all adjacent areas across the organization so that thermofluid systems are optimized in ways that support optimum deployment of other, complimentary systems and components. These efforts will be effectively employed alongside project engineers, validation and verification engineers, design engineers, and program leadership.
  • Perform detailed fluid flow, heat transfer, and thermo-mechanical analysis at whole-engine, sub-system and component level, using appropriate methods and tools and to a level of fidelity commensurate with each stage of the product lifecycle.
  • perform appropriate verification and validation activity to ensure that requirements have been correctly written and that all Thermofluid related aspects of the powerplant meet expectations. This will include the specification of appropriate test and measurement activity, the calibration of models against measured data, and the quantification of uncertainty.
  • Manage the technical approval of thermofluid Systems through certification and / or qualification, including process compliance checking, model auditing, and documentation approval and retention. This technical oversite will be managed within the structured audit and technical review gated processes.
  • Support the product in-service as required. This may include but is not limited to on-going technical analysis, root-cause-analysis and resolution, and in-service modifications.

Who we are looking for:

Basic Requirements:

  • A Bachelor’s degree in engineering and 1+ years of relevant experience OR
  • Master’s degree in Engineering OR
  • JD/Ph.D.
  • In order to qualify for this role you must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance, which requires US Citizenship

Our vision is to ensure that the quality and dynamism that shaped our history continues into our future. It’s a bold pursuit, and we never stop striving to go further, faster, and better. We lead progress, creating the technologies that move us forward. If you’re driven to grow, to learn, and to make a lasting difference, this is where you belong.


Rolls-Royce is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics.


Infinite Potential

title: Business Analyst (VP)
description:
WHO WE ARE:

As Singapore’s longest established bank, we have been dedicated to enabling individuals and businesses to achieve their aspirations since 1932. How? By taking the time to truly understand people. From there, we provide support, services, solutions, and career paths that meet their individual needs and desires.

Today, we’re on a journey of transformation. Leveraging technology and creativity to become a future-ready learning organisation. But for all that change, our strategic ambition is consistently clear and bold, which is to be Asia’s leading financial services partner for a sustainable future.

We invite you to build the bank of the future. Innovate the way we deliver financial services. Work in friendly, supportive teams. Build lasting value in your community. Help people grow their assets, business, and investments. Take your learning as far as you can. Or simply enjoy a vibrant, future-ready career.

Your Opportunity Starts Here.

The Business Analyst is part of the Business Solutioning team in technology department who serves as a liaison to business stakeholders, Business and Operation Managers, Product Owners in various Business Units across the OCBC group. Key business stakeholders include Bank of Singapore, Consumer Financial Services, Global Markets. The primary focus of this role is to elicit business initiatives across various business units and design an end-to-end solution for the Group Wealth Platform – GWP.

Why Join

Join OCBC’s Business Solutioning team and help shape the future of the Group Wealth Platform. You will partner with stakeholders across Bank of Singapore, Consumer Financial Services and Global Markets to drive strategic initiatives, solve complex business challenges and deliver impactful end-to-end solutions. This is an opportunity to influence regional wealth management transformation while creating lasting value through innovation and technology.


How you succeed

You succeed by combining deep wealth management expertise with strong analytical, solutioning and stakeholder management skills. You will translate complex business needs into practical technology solutions, collaborate effectively across business and technology teams, and balance business priorities, regulatory requirements and system constraints. Your ability to influence stakeholders and drive clarity will be key to delivering successful outcomes.

What you do

  • Solution Design: Design IT functional solutions for business initiatives or projects. Construct the desired solutions by considering the concept of end-to-end, reusability, high availability, forward looking and lasting value.
  • Requirements Gathering: Work with stakeholders across various departments across the region to gather and document detailed business requirements
  • Subject Matter Expert of responsible functional domains
  • Process Analysis and Optimization: Analyze existing operational processes to identify inefficiencies, bottlenecks, and areas for improvement through digitalization.
  • Explore new ideas/new tools to address the key EPICs and perform first level functional validation of new ideas/new tools.
  • Provide directions and clarifications to project team during the development phase of the project to any queries pertaining to the FSD or BRD. Where necessary, re-engage business SMEs to revise requirements and/or for the acceptance of alternative solutions, due to design or implementation constraints encountered.
  • Collaborate with Quality Assurance team to define the test strategy and approach and provide clarifications to queries during the testing phase, to both the Quality Assurance team and Business Testers during UAT.

Who you are

  • At least 12 years of relevant working experience as a Business Analyst or Solution Manager in Private banks, Investment banks, Asset Management Firms or relevant financial institutions. Have a broad understanding of the wealth management industrial trend and practices.
  • Excellent front-to-back knowledge of Investment products and/or wealth management products
  • Good understanding of the regulatory requirement and business rules in wealth management domains.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Proficient in the documentation of use cases, visual modeling, business processes, in the business requirements document and functional specifications document.
  • Excellent inter-personal and communication skills, with strong ability to manage and align expectations of senior level business stakeholders across different business units to accept solutions proposed by project team.
  • Good knowledge of system engineering concepts, data and information structures in an IT system environment including that of data modeling and database design appreciation.
  • Competent in IT solutioning processes such as effort estimation, vendor management negotiation
  • Degree in computer science, software engineering and/or investment discipline preferred.

What we offer:


Competitive base salary. A suite of holistic, flexible benefits to suit every lifestyle. Community initiatives. Industry-leading learning and professional development opportunities. Your wellbeing, growth and aspirations are every bit as cared for as the needs of our customers.

Workforce Absence Team Lead

PRIMARY PURPOSE: To supervise the operations of multiple teams of examiners and technical staff for disability claims for clients; to monitor colleagues' workload, provide training, and monitor individual claim activities; to provide technical/jurisdictional direction to examiner reports on claims adjudication; and to maintain a diary on claims within the teams including frequent diaries on complex or high exposure claims.

  • Compiles, reviews, and analyzes management reports and takes appropriate action.
  • Performs quality review on claims in compliance with audit requirements, service contract requirements, and quality standards.
  • Acts as second level of appeal for client and claimant issues regarding claim specific, procedural or special requests; implements final disposition of the appeal.
  • Reviews reserve amounts on high cost claims and claims over the authority of the individual examiner.
  • Monitors third party claims; maintains periodical review of litigated claims, serious vocational rehabilitation claims, questionable claims and sensitive claims as determined by client.
  • Maintains contact with the client on claims and promotes a professional client relationship; makes recommendations to client as suggested by the claim status; and provides written resumes of specific claims as requested by client.
  • Assures that direct reports are properly licensed in the jurisdictions serviced.
  • Ensures claims files are coded correctly and adequate documentation is made by claims examiners.

ADDITIONAL FUNCTIONS and RESPONSIBILITIES

Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university preferred. Licenses as required. Professional certifications as applicable to line of business preferred.

Experience
Six (6) years of claims experience or equivalent combination of education and experience required. Two (2) years of claims supervisory experience preferred.

  • Excellent oral and written communication, including presentation skills
  • PC literate, including Microsoft Office products

  • Analytical and interpretive skills
  • Strong organizational skills
  • Excellent interpersonal skills

WORK ENVIRONMENT
