  • Harmonize processes across sites while allowing justified local needs.
  • Translate stakeholder needs into future-state processes, requirements, system designs, and digital capabilities.
  • Define process maps, system interactions, information flows, roles, controls, and governance.
  • Use data, feedback, and metrics to drive continuous improvement.
Digital Systems Expertise

Provide business process and product leadership for:

  • OMP: Planning, scheduling, demand and capacity management, supply planning, and system integration.
  • SAP: Materials, procurement, inventory, finance, manufacturing, quality, master data, and supply chain processes.
  • PAS-X: Recipes, master batch records, electronic batch records, production execution, workflows, exception handling, and batch review.
  • Tulip: Connected worker solutions, digital work instructions, training, standard work, and shop-floor data capture.
  • LIMS and OneLab: Sample management, testing, results review, stability, laboratory operations, data integrity, and release activities.
  • MODA and related platforms: Quality, manufacturing, laboratory, and operational workflows.
  • Integration and lifecycle management: Interfaces, data flows, releases, upgrades, incidents, remediation, platform performance, and decommissioning.
  • AI & Data Analytics – Embed data and AI capabilities into Business Processes to accelerate scaling and maximize productivity
Stakeholder and Delivery Leadership
  • Serve as a strategic digital partner to Operations, Manufacturing, Quality, Laboratory, Supply Chain, Planning, and site leadership.
  • Facilitate workshops and governance forums to align stakeholders on priorities, scope, process design, and implementation plans.
  • Lead cross-functional Agile delivery teams through discovery, design, configuration, development, testing, validation, deployment, hypercare, and support transition.
  • Manage risks, dependencies, resources, release sequencing, operational readiness, communications, training, SOP updates, and adoption.
  • Present recommendations, investment needs, risks, roadmap decisions, and benefits to senior leaders.
  • Manage relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and systems integrators.
Data, Analytics, and Automation
  • Partner with Data & AI and IT teams to improve master data, transactional data, metadata, lineage, ownership, and access controls.
  • Promote consistent data models, interfaces, identifiers, event standards, and business rules across platforms.
  • Enable reporting, operational analytics, predictive insights, planning optimization, and performance management.
  • Identify automation opportunities that reduce manual effort, improve data capture, reduce errors, and accelerate decision-making.
  • Ensure processes and systems are structured to support future AI and machine learning use cases with appropriate governance and human oversight.
Compliance and Quality
  • Ensure systems and processes comply with GxP, AstraZeneca policies, data integrity principles, and regulatory expectations.
  • Partner with Quality, Validation, and IT teams on risk-based computerized system assurance.
  • Apply requirements related to ALCOA+, audit trails, electronic records and signatures, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, access controls, segregation of duties, traceability, and change control.
  • Maintain documentation, test evidence, decision records, process controls, and lifecycle records to support audits and inspections.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, information systems, life sciences, supply chain, business, or a related discipline; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in digital product management, business process management, enterprise systems, manufacturing systems, laboratory systems, supply chain technology, or a related field within a regulated industry.
  • At least 3 years of product, process, solution, or digital business leadership experience delivering digital capabilities in a regulated environment.
  • Experience with several platforms or technologies such as OMP, SAP, PAS-X, Tulip, LIMS, OneLab, MODA, ERP, MES, electronic batch records, quality systems, planning systems, workflow platforms, or data historians.
  • Strong knowledge of manufacturing, laboratory, quality, planning, supply chain, and site operations.
  • Experience integrating operational systems with enterprise platforms, data platforms, analytics solutions, and digital products.
  • Proven experience leading complex implementations, releases, process transformations, or system enhancements.
  • Practical knowledge of GxP, CSV/CSA, GAMP 5, data integrity, 21 CFR Part 11, EU GMP Annex 11, audit trails, electronic records, and change control.
  • Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, influencing, and executive presentation skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience with two or more of OMP, SAP, PAS-X, Tulip, LIMS, OneLab, and QC systems
  • Experience in cell therapy, cell and gene therapy, personalized medicine, biologics, sterile manufacturing, or other complex manufacturing environments.
  • Experience with MES, electronic batch records, connected worker technologies, laboratory execution, advanced planning, supply chain optimization, manufacturing intelligence, or operational analytics.
  • Knowledge of OT/IT integration standards such as OPC UA, MQTT, ISA-88, ISA-95, edge connectivity, and event-driven architecture.
  • Agile, Scrum, Product Management, Lean Six Sigma, or related certification.
  • Experience working across global, multi-site organizations and managing technology vendors or systems integrators.

Key Competencies

  • Digital product and portfolio leadership
  • End-to-end business process expertise
  • Enterprise and manufacturing systems thinking
  • Business value and benefits realization
  • Stakeholder influence and cross-functional collaboration
  • Agile delivery, roadmap, and dependency management

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
description:
**Grade UE07: £41,064 to £48,822 per annum, pro rata if part time**

**CSE / School of Mathematics**

**Full time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed term: for 36 months**

**Posts available: 2**

**The Opportunity:**

This project aims to (1) understand the fluid dynamics of small-scale processes in the Arctic Ocean that have the potential to redistribute heat and other tracers between the ocean surface and interior through turbulent mixing, (2) develop parameterisations of these processes for implementation in ocean and climate models, and (3) assess the impact of turbulent mixing on the Arctic Ocean state.

The PDRA(s) on this project will, together with the PI and her collaborators, develop theoretical models (e.g. for linear topographic wave generation), which will be verified against idealised numerical simulations using Oceananigans. Existing oceanic observations will be used throughout to identify the relevant regimes and evaluate results. Parameterisation schemes will be implemented and assessed in a regional Arctic model in collaboration with project partners at the National Oceanography Centre. The specific balance of theoretical and computational work can be tailored to the successful candidate's strengths.

These positions are funded by UKRI to work with Dr Lois Baker on understanding turbulent mixing in a changing Arctic Ocean. As our climate warms, Arctic currents are expected to become more energetic. This could result in more turbulence generation from small-scale processes such as internal waves, and consequently more heat flux from the relatively warm, deep Arctic to the vulnerable surface sea ice. Climate models do not currently represent these processes, which are dynamically different from those elsewhere in the global ocean. The project involves collaboration with partners at the National Oceanography Centre and the Universities of Cambridge, Southampton, and British Columbia.

This post is full-time (35 hours per week); however, we are open to considering part-time or flexible working patterns. We are also open to considering requests for hybrid working (on a non-contractual basis) that combines a mix of remote and regular on-campus working.

title: Senior Java Engineer - Trading Systems
description:
We're hiring multiple Senior Java Engineers for several global clients across crypto trading, digital assets, and traditional financial markets. These roles range from low-latency exchange engineering to automated liquidity strategy development to front-office derivatives systems.

If you're a strong Java engineer interested in high-performance systems, trading, crypto, or front office technology, this is an opportunity to be considered across multiple top-tier teams with one application.

What You'll Work on (Depending on team match)

You may work on one or more of the following depending on your background:

Low Latency systems / Exchange engineering

  • Design and build high-performance microservices and low-latency Java components.

  • Work with quant, risk, and product teams to build robust trading features.

  • Debug, profile, and optimize for throughput, latency, and reliability.

  • Help maintain test automation and code quality across complex distributed systems.

Crypto Liquidity & Strategy Engineering

  • Build automated pricing, execution and liquidity strategies.

  • Work closely with liquidity managers and product teams on strategy development.

  • Improve system stability, scalability, and auto-recovery for 24/7 crypto trading.

  • Own the production environment for strategy systems and infrastructure upgrades.

Front Office Java Engineering (Derivatives/Volatility)

  • Build and enhance volatility calibration, pricing, and marking tools.

  • Work directly with sales, traders, strats and financial engineering.

  • Implement pricing workflows for options, events, and vol surfaces.

  • Contribute to front-office libraries and tools in Java (and occasionally C++).

What We're Looking for:

  • Strong proficiency in Java (Java 11+ or 17+ ideal).

  • Experience with high-performance, low-latency, or trading systems.

  • Solid CS fundamentals data structures, algorithms, concurrency.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to tackle complex technical challenges.

  • STEM degree (Computer Science, Engineering, Math, Physics).

  • Interest in trading, financial markets, or crypto.

  • Strong communication skills ability to work with product, liquidity, quants, or front office depending on team.

Bonus skills (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with order books, matching engines, or high-frequency systems.

  • FX, equities, options, or derivatives knowledge.

  • Exposure to automated execution strategies, algo trading, or liquidity bots.

  • Familiarity with Kafka, Aeron, RabbitMQ, Chronicle Queue.

  • Front-office or quant-adjacent engineering experience.

  • Crypto trading or blockchain exposure.

Job Description Summary

The Global Journey Head, Hire & Move is a senior leader within the People & Organization Products & Experience (HR) organization, with strategic responsibility for the Hire & Move product grouping and the end-to-end employee and manager journeys it enables. The role leads the Product Owners accountable for Talent Attraction, Talent Acquisition, Onboarding, Internal Mobility, Global Mobility, Executive Scouting and External Workforce, ensuring journey coherence, portfolio health, disciplined investment and value realization. The portfolio is focused on attracting and hiring the right talent, integrating new joiners quickly, and enabling movement of employees and external talent across opportunities and locations.


Job Description

#Hybrid


This role can be based in East Hanover (US), London or Basel.

Please apply only once to the appropriate location.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Product Grouping Scope. Accountable for the Hire & Move product grouping, comprising: Talent Attraction; Talent Acquisition; Onboarding; Internal Mobility; Global Mobility; Executive Scouting; External Workforce. The role ensures these products operate as a coherent portfolio and collectively deliver the intended journey outcomes.
  • Leadership Team Contribution. Key and active member of the People Experience Leadership Team, together defining and driving the Novartis People Experience ambition, strategy and enterprise priorities.
  • Journey Strategy, Vision & Coherence. Own the multi-year ambition for the journeys enabled by the product grouping and translate company strategy, workforce priorities and Expertise Hub direction into coherent journey outcomes. Align Product Owners and partners around the best end-to-end result while preserving Product Owner accountability for individual product strategy, roadmap and lifecycle.
  • End User Insight & Business Outcome Definition. Maintain a deep, current and structured understanding of user needs across the portfolio. Sponsor human-centered discovery, use listening and external benchmarks, and define measurable business outcomes that govern portfolio choices.
  • Technology Portfolio Plan & Simplification. Work in partnership with the strategy & innovations team to define and drive the automation, AI and agentification strategy across the journey portfolio. Ensure the optimal balance between digital self-service, intelligent agents, automation and human interaction to improve experience, efficiency, compliance and business outcomes while maintaining appropriate governance and oversight. Define the business outcomes, priorities and value expectations that guide the product grouping technology roadmap with PTDI and DDIT. Identify fragmentation, duplication, technical debt, integration gaps and data constraints and prioritize simplification.
  • Expertise Hub Partnership & Strategic Priority Translation. Act as the primary portfolio relationship owner with relevant Expertise Hubs. Translate functional strategy, policy and standards into coherent portfolio choices and enable Product Owners to evolve products within agreed guardrails.
  • Product Portfolio Strategy, Governance & Lifecycle. Lead the portfolio of Product Owners and own portfolio strategy, composition and health. Establish common product cadences, align roadmaps, arbitrate priorities and recommend investment, acceleration, simplification, consolidation, replacement or retirement.
  • Journey, Portfolio KPI & Financial Value Stewardship. Own the KPI and value-realization framework, portfolio cost and investment view, and cross-product indicators. Make or recommend capacity and financial trade-offs so resources are directed toward the greatest benefit and strategic alignment.
  • Controls Architecture. Ensure every product has appropriate regulatory, policy, data privacy and process controls, that controls are regularly tested, and that material failures are surfaced and addressed.

Essential Criteria:

  • Extensive Senior P&O(HR) leadership background with breadth across domains across P&O, product, experience or technology-enabled transformation, including significant senior-level responsibility in a complex, global organization. Direct experience in more than one P&O domain is desirable; credible exposure through enterprise collaboration and portfolio leadership may provide equivalent breadth. For this product grouping, experience leading or materially shaping parts of the talent acquisition and movement lifecycle, such as talent attraction, recruiting and selection, onboarding, internal mobility, global mobility or external workforce, would be a preference. Experience connecting candidate, employee and manager journeys across organizational and geographic boundaries, improving high-volume and time-sensitive journeys, and delivering measurable outcomes such as quality of hire, hiring speed, candidate experience, time-to-productivity, internal movement or assignment effectiveness would be particularly useful.
  • Experience operating across the Expertise Hub–P&O Workforce Strategy–product boundary. Demonstrated experience navigating the intersection between strategic design and product or operational delivery, and building relationships that enable these communities to work together.
  • Technology strategy and AI orientation at portfolio level. Experience translating journey and product outcomes into technology priorities and investment choices, with sufficient understanding of AI, automation, data and architecture to assess value and risk with technical experts.
  • Product portfolio, financial and governance experience. Experience leading a portfolio of products, programs, workstreams or teams; setting priorities across competing demands; assessing costs and benefits; making resource trade-offs; and holding multiple teams accountable to shared outcomes.
  • Change Leadership & Organizational Influence. Shape how Product Owners work, how Expertise Hub partner and how the business experiences P&O. Build coalitions and communicate change narratives that land at executive level.
  • People Leadership & Team Building. Build and grow exceptional Product Owners, set standards for product craft and create an evidence-based, end-user-focused culture.
  • Senior Stakeholder Influence, CoE Partnership & Product Arbitration. Operate credibly with senior P&O, Expertise Hub, Country People Experience, P&O Business Partner, Finance, PTDI and DDIT leaders, aligning shared outcomes and arbitrating portfolio tensions.

description:
**UE07: £41,064 - £48,822 per annum**

**CMVM / Centre for Clinical Brain Sciences**

**Full-time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed-term: 12 months**

**The Opportunity:**

There is an opportunity to join Mahad lab research team, at the University of Edinburgh, that focuses basic science research on mechanisms of neurodegeneration in multiple sclerosis with a specific interest in mitochondria. Mahad lab has developed a number of animal models to better understand the pathophysiology of progressive MS and identify potentially neuroprotective drugs. The applicant will focus on characterising mitochondrial function and mitochondrial DNA at a single cell level in an animal model with chronic neurodegeneration, in collaboration with Professor Ken Smith based at the University College London. A skill set to assess mitochondrial function and mitochondrial DNA at a single cell level in brain tissue will be highly desirable. The candidate will have the opportunity to interact closely with researches at the Dementia Research Institute, led by Professor Siddharthan Chandran.

The opportunities at the University of Edinburgh will enable the candidate to be part of something bigger.  For early career researchers Edinburgh University offers opportunities where the candidate can flourish and make a real difference.

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
description:
**Grade UE07: £41,064- £ 48,822 per annum**

**School of Biological Sciences/ College of Sciences & Engineering**

**Full Time- 35 hours per week**

**36 months fixed term contract**

**The Opportunity:**

We are looking for a skilled and motivated 3‑year Postdoctoral Research Associate to join a NERC-funded project on adaptive introgression in European butterflies, led by Dr Konrad Lohse and Dr Simon Martin. The PDRA will lead population genomic analyses across two work packages:

- Comparative scans of selective sweeps across 42 butterfly species (21 sister-species pairs) to quantify how often adaptive evolution is fuelled by introgressed variants and to identify their functional targets.
- Analysis of a hybrid zone system, integrating whole‑genome resequencing and long‑read sperm sequencing to find spatial population genomic signals of gene conversion and adaptive introgression.


You will work with chromosome-level reference genomes, large WGS datasets and high‑performance computing, and collaborate closely with an RA responsible for lab work. The role includes opportunities for fieldwork in France, work with collaborators in Spain and Czech Republic, presenting at international conferences, and supervising project students.

You will join Konrad Lohse’s lab in the dynamic Institute of Ecology and Evolution, University of Edinburgh, as part of a project funded by the Natural Environmental Research Council (NERC). Applicants must have a PhD (or to be completed in 3 months) in evolutionary/population genomics or a related field, strong skills in Python/R, computational genomics and statistics, and enthusiasm for working with large genomic datasets. The post requires creativity in problem solving, and strong communication and organisational skills. An understanding of inference methods for detecting introgression and selective sweeps is desirable. Questions should be directed to konrad.lohse [@ed.ac.uk](mailto:Susan.Johnston@ed.ac.uk)

You’ll play a key role in delivering on-time, high-quality, and affordable solutions while helping to drive business growth and operational excellence. This position is located in Rochester, NY [L3Harris in New York](https://careers.l3harris.com/en/new-york).

This is more than a subcontract management role — it’s an opportunity to influence critical business outcomes, lead complex negotiations, and shape supplier strategies that directly impact program success. You’ll work with cross-functional teams, engage with key partners, and help deliver solutions that matter. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to make a visible impact across programs and partnerships, this role offers the opportunity to do just that.

• Develop acquisition requirements, Statements of Work, Requests for Proposals, evaluation criteria, and source selection strategies

• Communicate effectively with a wide array of professional levels and functions, including Engineering, Contracts, Finance, Legal, Operations, and Business Development

• Manage program budgets and explain variances in monthly performance

• Support small business initiatives

• Generate spending plans, payment forecasts, and variance reports

• Follow strategic direction set by Program and functional leadership

• Bachelor’s Degree and a minimum of 6 years of prior relevant experience; Or, Graduate Degree and a minimum of 4 years of prior related experience; Or, in lieu of a degree, a minimum of 10 years of prior related experience

• 4 years of experience in subcontracts management or procurement

• Previous work experience in a fast-paced, continuous-change integration environment

• Knowledge of and experience with DFARS, MMAS, SOX, and CAS requirements, as well as ITAR and EAR regulations

• Proficiency in Microsoft Suite of Products

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Law, or Business preferred

• Experience in negotiating complex terms and conditions

• Experience in government and commercial contracting/subcontracting managing supplier performance in the areas of technical scope, schedule, cost, and risk mitigation

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Experience as Cost Account Manager for subcontracts managing budgets and sales forecasting

title: Learning Professional (ASML Prioritized Initiatives)
description:
Introduction to the job

ASML is the world's leading supplier of lithography systems for the semiconductor industry. Across our global manufacturing network, thousands of employees contribute every day to building some of the most advanced machines in the world. To remain successful, ASML continuously evolves its processes, systems, and ways of working.


Many of these changes are driven by large-scale improvement programs that impact multiple sectors, factories, and employee groups worldwide. Within ASML, these initiatives are referred to as APIs (ASML Prioritized Initiatives): strategic transformation programs that help ASML prepare for future growth, scalability, standardization, and operational excellence.


While these initiatives create business value, successful implementation ultimately depends on people. Employees need to understand what is changing, why it is changing, and how they can successfully perform in the new situation. This is particularly important within Manufacturing, where global standards must often be translated into local factory realities, different organizational structures, and diverse target audiences.


This is where the Manufacturing Academy plays a key role.

Within the Manufacturing API Learning team, we help Manufacturing employees successfully navigate complex business transformations by translating change into effective learning, knowledge, and performance enablement solutions. We partner with global programs, Business Process Improvement (BPI), Manufacturing Change Management, Business Learning teams, factory stakeholders, subject matter experts, and end users to ensure people remain capable, confident, and productive throughout change.


To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Learning Professional (APIs) who thrives in complexity, enjoys creating structure in ambiguity, and is passionate about helping people perform successfully in changing environments.


Role and responsibilities

As our new API Learning Professional, you will operate at the intersection of learning, change enablement, business transformation, and manufacturing operations.


You will work closely with stakeholders across Manufacturing, BPI, Change Management, Learning organizations, and strategic programs to ensure employees are prepared for upcoming changes and can continue to perform successfully before, during, and after implementation.


In this role, you will work on:

  • Analyzing and understanding impact
    • Conduct performance and learning analyses for large-scale transformation initiatives.
    • Identify the impact of process, system, and organizational changes on Manufacturing employees.
    • Determine when training is needed and when alternative performance support interventions are more appropriate.
    • undefined

  • Designing learning and enablement approaches
    • Design learning, knowledge, and performance support solutions that help employees navigate change effectively using evidence-based methodologies to create.

In this role, you support:

  • Navigating complex stakeholder environments
    • Act as a trusted advisor to programs, business stakeholders, and learning partners by aligning diverse perspectives and competing priorities
    • Represent the Manufacturing perspective in strategic discussions and decision-making.
    • Influence without formal authority while maintaining strong relationships across the ecosystem.

  • Creating structure in complexity
    • Establish practical approaches, frameworks, templates, and working methods in situations where the path forward is not yet fully defined.
    • Provide input to the Learning Business Partner and Project Lead to create governance, planning, tracking, and reporting activities where needed.
    • Contribute to continuous improvement of the API Learning team's ways of working.

  • Ensuring business continuity
    • Help Manufacturing organizations successfully adopt new ways of working with minimal disruption.
    • Enable employees to remain productive and effective throughout transformation journeys.
    • Contribute to scalable and sustainable learning solutions that can be leveraged across factories and future initiatives.

What you bring

We are looking for someone who combines Learning expertise with business acumen, stakeholder influence, and the ability to operate effectively in dynamic environments.


Education and experience

Bachelor's or master's degree in Educational Sciences, Learning Sciences, Change Management, Instructional Design, Organizational Learning, Educational & Organizational Psychology, or related discipline.


Task Experience

  • Experience conducting learning needs analyses and performance analyses.
  • Experience designing and developing learning solutions and performance support solutions.
  • Experience translating business requirements into practical learner-centered solutions.

Organizational Experience

  • Experience operating in complex stakeholder environments and matrix organizations.
  • Experience supporting large-scale business transformation, process optimization, change enablement, or digital transformation initiatives.

Skills and capabilities

  • Strong stakeholder management and consulting skills.
  • Excellent communication and facilitation skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to influence without formal authority.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and make informed decisions despite incomplete information.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with pragmatic execution.
  • Digital curiosity and affinity with technology-enabled learning solutions.
  • Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools within daily work.

You will thrive if you:

  • Enjoy solving time-sensitive complex challenges.
  • Feel comfortable operating in rapidly changing environments.
  • Can make progress when not all answers are available.
  • Are able to create structure where none exists.
  • Can balance competing stakeholder expectations.
  • Remain pragmatic when priorities shift.
  • Enjoy collaborating in a highly autonomous and self-driven team environment.
  • Have a genuine interest in helping people perform successfully through change.

Nice to have

The following experience would be considered an advantage:


  • Knowledge of ASML Manufacturing and factory operations.
  • Experience working within Digital Transformation, or Process Excellence initiatives.
  • Experience with Change Management practices and business adoption strategies.
  • Experience with performance support and workflow learning solutions such as the 5 Moments of Need® methodology.Experience with 4C/ID (Four Component Instructional Design) methodology.
  • Experience with 12 Levers of Transfer Effectiveness®.
  • Experience with learning evaluation and business impact measurement (ROI, Philips, Kirkpatrick).
  • Experience with Articulate Storyline, Synthesia, or similar learning technologies.
  • Experience using Copilot and other AI-enabled tools for analysis, design, and development activities.

Interested?

Do you enjoy turning complexity into clarity? Do you like working at the intersection of business transformation, learning, and human performance? Are you energized by helping Manufacturing employees succeed through change?


Then we would love to meet you.


Join the API Learning team and help shape how ASML enables its global Manufacturing workforce for the next generation of business transformation.


Ready to make change work for people, not just processes? Apply now and help us build the future of learning and performance at ASML.

Inclusion and diversity

ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

title: Product Manager Essentials
description:
The Job

The Product Management department oversees the end-to-end product process, ensuring the full collection is delivered on time. As Product Manager, you align the collection with market needs and the stichd strategy by connecting internal processes and creative teams. You act as the central coordinator across Product Development, Product Design, Operations, Marketing, and Sales.

Working with a brand focus across several product groups, you translate product needs for different distribution channels and manage key account requests.

Your Mission

• Execute and manage the product process from clear briefs to range launch;

• Create a lineplan and planning and translate this effectively into a clear product briefing for the creative team and coordinate the tasks and responsibilities of the teams;

• Develop short- and long-term collection strategies, tactical product executions and innovations that position our brands as the leaders in the assigned categories;

• Prepare market- and competitor studies on an international level as well as analyzing forecasts and sales data;

• Cooperate with design, development, and sales to ensure final collections reflect market needs;

• Collaborate with stakeholders and drive the product creation process based on the Go-to-Market calendar milestones;

• Understand sales, margin, and merchandising requirements to deliver market / account fitting product concepts;

• Meet category financial targets as set by the organization;

• Manage, maintain, and distribute all information of assigned product lines. Ensuring correct and on time input in PLM (Product Lifecycle Management) and ERP system;

• Present product lines to internal and external teams in a comprehensive, clear, tactical manner.

Your Talent

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Fashion Management, or a related field;

• At least four years of product management experience, preferably in sports lifestyle, sporting goods, or an international organization working with global brands;

• Strong knowledge of the lifestyle, fashion, and/or sporting goods markets, with a sharp commercial mindset and a solid understanding of sales drivers, retail dynamics, and competitor activity;

• Experience in close-to-body product categories is preferred;

• Flexible and open-minded team player with strong organizational, analytical, and prioritization skills;

• Clear and confident communicator with excellent written and spoken English;

• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.


This role is based in Den Bosch, the Netherlands. Working remotely from other countries is not possible.

To apply for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in the Netherlands. We will not apply for work or residence permits.



We Offer



• Our salaries are based on 38 hours per week, but full-time work is 40 hours per week. Instead, you choose between a lot of holidays; 40 per year ór choose for a 40-hour salary per month with still 28 holidays. You can switch every six months;

• Annual bonus scheme;

• New hires (introduction) days;

• Great offer of e-learnings and a training offer for personal development;

• Enough free fruit for you daily vitamins;

• Provided lunch at a low cost;

• Choose between lease-bike, NS Business Card or travel by car for € 0,25 per km (>10km).

• 8% holiday allowance, employee insurances and a good pension scheme;

• Employee discount on the PUMA, Levi’s, Fuelforfans and BMW Lifestyle websites;

• Hybrid working: On full-time basis 3 days in the office and 2 days at home (incl. allowance for home working);

• Flexible working hours, modern workspace and a good working atmosphere;

• International working environment with colleagues of more than 50 different nationalities;

• Wellbeing activities (f.e. yoga, pilates and bootcamp) and an inhouse gym;

• Community involvement (STICHD impact tool);

• STICHD drinks 5/6x per year in the city center of Den Bosch;

• Work hard, play hard. Our STICHD-events are legendary.



About Us



We like to think of ourselves as a family of experts.


Ok, we know what you’re thinking: at over 700 members, that’s a pretty big family. But what we really mean is that, whatever our skills or our story, whatever the task or the time pressure, we’re in it together. Pushing each other, backing each other and believing in each other, always.


We’re one STICHD. And that matters, because this one company does a lot.


We partner with some of the world’s most iconic brands to create products that people love. From socks and underwear to swim and fanwear. From PUMA and Levi’s to Formula 1 and Manchester City. From design and logistics to retail and events. From our HQ in the Netherlands to sales offices and logistics centres all over the world. Like we said: a lot.


Why join us?

Because at STICHD, you get the best of both worlds. The buzz and exposure of working on a global scale with the world’s biggest brands. The freedom and flexibility to find your own passion and follow your own path. But most of all, because we care. We really care. About our brands and products. About each package and every fan’s experience. About one another.


We have some amazing people at STICHD. People with different backgrounds and skillsets, perspectives and personalities. Global leaders in their field who always stay curious, grounded and never stop learning.


Does this sound like it could be you? Click ‘apply’ and show us what you’ve got!


AQCUISITION AS A RESULT OF VACANIES IS NOT APPRECIATED


STICHD provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, colour, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at STICHD and PUMA, and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.


At STICHD and PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity - no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people -with real judgment and accountability. title: Quantitative Developer - Python/Django (LATAM)
description:
Quantitative Developer — Job Description

Role Definition

Reports To: Financial Engineering Manager
Seniority: Senior
Location: Open to candidates in LatAm, working EST hours

Owns scoring integrity end to end — implementation, validation harness, and production debugging — work currently handled ad hoc by the Principal Engineer.

What You'll Do

  • Build and maintain the production Python that computes PRISM and related risk scores — turning methodology into code that runs correctly and at scale
  • Build and maintain the reference-set harness that validates every model or classification change in CI
  • Diagnose scoring failures in production — distinguish code, data, and methodology issues — and fix the underlying class of bug, not just the instance
  • Rule on straightforward classification questions; escalate genuinely hard calls (structured products, buffered ETFs, private assets)
  • Estimate blast radius and maintain a tested rollback for every model or classification change before it ships
  • Keep the scoring path performant as portfolio and security volume grows

Skills & Requirements

Technical

  • Production Python you've shipped and maintained — not a prototype or notebook
  • Django — models, migrations, tests, CI, code review, to the same standard as any other engineering seat
  • SQL and data work at scale — pandas, numpy, portfolio-sized datasets
  • Testing & validation engineering — reference-set/golden-data harnesses wired into CI, not just unit tests
  • Large-scale systems, data pipelines, or automated systems (trading systems, scrapers, data adapters)

Domain

  • US market structure and asset classification — equities, fixed income, funds, ETFs, annuities, structured products, cash equivalents, private assets
  • Risk modeling and scoring fundamentals — volatility, correlation, concentration, tail measures
  • Hands-on options, structured products, or derivatives experience is a plus
  • Tax-aware analytics (after-tax return, cost basis, loss harvesting) is a plus — this would be built here, not maintained

Important Notes

  • Not a fit for someone whose experience is primarily research-grade quantitative code, notebooks, or prototypes — we need production software taken from development through deployment and maintenance
  • Looking for consistent employment history — 18+ month tenures in previous roles, demonstrating stability and long-term ownership
  • Work at the intersection of software engineering, quantitative finance, and fintech
  • Long-term opportunity to contribute to production systems used in real financial workflows

First 90 Days

  • Weeks 1–2 — take one live PRISM defect end to end and establish whether the cause is code, data or methodology
  • Weeks 3–6 — build the reference-set harness and wire it into CI as non-blocking
  • Weeks 7–12 — make it a required check, and take scoring incidents off the Principal Engineer

Interview Process

  1. Async Loom Screen — first-round async screen.
  2. Screening Interview — short live call: basic fit, motivation, communication, and logistics.
  3. Who Interview — chronological career walkthrough: for each role, what you were hired to do, what you're proudest of, the low points, who you worked with and what they'd say, and why you left.
  4. Focused / Technical Interview — deep-dive on the competencies for this seat, built around two role-specific exercises.
  5. Reference Interviews — calls with former managers and colleagues to verify track record, technical ability, and working style.

title: Senior Project Manager,  eDiscovery Cyber Services
description:
Job Description

At Norton Rose Fulbright, people thrive because of a shared commitment to quality, unity and integrity. The highly regarded law firm consistently receives recognition from Great Place to Work and Top Workplaces, two companies that specialize in assessing organizational culture. Teams collaborate across regions, value new ideas and deliver meaningful client solutions, supported by a culture that embraces ambition, development and shared success. With more than 3,000 lawyers and 3,000 business services professionals working together across 50 offices worldwide, this global law firm provides a full range of legal services to leading corporations and financial institutions operating in key markets and sectors.

As an early adopter of advanced eDiscovery technology and methodologies, the Firm's Global eDiscovery Services Department provides strategic services to our disputes lawyers and clients. Working alongside other talented professionals, you'll be surrounded by an open and collaborative culture that embraces recognition and professional development.


The Sr. Project Manager, eDiscovery Cyber Services leads eDiscovery and data analysis workstreams for complex cyber incident response (CIR) matters, from initial data assessment through review, extraction, normalization, entity resolution, notification and reporting. Partnering with the firm's Cybersecurity practice, clients, forensic providers, review providers and other third parties, the role manages scope, cost, risk, quality and delivery while developing defensible, efficient strategies that make effective use of technology.


Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Lead eDiscovery and data analysis strategies for complex CIR matters, including file listing analysis, data assessment, identification of sensitive data, defensible reduction, review, extraction, normalization, entity resolution, notification and reporting.
  • Serve as the senior eDiscovery/CIR advisor and primary point of contact for assigned matters, translating technical and data issues into practical strategies, risks, options and recommendations for legal teams, clients and stakeholders.
  • Design, validate and document defensible methodologies for data reduction, identification of sensitive data, search term calibration, statistical sampling, analytics and other technology assisted workflows.
  • Coordinate with forensic providers, clients, legal teams, vendors and review teams on secure data assessment, transfer, workflow design, quality control, productivity, budgets, timelines and deliverables.
  • Develop and manage matter budgets, forecasts, work plans, resource needs, metrics and customized reporting; monitor scope, costs and vendor spend and proactively identify variances.
  • Oversee extraction, normalization, entity resolution, deduplication, address validation and development of notification lists, including analysis of anomalies, near duplicates and matching issues using SQL, advanced Excel, scripts, queries or other data transformation techniques as appropriate.
  • Support legal teams and clients in interpreting data findings, methodologies, metrics, notification populations and responses to client or regulatory inquiries.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex project, technology and vendor issues while maintaining active ownership of complex matters and delegating effectively.

Leadership and professional development

  • Mentor and develop Project Managers, Project Analysts and other team members through coaching, knowledge sharing and guidance on active matters.
  • Help shape the department’s Cyber eDiscovery service model, standards, playbooks and process improvement initiatives.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies and analytics approaches that may improve quality, efficiency, defensibility or client outcomes.
  • Expand consulting, client service and leadership capabilities through increasingly complex matters and initiatives that span multiple practice and business functions.

Other duties

Please note this job description does not cover or contain all activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

This position is remote and can therefore be located in any city where we have a US office. Flexibility to visit the office for training or meetings is required.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required.
  • Minimum of five years of progressively responsible experience in eDiscovery, litigation support, legal technology or related consulting, including significant project management responsibility, and at least one year managing or substantially leading matters involving cyber incident response, data breaches or sensitive data review.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex matters with large data volumes; advise attorneys, clients and senior stakeholders on strategy, workflow, risk, cost and technology; and lead multidisciplinary teams, outside providers and escalations.
  • Advanced Excel skills required, including XLOOKUP, INDEX/MATCH, Power Query and Power Pivot/DAX; experience analyzing, formatting and reporting on large structured and semistructured datasets.

description:
Memory Care Director

Pay Range: $76,000 - $80,000

Ivy Park at Escondido is a premier senior living community situated on a beautifully landscaped campus. Managed by Oakmont Management Group, we provide exceptional quality, comfort, and care with five-star services and amenities. Residents enjoy a rewarding lifestyle with individualized comprehensive support that promotes continuing independence. We deliver meaningful lifestyles and relationships with residents, families, and team members by developing a winning culture and living these values: Authenticity * Teamwork * Compassion * Commitment * Resilience.

With communities across California, Colorado, Hawaii, and Nevada, opportunities for career growth, relocation, and travel are significant. In addition, eligible team members may enjoy the following benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits
  • Vacation, Personal Day, Sick Pay, Holidays
  • Complimentary Meals
  • Bonus Opportunities
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Team Member Discount Program (LifeMart)
  • 401(k) Savings Plan with Company Match
  • Recognition Programs
  • Student Loan Refinancing
  • Pet Insurance
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Emergency Financial Assistance

The Memory Care Director at Oakmont leads a ‘Whole living’ approach to dementia care in their community, which is the philosophy of partnering with the resident to care ‘with them’ rather than ‘for them in order to encourage each resident to reach their highest potential physically, cognitively, socially, emotionally and spiritually, ensuring maximized independence by creating an engaging and dignified environment that enhances the residents’ ability to be themselves and live their most fulfilling life.

The Memory Care Director is responsible for general oversight of all aspects of the Traditions (Memory Care) neighborhood in their community, ensuring that the delivery of dementia care services including the delivery of care, delivery of activities, and delivery of culinary, exceed the resident and family expectations and meet the required services outlined in the residents’ service plan. The memory care director offers dementia expertise and dementia care resources in collaboration with community leaders in culinary, activities, and health services to develop and execute a personalized care plan to best maintain the overall health and well-being of the residents.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintains a safe and secure environment for all team members, residents, and guests, following established safety standards.
  • Understands and ensures compliance with all state (Title 22) regulations concerning the memory care department.
  • Maintains recruiting of all memory care positions. Conducts interviews, hires, onboards, trains, motivates, and retains team members.
  • Coordinates departmental schedule to ensure adequate staffing in accordance with company standards, policies and procedures, and the needs of the residents.
  • Communicates effectively and displays tact and friendliness when dealing with residents, families, visitors, co-workers, and supervisors.
  • Supports resident participation in activities. Ensures an engaging and dynamic activities program is executed daily.
  • Supports resident participation in dining and collaborates with the Culinary team to ensure resident nutrition needs are met and the quality of the culinary experience remains positive.
  • Provides input to Health Services Director regarding Memory Care resident pre-admission assessments and reassessments.
  • Assists the Health Services Director in coordinating incidental medical, dental, vision, hearing, and podiatry care for residents and arrange resident escorts as needed.
  • Partners with community healthcare professionals, including physicians, discharge planners, nurses, and state agencies on the care needs of residents as needed.

Qualifications:

  • Must be eighteen (18) years of age
  • Prefer two (2) years of experience working with persons with dementia
  • Prefer one (1) year of experience supervising and managing employees
  • Preferred BA/S in Gerontology, psychology, sociology, or related field or at least 3 years working in social services, residential care, psychiatric facility, or related setting.
  • A Residential Care Facility for the Elderly administrators’ license may be required.
  • Hold or able to obtain one or more certifications related to Dementia care; such as Certified Dementia Practitioner (CDP), Certified Alzheimer’s Caregiver (CAC), Certified Alzheimer’s Educator (CAE), Certified Dementia Care Manager (CDCM), Certified Montessori Dementia Care Professional and/or other equivalents.
  • Able to obtain and maintain valid first aid and CPR certification
  • Able to obtain and maintain a valid Food Handler’s certification
  • Must pass a Criminal Background check and Health Screening tests, including physical and TB Tests.
  • For the health and safety of our team members and residents, Oakmont Management Group may require team members to vaccinate, participate in daily screening, surveillance testing, and to wear face coverings and other personal protective equipment (PPE) to prevent the spread of the COVID-19 or other communicable diseases, per regulatory guidelines.

Oakmont Management Group, based in Irvine, California, is a recognized leader in the senior living industry that manages a portfolio of communities under the Oakmont Senior Living and Ivy Living brands. OMG serves thousands of seniors across communities in California, Nevada, and Hawaii. At OMG, we strive to create an atmosphere of family and community among team members, residents, and resident family members. We know that caring and meaningful relationships are the foundation of a rewarding life, and our team is hand-selected for their skills, previous experience, and passion for working with the elderly. Our practice is to incorporate joy and laughter alongside our expectations of excellence. Walk into our communities and feel our pride of ownership and commitment to service.

title: Controller
description:
About Portless

Portless helps fast-growing direct-to-consumer brands ship orders from our fulfillment centers in China straight to their customers in North America, the UK and beyond. Brands no longer have to import and warehouse inventory in every market, which frees up cash and cuts costs.

We run the whole chain: fulfillment, freight, customs clearance and last-mile delivery, tied together by our own software and AI. Our merchants are mid-market brands in apparel, beauty, electronics and home goods.

We are venture-backed and on track to double revenue in 2026. Our team works across North America, China and beyond.

You will own Portless's books end to end: the monthly close across our entities in North America and Asia, merchant billing and collections, cash, and our first external audit. You will lead our accounting team, most of whom are based in China, and build the processes and controls that let us keep growing fast.

This is a hands-on role. You will be in the reconciliations yourself before you hand them off, and you will have real ownership from day one.

What you'll own

Month-end close. Own the close calendar across all entities, including consolidation, intercompany and FX, and get it done faster each month.

Billing and order-to-cash. Make sure every merchant is billed correctly and on time. That includes rate-card changes, credit notes and waivers with clear approvals, duties, VAT and tariffs billed back accurately, and cash applied across Stripe and our other payment channels.

AR and collections. Keep AR reconciled to the bank and payment processors, set our bad-debt reserve policy, and run collections with our billing team.

Cash. Own the daily cash position and a 13-week forecast tied to the bank, plus payment runs and approvals.

Audit and diligence. Select and lead our first external audit, prepare the books for investor and lender diligence, and own monthly lender reporting.

Tax and compliance. Coordinate outside advisors on Canadian, US and Chinese filings, sales tax and VAT, and transfer pricing.

Systems and controls. Tighten our stack (QuickBooks Online, Stripe, Bill.com, Ramp), document how things get done, and decide when we need an ERP.

Team. Lead and develop the accounting team, give every process a clear owner, and work closely with our data and engineering teams on billing data.

What success looks like in your first year

Outcome

By

90 days

You own the daily cash position and monthly lender reporting, and the whole team works from one close calendar.

6 months

Every entity closes by business day 10, and every rate-card change, credit note and waiver has an approval trail.

12 months

Our first external audit is complete. AR ties to the bank and payment processors every month, and duties and VAT billed match what we paid. The team runs on documented processes.

What you bring

CPA, CA or an equivalent designation.

8+ years in accounting, including at least 3 as a controller or assistant controller who owned the close.

A start in audit at a Big 4 or mid-tier public accounting firm.

You have owned a multi-entity, multi-currency close, including consolidation and intercompany.

You have run billing and collections at a high-volume business that bills per order, per transaction or on usage.

You have taken a company through a first audit or an audit-readiness cleanup, working directly with the auditors.

You have led a team, including people in another country.
You are comfortable with a lean stack and AI tools, and you keep your work auditable. Clear, direct written English.

Nice to have

Mandarin. Most of our accounting team is in China, so this is a big plus.

Experience in logistics, 3PL, freight forwarding, customs brokerage or cross-border e- commerce.

Accounting for duties, VAT and tariffs paid on behalf of customers, and for transfer pricing.

Financial due diligence or transaction services experience. An ERP implementation or migration, such as NetSuite.

How you work

You can't let a number go until it ties.

You stay calm and factual when things move fast.

You hold the line on controls, even when someone senior is asking for an exception.

You fix the biggest problems first instead of redesigning everything at once.

You are hands-on and low ego, and you'll do the reconciliations yourself until the team can.

You raise bad news early and say "I don't know" when you don't.

You manage across time zones and cultures with patience and clear writing.

Location and hours

This role is global and remote. What matters is overlap, not where you live: part of your working day must overlap with Eastern Time, where our merchants, auditors and lenders are, and part with China time, where most of the accounting team works.

For example, someone in Europe or the Middle East covers both in a normal day. Someone in Toronto or New York would add a short evening call with the China team, and someone in Asia an evening call with North America. Expect occasional travel to meet the team in person.

What we offer

A senior role with real ownership, reporting directly to a co-founder.
The chance to build the finance function of a company that is doubling revenue. Competitive base salary, performance bonus and equity.
Remote work on a global team, with flexible hours around the overlap windows.

Portless is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Lead Data Governance Architect (Remote, US)
description:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen is seeking a strategic and technically adept Senior Lead Data Governance Architect to lead delivery of its data governance technology program. The role sits on Lumen's Telemetry, Observability & Technology team within the Office of the Chief Data Officer. That team does three things:

  • Assesses new data tools and platforms before the organization adopts them.
  • Develops platform governance standards with Data Engineering and the Data & Analytics Center of Excellence.
  • Implements and manages the telemetry, observability, and enforcement tooling that measures and protects Lumen's data.

As the senior individual contributor delivery lead, this person turns governance tooling strategy into concrete implementation plans and owns their execution. They also manage two Senior Data Governance Architects. The Principal Data Governance Architect sets the architectural guardrails, and this role builds the implementation engine within them. The ideal candidate combines hands-on depth in catalog, data quality, and access-control tooling with the leadership to deliver across a complex, multi-platform data estate.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Governance Catalog Implementation: Lead the full implementation of the enterprise governance catalog (Informatica Cloud Data Governance & Catalog). This covers scanner configuration, taxonomy design, glossary seeding, and lineage mapping across legacy systems and modern platforms (for example, the enterprise data warehouse, Databricks, and Palantir Foundry), with consistency, auditability, and scalability as the goals.
  • Implementation Patterns & Technical Leadership: Define the implementation patterns that the Senior Data Governance Architects apply to their platform clusters. Be their main point of technical escalation. Mentor and develop team members in governance engineering best practices.
  • Observability & Data Quality Tooling: Own the rollout of observability tooling (Validio, Informatica Cloud Data Access Management, or equivalent). This includes designing the data quality rule framework, setting monitoring thresholds, and configuring alerts.
  • Technology Assessment: Lead technical assessment work alongside the Director, Data Governance Technology. Build evaluation environments, run capability tests, and produce technical findings for new data tools and platforms.
  • Identity & Access Integration: Coordinate SailPoint integration design with the Information Security Office. Write the identity-to-governance mapping specifications that the Senior Lead Data Governance Engineer implements.
  • Phased Delivery Leadership: Act as primary delivery lead for the governance technology roadmap. The sequence runs Unity Catalog connectivity first, then catalog scanning and data characterization, then birthright identity and policy enforcement.
  • Automation & Workflow Engineering: Design and build automated metadata ingestion, data quality rule deployment, and alert-driven workflows that cut manual processing and make governance tooling faster and more reliable. Use scripting (Python, SQL) alongside platform-native automation.
  • Technical Stakeholder Engagement: Work with Data Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, and Information Security so that governance tooling is built into platforms from the start rather than added later, and so that implementation is consistent across workspaces.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or governance tooling implementation, with at least 3 years in a senior or lead role.
  • Hands-on implementation experience with Informatica CDGC or a comparable enterprise catalog, meaning delivery and not only evaluation.
  • Experience implementing Databricks Unity Catalog, including catalog hierarchies, role-based access control, and data product registration.
  • Experience leading technical delivery for a small team of individual contributors in a complex, multi-platform environment.
  • Experience with data quality tooling (Validio, Great Expectations, Soda, or equivalent).
  • Proficiency in SQL and Python, with hands-on experience building automated workflows, scheduled pipelines, and data transformation scripts.

Preferred Skills

  • Familiarity with identity and access management integration (SailPoint or equivalent).
  • Familiarity with Palantir Foundry and ontology-driven data modeling.
  • Microsoft Purview experience for governing unstructured content and Microsoft 365 data.
  • Experience with audit preparation and producing control evidence in regulated environments (CMMC, FedRAMP, or SOX).
  • Understanding of telecom product structures and service definitions.
  • Comfort working across the full governance technology stack, from platform configuration to executive-facing findings, without needing handoffs between teams.

Compensation

title: Senior Systems Developer
description:
Work Schedule

Third Shift (Nights)

Job Description

Position Summary

The Senior Systems Developer / Developer III serves as the senior technical lead for the Clarity PPM platform and provides L3 technical support, complex development, configuration, integration, troubleshooting, upgrades, patching, release support, and technical solution design. The role acts as the primary internal Clarity technical SME and is responsible for resolving complex production issues, guiding technical standards, coordinating with product and infrastructure vendors, and developing broader technical capability across the support team.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide senior-level L3 technical support for Clarity PPM.
  • Own complex incidents and technical problems through resolution.
  • Perform detailed analysis and resolution of issues involving functional configuration, custom code, application data, reports, interfaces, integrations, and workflows.
  • Lead root-cause analysis for recurring, critical, or technically complex production issues.
  • Design, develop, configure, test, and deploy Clarity enhancements and technical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain GEL scripts, NSQL queries, SQL, XOG integrations, REST APIs, XML integrations, reports, portlets, workflows, and related technical components.
  • Translate functional requirements into detailed technical specifications and solution designs.
  • Review technical designs and development deliverables produced by other team members.
  • Support Clarity application services, batch processes, scheduled jobs, interfaces, and automated file transfers.
  • Troubleshoot failed batch jobs, integrations, data issues, and application processes.
  • Lead technical activities associated with Clarity upgrades, patches, hot fixes, and platform changes.
  • Coordinate with Broadcom for product-level issues, patches, defects, and vendor-supported fixes.
  • Support investigation of application-server and database-related issues from the application perspective and coordinate with infrastructure or DBA teams when resolution falls outside the Clarity support scope.
  • Support proactive application performance analysis and recommend preventative or corrective actions.
  • Participate in application monitoring and capacity-related technical analysis.
  • Lead or support technical testing, unit testing, integration testing, defect resolution, and production validation.
  • Support UAT and production deployment activities.
  • Maintain deployment instructions, technical evidence, rollback plans, validation results, and change records.
  • Ensure production changes are implemented in accordance with SOX controls, segregation-of-duties requirements, security standards, and approved change processes.
  • Support SOX audits, evidence requests, technical control testing, and remediation activities.
  • Maintain technical runbooks, system diagrams, Known Error Database entries, troubleshooting procedures, and support documentation.
  • Participate in structured knowledge transfer from the incumbent managed service provider.
  • Cross-train Developer II and Junior Application Administrators.
  • Support Disaster Recovery planning, application restoration procedures, mock DR exercises, and recovery validation.
  • Participate in the team's 16x5 operational support model.
  • Participate in the P1/P2 on-call rotation.
  • Lead or support planned weekend upgrades, patches, releases, deployments, and maintenance activities.
  • Act as technical escalation point when production issues require advanced analysis.

Required Qualifications

  • Advanced Degree plus 3 years of experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 5 years of professional software development experience
  • Preferred Fields of Study: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related technical field
  • Significant experience developing and supporting enterprise business applications.
  • Strong experience with production troubleshooting, application development, configuration, integrations, and technical support.
  • Strong SQL and relational database skills.
  • Experience with application upgrades, patches, releases, and production deployments.
  • Experience performing root-cause analysis and resolving complex production issues.
  • Experience operating within controlled change-management and audit environments.
  • Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills.
  • Ability to support extended-hours operations, weekend maintenance, and on-call responsibilities.

Required Clarity PPM Skills and Experience

  • Advanced hands-on Clarity PPM technical development, configuration, administration, and L3 production support experience.
  • Advanced proficiency with GEL scripting, NSQL, and SQL for complex development, data analysis, troubleshooting, and production support.
  • Strong proficiency with XOG, REST APIs, XML, web services, and enterprise application integrations.
  • Advanced experience developing and supporting Clarity custom content, including reports, portlets, workflows, processes, views, and customer-specific functionality.
  • Advanced experience troubleshooting Clarity production issues involving application configuration, integrations, batch jobs, data, performance, and custom code.
  • Strong working knowledge of Oracle and/or SQL Server and the ability to perform application-level database analysis without assuming DBA ownership.
  • Working knowledge of Linux and Apache Tomcat sufficient to diagnose application-layer issues and coordinate with infrastructure or middleware teams.
  • Advanced experience leading Clarity upgrades, patches, hot fixes, production deployments, rollback planning, and post-deployment validation.
  • Experience coordinating product-level defects, patches, and technical escalations with Broadcom.
  • Experience supporting Clarity in a SOX-controlled environment, including controlled changes, segregation of duties, audit evidence, and production access requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor developers and administrators and transfer Clarity technical knowledge across a support team.

Technical / Functional Skills

  • Clarity PPM
  • GEL scripting
  • NSQL
  • SQL
  • SQL Server and/or Oracle
  • XOG
  • REST APIs
  • XML
  • Web services

  • Application integrations

  • SOX technical controls
  • Audit evidence and technical control documentation

  • Stability and reliability of the Clarity platform
  • Quality and maintainability of technical solutions
  • Successful upgrades, patches, and releases
  • Reduction in repeat incidents
  • Reduction in vendor technical dependency
  • Complete and current technical documentation

title: Program manager (LATAM)
description:
Type: Full-time contractor (hours negotiable)

Location: Remote, based in Central or South America (Americas time zones)

Language Requirements: Spanish fluency required

Reports to: Head of Growth

OpenFn is the digital public good for public service automation & AI orchestration. Our platform automates data exchange and digital workflows so that governments and NGOs can deliver public services more efficiently, achieve interoperability across fragmented systems, and scale critical public services across health, humanitarian, and government programs.

Our team, Open Function Group, the primary steward of this open-source platform, is a lean, fully-remote team of integration specialists, solution architects, and implementation consultants working across 40+ countries.

We are not making marginal improvements to already comfortable lives. We are building the infrastructure that allows governments to function, clinics to operate, and vulnerable populations to access services they depend on.

The role

We need a remote, relationship-driven, commercially-minded Program Manager who is technically fluent, someone who can speak credibly about our platform, integrations, and data workflows with technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, to keep our existing customers happy, engaged, and growing, and to help us stand up program management as a function for the very first time.

We are hiring our first Program Manager to own and grow relationships with OpenFn's existing customers as we transition to a subscription model built around packaged product-and-services bundles.

As our first Program Manager in this market, you will own the full portfolio of existing subscription customers and be accountable for their retention, satisfaction, and growth. You will be the trusted advisor customers turn to, the person who makes sure they are getting real value from OpenFn, and the internal owner of the commercial health of each account.

OpenFn is a technical product: our customers use it to build integrations, move data between systems, and automate complex digital workflows. You do not need to be an engineer, and you will not be doing hands-on implementation work; we have solution architects and implementation consultants for that. But you do need to be technically fluent: able to understand how customers use the platform, hold a credible conversation with their technical teams, spot when something is going wrong, and know when to bring in a specialist. That technical credibility is what will make you a genuine trusted advisor rather than just a point of contact.

Because this is a foundational hire, you will both build and execute. You will not inherit a mature playbook; you will help create it, establishing the processes, cadences, and tooling that a strong program management function depends on, while carrying a live book of business from day one.

Requirements

Own & grow customer relationships

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of existing subscription customers
  • Build strong, multi-threaded relationships across each customer organization, from day-to-day users through to senior decision-makers
  • Develop and maintain account plans that map each customer's objectives to the value OpenFn delivers
  • Plan and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and other regular check-ins

Bring technical fluency to the relationship

  • Develop a strong working understanding of the OpenFn platform and how each of your customers uses it
  • Hold credible, substantive conversations with customers' technical teams about their integrations, data workflows, and use cases
  • Translate fluently between customers' technical staff and their non-technical decision-makers
  • Spot technical adoption risks early, and know when to bring in solution architects or implementation consultants

Drive retention & expansion

  • Own gross and net retention for your portfolio, and be accountable for renewals
  • Forecast renewals accurately and manage the end-to-end renewal process
  • Proactively identify at-risk accounts and lead recovery plans before they churn
  • Identify and pursue opportunities to grow accounts, including tier upgrades and cross-sell of additional services
  • Negotiate renewals and expansions in line with our pricing and packaging model

Deliver value & coordinate delivery

  • Ensure a smooth handoff from sales and implementation into ongoing program management
  • Monitor product usage and adoption, and work with customers to close gaps and deepen engagement
  • Act as the voice of the customer internally, channeling feedback to our product and services teams
  • Coordinate with support and implementation teams to meet SLA commitments and deliver project-based work
  • Manage escalations, bringing the right internal people together to resolve issues quickly

Build the program management function

  • Establish the playbooks, cadences, and health-scoring approach that will let program management scale as OpenFn grows
  • Maintain accurate account data, activity, and forecasts in our CRM, and report on core retention/growth metrics to leadership
  • Help migrate existing customers from legacy project-based arrangements onto the new subscription model

Required Qualifications

  • 3-7+ years of experience in account management, customer success, or a related customer-facing commercial role at a SaaS or subscription business
  • A proven track record of retaining and growing a portfolio of customers, including owning renewals, forecasting, and driving upsell or expansion
  • Experience managing customers for a technically substantive product, with a demonstrated ability to get up to speed on how a product actually works
  • Genuine technical fluency: comfort discussing concepts such as APIs, integrations, data exchange, and workflow automation, and the ability to translate between technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to earn trust with both technical users and senior stakeholders
  • Experience running customer cadences such as QBRs, service reviews, and success planning
  • Hands-on proficiency with a CRM, and a data-informed approach to managing account health and forecasts
  • Fluent, professional-level English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to work effectively across a distributed, multicultural team
  • Fluency in Spanish, in addition to English
  • A self-starter mindset suited to a foundational role where you build as well as execute, and the ability to work from home or a shared office space with fast, stable internet, preferably in a country located in Central or South America (compatible with Americas time zones)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience helping a business (or its customers) transition from project or services-based revenue to a subscription model
  • A technical background (e.g. a computer science degree, or prior experience in engineering, technical support, solutions, or implementation), including hands-on experience with integration tooling, data pipelines, or APIs
  • Experience managing government, NGO, public sector, or other international customers, ideally within the digital public goods or open source ecosystem

We are seeking a Postdoctoral Research Fellow in livestock genome engineering to join a Gates Foundation-funded project aiming to improve dairy productivity in cattle in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Working alongside quantitative geneticists and computational biologists, you will develop and deploy genome engineering approaches in cattle cells to test genetic changes prioritised by AI models and genetic studies as candidates for improving milk production and feed efficiency.
