title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Modalità di lavoro: Full remote (ufficio disponibile a Milano per chi preferisce lavorare in presenza)

Tundr sta riscrivendo le regole del welfare aziendale in Italia da fintech: tutto il welfare di un'azienda su un'unica carta, la Tundr Card, per rendere semplici e scalabili sia i fringe benefit che i flexible benefit, oggi spesso vissuti dalle aziende come un adempimento burocratico. In due anni Tundr ha acquisito oltre 1.500 clienti, si è posizionata all'11° posto della classifica Sifted 100 Southern Europe 2026 (le startup a crescita più rapida del Sud Europa) e ha appena annunciato un round serie A da 11 milioni di euro.

L'infrastruttura di Tundr gira interamente su AWS, con un'architettura fortemente serverless oriented, progettata e cresciuta in casa fin dall'inizio.

Oggi l'azienda cerca la seconda persona da affiancare a chi ha costruito tutta questa parte, per condividerne la responsabilità. La persona entrerà nel team Platform, che si occupa dell'architettura dell'intero prodotto insieme agli sviluppatori backend.

  • Garantirai che tutti i servizi su AWS siano up and running, gestendo l'infrastruttura in ottica Infrastructure as Code con CDK
  • Gestirai e farai evolvere le pipeline di CI/CD su GitHub Actions, che deployano su AWS.
  • Supporterai quotidianamente gli sviluppatori sui feature environment, repliche dell'intera architettura AWS su cui il team testa le nuove funzionalità prima della produzione
  • Imposterai da zero il sistema di observability e monitoring: metriche, SLI e SLO adatti al caso d'uso di Tundr, dashboard e alert, insieme agli standard che permetteranno agli sviluppatori di monitorare in autonomia le proprie feature
  • Contribuirai alle scelte architetturali su AWS quando c'è da progettare qualcosa di nuovo: quali servizi usare, come configurarli, come farli parlare tra loro
  • Lavorerai a stretto contatto con gli sviluppatori per la gestione di tutto il sistema event-driven di Tundr.
  • 7-8 anni di esperienza, di cui una parte significativa in un ruolo DevOps, SRE o Platform Engineering su un prodotto in produzione
  • Buona conoscenza di AWS e dei suoi servizi managed
  • Esperienza con Infrastructure as Code (CDK o strumenti analoghi come Terraform)
  • Esperienza nella gestione di pipeline CI/CD
  • Esperienza concreta su observability e monitoring (metriche, alerting, dashboard, SLI/SLO), meglio se in un progetto in cui hai contribuito in prima persona a impostare il sistema
  • Ottime capacità di comunicazione: saper spiegare concetti complessi in modo semplice, anche a persone non tecniche
  • Buona padronanza della lingua italiana

Non serve spuntare ogni voce al 100%: il perimetro del ruolo è ampio e siamo disposti a valutare anche chi è un po' meno forte su una delle aree (ad esempio AWS o GitHub Actions) se porta un'esperienza significativa sull'observability, purché abbia voglia di imparare il resto.

  • Esperienza con architetture serverless su AWS: Lambda, ECS su Fargate, DynamoDB, Aurora, API Gateway, SQS, Cognito
  • Esperienza con GitHub Actions
  • Esperienza con strumenti di observability come Prometheus, Grafana o simili
  • Conoscenza di Go (l'azienda ha una CLI interna in Go a supporto degli sviluppatori)
  • Esperienza in contesti startup o scale-up, su un prodotto consolidato con molti clienti e dati da gestire

Sei la persona ideale si:

Ti piace lavorare in autonomia: in Tundr non ricevi una soluzione già pronta da eseguire, ma una serie di problemi da mettere in priorità e risolvere, trovando tu la strada migliore.

Hai voglia di costruire qualcosa da zero, come il sistema di observability, e di portare le tue idee nelle scelte architetturali.

Pur essendo un ruolo da individual contributor, lavori a stretto contatto con gli altri: sei la persona a cui gli sviluppatori si rivolgono quando qualcosa non funziona negli environment o quando una nuova feature richiede di introdurre nuovi servizi AWS, quindi ti piace collaborare, ti fai sentire spesso e sai spiegare le cose con chiarezza a chiunque.

Ti trovi bene in un contesto da remoto che valorizza molto il confronto diretto e sincrono con il team.

  • Contratto di assunzione, CCNL Commercio
  • Bonus su obiettivi aziendali
  • Corposo piano di welfare aziendale
  • Buoni pasto (in arrivo da gennaio 2027)
  • Modalità di lavoro full remote, con ufficio a Milano sempre disponibile per chi lo desidera
  • Offsite periodici per allinearsi, confrontarsi e stare insieme
  • Un problema reale da risolvere, in un team che cresce e insegna, con autonomia vera e impatto misurabile

Processo di selezione:

  • 1 step tecnico con il team Tundr
  • Eventuale, non sempre presente, breve chiacchierata conoscitiva finale con l'HR

L'annuncio è rivolto a candidati di entrambi i sessi, nel rispetto del D.lgs. 198/2006 e s.m.i., e a persone di ogni età, nazionalità, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere e appartenenza etnica, nel rispetto dei principi di non discriminazione e pari opportunità.

title: Business Analyst (with AI Experience)
description:
We are seeking an experienced AI Business Analyst with hands-on AI experience to identify, assess, and shape practical AI-enabled solutions. You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders to translate real operational needs into clear requirements, measurable success criteria, and responsible implementation approaches.

Responsibilities:

  • Assess business processes to identify automation and AI opportunities, evaluating expected benefits, costs, feasibility, dependencies, and risks.
  • Lead discovery sessions with business stakeholders to understand pain points, process variations, data availability, controls, and desired outcomes.
  • Write clear functional requirements and user stories for AI-enabled features, including document intelligence and extraction, conversational assistants, classification and decisioning, and intelligent routing.
  • Define what good looks like for AI features, including accuracy thresholds, confidence handling, fallback paths, human-in-the-loop processes, exception management, and audit requirements.
  • Support business-side model evaluation by assessing AI outputs against real cases, helping structure representative evaluation datasets, documenting results, and identifying limitations.
  • Translate AI findings into actionable recommendations, acceptance criteria, process changes, operating procedures, and implementation priorities.
  • Clearly communicate AI capabilities, assumptions, risks, and limitations to non-technical stakeholders, and recognize when a rules-based or conventional solution is more appropriate.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, data, security, compliance, and operations teams throughout design, delivery, testing, rollout, and continuous improvement.

title: Lead Systems Engineer
description:
ABOUT ROCKET LAB

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

SPACE SYSTEMS

Rocket Lab’s Space Systems division builds complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space including solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, and radios.

The Space Systems division has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. We have built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S. Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help get to space — our Space Systems division is empowering the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

LEAD SYSTEMS ENGINEER

Rocket Lab Optical Systems solves mission-critical space domain and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance challenges for Department of Defense and Intelligence Community customers. Our vision is to revolutionize the space-based payload market with innovative and novel designs for space, terrestrial, and airborne environments. Building on more than 20 years of electro-optical and infrared systems innovation from Geost, Rocket Lab Optical Systems delivers solutions to the warfighter for responsive, scalable sensing solutions across all orbital domains.

As a Lead Systems Engineer for Rocket Lab Optical Systems in Tucson, AZ, you will be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of advanced space payloads in support of Tranche 3 of the U.S. Space Development Agency's Proliferated Warfighter Space Architecture.

WHAT YOU’LL GET TO DO:

  • Support the development of system architecture for space-based optical instruments, subsystems, and payloads on airborne and space platforms, with emphasis on electrical architecture and controls integration
  • Define, decompose, and manage system requirements with focus on electrical behavior, control functions, subsystem interactions, and overall system performance
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation including architecture descriptions, interface control documents, electrical interface definitions, concepts of operations, state and mode descriptions, test plans, and verification artifacts
  • Support development of electrical and functional architectures, including command and telemetry flow, power distribution, control logic, signal paths, timing, synchronization, and subsystem interaction
  • Collaborate with hardware, software, firmware, and test teams to ensure the electrical architecture and controls implementation align with system requirements and mission intent
  • Support the development, integration, and testing of space payloads to be integrated on spacecraft platforms
  • Support hardware and software development teams with system-level test planning, debugging, integration, and execution of verification procedures; analyze data and recommend design refinements
  • Participate in hardware and software verification and validation activities related to system behavior, electrical performance, controls implementation, and interface compliance
  • Support architecture trades involving sensors, motor control, embedded electronics, power systems, command and data handling, and subsystem interfaces
  • Participate in technical interchange meetings and project discussions with internal teams, customers, and external partners as needed
  • Identify, assess, and help mitigate technical risks related to electrical architecture, controls implementation, and subsystem integration
  • Support travel or off-site work as needed
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS YOU’LL BRING AS LEAD SYSTEMS ENGINEER:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical, systems, or aerospace engineering; or other technical discipline
  • 12+ years of engineering experience, including 3+ years supporting development programs and 2+ years in technical leadership, CAM, IPTL, or equivalent role
  • Demonstrated systems engineering experience with emphasis on electrical architecture, subsystem integration, and controls focused development
  • Strong electrical engineering background supporting complex aerospace, payload, avionics, or instrument systems
  • Experience developing system requirements, interface definitions, and verification approaches for complex systems
  • Strong background in electrical interfaces, control functions, avionics integration, or subsystem architecture
  • Experience with requirements management and modeling tools such as JAMA, DOORS, Cameo, or similar tools
  • Experience working across hardware, software, and firmware development throughout the lifecycle
  • Familiarity with command and telemetry interfaces, power architectures, signal interfaces, timing, synchronization, and control logic
  • Experience supporting integration and test, including troubleshooting electrical or controls-related issues at the subsystem or system level
  • Strong ability to read, interpret, and develop electrical, interface, and system technical documentation
  • Familiarity with aerospace development standards, environmental testing, and mission assurance practices

THESE QUALIFICATIONS WOULD BE NICE TO HAVE:

  • Current SSBI clearance
  • EO/IR payload integration experience
  • Experience with spacecraft bus interfaces, payload electrical integration, avionics architecture, or embedded electronics
  • Experience with pointing, stabilization, gimbals, motion control, focus/control electronics, or other closed-loop control applications
  • Experience defining or troubleshooting electrical architectures for sensors, actuators, motors, power systems, or embedded controllers
  • Hands-on expertise leading troubleshooting and resolution of system-level electrical or controls-related issues
  • Demonstrated experience working with minimal supervision in complex projects
  • Experience in astronomy, physics, or remote sensing
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary teams and explain complex implementation processes to other organization members
  • Strong communication, task management, and cross-functional coordination skills

This position may require prolonged periods of sitting, standing, walking, computer work, and occasional exposure to moderate levels of noise, dust, and fumes in production areas.

WHAT TO EXPECT

We’re on a mission to unlock the potential of space to improve life on Earth, but that’s not an easy task. It takes hard work, determination, relentless innovation, teamwork, grit, and an unwavering commitment to achieving what others often deem impossible. Our people out-think, out-work, and out-pace. We pride ourselves on having each other’s backs, checking our egos at the door, and rolling up our sleeves on all tasks big and small. We thrive under pressure, work to tight deadlines, and our focus is always on how we can deliver, rather than dwelling on the challenges that stand in the way.

The new Playdium is 30,000 square feet of games and food for teens, kids and families to explore, connect and play. Featuring state of the art Virtual Reality, bowling, ropes course, video and redemption games. The Amusement Cashier will be responsible for promoting an outstanding entertainment experience to our guests in accordance with Playdium standards of operation.

Playdium will be an unbeatable amusement and gaming experience. Perfect for groups of friends and families to engage in friendly competition, celebrate special occasions or simply hang out. Featuring fresh food options at a sit-down family restaurant, and fast casual dining, both accommodating for all types of occasions.

Cineplex Entertainment, headquartered in Toronto, Ontario, is currently recruiting for the position of Amusement Electronics Technician – Playdium Whitby, reporting to the Service Manager. This position will be based at our Playdium Whitby location at 75 Consumer Drive, Whitby, Ontario.

The Amusement Technician will conduct preventative maintenance diagnostics to ensure that Playdium gaming equipment maintains the highest industry standards. The Amusement Technician is accountable for the safe installation, testing, inspection, preventative maintenance, and repairs of gaming equipment. title: Eligibility Coordinator
description:
WHO YOU ARE

You are a compassionate, detail-oriented professional who takes pride in guiding others through complex financial and eligibility processes with clarity and care. At Lutheran Life Villages, your strong customer service mindset shines as you support residents and families during important life transitions, ensuring they feel informed, respected, and confident in their coverage. Your ability to manage multiple applications, track details, and stay current on Medicaid guidelines reflects your commitment to accuracy and excellence.

Your strong communication and interpersonal skills foster collaboration across teams while building trust with residents and their loved ones. You approach each interaction with empathy, professionalism, and discretion, especially when handling sensitive financial information. Self-motivated and organized, you anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and contribute to a Finance team that values teamwork, integrity, and service. You are passionate about making a meaningful difference and align with Lutheran Life Villages’ mission to support independence, wellness, and compassionate care.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As an Eligibility Coordinator, you will be responsible for several aspects of resident customer service and financial eligibility including insurance verification and benefit checks, filing Medicaid applications and redeterminations, and answering questions from residents and family members related to their stay. It also includes adhering to any changes in Medicaid policies and assisting residents with payer source changes when needed.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Submitting and tracking Medicaid and MedWaiver Applications until approved for all locations.
  • Submitting and tracking Medicaid and MedWaiver Redeterminations for all locations.
  • Acting as the first point of contact for all calls and emails to the Finance Department and payer switches to Medicaid and MedWaiver.
  • Notifying Medicaid of any Medicaid and MedWaiver admits and discharges.
  • Upholding LLV policy to submit and track applications to Social Security for LLV to become Rep Payee for Nursing Home Medicaid residents.
  • Assisting any resident and/or family in understanding their financial coverage as it relates to their stay, including attending care plans when needed.
  • Commuting to LLV campuses to meet with residents and their families as needed.
  • Verification of benefits for potential admissions.
  • Billing miscellaneous charges such as haircare, labs, x-rays, supplies, pharmacy, and therapy.
  • Provide back-up support for the Finance Department as needed.
  • Other duties as assigned.

WHAT YOU NEED

  • Education/Training: High school diploma and two-year associates degree or substantial work experience directly related to the long-term care industry or healthcare.
  • Work Experience: A minimum of 2-3 years working in a business office, experience assisting with Medicaid eligibility for long-term care, or comparable financial and accounting experience preferred.
  • Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: Strong verbal and written communication skills, excellent customer service, basic accounting, Microsoft Office programs, attention to detail, self-motivated.

WHY JOIN US?

At Lutheran Life Villages, we bring our core values of Leadership, Impact, Friendship, and Excellence (LIFE) into every part of our work. Here, you’ll find the opportunity to contribute to an organization dedicated to providing exceptional care for seniors while fostering a supportive, collaborative environment for its staff. Our commitment to Leadership means empowering our team members to grow personally and professionally, inspiring others by example. We’re passionate about making a meaningful Impact in the lives of our residents and nurturing relationships built on Friendship and compassion. By pursuing Excellence in all we do, our employees share our mission to deliver outstanding care.

As a valued member of the LLV team, you’ll enjoy a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth and well-being. With offerings from medical, dental, and vision insurance to paid time off on your birthday, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, and retirement matching, we’re committed to helping you thrive. Join us on a purposeful journey where your career and compassion come together!

**The Opportunity:**

The appointed PDRA will work in the group of Prof. Marialuisa Aliotta (PI) to conduct research in nuclear astrophysics for the [**UKRI-funded ERC Advanced Grant “NUCLEAR: NUclear Clustering Effects in Astrophysical Reactions”**](https://www.erc-nuclear.uk/) The appointed PDRA will develop and apply _R-matrix_ evaluations of experimental data on nuclear reactions cross sections of astrophysical interest, to support the research within the group and contirbute to a vibrant and exciting research area.  Working closely with the PI and collaborator DR James deBoer (Notre Dame University, US), the PDRA will contribute to, and utilize, a set of tools designed for these purposes.  The PDRA will maintain close ties with the PI's research team, providing R-matrix global fits of experimental data and contributing to the evaluation of astrophysical reason rates.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in experimental nuclear astrophysics, especially in underground laboratories, as well as an excellent academic track record of strong publications and leadership in the field. In addition, s/he will be expected to co-supervise research students and to contribute to project provision and supervision of graduate and undergraduate students. The successful candidate is expected to engage in frequent field trips to overseas laboratories, present their work at collaboration meetings as required, and maintain a good collaborative attitude.

The Edinburgh Nuclear Physics Group has an outstanding reputation for scientific leadership and innovative instrumentation in diverse areas of nuclear physics including nuclear astrophysics and properties of exotic nuclei. The Group’s research is performed at world-leading laboratories, using a variety of experimental techniques and state-of-the-art instrumentation developed by the Group.

The School of Physics and Astronomy at the University of Edinburgh is committed to encouraging equality and diversity among its workforce and eliminating discrimination. The School strives to create a more diverse, equitable and inclusive workplace for all, and we are looking to actively diversify our staff. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates and encourage applications from people of colour, women, people with disabilities, LGBTQ+ people and other minority and under-represented groups. We aim to ensure that our culture and systems support flexible and family-friendly working, as evidenced by our Juno Champion and Athena SWAN Silver awards.

The level of appointment for the PDRA post will be determined by the selection panel depending on the experience of the successful candidate.

A career with us has a range of other benefits that can be tailored to your lifestyle:

Responsibility and autonomy.

Excellent benefits and support.

Contributing to the work and purpose of the University.

This post is full-time (35 hours per week); however, we are open to considering part-time or flexible working patterns. We are also open to considering requests for hybrid working (on a non-contractual basis) that combines a mix of remote and regular on-campus working.

For informal enquiries contact Prof. Marialuisa Aliotta ( [m.aliotta@ed.ac.uk](mailto:m.aliotta@ed.ac.uk)) or Dr James deBoer ( [Richard.J.deBoer.12@nd.edu](mailto:Richard.J.deBoer.12@nd.edu))

Job Description:

At Regions, the Mainframe Systems Engineer installs and maintains mainframe operating systems ensuring the stability, performance and security of our mainframe environment while driving innovation and continuous improvement.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Ensures compliance with risk management programs, rules and regulations, and cybersecurity practices; identifies opportunities for and supports process improvements; applies disciplined change management practices

This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Business, or a related field and six (6) years of mainframe infrastructure technical software and hardware analysis, programming, and installation experience
  • Or High School Diploma or GED with ten (10) years of experience of mainframe infrastructure technical software and hardware analysis, programming, and installation
  • Experience in installation and support of Mainframe system products including ZOS, CICS, MQ, DB2, Storage, Automation, ZLINUX or Networking

      • Content delivery, load balancers
      • DNS basic knowledge: forward/reverse lookup, resolvers, DNS caching/time to live
      • FTP/FTPS/SFTP/SSH
    • VTAM
      • Basic configuration: Major nodes, application definitions, Enterprise Extender
    • Basic Unix knowledge
      • File structure
      • Basic commands: ls, cd, chmod, etc.
  • Basic z/OS knowledge
    • TSO, ISPF,JCL, job submission, etc.
  • Security
    • TLS sessions
    • Certificate chains, keyrings
  • Nice to have:
    • z/OS policy agent (PAGENT)
    • ZOSMF network configuration assistant
    • Managed file transfer applications such as Connect Direct
    • Mainframe print delivery (Infoprint)
    • Hypersockets and Shared Memory communication
    • Service Now experience

description:

Thank you for your interest in a career at Northcentral Technical College (NTC).

$27.59


JOB SUMMARY, DESCRIPTION & QUALIFICATIONS:

Job Summary

The Transfer Coordinator supports Northcentral Technical College’s university transfer pathways by coordinating the development, review, implementation, and ongoing maintenance of articulation agreements and transfer processes. This position serves as a primary point of contact for four-year university partners and collaborates across academic divisions, advising, enrollment, and other College departments to promote consistent and effective transfer practices. The Coordinator maintains centralized articulation and transfer documentation and supports the implementation and continuous improvement of processes that help students navigate clear and efficient pathways toward bachelor’s degree completion. The position also coordinates and implements grant-funded university transfer initiatives, including activities related to transfer infrastructure, partner engagement, student transfer programming, and data-informed evaluation of transfer practices and outcomes.

Please note this is an in-person position located on campus in Wausau, Wisconsin.



Essential Functions and Responsibilities

The following duties are primarily performed and are essential for this position. Employees are expected to be able to perform each of these job duties satisfactorily and successfully with or without reasonable accommodation.

Articulation & Transfer Coordination

  • Coordinate the development, review, implementation, renewal, and ongoing maintenance of articulation and transfer agreements with four-year institutions.
  • Serve as a primary operational point of contact for university partners and coordinate communication among NTC faculty, academic leaders, advising, enrollment, and other College departments involved in articulation and transfer processes.
  • Facilitate collaboration between NTC faculty and university partners to evaluate course and program alignment, maximize credit transferability, and develop clear transfer pathways for students.
  • Maintain centralized, accurate, and accessible records of articulation agreements, transfer pathways, equivalency information, and related documentation.
  • Coordinate established review and approval processes for articulation agreements to promote consistency with College standards, transfer practices, and applicable requirements.
  • Monitor existing agreements and transfer pathways for needed updates, expirations, curricular changes, or other conditions requiring review or revision.
  • Support the development and implementation of standardized articulation and transfer processes, tools, and resources across College departments.

Partnership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Build and maintain collaborative working relationships with four-year institutions to support existing transfer pathways and identify opportunities for new or expanded articulation agreements.
  • Coordinate meetings and structured planning activities among NTC faculty, academic leaders, advisors, university representatives, and other internal and external partners.
  • Collaborate with K–12 schools, workforce organizations, adult education providers, and other community partners to strengthen awareness of and access to university transfer pathways.
  • Facilitate partner conversations related to articulation alignment, transfer processes, student navigation, and emerging pathway opportunities.
  • Represent NTC in transfer-related meetings, events, partner visits, advisory activities, and other assigned external engagements.
  • Coordinate transfer-focused partner and student engagement activities, including university visits, transfer events, workshops, orientations, and related programming.

Transfer Information, Resources & Communication

  • Develop, maintain, and coordinate transfer-related tools, resources, templates, and documentation to support consistent communication of articulation and transfer information.
  • Collaborate with advising, enrollment, marketing, academic departments, and university partners to ensure transfer information is accurate, current, and aligned across student-facing resources.
  • Provide articulation and transfer information and guidance to faculty, staff, students, and external partners and connect individuals with appropriate College or university resources as needed.
  • Support the development of communication and outreach materials that clarify transfer pathways, course applicability, degree alignment, and transfer processes.
  • Identify opportunities to improve the accessibility and usability of transfer information for students, families, faculty, staff, and external partners.

Data, Evaluation & Continuous Improvement

  • Collaborate with Institutional Research and other College departments to establish, maintain, and review data related to articulation, enrollment, persistence, transfer readiness, and transfer outcomes.
  • Monitor articulation and transfer activities and outcomes to identify gaps, trends, and opportunities for process improvement.
  • Participate in regular review of transfer data and project measures and use findings to recommend operational adjustments to articulation processes, partner engagement, transfer resources, and related activities.
  • Track and document progress toward established objectives and benchmarks and provide accurate information to support institutional reporting and continuous improvement.
  • Gather and incorporate feedback from students, faculty, staff, and external partners to improve articulation and transfer processes and resources.
  • Remain current on transfer practices, regulatory or system requirements, and trends affecting articulation and university transfer.

Grant & Project Coordination

  • Plan and implement assigned activities of the College’s university transfer grant in collaboration with the Project Manager, Student Success Advisor, and cross-functional College teams.
  • Facilitate implementation activities associated with the Transfer Policy & Practice Audit, including gathering information, engaging internal partners, documenting findings, and supporting implementation of identified improvements.
  • Support the development and implementation of the co-located Transfer Center in partnership with UW–Stevens Point, including coordination of articulation, advising, referral, and transfer processes across institutions.
  • Coordinate assigned components of the University Transfer High School Academy, including articulation alignment, faculty and partner coordination, pathway development, and implementation activities.
  • Collaborate with College departments and external partners to implement transfer-focused outreach, engagement, and programming for traditional students, high school students, adult learners, and other identified populations.
  • Maintain project documentation, monitor assigned activities and timelines, and provide information and data necessary to support grant reporting, evaluation, and continuous improvement.

College & Professional Responsibilities

  • Participate in College teams, committees, meetings, professional development activities, and other assigned institutional initiatives related to the responsibilities of the position.
  • Maintain current knowledge of articulation, transfer, higher education practices, technologies, and applicable College, WTCS, and partner-institution requirements.
  • Participate in professional learning and networking opportunities related to university transfer, articulation, student success, and assigned grant activities.
  • Assist with College events and activities related to student recruitment, enrollment, transfer, and partner engagement, as assigned.
  • Perform other duties as assigned consistent with the responsibilities and scope of the position.



Minimum Qualifications Required

In limited circumstances, NTC may consider a combination of education, training, and experience which provides the necessary knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the duties of this position.


Education: Bachelor's Degree

Bachelor’s degree in education, higher education, student affairs, business, communications, project management, or a related field.

Experience: 2 Years


Additional Experience Information:

  • Minimum of two years of relevant professional experience in project coordination, education, higher education, student services, academic affairs, partnership development, or a related area.
  • Experience coordinating projects, processes, or initiatives involving multiple internal and/or external partners.
  • Experience interpreting and applying policies, procedures, requirements, or other complex organizational information.
  • Experience organizing and maintaining detailed records, documentation, timelines, and multiple concurrent priorities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in a higher education environment, particularly within a technical college, community college, or university.
  • Knowledge of articulation agreements, university transfer pathways, curriculum, academic advising, enrollment services, registrar functions, or transfer-credit processes.
  • Experience working with four-year institutions or other external educational partners.
  • Familiarity with student information systems, transfer/articulation platforms such as Transferology, or related higher education technologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to use data to evaluate processes, monitor outcomes, or support continuous improvement.
  • Experience with grant-funded projects or initiatives.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

In order to perform the functions and responsibilities of the position (listed above) the following knowledge, skills, and abilities, including language skills, reasoning and mathematical abilities are essential.


Language Skills:

Ability to read, write, analyze and interpret complex documents; present topics to internal and external individuals of all levels.

Ability to perform and work complex calculations, make comparisons, interpret and provide logical explanations to others.


Reasoning Ability:

Technical Skills:

title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, CUDA Driver
description:
NVIDIA’s invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing — with the GPU acting as the brain of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. We're looking to grow our company and form teams with the most inquisitive people in the world. Join us at the forefront of technological advancement. We are hiring software engineers to work on the CUDA driver for Tegra. CUDA is NVIDIA’s platform for accelerating general purpose computation on the GPU. Our team delivers features and improvements to better realize the potential of NVIDIA hardware for a growing range of computational workloads, ranging from deep learning, scientific computation, and self-driving cars to video games and virtual reality. CUDA defines a unified programming model across a range of system configurations and hardware capabilities. To accomplish this, the CUDA driver interacts with GPU hardware, kernel mode drivers, user mode drivers, and the operating system.


What you’ll be doing:


As a member of our team, you will use your design abilities, coding expertise, and creativity to deliver the best compute platform in the world. You will craft elegant solutions to exciting problems and shape the future direction of CUDA as you collaborate with your peers across NVIDIA.

  • You will architect and implement new features
  • Coordinate development efforts across multiple teams
  • Help define forward-looking improvement to the CUDA APIs and programming model
  • Write effective, maintainable, and well-tested code
  • Focus on developing code that targets the Tegra devices
  • Integrate AI practices into the development workflows across the compute organisation

What we need to see:

  • BS or MS degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 8+ years of relevant industry experience or equivalent academic experience after BS
  • Strong C and C++ programming skills
  • Experience working with large codebases
  • Experience with operating system interfaces for threads, process control, and virtual memory
  • Experience writing and debugging multithreaded programs
  • Understanding of system level architecture, such as interconnects, memory hierarchy, interrupts, and memory-mapped IO
  • Strong interest in system software
  • Good written communication

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Prior experience with parallel computing - preferably writing CUDA Programs or Libraries that use CUDA
  • User mode driver development experience
  • Experience with Linux Systems Software development as well as experience maintaining and extending programming models or higher-level language support for similar environments

title: Data Migration Specialist
description:
Job Description

Job Overview:

We are seeking an experienced Data Migration Specialist to deliver end-to-end data migration projects across a diverse client base, including nonprofits, charities, community service organisations and professional associations.

This is a hands-on, client-facing role where you will be responsible for shaping and delivering data migration projects, from discovery and design through to implementation and handover. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including Solution Architects, Developers, Designers and Project Managers to deliver high-quality, scalable solutions.

You will also play a key role in guiding clients through their data migration journey, acting as a trusted advisor to ensure solutions are practical, sustainable and aligned with project goals.

Responsibilities
  • Lead and facilitate client data workshops to gather requirements and define data migration strategies.
  • Design and deliver fit-for-purpose data migration solutions across varied client environments.
  • Hands on end-to-end data migration into Salesforce, including planning, design, build, testing and deployment.
  • Perform data analysis and develop clear, well-documented migration approaches and strategy designs.
  • Lead data team members to ensure successful project delivery and contribute to capability uplift within the team.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers on timelines, risks, budgets and stakeholder communication.
  • Build strong client relationships and provide practical, consultative advice on data solutions.
  • Ensure data quality, data referential integrity and data governance best practices are upheld across all deliverables.
Qualifications
  • Experience: Typically 8-10 years' hands-on experience delivering data solutions, with a strong track record in the Microsoft data stack (MSSQL, SSIS, SSDT, Visual Studio).
  • Salesforce Migration (Crucial): Proven capability delivering full end-to-end data migration into Salesforce CRM, including familiarity with Bulk API, sandbox environments and the Salesforce object model.
  • SQL Mastery (Crucial): Advanced ability to design, write and optimise complex SQL queries, views and stored procedures.
  • Deep Data Expertise (Crucial): Expert-level skills across the data domain, including data migration, ETL, data modelling and pipeline development.
  • Project Delivery: Successfully delivered 5 or more complex data migration projects end-to-end.
  • Nonprofit CRM Experience: Experience migrating data from nonprofit systems such as ThankQ, NPSP, Nonprofit Cloud, Penelope or Carelink.
  • Location: Must be based in Australia (preferably Melbourne) and have a valid permit to work full-time and long-term.
Skills
  • Strong ETL and data engineering capability, including pipeline development, transformation logic and optimisation.
  • Accuracy mindset with a strong focus on data quality, integrity and accuracy.
  • Solid understanding of the full data lifecycle, including ingestion, transformation, data management, orchestration, security and pipeline deployment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with strong problem-solving, documentation and stakeholder management capability.
  • Ability to produce high-quality documentation, including data artefacts, mappings, process maps, architecture diagrams and requirements specifications.
  • Experience working effectively across both Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to guide and mentor team members, supporting professional growth within project teams.
  • Passion for the for-purpose sector or prior experience delivering projects within nonprofit organisations.

As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

The Maritime Manufacturing Technology team is responsible for rapidly developing and implementing manufacturing technologies and processes for cutting-edge defense hardware, including deployable static and moving surface, undersea and sea to air vehicles and scaling these products in our new manufacturing facilities.

ABOUT THE JOB

  • Build and operate AI powered system to control all aspects of a factor.

  • Design, build, and maintain business process automation for full schedule management across platforms.
  • Implement and maintain one integrated master schedule for the Protofactory.
  • Build automated workflows connecting: tickets, M&E deliveries, production start events, bar charts, and reporting.
  • Develop advanced simulation models to test schedule scenarios, identify bottlenecks, and optimize flow.
  • Leverage AI/ML tools (including Claude Code) to accelerate automation development.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Exceptional skills using AI to build and automate workflows. We are looking for a hacker that will make the system work.
  • Software engineering proficiency â can write production-quality code (Python, SQL, or similar).
  • Self-directed with strong problem-solving instincts.
  • Proficiency with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar) for rapid automation development.
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance.

Position Information


Job Summary:

The Web Applications Developer II – WordPress & Full-Stack Web Development, under direction, performs complex and specialized web development functions in support of organizational websites, web applications, and digital platforms. WordPress is a primary development platform for this position, with responsibilities also extending to custom web applications, APIs, integrations, and related web technologies.


The role supports front-end and back-end development, modern WordPress theme, plugin, and block development, application troubleshooting, testing, accessibility, and ongoing platform support. The position works collaboratively with developers, designers, content managers, project leaders, and stakeholders to develop, modernize, and maintain public-facing websites and web applications across the organization.


Responsibilities:


Problem Resolution, Technical Evaluation, and Project Management

  • Reviews and analyzes web application and WordPress documentation, source code, configurations, and production results to facilitate problem resolution and identify root causes of application issues.
  • Troubleshoots and resolves complex problems in WordPress and other web application environments, including theme and plugin conflicts, custom code defects, block editor issues, application errors, performance problems, integration issues, and accessibility defects.
  • Evaluates and follows through on web development issues and problems until resolved or appropriately escalated.
  • Participates in application and data design for web solutions, including content modeling, database structures, APIs, integrations, and application components.
  • Participates in the evaluation of WordPress plugins, themes, block themes, frameworks, libraries, APIs, and other web development tools to determine applicability, security, accessibility, performance, and maintainability.
  • Assists the project leader with developing work plans and schedules for website and web application projects, including outlining phases, identifying technical needs, estimating development effort, and tracking milestones for development, modernization, and migration work.

Project Planning and Consultation

  • Consults with clients and stakeholders to understand project requirements and provides technical recommendations regarding WordPress capabilities, web development approaches, integrations, accessibility, and implementation options within established technical standards.
  • Reviews project plans and schedules, communicates development and testing results, and discusses technical problems or concerns with project leaders and stakeholders.
  • Contributes to technical specifications and design documentation based on project and stakeholder requirements.
  • Collaborates with project leaders, developers, designers, and content managers throughout development, testing, deployment, and ongoing support.

Design, Development, and Testing

  • Develops and implements complex WordPress websites, themes, block themes, custom blocks, plugins, and web applications according to established requirements and specifications.
  • Develops front-end and back-end components for WordPress and other web applications using appropriate web technologies.
  • Writes complex PHP, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and related web application code in accordance with WordPress coding standards and established development guidelines.
  • Applies modern WordPress development practices, including the block editor/Gutenberg, block-based development, block themes, theme.json, and Full Site Editing where appropriate.
  • Develops and maintains integrations between WordPress, external APIs, data sources, databases, and other web applications as needed to support application functionality.
  • Tests and remediates WordPress solutions and other web applications for functionality, cross-browser compatibility, responsive behavior, overall quality, and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility.
  • Uses version control and established development workflows to manage source code and application changes.

Other Duties

  • Authors and maintains technical documentation, developer guides, application documentation, and onboarding materials for websites and web applications.
  • Provides technical support and guidance to less experienced staff on WordPress development workflows, application codebases, troubleshooting, and established quality standards.
  • Participates in code reviews and collaborative development activities.
  • Maintains knowledge of evolving WordPress and web development technologies and applies appropriate practices to assigned work.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Qualifications


Required Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Information Systems, Computer Science, or closely related field, or, an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • Four years of related experience.

Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and work cooperatively with others.
  • Working knowledge of front-end and back-end web development using HTML5, CSS3, PHP, JavaScript, and related web technologies.
  • Working knowledge of modern WordPress development and administration, including themes, plugins, blocks, templates, block-based site development, content management workflows, and site configuration.
  • Familiarity with APIs, databases, structured data, and web application integrations.
  • Knowledge of responsive web development and cross-browser compatibility.
  • Knowledge of web accessibility standards and accessible development practices.
  • Knowledge of version control practices and collaborative development workflows.
  • Ability to analyze technical problems, evaluate potential solutions, and communicate technical information to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Web Development, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • More than four years of WordPress, full-stack, or web application development experience.
  • Experience developing custom WordPress themes, block themes, plugins, or blocks using modern WordPress development practices, including Gutenberg, Full Site Editing, or theme.json.
  • Experience developing or integrating REST APIs and third-party services.
  • Experience working with relational databases or application data.

title: Grounds & Property Operations Supervisor
description:
Grounds & Property Operations Supervisor

Lutheran Life Villages is seeking a Grounds & Property Operations Supervisor to lead the care, appearance, and day-to-day exterior operations across our communities. This is a hands-on working supervisor role for someone who enjoys being outdoors, takes pride in a job well done, and knows how to bring out the best in a team.

This role supervises and works alongside Property Technicians while overseeing groundskeeping, landscaping, seasonal maintenance, equipment, and exterior property needs across LLV’s campuses. From mowing and landscaping to seasonal cleanup and weather response, you’ll help ensure our communities are safe, welcoming, and beautifully maintained!

WHO YOU ARE

You are a hands-on leader, team builder, and problem solver who takes pride in creating safe, welcoming, and beautifully maintained surroundings. You’re not afraid to grab a mower, pick up a shovel, or work alongside your team—you lead by example and believe the best results come from being willing to get the job done together.

You understand that exceptional grounds and property operations require planning, organization, teamwork, attention to detail, and pride in the finished product. You know how to turn daily tasks into an efficient operation, develop productive work plans, care for equipment and resources, and bring out the best in your team.

You enjoy working outdoors, thrive in a hands-on environment, and take ownership of the appearance and upkeep of the communities you serve. You’re equally comfortable tackling routine maintenance, seasonal projects, weather-related needs, and unexpected challenges.

If you’re someone who leads from the front, builds a strong team, works efficiently, and takes pride in making a difference in the places people call home, we’d love to hear from you.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Lead from the Field

  • Supervise, train, schedule, and provide direction to Property Technicians.
  • Work alongside the team performing mowing, trimming, planting, mulching, pruning, landscaping, irrigation support, seasonal cleanup, and other grounds maintenance.
  • Establish consistent standards for the appearance, cleanliness, safety, and maintenance of exterior areas across LLV campuses.
  • Promote teamwork, accountability, safety, and continuous improvement.

Plan & Maximize the Work

  • Develop daily, weekly, and seasonal work schedules across multiple campuses.
  • Coordinate staffing and priorities based on weather, seasonal demands, and organizational needs.
  • Keep Property Technicians productively engaged during slower or off-season periods through equipment maintenance, campus projects, Building Services support, snow response, and other appropriate operational work.
  • Identify opportunities to improve labor efficiency and maximize the value of in-house resources.

Manage Equipment & Resources

  • Oversee groundskeeping equipment, vehicles, tools, parts, and supplies.
  • Coordinate equipment maintenance, repairs, replacement, and safe operation.
  • Assist with purchasing materials, supplies, and equipment.
  • Ensure the team has the resources needed to complete work safely and efficiently.

Build an In-House Grounds Operation

  • Help transition appropriate landscaping and grounds work from outside contractors to LLV’s internal team.
  • Identify work that can be performed effectively in-house.
  • Develop staffing, tools, processes, schedules, and service standards to support self-performing operations.
  • Evaluate efficiency and cost-effectiveness of internal services compared with contracted work.

Support Across LLV

  • Partner with Property Management, Facility Services, Building Services, and campus leadership to coordinate priorities.
  • Provide labor support during off-season and lower-demand periods.
  • Assist with campus projects, light maintenance, equipment upkeep, minor repairs, and other operational needs.
  • Support weather-related response, including minor snow removal and salting of sidewalks, entrances, and pedestrian areas.
  • Coordinate with contracted vendors for major parking lot snow removal and salting services.

Keep Safety First

  • Ensure work is performed in accordance with LLV safety policies, OSHA requirements, infection control practices, and established procedures.
  • Identify and address safety hazards, equipment concerns, and property issues.
  • Promote safe equipment operation and working practices throughout the team.

Other Responsibilities: Participate in required meetings, coordination sessions, and planning discussions; support Property Management initiatives; and perform other duties as assigned. Support Lutheran Life Villages’ mission, vision, and values in all interactions and work.

    WHAT YOU NEED

    • High school diploma or GED required.
    • Minimum of 3 years of groundskeeping, landscaping, or related experience.
    • Previous supervisory or team leadership experience preferred.
    • Hands-on experience with mowing, landscaping, planting, pruning, mulching, seasonal cleanup, and routine grounds maintenance.
    • Experience with minor snow removal and salting support preferred.
    • Knowledge of landscaping practices, seasonal operations, and campus beautification.
    • Equipment operation and basic mechanical knowledge.
    • Strong organization, scheduling, and time-management skills.
    • Ability to coordinate work across multiple locations.
    • Effective communication and interpersonal skills.
    • A willingness and ability to perform physically demanding, hands-on outdoor work alongside your team.

    Preferred: Relevant training or certifications in landscaping, horticulture, equipment operation, facilities management, landscape design, or related areas.

    WHY JOIN US?

    At Lutheran Life Villages, we bring our core values of Leadership, Impact, Friendship, and Excellence (LIFE) into every part of our work. Here, you’ll find the opportunity to contribute to an organization dedicated to providing exceptional care for seniors while fostering a supportive, collaborative environment for its staff. Our commitment to Leadership means empowering our team members to grow personally and professionally, inspiring others by example. We’re passionate about making a meaningful Impact in the lives of our residents and nurturing relationships built on Friendship and compassion. By pursuing Excellence in all we do, our employees share our mission to deliver outstanding care.

    As a valued member of the LLV team, you’ll enjoy a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth and well-being. With offerings from medical, dental, and vision insurance to paid time off on your birthday, paid holidays, tuition reimbursement, and retirement matching, we’re committed to helping you thrive. Join us on a purposeful journey where your career and compassion come together!

title: Engineering Technician B
description:
L3Harris is dedicated to recruiting and developing high-performing talent who are passionate about what they do. Our employees are unified in a shared dedication to our customers’ mission and quest for professional growth. L3Harris provides an inclusive, engaging environment designed to empower employees and promote work-life success. Fundamental to our culture is an unwavering focus on values, dedication to our communities, and commitment to excellence in everything we do.

L3Harris is the Trusted Disruptor in defense tech. With customers’ mission-critical needs always in mind, our employees deliver end-to-end technology solutions connecting the space, air, land, sea and cyber domains in the interest of national security.

**_Job Title: Engineering Technician B_**

**_Job Code: 45901_**

**_Job Location: Palm Bay, Florida_**

**_Job Schedule: 9/80, 1st shift_**

**Job Description:**

_This opportunity is for an Engineering Technician position with the L3Harris Environmental Test Laboratory. Candidate will set up and execute environmental testing projects designed to take L3Harris products to the limit of their functional and structural design. Candidate will learn to operate climatic chambers designed to replicate the freezing temperatures of earth poles, the scorching temperatures of the deserts, the humidity of the jungles, the altitudes of the skies, and the frigid vacuum of space. Similarly, the candidate will learn to operate electrodynamic shakers where harsh vibration environments are reproduced to test products for their survivability to transportation, gun fire, aircraft-carrier arrests, and rocket launch conditions. Candidate will be working in a team orientated environment in a laboratory that runs year-round._

_Activities include (but are not limited to) the handling and manipulation of extreme high value hardware, installation of instrumentation such as thermocouples and accelerometers, programming of test chamber computer control systems, monitoring of data acquisition systems, monitoring/controlling chamber/shaker performance._

**_This position is for 1stshift (7am-4:30pm) with the occasional need for overtime to support customer demands._**

**Essential Functions:**

- Set up, operate, and execute environmental exposure tests in accordance with approved procedures and test requirements on high-technology, high-value defense hardware.
- Continuously monitor active test events to verify compliance with established operating parameters, safety requirements, and test limits.
- Identify, troubleshoot, and respond to test anomalies or out-of-limit conditions to stabilize ongoing test activities and minimize impact to hardware, schedule, and data integrity.
- Support failure reporting, anomaly documentation, and investigative activities by capturing relevant test data, observations, and event details.
- Collaborate with engineering, quality, and test personnel to ensure accurate test execution, issue resolution, and completion of required documentation.

- This position may require overtime work depending on critical milestones.
- On-the-job training will be given regardless of experience level.

**Qualifications:**

- Requires developing job knowledge/skills. Requires a High School Diploma or equivalent and a minimum of 4 years of prior relevant Aerospace experience or 2 years post-Secondary/Associates Degree with 0 to 2 years of prior related experience.

**Preferred Additional Skills:**

- Soft skills (I.E. Proficient in MS Office, Strong communication…)
- Experience operating thermal chambers, vibration shakers, or thermal-vacuum systems to evaluate product performance.
- Experience conducting MIL-STD-810 testing.
- Active Security Clearance is a plus
- Experience working with people in either a customer service role or a role that required strong communication, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills.

Position Summary: The Executive Director of Finance is responsible for developing and executing financial organizational strategies for the Evermore brand. Will manage financial and accounting information, controlling assets, internal audits, operating budget, capital expenditure budget, critical measurements, quality control, thorough analysis reporting, strategic thinking, and establishing critical measurements that will drive revenue and achieve financial strategic goals. Will report directly to the Managing Director of the resort, providing financial insights and updates regularly, and partner with the Dart ownership CFO to ensure the program is designed to meet strategic objectives and operational requirements and is positioned for successful adoption across the resort.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the development of financial objectives in line with the resort's strategic goals.
  • Monitor and direct the implementation of strategic business plans in partnership with the Managing Director.
  • Responsible for end-to-end program governance, executive stakeholder management, and the integrated delivery of all workstreams, including ERP implementation, service delivery model transformation, process standardization, data governance, and change management.
  • Serve as the executive leader for Evermore's ERP and finance transformation initiative, overseeing program governance, integrated delivery across workstreams (ERP implementation, process standardization, data governance, and change management), program budget and capex governance, and coordination with the ERP vendor, system integrator, and advisory partners.
  • Assist Asset Management (ownership) as needed with financial modelling on existing assets, development opportunities, and potential acquisitions.
  • Produce timely and accurate financial and analytical reports for executive, asset, operational, and financial management teams.
  • Oversee the planning and execution of capital expenses for the resort. This includes making investment decisions, budgeting, and ensuring that capital projects are completed within budget and timelines.
  • Plan, facilitate, review, distribute, and/or present budgeting and cash forecasting activities and reports.
  • Guide department leaders in business strategy, budgeting, and forecasting. Establish and manage procedures to work collaboratively with the department managers to ensure that their financial reports accurately reflect the operational activities and that variances from budgets are appropriately captured, investigated, and reported.
  • Assist in the development, documentation, implementation, and compliance aspects of an effective internal controls system, including written policies, standard operating procedures, and forms.
  • Assist in cash management and treasury activities, including banking, funding, debt, and intercompany transfers.
  • Coordinate the maintenance and support of IT systems, applications, access, and controls with responsible parties to ensure efficient, secure, and productive use of resources and equipment.
  • Establish procedures for effectively managing intercompany transactions and allocations.
  • Prepare monthly financial statements, along with full working papers for the consolidated group of companies in accordance with US GAAP.
  • Oversee and support the Resort Director of Accounting in managing the accounting operations.

  • Oversee and support the Resort Director of Accounting in managing the accounting operations.

  • Lead and support Evermore’s accounting team, including hiring, training, performance evaluation, and professional development of the staff.

  • Auditing: Will audit the resort's financial records for accuracy and compliance, and subject to periodic operations audits to maintain financial integrity and transparency.
  • Collaborate with Hilton, corporate, and Conrad leadership team to ensure the financial direction aligns with Evermore’s operation strategy, execution, and goal setting.
  • Be a visible leader to all operations teams, attend events, and interact with guests and team members.
  • Develop and maintain collaborative relationships with peers.
  • Must be willing to work some weekends and evenings, with occasional travel expected.
  • Stay up to date on the hospitality industry in the resort/vacation rental space for benchmarking and new ideas, and be active in key industry organizations.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education, Skills, and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field, preferably with a master’s degree or an MBA.
  • 10+ years of resort/hospitality finance experience in a high-volume resort with a preference for luxury, independents, similar vacation homes, and golf resorts.
  • Expertise in managing property taxes and capital expenses for large properties.
  • Strong financial acumen and the ability to analyze and interpret financial data, create budgets, and make strategic financial decisions.
  • Clear and effective communication skills, both written and verbal, are crucial for presenting financial information to stakeholders and interacting with team members, management, and ownership.
  • Excellent leadership and management skills to effectively oversee the accounting team and collaborate with other departments.
  • Capacity to think critically and problem-solve, especially when dealing with complex financial matters.
  • Proficiency in contract negotiations and vendor management.
  • A keen eye for detail is essential for accurate financial reporting and compliance.
  • The ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Familiarity with financial software, accounting systems, and enterprise resource planning (ERP) tools.
  • Certified Public Accountant (CPA) designation and expertise in accounting and financial management.
  • Resonate with the Evermore brand and values and carry them daily.

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive hand motions, such as typing.
  • Able to sit and perform deskwork for hours at a time.
  • Must be able to lift 25 pounds.
  • Able to stand, walk long distances, stoop, kneel, bend, and/or reach periodically.
  • Able to be on feet and moving around for entire shift

Evermore Culture

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. title: Research Scientist, Benchmarks & Evals
description:
ABOUT KLED

Kled is building the largest opt-in human data network in the world.

We are not a labeling firm. We are not a task marketplace.

We are a consumer application where people upload their real photos, videos, and documents and get paid continuously.

We then filter, standardize, and license that data to frontier AI labs and enterprises that need fresh, rights-aware training data.

Since launching our mobile app in 2026, we have:

• Reached #1 on the App Store (Finance) with 0 paid marketing
• Scaled to 600,000+ active data contributors
• Processed 5M uploads per day
• Raised $15M+ from investors behind SpaceX, Airbnb, Coinbase, xAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, Spotify, Lyft, Uber, and more

Our mission is to let anyone download the app and earn a real living wage from uploading their data.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Research Scientist - Benchmarks & Evals

AI labs buy data when a benchmark shows it works.

You’ll build the benchmarks that show what one of the largest human data networks in the world can do for frontier AI models.

You will:

- Design and ship public benchmarks for image, video and document models

- Build private test sets from real, opt-in data that no model has trained on

- Run data-value experiments: train models with and without Kled data, measure what changes

- Design human evaluation studies and the automatic metrics that track them

- Publish leaderboards and reports that researchers at frontier labs trust

- Find where models fall short and tell our team what data to collect next

- Work directly with the founders and lab buyers to turn results into data deals

WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- 3+ years ML research or research engineering experience

- A benchmark or evaluation you built that other people actually used

- Strong hands-on experience training and fine-tuning image or video models (PyTorch)

- Deep understanding of experimental design and statistics (controls, ablations, human studies)

- Experience running experiments end to end, from GPUs to final report

- Clear writing for both researchers and buyers

Bonus:

- Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR or CVPR (datasets and benchmarks especially)

- Experience on an evaluation or data team at an AI lab

- Experience selling or licensing data to AI labs

- Experience with data valuation or data attribution research

CURRENT STACK

Research

- Python / PyTorch

- Open-weight image and video models

- Cloud GPUs

Data

- Hundreds of millions of opt-in photos, videos and documents

- PostgreSQL (Supabase)

- S3 storage

COMPENSATION

- Base salary: $150,000 - $250,000

- $350,000 – $750,000 equity

We move fast and work hard.

If you're excited to build the benchmarks that decide what data trains frontier AI, let’s talk!

GROWTH OPPORTUNITY

You’ll join a team operating at the frontier of applied AI data infrastructure.

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to:

• Own core systems that power one of the largest human data networks in the world
• Design infrastructure that directly influences what data trains next-generation AI models
• Build at real scale - millions of uploads per day, adversarial environments, global contributors
• Ship alongside a team that has built marketplaces, AI systems, and products used by millions

If you’re excited to move fast, build systems that matter, and help define how human data powers frontier AI, let’s talk.

title: Data & AI Engineer
description:
Overview

Are you a Data Engineer or Architect who likes taking an idea all the way to production, close to the business and without waiting for a finished spec? Are you equally at home with data pipelines, agentic AI solutions and enterprise IT? Then this role might be just right for you.

Nortal is looking for a hands-onData & AI Engineer to join our team and work at a large Finnish industrial sector company, strengthening the execution of their data and AI programme. You will sit inside the client's team and take prioritised business use cases from scoping to production, so that ideas reach production and start delivering value within weeks. You will work alongside the client's data, AI, platform and architecture specialists, and AI-assisted and agentic development (Claude Code or similar) is a core part of how the work is done.

The role covers a lot of ground, from data pipelines to agentic AI and enterprise IT, and breadth is what makes it interesting. Your first assignments could include, for example, migrating business pipelines onto the data platform, transaction monitoring, and FinOps and AI usage reporting with Entra integrations and dashboards.

What you will do

  • Take business use cases from scoping to production, working closely with business stakeholders and technical teams.
  • Design, build and productionise data pipelines and prepare data for downstream use.
  • Build agentic AI solutions on top of the data platform.
  • Work with the client's data, AI, platform and architecture experts to make solutions fit the wider enterprise environment.
  • Own both the design and the hands-on delivery, and keep things moving even when the full picture isn't clear yet.

What will help you to succeed

  • Strong data engineering skills: designing, building and productionising pipelines.
  • Experience with Databricks or a comparable platform, and the ability to pick it up quickly.
  • Solid data modelling skills.
  • Hands-on AI engineering experience with agentic solutions, such as LLM APIs, agent frameworks and orchestration, tool calling, RAG and MCP.
  • General enterprise IT understanding: networking, identity and access management (Entra), cloud (GCP or Azure), APIs and integrations, and security practices.
  • Taking ownership: you can make progress without a finished spec and communicate clearly with both business and technical people.
  • Good English skills. Finnish or Swedish is a plus.

Nice to have:

ML or data science, BI and dashboards, DataOps or MLOps, and integration platforms such as Frends.

Location

worth being clear about: the role is on-site at the client's Helsinki office, with flexibility agreed case by case. The whole working model depends on being physically close to the business, so this isn't one that can be done fully remote.

Why join us?

  • You'll work on real, high-impact data and AI projects with some of the leading companies in Finland. You get to work with business-critical systems and take real ownership of what you build.
  • We value individuals not just for their skills, but also for their cultural alignment. Our core values include a commitment to delivering value and results, taking ownership, empowering oneself and others, and owning your future and growth. In addition to our professionalism, we appreciate a touch of good humor!
  • We prioritize your growth and development. At Nortal, we actively support constant improvement and knowledge sharing through our Capability teams, both internal and external training opportunities, self-learning, a mentorship program, and strong 1:1 culture.
  • We prioritize your health and well-being by offering a flexible range of benefits, including adaptable working hours, access to high-quality occupational healthcare, massage services, and bicycle benefit.

Nortal values equality and diversity in our work community. We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, such as in regard to age, gender, culture or minority group.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

AYES, multinazionale di consulenza ingegneristica e tecnologica, in vista dell’espansione delle proprie attività in Italia e all’estero, è alla ricerca di un DevOps Engineer per potenziare il proprio team in zona Varese, su un progetto ad alto contenuto tecnologico nel settore biomedicale.

AYES opera a livello globale, offrendo soluzioni avanzate e progetti innovativi nei settori più affermati dell’industria: Automotive, Aerospazio e Difesa, Ferroviario, Energia, Oil & Gas, Life Sciences e Telecomunicazioni. Responsabilità principali:

  • Gestione, configurazione e automazione delle infrastrutture IT;
  • Sviluppo e manutenzione di procedure di Infrastructure as Code (IaC) mediante Terraform;
  • Automazione delle attività di configurazione e provisioning attraverso Ansible;
  • Creazione, configurazione e gestione di ambienti containerizzati tramite Docker;
  • Supporto alla gestione e all’ottimizzazione degli ambienti di sviluppo, test e produzione;
  • Supporto ai processi di deployment e rilascio delle applicazioni;
  • Monitoraggio e troubleshooting degli ambienti infrastrutturali;
  • Collaborazione con i team Software e IT per garantire affidabilità, scalabilità e continuità operativa dei sistemi;
  • Redazione e aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica relativa alle configurazioni e alle infrastrutture.
  • Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Informatica o discipline affini;
  • Esperienza in attività DevOps, Infrastructure o System Engineering;
  • Buona conoscenza di Ansible;
  • Buona conoscenza di Terraform;
  • Buona conoscenza di Docker e dei principi di containerizzazione;
  • Familiarità con sistemi operativi Linux;
  • Conoscenza dei principi di Infrastructure as Code e automazione infrastrutturale;
  • Buona conoscenza della lingua italiana e inglese;
  • Buone capacità di problem solving, troubleshooting, teamwork e gestione delle priorità.

Costituiscono un plus:

  • Esperienza professionale nel settore Biomedicale, Medical Devices o Life Sciences;
  • Conoscenza di strumenti e processi CI/CD;
  • Esperienza con piattaforme Cloud;
  • Conoscenza di sistemi di orchestrazione dei container, come Kubernetes;
