title: Analista/ Técnico/a de Validación y Transferencia de Métodos Analíticos
description:
This is where your work makes a difference.

At Baxter, we believe every person—regardless of who they are or where they are from—deserves a chance to live a healthy life. It was our founding belief in 1931 and continues to be our guiding principle. We are redefining healthcare delivery to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

Our Baxter colleagues are united by our Mission to Save and Sustain Lives. Together, our community is driven by a culture of courage, trust, and collaboration. Every individual is empowered to take ownership and make a meaningful impact. We strive for efficient and effective operations, and we hold each other accountable for delivering exceptional results.

Here, you will find more than just a job—you will find purpose and pride.

Sobre el puesto


Buscamos incorporar un/a Analista o Técnico/a (según experiencia) de Laboratorio al equipo de Transferencia y Validación de Métodos Analíticos en nuestra planta de Sabiñánigo, para desempeñar un papel clave en la incorporación robusta y fiable de métodos analíticos al entorno productivo.


Esta posición ofrece la oportunidad de trabajar en un entorno altamente técnico y colaborativo, participando activamente en estudios de transferencia y validación, asegurando el cumplimiento de los más altos estándares de calidad y GMP, y colaborando con equipos internacionales en un entorno farmacéutico innovador y en constante evolución.


¿Qué harás?

  • Revisar y analizar métodos analíticos y protocolos de transferencia y/o validación desarrollados por el área de I+D, asegurando su viabilidad, robustez y correcta implementación en el entorno productivo.
  • Gestionar el aprovisionamiento y control de reactivos y materiales de laboratorio, garantizando su disponibilidad y adecuación para la ejecución de los estudios de transferencia.
  • Colaborar de forma continua con equipos de I+D en diferentes plantas de Baxter, participando activamente en la preparación, revisión y aprobación final de protocolos e informes, así como dando soporte técnico durante la ejecución de los test.
  • Ejecutar los tests de transferencia de métodos analíticos de acuerdo con los protocolos aprobados, cumpliendo estrictamente con las Buenas Prácticas de Fabricación (GMP) y los procedimientos internos aplicables.
  • Asegurar el correcto uso, verificación y mantenimiento de los equipos de laboratorio, especialmente aquellos empleados en análisis instrumentales, contribuyendo a la fiabilidad y reproducibilidad de los resultados.
  • Participar en la validación de nuevos equipos de laboratorio, aportando conocimiento técnico durante su puesta en marcha y asegurando su adecuación para los ensayos de transferencia analítica.
  • Adicionalmente, aquellos cualificados como técnicos/as participarán en la revisión de informes de resultados y proporcionarán apoyo y formación cuando sea necesario al equipo de analistas.

Buscamos profesionales que tengan:

  • Experiencia y conocimientos técnicos en análisis químicos e instrumentales, con dominio de HPLC, preferiblemente marca Waters, y manejo de Software Empower indispensable.
  • Formación en Química, ciclo superior o grado universitario, y una base sólida para el trabajo en laboratorio analítico dentro de un entorno regulado.
  • Conocimiento de otras técnicas como LC‑MS o GC será valorado positivamente.
  • Trayectoria previa en transferencia y validación de métodos analíticos, idealmente en la industria farmacéutica, química o de entornos GMP similares, es considerado ventajoso.
  • Capacidad para comunicarse en inglés en un entorno profesional,especialmente en contextos técnicos, para interactuar con equipos internacionales y colaborar con áreas de I+D externas a la planta.
  • Orientación al trabajo en equipo, atención al detalle y un enfoque analítico que permita proponer soluciones de forma estructurada.
  • Actitud proactiva y resiliente, con motivación por afrontar nuevos retos técnicos en un entorno dinámico y exigente.

¿Por qué quieres trabajar en Baxter?

  • Paquete de compensación total competitivo, que incluye salario acorde al mercado y opciones de retribución flexible como programas de descuentos para empleados y otras iniciativas pensadas para adaptarse a las distintas etapas de la vida personal y profesional.
  • Oportunidades de desarrollo y crecimiento profesional con acceso a oportunidades de formación, aprendizaje en entornos altamente técnicos y posibilidades reales de evolución dentro de una compañía global.

title: Adjunct Instructor of Biological Sciences
description:
Ohio University Regional Campuses are seeking part-time instructors to teach **Biological Sciences** courses at the undergraduate level **in-person** at the **Lancaster and Eastern campuses**. The exact number of Instructors needed is undetermined at this time as it is primarily dependent upon enrollments and overall student demand. When a need arises, the department will select qualified candidates from this pool.

Preference will be given to applicants who can teach the following **in-person** sections at **Lancaster** and **Eastern**:

- BIOS 1300 (Principles of Human Anatomy and Physiology I)
- BIOS 1310 (Principles of Human Anatomy and Physiology II)

**Lancaster- in person:**

- BIOS 1030 (Human Biology)
- BIOL 1010 (Principles of Biology, lecture)

BIOS 1030: For nonmajors. Humans as biological organisms: our origins, ecology, and inheritance, and functioning of our body systems.

BIOS 1300: Introduction to the structure and function of the human body using chemicals, cells, tissues, to study the integumentary, skeletal, muscular and nervous systems.

BIOS 1310: is a continuation of the BIOS 1300 series, the second course in a 2-course introduction to the structure and function of the human body, featuring study and critical-thinking evaluation of the endocrine, cardiovascular, lymphatic & immune, respiratory, gastrointestinal, urinary and reproductive systems.

BIOL 1010: Non-science majors explore living organisms from the cellular to ecosystem levels, using scientific information and laboratory exercises to understand historic discovery and contemporary issues in biology and evolutionary processes.

Position will include teaching from 3 credit hours to up to 11 credit hours per term.

title: Coder, ProFee
description:
About the Job



Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!

At Ovation Healthcare (formerly QHR Health), we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.


The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.


We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.


Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .

Summary:

Ovation Healthcare company is seeking a Pro-Fee, Coder. This role, under general direction, is responsible for coding and abstracting of diagnoses and charging for procedures from medical records for optimal and timely reimbursement and quality reporting.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Assigns ICD-10-CM codes, and CPT/HCPCS codes for various specialty service accounts, including but not limited to diagnoses, provider level evaluation & management (E/M) charges, and additional CPT-4 procedures.
  • Abstracts key data elements required for billing, regulatory agencies, and other databases.
  • Reviews records for clinical pertinence and documentation to support accurate facility and provider-based charges for services performed during the encounter.
  • Communicates with providers for clarification of documentation to ensure appropriate assignment of diagnoses, procedures, and/or facility and provider evaluation/management (E/M) levels.
  • Reviews and resolves claim edits related to emergency department encounters to ensure compliant billing, including but not limited to medical necessity and NCCI/CCI edits.
  • Assists with resolution of simple visit coding errors related to other outpatient visits as needed.
  • Demonstrates courtesy and professionalism through interaction, appearance, attitude, and written and oral communications with visitors, co-workers, physicians, and other hospital personnel as to represent the Medical Records Services as a high-quality service area of the Hospitals.
  • Maintains patient confidentiality as required by Hospitals/departmental policy and industry/legal standards.
  • Acknowledges and supports Hospitals defined goals and approach to patient care; attends regular training sessions to improve patient and customer communications.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Skill in prioritizing and performing a variety of duties within a system that has frequently changing assignments, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Ability to impart knowledge of procedures and techniques.
  • Thorough working knowledge of ICD-10-CM and CPT coding systems, and federal/state regulations regarding reimbursement.
  • Thorough working knowledge of the hospital information system, electronic medical record systems, and encoder.
  • Working knowledge of standards for chart completion.
  • Maintains Continuing Education credits in accordance with the American Health Information Management Association's and/or American Academy of Professional Coders’ requirements based upon certification(s).
  • Performs qualitative analysis of records in accordance with regulatory standards and coding requirements using CPT/HCPCS and ICD-10-CM guidelines.
  • Working knowledge of medical-legal rules and regulations that govern the confidentiality and release of medical information with the ability to interpret and implement the standards.
  • Must maintain total confidentiality of all patient records.
  • Must be comfortable working with AR teams to resolve issues.
  • Must be able to pass a coding assessment.
  • Must be proficient in Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Teams.
  • Ability to multi-task and have excellent communication skills.
  • Must meet and maintain a 95% quality accuracy rate and productivity standards.
  • Must have experience working in a remote environment.

Work Experience, Education, and Certifications:

  • RHIT, RHIA, CEDC, COC, CPC, CCS-P or CCS Credentials
  • Three or more years of Coding experience

100% Remote



Benefits


The base compensation range for this position is:


$49,603.71 - $74,405.56



Compensation ranges could be hourly or salary depending upon the exempt status of the posted position.


Beginning compensation is determined based on objective factors such as location, qualifications, skills, certifications, and experience. Typically, a candidate is hired in the lower to midpoint of the range; the top end of the range is reserved for candidates with extensive specialized experience and mastery within the role. Compensation may increase over time based on performance, experience, and tenure.


Compensation is only part of Ovation's total compensation package. Some additional benefits offered to full-time associates are:

  • Comprehensive health and wellness benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short and long-term disability coverage
  • HSA with employer contributions, flexible spending accounts for health care, and dependent care accounts
  • Wellness platform with premium incentives
  • Employee assistance support and additional voluntary supplemental plans including accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, and child disability insurance
  • Robust and flexible paid time off offerings and company paid holidays
  • 401(k) plan with discretionary employer match opportunities
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Company issued equipment

title: Data Centre Network-ACI Engineer & Architect
description:
Employer: Millennium Technology Services (MTS)

We are seeking Data Centre Network Engineers and Architects to support enterprise customer projects in Indonesia, focusing on Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) design, deployment and operational support.

Candidates will be considered for Engineer or Architect positions based on their experience and design capabilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement and support ACI and Nexus data centre network solutions.
  • Configure and troubleshoot ACI fabrics, including APIC, spine/leaf switches, tenants, VRFs, bridge domains, EPGs, contracts and L3Out connectivity.
  • Support network deployments, migrations, upgrades and integration with existing infrastructure.
  • Troubleshoot routing, switching, fabric connectivity and performance issues.
  • Work with customers to understand requirements and provide technical recommendations.
  • Prepare implementation plans, technical documentation, change procedures and operational handover materials.
  • Collaborate with security, server, storage and virtualisation teams.
  • Support network automation and operational improvements.

Additional Responsibilities for Architects

  • Lead solution architecture and develop high-level and low-level designs.
  • Define fabric topology, segmentation, resilience and external connectivity.
  • Lead technical workshops, design reviews and migration planning.
  • Assess technical risks and guide engineers throughout implementation.

Requirements

  • Relevant data centre networking experience, with hands-on ACI deployment or support experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Nexus switches, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, VXLAN and high-availability designs.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex issues in enterprise customer environments.
  • Experience with network changes, implementation documentation and incident resolution.
  • Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English.
  • For Architect applicants: proven experience designing ACI solutions and leading implementations.

Joker er den lokale butikken både der folk bor og ferierer, og vi er den kjeden som har flest søndagsåpne butikker. Vi er møteplassen i byen og på bygda. Vi var først med å løfte frem kjøpmennene som våre fremste talspersoner, og vi mener at våre kjøpmenn og deres ansatte leverer personlig og god service hver dag.

title: Claims and Coding Denial Analyst
description:
St. Luke's is proud of the skills, experience and compassion of its employees. The employees of St. Luke's are our most valuable asset! Individually and together, our employees are dedicated to satisfying the mission of our organization which is an unwavering commitment to excellence as we care for the sick and injured; educate physicians, nurses and other health care providers; and improve access to care in the communities we serve, regardless of a patient's ability to pay for health care.

HOURS:


FT, 40 hours/week, Days

Mon-Fri, days- hours flexible after training at manager's discretion
Home location at St. Luke's Center, Allentown, PA with the opportunity for remote or hybrid remote work, available after at least 6 months on site, at manager's discretion, for local ( PA or NJ) candidates only.

Obstetrics and Gynecology coding experience preferred.

CPC required




The Claim and Denial Coding Analyst role is a Certified Medical Coder who ensures clean claim submission and timely review and resolution of coding related claim denials for professional services, FQHC, MSO, and ASCs across the network. Utilizes provider documentation and queries, coding software tools and Insurance carrier medical and reimbursement policies during the claim review process.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain current knowledge of coding, compliance, and documentation guidelines

  • Resolve Charge Review and Claim Edit CCI/LCD edits, diagnosis coding errors and MUE frequency for clean claim submission

  • Resolve coding denials through claim correction or appeal. Claim corrections will be made after review of supporting documentation, CCI/LCD, carrier policy and utilization of coding software applications. The appeals process may include collaboration with the Claim Editing Manager, Physician, Specialty Coder, AR specialist or Auditor/Educator. Demonstrate the ability to formulate an appeal rationale based on clinical documentation, application of LCD, relative carrier policy and published Academy or Societal guidance

  • Provide coding guidance to providers and charge entry staff for single or low volume errors. Report high volume coding denial trends to the coordinator

  • Maintain meticulous documentation, spreadsheets, account, and claim examples of root cause issues. Performs searches of governmental, payor-specific, guidelines to identify and coding and billing requirements to make recommendations

  • Review TCM Charge Review encounters to verify the documentation supports all required TCM components. Relevel TCM service when not supported by the documentation or TCM has been rendered during another TCM 30-day period

  • Attends coding conferences, workshops, and in house sessions to receive updated coding information and changes in coding and/or regulations

  • Assists with training new staff in all aspects of the Analyst role.

PHYSICAL AND SENSORY REQUIREMENTS:

Sitting for up to 8 hours per day, 3 hours at a time. Standing and walking as necessary. Fingering and handling frequently, twisting and turning of hands occasionally. Pushing and pulling. Occasionally stoops, bends, squats, kneels and reach above shoulder level. Hearing as it relates to normal conversation. Seeing as it relates to general and near vision.

EDUCATION:

CPC or CCA certification required.

TRAINING AND EXPERIENCE:

At least 2 years of active E&M and/or Surgical Coding experience required. Must possess a comprehensive knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT and HCPCS coding. Knowledge and experience in dealing with third party insurance companies relative to claim processing and coding denials follow up. Epic Resolute experience helpful

Please complete your application using your full legal name and current home address. Be sure to include employment history for the past seven (7) years, including your present employer. Additionally, you are encouraged to upload a current resume, including all work history, education, and/or certifications and licenses, if applicable. It is highly recommended that you create a profile at the conclusion of submitting your first application. Thank you for your interest in St. Luke's!!

St. Luke's University Health Network is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

A Presidential proclamation issued on September 19, 2025, imposes a $100,000 fee on new H-1B petitions filed after September 21, 2025. Please be advised that Texas A&M University will NOT pay this fee. Therefore, if you need immigration sponsorship for your employment, we recommend that you consult with your private immigration counsel at your own expense to ascertain whether your current immigration status would make a potential offer of employment from Texas A&M University subject to this fee.

In addition, on January 27, 2026, Texas Governor Abbot issued a moratorium on the filing of any new H-1B unless approved by the Texas Workforce Commission. Accordingly, if you will now or in the future require sponsorship for employment visa status this moratorium may affect our ability to employ you should you be selected as the final candidate.


SUMMARY:

The School of Music at East Texas A&M invites applicants for a full-time, tenure-track Assistant/Associate Professor in Music (Director of Bands and Instrumental Activities). The successful candidate will provide artistic, academic, and programmatic leadership for the University's band program while contributing to teaching, Research, Scholarship, and Creative Activities (RSCA), recruitment, outreach, and service. The position includes a reduced teaching load to accommodate administrative duties, in consultation annually with the Director of the School of Music.

The School of Music at East Texas A&M serves approximately 240 music majors across instrumental, vocal, and keyboard areas and is fully accredited by the National Association of Schools of Music (NASM). It offers baccalaureate and master's degrees in music education and performance, and a Bachelor of Arts in Music. The School of Music is housed in a $30 million music building completed in 2010 containing state-of-the-art recital and concert halls, studios, rehearsal halls, classrooms, and teaching areas.

The band program includes three concert bands, two jazz ensembles, and marching and athletic bands. The Wind Ensemble has performed at both regional and national College Band Directors National Association Conferences as well as the Texas Music Educators Association Clinic/Convention, most recently in 2018. The Wind Ensemble is also actively involved in commissioning and premiering new works from the nation’s leading composers. The Marching Band performs at all home games as well as exhibitions at marching contests such as the Texas State UIL Marching Band Contest and Bands of America Regionals and Grand Nationals Marching Festival.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Conduct the Wind Ensemble (top ensemble)
  • Teach Graduate and Undergraduate Conducting
  • Teach graduate coursework in instrumental repertoire and pedagogy
  • Teach additional courses based upon the candidate’s area of expertise
  • Organize and administer a comprehensive university band program including concert ensembles, marching band, jazz ensembles and athletic bands
  • Provide overall leadership of the band staff and instrumental faculty, as well as program development
  • Supervise budget management and fiscal responsibilities for division needs
  • Recruit for the band and university at the regional and state level
  • Promote the band and university at regional, state and national events
  • Participate in creative and/or research activities consistent with all faculty appointments
  • Participate in service activities consistent with all faculty appointments
  • Other duties as assigned by the Director of the School of Music
  • Participate in service activities consistent with all faculty appointments

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

· Education: Doctorate in Music Education, Conducting, or a closely related field from an accredited institution; equivalent university experience and demonstrated achievement maybe considered in lieu of the doctorate

· Experience / Knowledge / Skills: At least three (3) years of experience as either a Director or Assistant Director of Bands at the university level

· Ability to: Multi-task and work well as part of a team, manage budgets associated with an R2 institution, coordinate department-wide recruiting activities


PREFERRED EDUCATION / SKILLS/ EXPERIENCE:

  • At least five (5) years of experience in university teaching

APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS:

  • Letter of application that addresses the position qualifications
  • Curriculum vitae
  • Selected repertoire list from the last five years
  • A brief (one page) statement of teaching philosophy
  • A brief (one page) statement of professional activity and goals (research and/or performance)
  • Transcripts (unofficial and scanned copies are acceptable)
  • The names and contact information for three professional references (at least one must be able to address teaching experience and teaching effectiveness; please indicate the teaching reference in your letter of application).
  • At this time, please only upload the required documents listed above; semi-finalists may be asked to submit video recordings of their conducting in performance and rehearsal, and/or teaching.

Review of candidates will begin on November 2nd, 2026.

All positions are security-sensitive. Applicants are subject to a criminal history investigation, and employment is contingent upon the institution’s verification of credentials and/or other information required by the institution’s procedures, including the completion of the criminal history check.

title: Puheterapeutti, Terapiamerkurius Oy, Tampere
description:
Etsimme nyt Tampereen tiimiimme puheterapeuttia, jonka asiakaskunta koostuu perusterveydenhuollon maksusitoumuksin ja Kelan päätöksellä olevista asiakkaista. Tällä hetkellä työ on vielä hyvin liikkuvaa, joten omasta autosta on etua. Osin on mahdollista tehdä myös etäterapiaa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle työntekijänä:

  • Vapaa kouluttautuminen

  • Viikoittaiset case-työnohjaukset pienryhmissä

  • Vapaus suunnitella oma kalenteri niin asiakasmäärien kuin työaikojen osalta

  • Itsenäinen työnkuva, jossa kuitenkin vankka matalan kynnyksen tuki ja apu

  • Moniammatillinen työyhteisö

  • Mahdollisuus keskittyä vain terapiaan ilman toimistotöitä, sillä tukitiimi hoitaa kaiken muun

Mitä edellytämme sinulta:

  • Laillistetun puheterapeutin pätevyyttä, mutta voit olla myös loppuvaiheen opiskelija

  • Tehtävään valitun on esitettävä rikostaustaote alaikäisten kanssa toimimiseen

Tietoa meistä:

Terapiamerkurius on savonlinnalainen yritys, joka tuottaa puheterapiaa, toimintaterapiaa, ratsastusterapiaa, kommunikaatio-ohjausta, puhevammaisten tulkkausta sekä neuropsykiatrista valmennusta. Meillä on toimipiste Savonlinnan lisäksi myös Kempeleessä, Lahdessa, Tampereella ja Varkaudessa. Voit käydä tutustumassa meihin osoitteessa terapiamerkurius.com, Instagramissa tai Facebookissa.

Meidän sydämemme Terapiamerkuriuksessa palaa toiminnan laadulle ja asiakaslähtöisyydelle. Pyrimme olemaan aina hieman edellä aikaamme ja innovoimaan työtämme sekä työtapojamme jatkuvasti eteenpäin. Kouluttaudumme ahkerasti, koska haluamme tehdä työmme laadukkaasti, asiakkaan kannalta mahdollisimman tarkoituksenmukaisesti sekä tehokkaasti.

Työhyvinvointi on meille tärkeää ja pidämme henkilöstön jaksamisesta huolta. Jokaviikkoiset case-työnohjaukset auttavat meitä jaksamaan. Ajattelemme, että työssä jaksamista auttaa myös, että työajoista ja asiakasmääristä saa päättää itse. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että toimimme yhteisöohjautuvan TEAL-organisaation mallilla.

Meillä terapeutit saavat keskittyä terapioiden suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen, kun tukitiimi huolehtii kaikesta muusta, niin askartelusta, palautteiden lähettämisestä kuin koulutuksiin ilmoittautumisista puolestasi. Moniammatillisessa tiimissä pidämme huolta toisistamme ja jaamme ammatillisia neuvoja ja tukea yli ammattirajojen.

Me täällä Terapiamerkuriuksessa jo odottelemme yhteydenottoasi ja uutta kollegaa tiimiimme. Ota rohkeasti yhteyttä, niin jutellaan lisää!

Huomioithan, että käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja palkkaamme heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Postdoctoral Research Associate
description:
**Grade UE07: £41,064 - £48,822 per annum, pro rata if part-time**

**CMVM / School of Genetics and Cancer**

**Full-time: 35 hours per week**

**Fixed-term: 3 years**

**Where passion meets purpose. Be part of something bigger.**

We offer careers and roles in just about every area you can think of. Whether you’re looking to take the next step in your current specialism, explore a new challenge, or broaden your experience, we offer opportunities where you can flourish and make a real difference. Our people come from a wide range of backgrounds, each bringing their abilities and experiences to our organisation, helping us thrive and innovate together.

The University of Edinburgh is a world-class organisation. We look for the best in the field across all disciplines and provide a working environment where academics can develop their careers and passion for their chosen subject area. We offer the full range of academic roles and have a genuine focus on our student’s performance and wellbeing.

**The Opportunity:**

**Epigenetic regulation of stem/progenitor cells in growth and ageing**

We are seeking an enthusiastic cell biologist to join our research team as a postdoctoral researcher. Funded by an ERC Advanced Grant we aim to address fundamental mechanisms controlling tissue cellularity that result in epigenetic ageing and determine size in mammals.

We have discovered a new accelerated ageing syndrome, that links a cell intrinsic clock with both ageing and human size (Sarni et al. Nat Genet 2026). The project team will use stem cell culture systems, targeted epigenomic engineering, CRISPR barcoding and mouse models; to define mechanisms connecting DNA methylation at lineage-determining genes to profound changes in stem cell output and tissue regeneration. The long-term goal is to identify targetable cellular pathways for future therapies, and to shed light on how this DNA methylation clock could regulate size and longevity across mammalian evolution.

The post-holder will be part of a multidisciplinary team in the lab of Prof. Andrew Jackson FRS, working in a cross-disciplinary environment that addresses both fundamental cellular processes and disease mechanisms. The lab is based in the Institute of Genetics and Cancer, a highly collaborative and supportive environment.

The research group is internationally diverse and strongly competitive, consistently publishing in high-level journals. For further details on the research group:

[https://institute-genetics-cancer.ed.ac.uk/research/research-groups-a-z/a-jackson-group](https://institute-genetics-cancer.ed.ac.uk/research/research-groups-a-z/a-jackson-group)

title: QA Engineer
description:
Job Title: QA Engineer

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Required Skills: Automation Testing, QA

We’re looking for a QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and overall performance of our products. In this role, you’ll work closely with engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle. You’ll be responsible for testing new features, identifying and documenting issues, improving test coverage, and helping the team maintain a high standard of quality as we continue to build and ship quickly. The ideal candidate has strong manual testing fundamentals, hands-on experience with test automation, and a solid understanding of modern QA practices and software development lifecycles.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Own testing activities across new features, product improvements, and bug fixes.

  2. Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual test cases and test scenarios.

  3. Identify, document, track, and validate bugs throughout the development lifecycle.

  4. Build and maintain automated tests to improve regression coverage and overall testing efficiency.

  5. Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing across the product.

  6. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand requirements, identify potential risks, and ensure appropriate test coverage.

  7. Participate in Agile development processes, including planning, refinement, and release cycles.

  8. Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, testing practices, and overall product quality.

  9. Manage testing priorities and communicate blockers, risks, and findings throughout the development lifecycle.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience in software quality assurance within agile, fast-paced environments.

  • Strong expertise in manual testing methodologies, test planning, and test execution.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, maintaining, and executing automated tests and testing frameworks.

  • Proven experience performing functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.

  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, QA processes, and release validation.

  • Solid experience with bug-tracking systems, test management tools, and version control platforms.

  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, reproducing, and validating software defects.

  • Strong understanding of test coverage, regression strategies, and quality assurance best practices.

description:
Build your big career with the firm that does Big Law, Better. McDermott Will & Schulte is a leading global law firm that brings together more than 1,700+ lawyers and 1,400 business professionals. We celebrate excellence, collaboration, and community and have been recognized as a top workplace by USA Today, Fortune, The American Lawyer, Vault and others.   • A firm where everyone belongs: Our award-winning culture prioritizes warmth and authenticity — we encourage you to be yourself!

Job Description:

McDermott, Will & Schulte LLP is building one of the most ambitious AI programs in the legal industry — and quality is not an afterthought. As we deploy AI-powered solutions across legal practices and operational teams, we need someone who can own the full quality lifecycle: from unit tests and edge cases through system testing, performance, and CI/CD pipeline integration. The AI Solutions QA Analyst partners directly with our Analysts and engineering team to ensure every solution we ship is tested, reliable, and production-ready — leveraging AI itself to do it faster and more thoroughly than traditional QA ever could.

WHY MWS:

Shape quality standards for an entirely new category of legal AI solutions — from the ground up

Work with frontier AI tools to build and run tests faster than traditional QA methods allow

High-visibility role reporting to Director of QA with direct impact on every solution the team ships

Remote-first, technically rigorous team that takes production quality seriously

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Own the full QA lifecycle for AI-powered solutions — from unit and integration testing through system, performance, and scalability testing

Partner with Analysts to generate and evaluate test cases using AI-assisted tools, with particular focus on boundary conditions, edge cases, and AI output validation

Work with the engineering team to define and integrate automated test suites into the Azure DevOps CI/CD pipeline for each solution

Define system-level test strategies in collaboration with the Director of QA, covering functional, regression, and non-functional testing requirements

Coordinate with the dedicated security team to translate security testing guidance into solution-specific security test cases

Evaluate AI solution reliability across varied inputs — ensuring consistent, predictable behavior under real-world conditions

Maintain test documentation, defect tracking, and quality metrics that give leadership clear visibility into solution readiness

Champion a quality culture across the delivery team — making testing a natural part of the development workflow, not a gate at the end

WHAT YOU BRING:

4+ years of formal QA experience, including writing and executing test scripts across the full testing lifecycle

Strong experience with unit, integration, system, and regression testing — both manual and automated

Hands-on experience integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines; Azure DevOps experience strongly preferred

Demonstrated ability to design boundary and edge case tests for complex, data-driven applications

AI fluency — you use AI tools actively and can direct leading AI platforms to generate, evaluate, and refine test cases

Understanding of performance and scalability testing concepts; experience with load testing tools a plus

Solid grasp of defect tracking, test documentation, and quality metrics reporting

Strong analytical thinking — you approach untested AI behavior the way an engineer approaches an unknown system

BS in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent experience

Preferred:

Experience testing AI-powered applications — prompt-driven systems, agentic workflows, or LLM-integrated tools

Familiarity with AI-assisted test generation workflows and code-generating platforms

Exposure to security testing principles in collaboration with a dedicated security team

Experience in legal, financial services, or other regulated industry environments

Knowledge of Azure DevOps, including pipeline configuration and automated test integration

Successful candidates will be provided with outstanding career opportunities and will receive a competitive total rewards package with the opportunity to earn performance-based bonuses.

description:
Job Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989.
Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

We are looking for a Full Stack Engineer to design, develop, and support scalable cloud-native applications that power Workforce Management (WFM), Customer Experience (CX), and operational business processes. You will use Java and Spring Boot to develop scalable backend services, React with TypeScript to create responsive user experiences, and Node.js where appropriate for supporting components.
The role suits a hands‑on engineer with strong software development fundamentals who can take features from detailed technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and production support. Experience with Workforce Management (WFM), Customer Experience (CX), or contact center solutions is an advantage

Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable backend services using Java, Spring Boot, and established software engineering practices.
  • Build modern web applications using React, TypeScript, reusable components, responsive layouts, and accessible interaction patterns.
  • Develop and consume REST APIs using an API-first approach; maintain clear OpenAPI/Swagger contracts and error handling.
  • Contribute to the design of modular, maintainable solutions using microservices and appropriate object-oriented and event-driven design patterns.
  • Use Node.js where appropriate for lightweight services, backend-for-frontend components, integrations, or development tooling.
  • Contribute to the design and optimization ofPostgreSQL data models and queries with attention to integrity, performance, and audit history.
  • Implement and support reliable integrations with internal and external systems using REST APIs, webhooks, messaging, and other appropriate integration patterns.
  • Containerize applications and contribute to cloud-based deployment patterns, configuration management, and environment consistency.
  • Build and maintain Jenkins-based CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, quality gates, and repeatable deployments.
  • Instrument applications with structured logging, metrics, tracing, and actionable error reporting.
  • Troubleshoot functional and production issues and improve application performance, resilience, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Collaborate with Product, UX, QA, DevOps, Architecture, and other engineers through design sessions, code reviews, planning, and continuous improvement.
Qualifications
  • 5+ years of full-stack software development experience, including contribution to production applications.
  • Hands‑on experience with Java and Spring technologies, particularly Spring Boot, REST services, persistence, security, and automated testing.
  • Frontend development experience with Angular or React, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, component-based design, state management, and modern testing practices.
  • Familiarity with Node.js for lightweight services, integrations, build tooling, or supporting components.
  • Experience developingREST APIs, microservices, and maintainable applications in distributed environments.
  • Strong SQL skills and experience designing efficient data models in PostgreSQL or comparable relational databases.
  • Experience developing, deploying, or supporting cloud-based and containerized applications.
  • Excellent communication skills, including the ability to produce clear technical documentation and participate in client‑facing workshops.
  • Knowledge of OAuth2, OpenID Connect, JWT, and secure API design.
  • Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or comparable messaging and event-streaming technologies.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud platforms, observability tooling, and secure software delivery practices.
Nice to have
  • Experience with Workforce Management (WFM), Customer Experience (CX), contact center, or customer service solutions.
  • Experience with AWS, Amazon Connect, FreeSWITCH, Kamailio, Twilio, or similar communication technologies.
  • Knowledge of workforce optimization and contact center operations, including forecasting, scheduling, routing, and adherence.
  • Experience integrating enterprise applications with CRM, HR, identity, payroll, and analytics platforms.
  • Familiarity with AI‑assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or Claude.
Additional Information

We offer:

  • Culture of relentless performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year‑over‑year revenue growth.
  • Competitive pay and benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, language courses, and a relocation program.

  • Welcoming multicultural environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team‑building company social events.
  • Social sustainability values: join oursustainable business practicesfocused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

Imagine your work helps millions of children to unlock their learning potential?

At HMH, we take direct actions to attract, hire, and retain more diverse talent, nurture an inclusive workplace, and create opportunities for meaningful conversations about what it means to be antiracist. Our technical infrastructure

More about your role

This is a role withreal impact.


You’ll be constantly asking: what are the most important infrastructure problems we need to solve for today, that will increase the reliability and performance of our applications and infrastructure.

title: Senior Specialist, MSAT Investigations
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.




Position summary

The MSAT (Manufacturing Sciences and Technology) team is responsible for overseeing and supporting the management of deviation records through the electronic quality record management system at the Juno Manufacturing Plant (JuMP) located in Bothell, WA. The Deviation Investigator on the MSAT team is an individual contributor role responsible for investigating Notice of Event, Minor, Major, and Critical deviations to determine root cause, corrective actions, ensuring the written report contains the technical merit and completeness according to regulatory expectations. This position will be responsible for operating cross-functionally, collecting necessary data and information associated with the manufacturing and laboratory investigations and determine the associated corrective action to prevent the deviation from reoccurring.


This person will be a key player in the JuMP MSAT team and a champion for quality priority principles and compliance within the JuMP organization.


Duties/Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities


· Actively manages deviations to achieve RFT (right first time) and on-time phase completion, including deviation closure by the original due date

· Immediately upon assignment of an investigation, partners with their investigation team (QA Reviewer/ Approver, SMEs [subject matter experts], and necessary stakeholders) on definition and alignment of the investigation plan, required data, and timing for completion. Continues to partner with investigation team throughout the investigation process to ensure agreement / alignment on root cause and CAPA

· When CAPA are needed, facilitates the investigation / CAPA team to define objectives, deliverables, ownership, due dates, and effectiveness requirements

· Ensures smooth transition of the defined CAPA to the owning department SME and ensures the CAPA progresses to implementation timely to ensure on-time deviation closure

· Owns and investigates department-specific trend deviations. Leads investigation team to perform deep-dive analysis of department-specific trends, including to:

· Assess trend details to ensure accuracy and alignment across the team

· Facilitate in-depth root cause analysis to determine additional process and system failure modes

· Evaluate previous root causes and CAPA (in-progress or implemented) identified to lessen the trend

· Determine if previous identified CAPA are sufficient to reduce the trend by defined targets

· Leads GEMBAs and interviews the people closest to the work to identify failure modes and seek further understanding of the deviations

· Applies HOP (Human and Organizational Performance) principles to investigations

· Uses both soft-skills and technical skills to drive the deviation and CAPA processes:

· Demonstrates good teamwork, collaboration, and communication skills with all internal and external customers

· Seeks to understand, demonstrates humility, and shows curiosity for learning

· Completes deviations that are thorough, accurate, and complete

· Understands the overall deviation and CAPA processes including all phases of the records and proper content for each phase

· Understands appropriate assignment of classifications and requirements for each

· Understands the importance and impact of lot association within deviations and the relation to product disposition

· Captures the necessary data to support containment activities and impact assessment

· Attaches all necessary supporting evidence to the electronic deviation and ensures all attachments have been referenced in the record

· Performs investigations and root cause analyses that are commensurate to the event being investigated

· Understands multiple RCA tools and when, where, and how to apply them

· Utilizes good technical writing skills

· Contacts vendor as needed to complete investigations in a timely manner


Qualifications

Education:

· Minimum of Bachelor’s degree in relevant Science or Engineering discipline and/or equivalent combination of work experience is required.


Experience

· 5+ years of relevant cGMP experience. Experience in FDA/EMA regulation in the biotechnology and/or cellular therapy field is preferred.

· Minimum of 2 years working within quality systems managing deviation and CAPA records is preferred.

· Demonstrated proficiency in selection of team and effectively managing personnel issues is highly desired. Proven ability to demonstrate attention to detail, personal and team accountability where it is critical to success.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

· Expertise in GMP compliance and FDA/EMA regulations.

· Demonstrate excellence in written and verbal communication.

· Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally and to develop and maintain strong business partner relationships.

· Ability to Anticipate and mitigate challenges

· Innovative, proactive, and resourceful; committed to quality and continuous improvement.


We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.

ABOUT STORD


Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.


By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.


With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.


Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like True Classic, Native, Seed Health, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

About The Role
The Customer Experience Associate (CEA I) is responsible for delivering timely, accurate, and professional support to clients across multiple communication channels. This is a foundational role focused on executing established processes, managing standard client inquiries, and building core skills in case management and problem-solving.

CEA's are expected to operate with a strong sense of accountability, consistently meet performance expectations, and develop the skills required to handle more complex scenarios over time.

This position will sit onsite Monday through Friday 8:30am - 5:30pm.

What You'll Do:

Client Support & Responsiveness

  • Respond to client inquiries across multiple channels (Salesforce, email, Slack, etc.) within established SLAs
  • Acknowledge and triage incoming requests quickly to ensure timely engagement
  • Communicate clearly and professionally in all client interactions
  • Provide consistent updates to clients through resolution

Case Management & Execution

  • Manage assigned cases from intake through resolution using established processes
  • Accurately document, categorize, and update cases in Salesforce
  • Follow SOPs to resolve standard and well-defined client issues
  • Escalate more complex or unclear issues to senior team members when needed

Process Adherence & Quality

  • Follow established workflows, SOPs, and guidelines consistently
  • Maintain accurate and complete case documentation
  • Ensure attention to detail in all client communications and system updates
  • Identify when processes are unclear or missing and flag to leadership

Collaboration & Team Support

  • Partner with internal teams as needed to support case resolution
  • Ask questions and seek guidance when navigating unfamiliar scenarios
  • Contribute to a positive, professional, and accountable team environment

Learning & Development

  • Build foundational knowledge of systems, workflows, and client needs
  • Actively incorporate feedback to improve performance
  • Develop problem-solving skills and confidence in handling cases independently
  • Progress toward managing more complex cases with less oversight

What You'll Need:

Experience

title: Reservations Agent
description:
Shape the Next Generation of Vacations!
Welcome to Evermore Orlando Resort—the resort that’s redefining the Orlando vacation experience. Just steps away from Walt Disney World®, Evermore stretches across 1,100 acres and offers a one-of-a-kind blend of spacious, upscale vacation homes, flats, and villas alongside the luxurious Conrad hotel. Our Team Members are true trailblazers, reimagining the vacation experience for each guest. Here, guests create their own adventure, enjoying the best of both worlds: the space and comforts of vacation home rentals combined with the amenities and services of a world-class resort.

Evermore is Orlando’s ultimate game changer. In a city known for its theme parks and endless lines, Evermore is the paradise guests crave on their days between park visits. Imagine endless relaxation around Orlando’s first and only beach paradise, Evermore Bay. Our stunning 8-acre crystal-clear lagoon is framed by zero-entry swim zones, beach bars, private cabanas, cozy firepits, and 20-acres of white sand. From beachside bars to a vibrant food hall and rooftop dining with views of the fireworks, we’ve crafted unforgettable experiences. Guests can challenge themselves on 2 Jack Nicklaus championship golf courses, enjoy water sports including kayaks and paddleboards, a family water slide, rope swing, and activities that fill their days including pickleball, bocce ball, and volleyball.

If you’re excited to help guests reimagine the Orlando vacation, join us! Become part of an energetic team bringing Evermore Orlando Resort to life!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer incoming calls promptly and provide callers with resort information and accommodations
  • Gather detailed caller information and create leads for follow-up as part of outbound calling program
  • Meet goals set for outbound call production
  • Convert telephone inquiries into reservations, maintaining acceptable performance statistics
  • Book reservations accurately and efficiently utilizing telephone, internet, group booking fax, room lists and the other forms of reporting
  • Have detailed knowledge of our amenities, including all rates and packages for current and future season, available discounts, special package offerings
  • Familiarize the Manager on Duty and/or the appropriate Salesperson of any arriving VIPs
  • Attend all department meetings including required safety meetings when requested
  • Assist with entering of individual and group reservations in the system, specifying billing instruction and securing all payments as outlined in the group contract
  • Load group rooming lists, assigning rooms, specifying billing instructions and securing final payments in full prior to group arrival
  • Process advance deposits through credit card or other acceptable payments
  • Work with minimal supervision and have excellent customer service skills
  • Up-sell unit reservations and have excellent knowledge of all the recreational activities Evermore offers
  • Perform all other duties as assigned by the Manager

Education, Skills, and Experience:

  • Good computer skills in PMS, email, web browsing and scheduling software
  • Good typing skills (45 wpm or better)
  • Ability to speak, read, write, and comprehend the English language at a level sufficient to communicate effectively with clients, members, guests, and co-workers
  • Ability to speak or read in Portuguese or Spanish is highly desirable
  • Answer calls in a warm and professional tone utilizing the provided scripting as a guide
  • Able to handle guest requests in a detailed manner
  • Adhere to property and company policies and procedures
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; ability to interact with a wide range of people
  • Outstanding organizational, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to multi-task in a fast-paced environment, an ever-changing environment and prioritize job duties
  • Capable of working scheduled hours, including weekdays, weekends, nights, and holidays

Physical Requirements:

  • Able to safely lift, pull and push up to 25 pounds
  • Able to stand, walk, stoop, kneel, bend, and reach periodically
  • Visually look at a computer for extended periods
  • Able to sit and use the computer for hours at a time
  • Subject to environmental conditions, work activities can occur inside and outside
  • Visually look at a computer for extended periods
  • Repetitive hand motions, such as typing

Evermore Culture

At Evermore, our purpose is Togetherness, and our vision is to make a more together world possible.

Through relational wellness, we cultivate an inclusive, people-first culture where collaboration, trust, and respect empower every Team Member to thrive. Our Values guide how we think, make decisions, and show up for our guests, one another, and the moments that matter most. We are committed to acting with integrity, striving for the extraordinary, and recognizing that our greatest success comes when we succeed together.

We offer our Team Members competitive pay, along with a range of benefits including FREE Life Insurance, FREE Short-Term Disability, FREE Long-Term Disability. Additionally, we provide affordable health benefits, including Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for your dependents. Furthermore, we offer a 401K with employer match, a robust paid time off policy, parental and grandparent leave, as well as family and pet bereavement leave. We also have unique policies in support of our team and significant relationships in their lives.
